title: Program Coordinator / Educator
description:
FLIPANY is disrupting the way health and wellness support is offered to communities that have been historically ignored. We serve nutritious food, encourage healthy eating and get people to move. Whether we are working with partners to connect families to food, teaching kids to dice veggies or kick a ball, or designing customized health and wellness programs, FLIPANY takes an active, “hands-on” approach. We incorporate life skills into all of our programs to increase the emotional wellbeing and resilience of the kids and families we serve. We push beyond boundaries and explore every opportunity to offer creative health and wellness initiatives that will inspire people to transform their lives forever.


Position Overview:

We are looking for someone who wants to be part of making their community healthier, connected and genuinely invested in the lives of the youth they serve.

FLIPANY serves youth, adults, and seniors across South Florida through four core areas of work: out-of-school meal programs (Afterschool Meal Program and Summer BreakSpot), senior meal programs, food pantries, and hands-on wellness and nutrition education delivered directly in the community. These include nutrition education and interactive, hands-on food and wellness activities. This position works directly with our community partners throughout Palm Beach County, including schools, after-school centers, community centers, and city-run sites.

This role begins in the classroom with youth. This role is ideal for a passionate individual prepared to mentor and guide youth through social-emotional learning activities and wellness experiences that promote healthy lifestyle habits. This is a part-time role at 16 hours per week. Instructors must be available Monday through Friday between 1:30 and 6:00 p.m. Shifts are assigned on a biweekly basis as classes are scheduled.

For those who thrive in this role, FLIPANY offers opportunities to deepen their work in the community through expanded responsibilities across our programs, including our Healthy Meals Out of School department.


Schedule and Hours:

This is a part-time role at 16 hours per week. We are looking for instructors who are available Monday through Friday between 1:30 and 6:00 p.m. We also have Per Diem Instructor positions available for those who are only available 2 or 3 time a week.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of experience working with groups of children, with a genuine passion for youth development.
  • Background in Child Development/Behavior, Psychology, or other Social Sciences through education or hands-on experience.
  • Valid Florida Driver’s License and access to a reliable vehicle for travel to program sites.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • A personal commitment to health and wellness, and the ability to model and communicate its value to youth and families in an authentic way
  • A personal commitment to health and wellness, and the ability to model and communicate its value to youth and families in an authentic way
  • Personally committed to health and wellness, with the ability to model and communicate its value to youth and families in an authentic way
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong administrative and time management skills
  • A natural relationship builder who collaborates effectively with youth, site staff, and partner agencies with a people-first approach
  • Calm and adaptable under pressure, maintaining professionalism when unexpected situations arise
  • Comfortable with technology (iPad, mifi), completing real-time tasks including documentation, surveys, and photo uploads efficiently in a field setting
  • Accountable and reliable, managing multiple responsibilities and consistently meeting deadlines
  • Available for occasional evenings and weekends for community outreach or fundraising events

Key Responsibilities:

  • Arrive prepared to each class with all materials, supplies, and equipment packed and ready, handling setup and cleanup at the site for each session
  • Deliver in-person wellness and nutrition education classes to groups of 15–20 youth, following FLIPANY's program guidelines and curriculum
  • Guide youth through hands-on activities including healthy cooking using tools such as blenders and skillets, gardening, nutrition education.
  • Maintain a positive and structured learning environment throughout each session, addressing behavioral challenges as they arise
  • Plan ahead for each class by reviewing curriculum, ordering supplies, and confirming site details and scheduling in advance
  • Complete real-time class documentation including attendance, surveys, and photo uploads using a FLIPANY-issued tablet
  • Maintain accurate mileage reports for all program-related travel
  • Communicate proactively with site staff to ensure sessions run smoothly, build strong relationships with partner organizations, and ensure sites uphold program agreements
  • Report back to the FLIPANY team on class progress, site issues, and cohort updates in a timely manner
  • Maintain knowledge of FLIPANY's programs and services in order to connect youth, families, and site staff to additional resources and opportunities
  • Support and supervise volunteers, interns, or AmeriCorps members assigned to assist in class delivery
  • Participate in required training, curriculum review, and ongoing professional development as directed
  • Monitor programs, conduct site visits, and ensure compliance with Federal Food program regulations.


Physical Requirements

Work is performed both indoors and outdoors. Exposure to extreme temperatures, extreme sunlight, noise, heights, dirt, dust and potentially hazardous chemicals is common. Work may be performed on uneven surfaces.

While performing the essential functions of this position, the employee must be able to lift, carry and/or push articles weighing up to 50 lbs.

The employee is frequently required to stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, stand, walk, sit and reach with hands and arms. Must have use of hands to finger, handle or feel and/or operate objects, tools or controls.

Must have the use of sensory skills in order to effectively communicate and interact with other employees and the public through the use of telephone and personal contact. Must be able to read, write and communicate in English. Must have the ability to see, read, talk and hear.

Physical capability to effectively use and operate various items of equipment; such as but not limited to a personal computer, calculator, copy machine and fax machine.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

FLIPANY is a Drug Free Workplace and Equal Opportunity Employer

This job opportunity requires a Level 2 background screening through the Florida Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse.

title: Extreme Light, Matter, and Fusion Undergraduate Intern - Summer 2027
description:
The Extreme Light, Matter, and Fusion Directorate (formerly NIF&PS) has multiple openings for continuing undergraduate students to engage in practical research experiences to further their educational goals. You will have opportunities to work in a wide array of fields, such as lasers, laser-plasma physics, electro-optics, software development, and optical, x-ray, and nuclear instrument development and testing. For more information, please visit: . References may be required.

Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

You will

  • Work alongside scientists conducting research at onsite laser and nuclear facilities in the areas of advanced laser development, fusion energy technologies, laser plasma interactions, hydrodynamics, materials science, radiation physics and various advanced diagnostic systems.
  • Conduct research (experimental, theoretical, or modeling) in assigned areas, under close supervision.
  • Gather and analyze data or information in support of scientific research.
  • Communicate research results: document work, present and discuss findings.
  • Attend relevant seminars and prepare a poster for the Student Intern Poster Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). See Additional Information section below for details.
  • Must be a college or university student in good academic standing, enrolled in an accredited institution, and pursuing an associate’s or bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated exposure through coursework or relevant experience with tools related to your field of study. For experimental work this can include data reduction and manipulation, image processing, computer-aided drafting, or similar; for theoretical/computational work this includes numerical methods and scientific programming languages (Python, MATLAB, etc.).
  • A sustained record of outstanding academic performance.
  • Ability to work full time for ten to twelve weeks during the summer months.
  • Ability to apply basic engineering or scientific principles to solve technical problems.
  • Ability to present and communicate concepts and ideas.
  • Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to work in a team environment.
  • Experience working with personal computers and familiarity with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Prior experience in physics or engineering laboratory settings for experimental assignments, and in cluster/high-performance computing or plasma physics codes for computational assignments.
  • GPA of 3.0 or above.

Pay Range

$23.26 - $31.62

This position is under a step structure. Please note that the step placement is determined by your most recent completed academic year.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

  • Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
  • Holiday Pay
  • Sick leave accrual
  • Individual 401(k) contributions
  • Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

None required. However, if your assignment is longer than 179 days cumulatively within a calendar year, you must go through the Personal Identity Verification process. This process includes completing an online background investigation form and receiving approval of the background check.

National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)

The 2025 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), Section 3112, generally prohibits citizens of China, Russia, Iran and North Korea without dual US citizenship or legal permanent residence from accessing specific non-public areas of national security or nuclear weapons facilities. The restrictions of NDAA Section 3112 apply to this position. To be qualified for this position, Candidates must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How to identify fake job advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams:

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Job Description

About Strathclyde Partnership for Transport


Strathclyde Partnership for Transport (SPT) is the largest of Scotland’s seven Regional Transport Partnerships, serving a population of more than 2.2 million people across 12 local authority areas in the West of Scotland.


SPT’s role is to bring together local authorities and key regional and national partners to plan and deliver an integrated, sustainable transport system that supports inclusive economic growth, tackles inequality, and improves quality of life. At the heart of this is a clear ambition: to deliver a world-class, low-carbon transport system that meets the needs of people and communities now and in the future.


SPT sits at the centre of regional transport planning, combining strategic insight, robust analysis, and practical delivery. The organisation plans and supports transport across all modes, working closely with councils, Transport Scotland, the Scottish Government, operators, and communities to shape how transport services evolve over time.


Alongside its strategic planning role, SPT delivers and supports a wide range of transport activity across the region. This includes investment in bus services, infrastructure and subway, management of major transport programmes, and the delivery of passenger-focused improvements that help keep communities connected.


SPT is now entering a period of significant transformation. Completion of the Subway Modernisation project, major programmes such as Bus Reform and Clyde Metro represent some of the most ambitious transport initiatives ever undertaken in the West of Scotland.


Together, they will reshape how public transport is planned, governed, and delivered, placing passengers, communities and long-term sustainability at the heart of decision-making.


This is an organisation with a strong public service ethos, a collaborative culture and a growing national profile. For professionals who want to work at scale, influence long-term outcomes and help deliver meaningful change, SPT offers a uniquely compelling environment.


You can read more at our SPT website by clicking the Apply button now.


About this role:


We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our Business Intelligence team and play a key role in transforming how data is managed, modelled and used across SPT. As we deliver our Data Strategy and establish a modern cloud-based data platform, you will help build trusted, scalable data products that support decision-making across the organisation.


Working closely with business stakeholders, analysts and technical teams, you will develop and maintain data pipelines, data models and semantic layers that turn complex data into reliable, accessible information. You will help establish modern engineering practices, improve data quality and governance, and support the delivery of strategic initiatives that will shape the future of transport across the west of Scotland.


About You


You will have experience working with modern data platforms and a strong understanding of data modelling, transformation and integration principles. You’ll be comfortable developing data pipelines and analytical solutions using tools such as SQL and cloud-based technologies, with an appreciation of data governance, quality and security requirements.


We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with a collaborative approach. You will be able to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating business requirements into robust data solutions.


Most importantly, you’ll be motivated by the opportunity to help establish a data-driven culture and contribute to some of Scotland’s most significant and transformative public transport programmes.


Full time hours will be 35 hours per week Monday to Friday. However, you may be required to undertake work outwith this norm to meet the responsibilities of the post.


Whilst you will be based at 131 St Vincent Street, Glasgow, SPT operate a hybrid working pattern which allows 40% home working (i.e. 2 days per week Monday to Friday).


Please note, this position falls into the low-risk category under the Alcohol and Drugs policy and therefore is subject to for-cause testing procedures.


Further details of the role and key responsibilities are set out in the job description.


What we can offer……


Working at SPT comes with many benefits you can look forward to:


  • 33 Days Annual and Public Holiday Entitlement then 41 days after 5 years’ service (pro rata to shift pattern)
  • Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme - SPT contribute a percentage of your annualised pay in line with the requirements of the Strathclyde Pension Fund
  • Group Life Assurance Cover
  • SPT actively encourages learning and development and are committed to ongoing learning and development to support career progression
  • Employee Travel Pass Scheme - a Subway Smartcard to travel on the Glasgow Subway for free plus an additional card for a member of your household
  • Salary Sacrifice Bus or Rail Season Ticket Scheme - subsidised at a maximum of £667 towards the cost
  • Cycle to Work Scheme, Childcare Vouchers, Employee Assistance Programme, Long Service Awards, Credit Union


How to Apply?


To apply, please select the ‘apply now’ button to complete an online application form. Closing date for applications will be Wednesday 7th October 11.59pm .


SPT is an Equal Opportunities company welcoming applications from a diverse background. If you’ve got the right skills for the job, we want to hear from you. SPT encourage applications from the right candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, belief or race.


SPT operates blind recruitment, which is the process of removing any and all identification details from candidate application forms. This includes identifiable personal details such a candidate’s name, gender, ethnicity and age. This information is not visible to our Hiring Managers. This practice is used to ensure fairness, attract diverse candidates and to remove unconscious bias from our recruitment process. By implementing this approach, SPT aims to create a level playing field to assess applicants solely based on their skills, qualifications and experience.


For applicants with special requirements, or if you have any questions, please email quoting the above reference.

title: AI Technical Scrum Master with Python Development
location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States
description:
Job Level: AI Technical Scrum Master with Python Development

Type: Contract - Remote (US)

Duration: 12+ months

Clearance Required: Ability to Obtain Public Trust

We are seeking an AI Technical Scrum Master with Python Development to lead Agile delivery for mission-focused, AI-enabled software products in a SAFe Agile environment while providing targeted, part-time Python development support.

This is an intentionally hybrid position, not two full-time roles combined into one. The primary responsibility is serving as the Scrum Master and Agile delivery lead for a cross-functional team. The secondary responsibility is contributing hands-on Python development for automation, APIs, integrations, data-processing utilities, testing, and selected technical backlog items based on sprint priorities and available capacity.

The successful candidate will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove delivery impediments, strengthen team execution, coordinate dependencies, and foster continuous improvement across teams building trusted, secure, and scalable AI-enabled information systems. The candidate will also apply practical Python development skills to support delivery when additional technical capacity is needed, without compromising Scrum Master responsibilities, team coaching, or Agile leadership.

You will work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Release Train Engineers, architects, software engineers, data scientists, testers, security teams, and operations teams to plan, coordinate, and deliver AI solutions that improve operational workflows, decision-making, and mission outcomes. The role requires strong Scrum Master leadership, experience with SAFe Agile delivery, an understanding of modern software engineering practices, and the ability to contribute maintainable Python code within an enterprise delivery environment.

This position is ideal for a technically capable servant leader who can enable a high-performing Agile team, communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and provide focused Python development support for well-defined backlog items.

Role Responsibility Model

Primary Role: Technical Scrum Master and Agile Delivery Lead

The primary focus of the position is Scrum Master leadership and Agile delivery. The individual is accountable for team facilitation, coaching, delivery coordination, impediment removal, continuous improvement, and support for successful sprint and Program Increment execution.

Secondary Role: Part-Time Python Developer

The secondary focus is hands-on Python development performed according to sprint priorities, team capacity, and technical need. Development assignments may include automation, APIs, integrations, data-processing utilities, testing tools, prototypes, and other clearly defined technical backlog items. The individual is not expected to perform the workload of a full-time Python developer in addition to full-time Scrum Master responsibilities.

What you will do

  • Serve as the Technical Scrum Master and Agile Delivery Lead
  • Serve as the Scrum Master for an Agile team delivering AI-enabled information systems in a SAFe Agile environment.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other team synchronization activities.
  • Support Program Increment Planning, iteration execution, dependency coordination, risk management, and alignment with broader program objectives.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Release Train Engineers, technical leads, and stakeholders to promote transparency, delivery discipline, and predictable outcomes.
  • Help maintain a healthy, prioritized, and sprint-ready backlog by facilitating effective collaboration among product, business, and technical stakeholders.
  • Ensure Agile practices are applied consistently and pragmatically in alignment with SAFe principles and organizational delivery standards.
  • Protect sufficient capacity for Scrum Master responsibilities while transparently planning any part-time Python development commitments.
  • Enable Delivery of AI-Enabled Information Systems
  • Support teams delivering AI-enabled capabilities such as document understanding, semantic search, summarization, recommendations, intelligent automation, conversational experiences, predictive analytics, and decision-support tools.
  • Help the team manage AI-specific delivery considerations, including experimentation, iterative model improvement, data dependencies, integration readiness, model and prompt evaluation, and validation of AI-generated outputs.
  • Coordinate across product, engineering, data science, testing, security, governance, and operations teams to help ensure AI capabilities are practical, usable, secure, supportable, and ready for release.
  • Promote iterative delivery approaches that balance delivery speed, technical feasibility, quality, trust, governance, security, and mission value.
  • Help translate complex technical work into clear plans, risks, dependencies, outcomes, and decisions for business and program stakeholders.
  • Remove Impediments and Improve Team Performance
  • Proactively identify, track, escalate, and help resolve impediments affecting delivery, quality, velocity, or team effectiveness.
  • Coach team members on Agile practices, collaboration, self-organization, estimation, work management, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Foster an environment of focus, transparency, inclusion, ownership, and continuous learning.
  • Use Agile metrics and team insights to identify improvement opportunities and support more effective sprint and Program Increment execution.
  • Help the team improve delivery flow, reduce bottlenecks, manage technical and delivery risks, and strengthen cross-functional coordination.
  • Facilitate retrospectives that produce specific, achievable, and measurable improvement actions.
  • Drive Cross-Team Coordination and Program Execution
  • Coordinate dependencies, risks, constraints, decisions, and integration points across teams and stakeholders.
  • Work with Product Owners and technical leads to clarify priorities, maintain sprint readiness, and establish achievable delivery commitments.
  • Facilitate communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders to maintain alignment on scope, progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Maintain visibility into team progress, delivery health, impediments, technical challenges, and upcoming milestones.
  • Contribute to release readiness and support the smooth transition of completed capabilities into testing, deployment, operations, and sustainment.
  • Contribute Part-Time Python Development
  • Contribute hands-on Python development for clearly defined technical backlog items after Scrum Master and Agile delivery responsibilities are appropriately planned and protected.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based automation scripts, REST APIs, system integrations, data-processing utilities, testing tools, prototypes, and internal delivery utilities.

  • Coordinate with the Product Owner and technical lead when Scrum Master duties or unplanned impediments affect development capacity or commitments.
  • Support Quality, Governance, and Responsible Delivery
  • Encourage Agile delivery practices that support quality, traceability, security, compliance, and operational readiness.
  • Help incorporate architecture, governance, cybersecurity, testing, documentation, and release requirements into backlog planning and execution.
  • Support delivery practices appropriate for systems processing PII, PHI, CUI, or other sensitive information.

  • Champion Agile Maturity and Continuous Improvement
  • Coach team members and stakeholders on SAFe Agile values, Scrum practices, and effective delivery behaviors.
  • Help strengthen Agile maturity by sharing good practices, delivery insights, technical understanding, and lessons learned.
  • Encourage collaboration, trust, adaptability, and evidence-based decision-making in response to evolving mission and business needs.
  • Identify opportunities to use automation and responsible AI-assisted tools to reduce administrative effort and improve delivery visibility without replacing human judgment or accountability.

What you will need

  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Data Science, or a related field, OR an additional FOUR (4) years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum THREE (3) years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting enterprise software delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a Scrum Master in a SAFe Agile environment, including sprint execution, Program Increment Planning, dependency coordination, risk and issue management, and cross-team collaboration.

  • Experience supporting cross-functional teams that include Product Owners, engineers, architects, data scientists, testers, security personnel, and operations staff.
  • Strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, including planning, design, development, testing, security, release, deployment, and operational readiness.
  • Experience supporting delivery in enterprise environments with governance, compliance, security, quality, and documentation requirements.
  • Experience supporting AI-enabled information systems, advanced analytics platforms, machine learning solutions, intelligent automation, or other data-driven applications.
  • Minimum TWO (2) years of hands-on Python software development experience supporting production applications, enterprise solutions, automation, data engineering, or system integration use cases.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Python fundamentals, including object-oriented programming, data structures, modules, exception handling, logging, package management, and development of maintainable and reusable code.
  • Experience developing or integrating REST APIs, backend services, automation scripts, system integrations, or data-processing workflows using Python.
  • Experience with Python testing and quality practices, including unit testing, debugging, code reviews, static analysis, dependency management, and secure coding standards.
  • Experience using Git-based source control, branches, pull requests, peer reviews, and modern CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to translate technical backlog items into appropriately sized development tasks and communicate implementation risks, assumptions, dependencies, and tradeoffs.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance primary Scrum Master responsibilities with part-time Python development based on sprint priorities, available capacity, and team needs.
  • Ability to recognize and clearly communicate when Agile leadership obligations require reprioritization, reassignment, or adjustment of development commitments.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, organization, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.

What would be nice to have

  • SAFe Scrum Master, Certified ScrumMaster, PMI Agile Certified Practitioner, or a similar Agile certification.
  • Experience with Python frameworks and libraries such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, Pandas, NumPy, Pydantic, PyTest, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience creating API specifications, data-validation models, automated tests, and reusable Python packages.
  • Experience developing Python solutions that integrate with AWS services such as AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, Amazon S3, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, AWS Glue, Amazon DynamoDB, or related cloud services.
  • Familiarity with containerized Python applications, Docker, infrastructure automation, application monitoring, logging, and observability practices.
  • Experience supporting Generative AI, large language model, or AI-assisted software products involving summarization, intelligent search, document understanding, conversational experiences, retrieval-augmented generation, or decision support.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML delivery concepts such as model evaluation, prompt iteration, human-in-the-loop workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, confidence scoring, output validation, and governance controls.
  • Experience working with regulated or sensitive data, including PII, PHI, CUI, retention requirements, auditability, and security controls.

  • Experience in government, healthcare, human services, case management, grants management, or other mission-oriented operational environments.
  • Experience partnering with Product Owners, Release Train Engineers, architects, technical leads, and leadership teams to improve Agile maturity, engineering discipline, and release outcomes.
  • Experience using Generative AI-assisted tools to improve meeting preparation, sprint reporting, action tracking, risk identification, backlog refinement, software development, testing, and documentation while maintaining security, governance, and human oversight.

Success in this role

Success will be measured primarily by the effectiveness of Agile delivery leadership, including team health, impediment resolution, delivery transparency, predictable execution, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement. Python development contributions will be evaluated as a secondary responsibility based on the quality, maintainability, security, testing, and timely completion of appropriately scoped technical backlog items.

The successful candidate will demonstrate sound judgment in balancing the two responsibilities. When priorities conflict, the individual will protect essential Scrum Master and Agile delivery obligations, communicate capacity impacts early, and work with the Product Owner and technical lead to adjust or reassign Python development commitments as needed.

title: Senior GNC Engineer
description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

The GNC Engineer owns terminal guidance and the associated control path across Neros unmanned aircraft, covering the guidance law, aimpoint command, achievable-acceleration management, and the interface to flight control. This role is accountable for engagement accuracy against maneuvering targets under realistic conditions, including imperfect target state estimates, degraded or lost sensor track, and limited control authority late in the engagement.

You should have the following

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing guidance, navigation, and control software for missiles, interceptors, guided munitions, unmanned aircraft, or comparable autonomous vehicles, with demonstrated ownership of a guidance or control function through flight
  • Expert-level knowledge of terminal homing guidance, including proportional and augmented proportional navigation, zero-effort-miss formulations, time-to-go estimation, lead-pursuit geometry, and miss-distance analysis against maneuvering targets
  • Demonstrated delivery of guidance or control software onto a physical air vehicle that has flown, not just in simulation
  • Production proficiency in C++ and Python, including embedded or real-time development under deterministic execution and latency constraints on resource-limited flight computers
  • Working depth in state estimation and sensor fusion, including Kalman and extended Kalman filtering, target motion models, covariance propagation, and observability analysis
  • Experience with flight dynamics and control, including autopilot and inner-loop interfaces. Including control authority and actuator saturation limits, achievable-acceleration envelopes, and position or velocity hold control
  • Demonstrated use of flight or field test data for closed-loop analysis, including log-based replay, reconstruction of onboard decisions, and root-cause investigation of anomalous engagements
  • Fluency with coordinate frame conventions, time synchronization, sensor latency accounting, and uncertainty representation across software interfaces
  • Experience participating directly in flight or field test operations, including test planning, instrumentation requirements, range operations, and post-test data review

Nice to have

  • Experience with terminal guidance against surface or ground targets, including aimpoint selection on an extended target, impact-angle or impact-point shaping, and engagement geometry planning
  • Experience developing safety-critical or high-consequence decision logic, such as engagement authorization, abort criteria, or failsafe behavior, together with the supporting test evidence and written rationale
  • Experience with deterministic, reproducible software design for flight-critical components, including bit-exact replay from logged data.
  • Background in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or another domain with mature closed-loop evaluation practice, including regression suites, scenario libraries, and release gating on measured performance

US Salary Range

$163,500 – $228,500 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Neros' total compensation package.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Member Service Specialist
description:
ABOUT THRIVE MARKET

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come.

The Role

We are looking for Member Services Specialists to help our members lead healthier lives by addressing their questions, needs, and concerns. This includes assisting with order questions and issues, troubleshooting technical problems, making retention offers, processing membership cancellation requests, assisting with website navigation, recommending products for specific diets, and more. To excel in this role, you'll need a strong passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and helping members get the most out of their Thrive Market membership. If you believe in our mission and thrive in a fast-paced, creative environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Compensation starts at $18 per hour. We are hiring remote team members for full-time positions. The shift is Tuesday to Saturday, with start times ranging every 30 minutes from 6:00 AM to 8:30 AM PST. Your specific start time will be discussed during the interview process. Once your start time is assigned, you can expect to work that schedule for 8 months to 1 year before any potential changes. Onboarding for this role will take 3 weeks, is conducted remotely, and may be scheduled Monday to Friday.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide excellent customer support via chat, phone, text, and email channels.
  • Address member questions and concerns, including shipping inquiries, damaged orders, website/app troubleshooting, account updates, cancellation requests, and more.
  • Educate shoppers on the benefits of Thrive Market membership, highlighting features, perks, and benefits that align with their needs to encourage membership retention.
  • Become a subject matter expert on our growing catalog of products and supported dietary values to identify cross-sell opportunities and improve average order value (AOV).
  • Collect and record customer insights through our CRM platform, providing valuable data to organizational stakeholders.
  • Stay informed about department updates by reading Slack communications and attending team meetings and training sessions.
  • Engage in 1:1 conversations with your team lead to review performance, discuss best practices, and receive guidance on handling specific situations.
  • Be comfortable working at a desk with a laptop, keyboard, mouse, monitor, and headset.
  • Adhere to your schedule by taking breaks and lunches at designated times.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • You are passionate about health and wellness and believe in Thrive Market's mission.
  • You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills and can engage effectively with members.
  • You are comfortable assisting members across all channels for an 8-hour workday.
  • You are proficient in Google Apps (Calendar, Mail, etc.) and have experience using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools.
  • Call center experience is helpful, but not required.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Great listener who can recognize customer cues and provide the appropriate solution.
  • Ability to distinguish between minor and major issues and respond accordingly.
  • Creative and analytical problem solver who thinks critically to resolve challenges.
  • Receptive to feedback and quick to implement suggestions for improvement.
  • Strong ability to self-manage productivity and self-assess performance to stay on track.
  • Demonstrates genuine care for Thrive Market members and is dedicated to ensuring a positive customer support experience.

BELONG TO A BETTER COMPANY

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, life and disability)
  • Competitive salary (DOE) + equity
  • 401k plan
  • 9 Observed Holidays
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Subsidized ClassPass Membership with access to fitness classes and wellness and beauty experiences
  • Ability to work in our beautiful office in Playa Vista
  • Free Thrive Market membership with exclusive employee discount
  • Coverage for Life Coaching & Therapy Sessions on our holistic mental health and well-being platform

We're a community of more than 1 Million + members who are united by a singular belief: It should be easy to find better products, support better brands, make better choices, and build a better world in the process.

At Thrive Market, we believe in building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic culture. If you are excited about this role along with our mission and values, we encourage you to apply.

Thrive Market is an EEO/Veterans/Disabled/LGBTQ employer

At Thrive Market, our goal is to be a diverse and inclusive workplace that is representative, at all job levels, of the members we serve and the communities we operate in. We’re proud to be an inclusive company and an Equal Opportunity Employer and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. We believe that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success as a company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. If you’re thinking about joining our team, we expect that you would agree!

Employment with Thrive Market requires that employees be based in the United States. This is a condition of employment and must be maintained throughout the duration of employment.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please email us at eeo@thrivemarket.com and we’ll be happy to assist you.

title: Lead Product Designer, Growth Platform
description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

About the role

Atlassian is looking for a Lead Product Designer to join the Growth Platform team, the organization responsible for Atlassian’s front door: {"type":"inlineCard","attrs":{"url":"https://www.atlassian.com","localId":null,"data":null}}www.atlassian.com

Millions of teams visit our website to discover Atlassian and find the products and solutions that can help them work better. We’re evolving that experience from a collection of standalone pages into cohesive, end-to-end customer journeys grounded in clear customer intent and JTBD, and shaped by AI-first experiences.

As a Lead Product Designer, you’ll play a critical role in defining that future. Partnering with another Lead Designer, Product Management, Engineering, Content, and Growth Analytics, you’ll lead both strategy and execution across some of our highest-impact growth experiences.

You’ll put design in the driver’s seat: shaping the evolution of our website and design system, establishing a high bar for visual and interaction craft, and creating experiences that improve engagement, activation, and long-term customer value.

What you’ll do

You’ll work across the Growth Platform portfolio, setting direction and leading design across several core areas:

  • Modernization & craft leadership: Elevate the overall look, feel, and narrative of our website to reflect a modern, premium, AI-first technology company. Set an exceptional bar for visual hierarchy, typography, motion, grid systems, responsive design, and interaction quality. Help evolve our website design system to create greater cohesion, quality, and scalability across the experience.

  • User engagement & activation: Design innovative landing, discovery, and onboarding experiences that communicate product value, capture customer intent, and turn interest into meaningful product engagement. Use experimentation and customer insights to improve conversion and early-lifecycle activation.

  • Journey-led architecture & JTBD: Help shift our website strategy from disconnected pages and templates toward cohesive, intent- and persona-driven journeys. Architect experiences that guide customers seamlessly from discovery and evaluation through trial, adoption, and deeper engagement with Atlassian.

  • AI-powered experiences & ways of working: Explore how AI can reshape both how customers discover Atlassian and how we design and build for them. Design for emerging AI-powered discovery and answer-engine experiences, ensuring Atlassian’s products and content are structured and experienced effectively across generative search surfaces. Partner closely with Engineering to prototype new AI-first experiences and evolve the tools and workflows we use to rapidly design, test, and publish experiences on the site.

  • Cross-functional influence & mentorship: Partner with leaders across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Content, and Analytics to shape strategy and champion a design-led approach to growth. Mentor other designers, elevate the quality of critique and decision-making, and help raise the craft bar across the broader Growth organization.

Candidate Profile

What You Bring

You have 10+ years of product design experience, with a track record of leading complex, high-visibility web or digital product initiatives from strategy through execution.

  • Exceptional visual & interaction craft: You bring an exceptional craft bar and a strong point of view on contemporary digital experiences. You’re highly skilled in visual design, typography, spatial layout, motion and micro-interactions, responsive design, and design systems, and you know how to turn those elements into experiences that feel cohesive, distinctive, and polished.

  • AI-first prototyping & tooling: You’re comfortable using AI as part of how you think, design, and make. You have experience prototyping in code and using AI-powered tools to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. You are familiar with generative UI, AI-assisted workflows, personalization, and designing AI-native experiences.

  • Journey-driven systems thinking: You think beyond individual pages and features, designing interconnected experiences and scalable frameworks grounded in customer intent, personas, journeys, information architecture, and Jobs to Be Done.

  • Strategic vision & comfort with ambiguity: You can take complex business goals and ambiguous problem spaces and turn them into compelling future-state visions. You use storytelling and prototyping to make ideas tangible, build alignment, and translate long-term direction into actionable roadmaps and near-term opportunities.

  • Data-informed & outcome-oriented: You connect design decisions to measurable customer and business outcomes across acquisition, conversion, engagement, and activation. You partner with Analytics and Research to form and validate hypotheses, while knowing when data should inform the experience and when strong design judgment should lead.

  • Collaborative leadership & influence: You build trust across disciplines and levels, communicate a clear design point of view, and bring others along with you. You’re comfortable influencing senior and executive stakeholders and partnering deeply with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Content, Research, and Analytics.

What Would Set You Apart

  • Experience designing high-traffic marketing websites, web platforms, digital storefronts, or other large-scale customer-facing web experiences.

  • Experience working in Growth, experimentation, conversion optimization, or lifecycle activation.

  • Experience operating across organizational boundaries, where influence, alignment, and systems thinking matter as much as direct ownership.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Qualifications

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Test Engineer 1 (R&D)
description:
NOTE: This is a 40 hour/week, fully benefited, limited duration position estimated to last between 6- 12 months. There is potential to transition to standard full-time employment. Work may be performed remotely within the contiguous United States. However, individuals who reside within a 30 mile radius of our Houston, TX or Corvallis, OR office will be required to be in office at least 4 days per week.

POSITION SUMMARY: This position directly supports the Test Engineering Manager. The Test Engineer is responsible for developing and executing test programs, primarily though contracted resources, that support the design, certification, manufacture and commercial deployment of the NuScale Microreactor. Test programs conducted provide technology maturation and risk reduction, technology demonstrations, and qualification of reactor structures, systems, components and instrumentation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Plans, devlops and executes various types of test programs including proof-of-concept, component, performance, functional, compliance, reliability and environmental qualification.
  • Identity suitable metallography and materials characterization methods as part of materials development and testing
  • Participates in test planning, development and review of test specification, approval of supplier test procedures, oversight of test execution, data review and data acceptance.
  • Manage small projects and oversees test project progression through supplier evaluation, contract execution, design, implementation, testing, reporting, data acceptance, and contract close out.
  • Prepares test program budgets, schedules, resource requirements, statements-of-work, requests for quote, test specifications and test reports.
  • Leads and reviews design drawings, sketches, schematics, procedures, results, reports and documentation.
  • Leads test hardware design reviews for small projects and resolves comments stemming from these reviews.
  • Analyzes test data and validation efforts that utilize test data.
  • Organize data sets from test program
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

CORE COMPETENCIES: To perform the job successfully, the individual should demonstrate competencies in performing the essential functions of this position by performing satisfactorily in each of these competencies.

  • Problem solving: Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner, gathers and reviews information appropriately. Uses own judgment and acts independently; seeks input from other team members as appropriate for complex or sensitive situations.
  • Oral/written communication: Listens carefully and speaks clearly and professionally in all situations. Edits work for accuracy and clarity, is able to create, read and interpret complex written information. Ability to develop strong interpersonal networks within the organization.
  • Planning/organizing: Prioritizes and plans work activities, organizes personal and project timelines and deadlines, tracks project timelines and deadlines, and uses time efficiently.
  • Adaptability: Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands and is able to deal with frequent interruptions, changes, delays, or unexpected events.
  • Dependability: Consistently on time and at work, responds to management expectations and solicits feedback to improve performance.
  • Team Building: Capable of developing strong interpersonal networks and trust within the organization.
  • Safety Culture: Adheres to the NuScale Safety culture and is expected to model safe behavior and influence peers to meet high standards.
  • Quality Assurance: Commits to the understanding and implementation of quality assurance regulations, standards and guidelines of 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, 10 CFR 21, and NQA-1.

MINIMUM SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS AND ABILITIES:

  • Education: A minimum of a B.S. degree in Material Science, Mechanical, Nuclear or Chemical Engineering from a four-year accredited college or university. An advanced degree is preferred.

title: Copy of Child Psychologist - Full Time or Part Time - Gledswood Hills
description:
The honest bits first, because they're what you're actually wondering

  • Days are yours. Minimum two, up to five, and we build the week around the right person. We recruit on a rolling basis, so let's talk about what fits your life.
  • Flexibility that respects your time. Client cancels? Go home and write your notes from the couch instead of warming a chair for two hours. Where it's appropriate, part of your week can be worked from home. Face-to-face therapy is anchored in-clinic.
  • Pay with no games. A transparent provisional band of $85,000 to $95,000, with clear annual reviews and a step up when you reach general registration. Reports, longer calls and case conferences all get billed.

Supervision and your internship

  • A Board-approved principal supervisor, with supervision in paid time.
  • Support with the internship paperwork (your plan, progress reports, case reports) and time set aside to prepare for the National Psychology Exam if you haven't sat it yet.
  • Monthly group supervision plus dedicated 1-on-1, so you're getting more than the minimum hours.
  • A real path forward. Our most recent provisional psychologist reached general registration last month. From there it's general and clinical roles through to senior positions.

What the work is actually like

  • 50-minute sessions with note-taking built in, plus 90 minutes of protected admin every day. AI note-taking (clients consent at intake) so your evenings come back.
  • A dedicated, highly skilled admin team runs booking, billing and scheduling. You do psychology, not paperwork.
  • A caseload that ramps up with you. You start lighter and build as you and your supervisor agree you're ready. Interested in anxiety, school refusal, trauma or parent work? We route you that work and hold off on what doesn't fit yet.
  • A $1,000 PD allowance, up to $1,000 wellness allowance, early long-service leave (3 years, not 10), and salary packaging.

You won't be doing this on your own

When the team's capacity tightens, we take that as our signal to hire rather than a reason to squeeze another client into your week, and right now the tight spot is kids, which is why this role exists. There's also a room full of colleagues to debrief with when a session lands heavy, which in your first year happens more than anyone tells you.

Recognition so far

  • Finalist, Allied Health Team Culture Excellence, Australian Allied Health Awards 2026
  • Great Place To Work® Best Workplaces™ in Australia 2025 (Micro category)
  • Great Place To Work® Best Workplaces™ in Healthcare & Social Assistance 2024 (Micro & Small category)
  • Finalist, Outstanding Health Improvement Services, Camden Local Business Awards 2024 and 2026, and Penrith City Local Business Awards 2026

Who we're after

A psychologist with provisional registration with AHPRA, who does thoughtful clinical work and wants to do it somewhere sane. Most of your caseload will be children and their parents, with some adults alongside, so you'll need to be confident with both. Experience with children from placements or a previous role helps. Heart, judgment and genuine care for clients matter more to us than a perfect CV.

Interested? Hit Apply. Prefer to ask first? Email careers@unboundminds.com.au and a real person will answer.

Monica and Justin, founders, Unbound Minds

title: Director of Language and Literacy & MLL
description:
At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential. We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential.

Position Description
Rocketship Public Schools seeks an experienced Director of Language and Literacy & MLL to strengthen the organization’s literacy strategy, multilingual learner supports, instructional support, and program implementation across regions. This role partners closely with network and school leaders to advance high-quality literacy instruction, written and oral language development, equitable access to grade-level content, and strong outcomes for students.

The Director of Language and Literacy & MLL helps shape the planning, implementation, review, and continuous improvement of literacy-related curriculum, instruction, and multilingual learner supports. This leader works in close partnership with the Senior Director of Language and Literacy and other academic leaders to ensure literacy and multilingual learner priorities are aligned to state standards, network goals, and instructional practices that drive student achievement and instructional excellence.

The ideal candidate brings strong systems thinking, deep literacy expertise, knowledge of language development, project management, and the ability to influence across teams. This leader builds strong partnerships with school leaders, teachers, and Network Support Team colleagues to ensure schools receive excellent literacy and multilingual learner support in service of Rocketeers and families. The Director of Language and Literacy & MLL reports to the Senior Director of Language and Literacy.

The following are essential functions related to the role:

Advance Rocketship’s literacy and multilingual learner strategy by:

  • Setting the vision and direction of multilingual learning pedagogy and implementation
  • Advising academic and school leaders on effective literacy instruction, multilingual learner supports, and program implementation
  • Analyzing student achievement, language proficiency, coaching, and observation data to identify priorities and inform action plans
  • Leading professional learning to strengthen literacy instruction and support multilingual learners across regions
  • Supporting curriculum adoption and guiding rollout of literacy, language, and integrated English language development supports
  • Coordinating with network achievement team members to align instructional support and resources, including any customization to curriculum
  • Monitoring progress toward literacy and multilingual learner goals to inform network and regional support

Build capacity across teams by:

  • Recommending high-quality instructional materials and planning resources
  • Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to strengthen literacy and multilingual learner programming
  • Coaching and developing team members in content knowledge, pedagogy, and implementation toward strong instructional outcomes
  • Leading regular team meetings to align priorities and monitor progress
  • Conducting school visits to inform support, planning, and strategy
  • Contributing to team member feedback, growth, and evaluation processes
  • Building the capacity of regional achievement team members and school-based leads in language acquisition, literacy, and data-informed instructional practice

Design professional learning & coaching by:

  • Training regional leaders, school leaders, and other instructional staff in strong literacy practices, instructional strategies, and support for multilingual learners
  • Observing instruction and reviewing curriculum to identify strengths and improvement needs
  • Providing actionable feedback grounded in observation, student performance, and language development data
  • Developing tools and resources that support curriculum implementation and integrated language development
  • Helping facilitate network-wide professional development
  • Partnering with principals and regional leaders to plan professional learning aligned to school needs and multilingual learner priorities

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 3+ years of experience coaching, managing, or developing adults toward strong instructional and student outcomes in a high-performing charter, district, or similar
  • 2–4 additional years of successful teaching experience, preferably in elementary settings, with a record of strong student achievement
  • Experience leading curriculum development, implementation, instructional projects, and/or school-based academic initiatives (Experience with Amplify CKLA strongly preferred)
  • Experience designing and delivering professional development to varied audiences
  • Expertise in literacy curriculum design and development, with a strong understanding of English language development and multilingual learner instruction
  • Strong organizational, project management, and communication skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
This role requires significant travel, which could be up to 25% of the Director’s time.

Physical Demands:

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally climb ladders. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is moderate to high.

title: Scientist III
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

The **Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology**, invites applications for a **Staff Scientist position** working in cosmology. JPL has an established culture for collaborations and opportunities for developing new ideas and pursuits and is committed to fostering an enriching and rewarding research environment with strong support and coaching for professional and personal development.

**Responsibilities:**

We are looking for an innovative **Scientist III** to play a pivotal role in the analysis and interpretation of the next generation of dark sector surveys. As JPL expands its leadership in NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope and ESA’s Euclid, the focus is shifting from precision measurement to the complex challenges of modeling and cosmological interpretation. This role is essential for capitalizing on the imminent release of Euclid’s ~1900 square degrees (Data Release 1) and the imminent launch of Roman.

The successful candidate will:

- Bridge the gap between raw measurement and theoretical insight, providing critical expertise in cosmological simulations, modeling, and interpretation of cosmological data.
- Join the vibrant JPL dark sector community contributing to the JPL-led OpenUniverse cosmological simulations project and the Euclid and Roman science teams. Beyond current missions, the successful candidate will join a collaborative team to shape the post-Roman landscape, developing mission concepts and strategies to influence the 2030 Decadal Survey.
- Integrate astrophysical, instrumental, and statistical systematics into robust models, which will aim to define the future of how we understand the dark universe.

**Required Qualifications:**

- A Ph.D. in Astrophysics or a related discipline with a minimum of 2 years’ experience, or a master’s degree in a related discipline with a minimum of 4 years of related experience; or a bachelor’s degree in a related discipline with a minimum of 6 years of related experience.
- Deep technical foundation in some combination of cosmological simulations, modeling, and cosmological data interpretation.
- Proven expertise in weak lensing and/or galaxy clustering as primary probes for investigating dark matter and dark energy.
- Strong interpersonal skills and a demonstrated ability to thrive within a collaborative team environment.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a proactive commitment to fostering diverse ideas and backgrounds in the workplace, ensuring a dynamic and inclusive research culture as we tackle the most complex questions in modern cosmology.

**Preferred Skills:**

- A Ph.D. in Astrophysics or a related discipline with a minimum of 5 years’ experience.
- Demonstrated professional reputation as a productive researcher with a track record of publications in peer-reviewed journals and presentations at national and/or international conferences.
- Demonstrated record of successfully proposing for research funds as Principal Investigator.

**Note:** Complete applications will include a cover letter describing the applicant’s vision for their role at JPL as a leader and contributor in the fields of dark energy cosmology and dark matter, a curriculum vita including a bibliography of peer-reviewed and other publications, **a statement on research experience and research objectives (no more than 3 pages)**, and contact information for at least three professional reference writers **.**

JPL has a catalog of benefits and perks that span from the traditional to the unique. This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. Our focus is on work-life balance, and living healthy, fulfilling lives as we Dare Mighty Things Together. For benefits eligible positions, benefits are effective the first day of the month coincident with or immediately following the employee’s start date.

For further benefits information click [Benefits and Perks](https://www.jpl.jobs/benefits-perks)

The hiring range displayed below is specifically for those who will work in or reside in the location listed. In extending an offer, Jet Propulsion Laboratory considers factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s job related skills, experience, knowledge, and relevant education/training.

The typical full time equivalent annual hiring range for this job in Pasadena, California.

$144,664 - $180,752

JPL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy or perceived pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, protected military or veteran status or any other characteristic or condition protected by Federal, state or local law.

In addition, JPL is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

title: AI Product Owner
description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary


The Standard Insurance Company is seeking a skilled and driven AI Product Owner to join our AI & Automation department. In this role, you turn a prioritized product vision into working software. You own the backlog, the sprint, the release and the production health of Applied AI products designed to transform our core operations.


As an AI Product Owner, you will partner with our AI Product Manager, who sets product strategy and the roadmap. Your job is to answer the next question: how do we build it, and who needs to help us? You will translate strategic direction into actionable work plans and user stories. You will elicit detailed implementation requirements from engineers, data scientists and business partners, and you will lead the scrum ceremonies that keep your pod aligned. You will guide your team through PI planning by defining work packages and their sequence, then set interim sprint goals and drive the team to thorough completion. You will also own release coordination and communication, monitor production system health against uptime expectations, assist with testing and coordinate with dependent teams during each sprint so implementation meets their expectations. A strong understanding of the SDLC and Agile/Scrum methodologies is essential.


Your understanding of AI concepts will be valuable, because these solutions integrate machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, optimization, robotic process automation, computer vision and logical rule sets on a modern AI/ML DevOps infrastructure. Direct AI development experience is an advantage given the complexity of our AI product release cycles. When a written story is the slower path, you will communicate intent through a coded prototype or a pull request.

As AI compresses delivery timeframes from months to days, demand for work-ready items will grow quickly. You will apply AI tooling to your own work, from requirements capture through story generation and test coverage, to help the team keep pace.


Join us in pushing the boundaries of responsible and ethical AI at The Standard to revolutionize business processes and customer experiences.


Skills and Background You'll Need


EDUCATION: A high school diploma or GED is required. A Bachelor's degree is preferred.


EXPERIENCE: 5+ years of professional technology and business analysis experience, with prior experience in team-oriented roles that require collaboration with others. An understanding of high-level requirements for cloud-based software applications, traditional AI/ML modeling techniques and generative AI systems is preferred.


  • Agile/Scrum experience is required, including hands-on ownership of a backlog, a sprint cadence and a release process. An understanding of the SDLC is preferred.
  • Proven success delivering forward-leaning technical products that combine AI methods and tools, such as ML, DL, optimization, RPA, OCR, generative AI and classification, is highly preferred. AI development experience on an enterprise-level product is preferred, as is the technical fluency to read a pull request, build a prototype and hold a credible design conversation with engineers.
  • Experience supporting production software, including incident response and uptime monitoring, is preferred.
  • Experience working in underwriting or claims is preferred, as is experience in the financial or insurance industry.
  • The ability to translate technical, data science and business perspectives for a non-technical audience is required, as is the ability to coordinate work across teams you do not manage.
  • You communicate release plans, timing and progress clearly to stakeholders, IT leaders and internal teams.
  • Top candidates document thoroughly, listen diligently and turn complex feedback into clear implementation direction. Proficiency in Jira, Miro, Databricks, Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint is preferred.
  • Experience working with a global capability center or equivalent off-shore organization is preferred.
  • Experience with dual-track discovery delivery method is preferred.


Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate


Adaptability – Demonstrates flexibility by willingly accepting new situations such as teams, projects or work processes.


Customer Focus – Responds to standard requests from internal and external customers; performs necessary duties consistently and reliably to meet customer expectations.


Improvement Mindset – Proves curiosity by asking questions about current approaches and methods and finding potential changes.




Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

  • A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

  • An annual incentive bonus plan

  • Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure

  • A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement

  • Paid parental leave and adoption/surrogacy assistance

  • An employee giving program that double matches your donations to eligible nonprofits and schools

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

title: Senior User Researcher
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

As a Senior User Researcher at Snowflake, you’ll shape what we build and how customers experience it. You’ll work alongside product, design, engineering, and marketing leads to set priorities, make tough calls, and bring ideas to market. Your deep understanding of customer needs and business goals will make you a trusted partner in those decisions.
