title: Rust Systems Engineer, Browser Security
description:
Datamint | Rust Systems Engineer, Browser Security | Remote (Global) | Full-time | $120k–$170k + Equity | https://datamint.xyz

We build high-throughput crawling and structured data extraction infra designed for AI agents and LLM pipelines.

If you’ve built scrapers recently, you already know the state of the market:

- Traditional proxy providers (Bright Data, Oxylabs, Smartproxy, Proxybase) give you raw IPs or massive unparsed HTML blobs, leaving you to deal with DOM bloat, token waste, and brittle parsing pipelines.

- Modern tools like Firecrawl or Jina made clean Markdown extraction easy for hobby setups, but they often struggle when you throw heavy SPAs, high-concurrency jobs, or hardened anti-bot walls (Cloudflare Under-Attack / Turnstile, Kasada, DataDome) at them.

- Rolling your own Playwright / Puppeteer cluster works until target sites deploy new JA4/TLS fingerprints, and your data team ends up spending 30% of their sprints fixing broken crawlers instead of shipping product.

We're tackling this by combining a low-latency Rust fast-fetch engine (JA4/TLS and HTTP/2 frame emulation) with an isolated stealth browser fleet, zero-code schema validation (JSON Schema/Pydantic), and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support.

Trade-offs / where we fit: If you just need to curl a few static Wikipedia pages, a 10-line Python script is better and cheaper. But if you need reliable, structured data out of bot-defended sites without babying headless browsers, that's what we do.

We're looking for:

1. Rust Systems Engineer: High-concurrency network I/O, Axum/Tokio, TLS/BoringSSL fingerprinting, proxy routing matrices, and low-latency data pipelines.

2. Browser Security Engineer: Deep familiarity with browser internals (Firefox/Chromium source), canvas/WebGL/audio fingerprint evasion, CDP/WebDriver stealth, and familarity with anti-bot defenses.

Our stack: Rust, Next.js 16/React 19, TypeScript, hardened Firefox/dwx_crawler, Linux/Xvfb, SQLite WAL/Postgres.

If interested, shoot an email to jobs@datamint.xyz (or founders@datamint.xyz) with your GitHub, a project you built or broke, and what you find interesting in this space. No formal cover letter needed.

description:

title: SVN: Project Associate (EPR & ABA) - Porto Alegre/RS
description:

It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants. Brazil is a Member State of IOM since 2004.

IOM applies Emergency Preparedness and Response (EPR) and Area-Based Approaches (ABA) to strengthen local preparedness, response, and resilience. EPR focuses on risk identification, preparedness, capacity-building, simulation exercises, and coordination, while ABA provides a place-based perspective to understand local risks, capacities, and needs and to support integrated interventions involving authorities, communities, civil society, the private sector, and other stakeholders.

title: Lead Systems Engineer, MCA – Fleet Innovation & Transformation
description:
Who will you be working with?

Our Freight Services Division provides locomotive maintenance services to our customers, the country’s largest freight railroads, helping them keep their locomotives running at optimal levels. The mission of the Fleet Innovation & Transformation team is to accelerate fleet transformation by consistently providing compelling solutions and innovative technologies that improve reliability, sustainability, and performance.

How will you make a difference?

The Lead Systems Engineer, MCA – Will work within a team of engineers focused on delivering software solutions for Wabtec’s growing fleet of MCA based control system locomotives. In this role, you will help evaluate the technical requirements definition, verification, validation and implementation phases of MCA software release(s) to ensure customer satisfaction.

Working with the Lead Systems Engineer, you will assist in the execution of software verification and validation starting with System level requirements definition & flow-down through the sub-system level, followed by internal sub-system & system level validation. Provide primary support for installation on our customer locomotives in the field and in the factory. This includes ensuring system and sub-system level validation planning and tests are appropriate for the defined requirements and scope. Your participation will help ensure that the software will deliver a product that exceeds customer expectations, is installed with as little disruption to the customer as possible, and with minimal support needed from Wabtec.

What do we want to know about you?

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelors Degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years safety-critical controls or embedded controls experience
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve product problems in a ‘high-pressure’ environment
  • Ability to estimate engineering effort for defined tasks
  • High level of integrity
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate technical people with a high level of urgency
  • Proven ability to strengthen teams, increase effectiveness, and broaden responsibilities
  • Project/Program Management experience
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive projects to completion by setting and meeting key milestones
  • Strong Verbal & Written communication skills

Desired Characteristics:

  • Masters Degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science.
  • Working knowledge of INCOSE systems engineering best practices and Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
  • Demonstrated experience in motivating employees and creating an atmosphere of acceptance and teamwork
  • Knowledge of MCA control system(s) including software development & release processes
  • 3+ years Locomotive Systems Engineering Experience which includes time spent on New Product Development, Requisition, and Installed Base product support.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Execute on MCA Software revision/release scope with appropriate requirements definition, documentation updates, design review planning, verification and validation plans.
  • Assist in end-to-end oversight of MCA software release process ensuring system level requirements are met through appropriate validation testing.
  • Identify risks and develop mitigation activities to reduce risks to acceptable levels prior to software release.
  • Communicate program & project progress to all levels of the organization.

Our job titles may span more than one career level. Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

title: Physical Security Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for talented professionals to be a part of a dynamic team. We place a focus on professionalism, kindness, integrity, and a high level of confidentiality, with the goal to deliver best in class service while providing a positive working experience for its staff.

Job Summary: The Physical Security System Engineer will be responsible for designing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting the access control (ACS) and video management systems (VMS) and related systems. Onsite project acceptance and documentation of new construction and retrofits and will be responsible for implementing systems / policies / procedures to maintain and improve the health and functionality of technical systems. Success in this role requires leadership, active planning, proactive communication, and collaboration across the org toward supporting the properties, end users and maintaining a secure environment. Must be a highly capable team member, but also work autonomously with minimal guidance. The highest level of integrity and discretion in handling confidential information is required in addition to maintaining a high degree of professionalism.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Assist with the selection, installation, and maintenance of ACS and VMS as well as supporting related intrusion detection systems (IDS) and security subsystems such as Envoy, Amazon Workspaces, and GPS trackers.
  • Coordinate the installation of a wide range of ACS and intrusion detection systems, overt/concealed security cameras, and industry-standard and prototype security technologies.
  • Design, program, and oversee projects related to ACS, IDS, and video surveillance.
  • Review new project plans to ensure the scope meets designated requirements and standards.
  • Plan, organize, direct, and implement application upgrades, system upgrades, and migrations, including commissioning of new systems.
  • Maintenance of physical security-related aspects for both existing and new construction projects, testing, field verification of systems, and inspection of work in progress for compliance with standards.
  • Keep pace with new industry standards and technology; research and recommend new security-related hardware or software products, and provide assessments of their viability and use case.
  • Participate in physical security project meetings, problem-solving, and discussions of system and project-related issues; recommend security equipment and systems solutions.
  • Act as a primary point of contact for issues related to ACS and VMS programming; work closely with vendors to assure timely resolution of service issues.
  • Plan, organize, direct, and implement physical security-related projects, upgrades, system migrations, and commissioning.
  • Coordinate with general contractors, subcontractors, vendors, architects, and project managers to review and verify security designs for “sign-off”.
  • Develop and maintain security standards, confirming their integration into site drawings and security designs.
  • Educate members of the home team on physical security system operations and provide training and accompanying documentation.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure policy, process, and systems are aligned to meet the needs of the programs.
  • Manage support agreements and licensing needs for related physical security systems.
  • Enhance security systems utilization to maximize responsive and informed monitoring and decision making by operations teams.
  • Participate and implement proof of concept system enhancements and approaches working with operations and security program management.

Leadership

  • Provide workflow definition and adjustments, technical oversight and documentation for Physical Security systems
  • Mentor and train other team members to improve understanding and improve processes.
  • Partner with operations on documentation of existing standards and project teams implementation of standards and best practices.

Hardware

  • Become familiar with electronic and mechanical locking systems related to basic access control and specialty applications including multi-point assemblies.
  • Participate in design team meetings related to hardware and ancillary power supplies to verify minimal failures and client safety.
  • Be versed in functions of locking hardware and review contractor submittals to verify adherence to standards and design specifications.
  • Understand power supplies and remote monitoring capabilities to proactively service potential failures or deterioration of components.
  • Assist facilities in troubleshooting issues related to electronic elements and connections.
  • Familiarity with motorized gates, safety loops, photo beams and associated electronics and controls.
  • Document changes for capturing in record drawings.

Systems Administration

  • Perform needed user account management, hardware configurations, and remote troubleshooting for all Physical Security teams and users
  • Support for existing applications running in the cloud.
  • Best effort to migrate all systems to the cloud.
  • Management of inventory, acquisition, and deployment of new hardware.
  • Arrange and carry out Final Acceptance Testing on behalf of the organization
  • Server Operating system updates and patch management.
  • Database Server software updates and patch management.
  • Ad hoc Reports.
  • Application of software patches and hot-fixes.
  • Monitoring of systems and the network environment.
  • Other system configuration instructions, as may be required and applicable in the environment.

Skills

  • 5-10 years experience designing, implementing, and supporting physical security systems and the corresponding IT related infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with comparable ACS such as OnGuard, S2 or Genetec.
  • Certification in S2 ACS and VMS or comparable ACS\VMS.
  • Experience with AWS (Amazon Web Services) including VPC (virtual private cloud), EC2 (elastic compute), Workspaces. Manage EBS block storage and security groups for the physical security EC2 instances.
  • A strong understanding of TCP/IP network protocols including DNS, VLANs, and routing. Ability to systematically troubleshoot problems in complex systems across LAN, WAN, WLAN, and cloud environments.

title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
description:
The Opportunity

As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled.

What You'll Do

  • Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates.
  • Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date.
  • Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays.
  • Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections.
  • Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call.
  • Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin.
  • Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event.
  • Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation.
  • Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture.
  • Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise.
  • Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races.
  • Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts).
  • Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts.
  • Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls.
  • Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination.
  • Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known.
  • Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics.
  • Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket.
  • Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant.
  • Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps.
  • Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards.
  • Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content.

title: Consultant Data Engineer
description:

At Data Intellect it has never been just about data or technology, they are our tools. It’s about human intellect, collaboration and providing solutions for the most complex of challenges.

For over two decades, we've partnered with many of the world's leading investment banks, hedge funds and exchanges, helping them build high-performance data platforms that power trading, analytics and market surveillance. At our core, Data Intellect is a data and technology consultancy firm. Our key area of expertise is financial and capital markets technology solutions. However, the utility of these solutions allow us to apply fintech data expertise to other industries such as smart energy and healthcare.

title: Senior Systems Designer
description:
WE ARE GAME MAKERS

Who We Are:

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

What We Need:

We’re looking for a Senior Systems Designer to join our team and help us shape the future of online multiplayer gaming. In this role, you’ll be a key feature driver, partnering with various cross functional teams to shape how players grow, are rewarded, and evolve over time! You have proven expertise in game economy design, reward systems, and the intentional design work needed to balance the complex relationship between them. You can both communicate and document design features, intent and specs clearly and work in-engine to bring those experiences to reality. You seamlessly form strong working relationships among peers of different disciplines, bring others with you towards a shared vision, and proactively work with production & game leadership to make it a reality. We’re a studio that values autonomy and self-drive in developers who are empowered to do the best work of their careers. If this is you, let’s talk!

What You'll Do:

  • Drive a small portfolio of complex features through initial creative input, stakeholder buy-in and alignment, consistent design reviews, and day-to-day execution.
  • Respond quickly to feedback with stable in-engine updates and iterate rapidly.
  • Provide design leadership within your feature area while contributing to broader game quality by mentoring others and sharing insights.
  • Reliably source ideas from around the studio, combining with own proposals and references to other products, in order to quickly solve and innovate within design challenges.
  • Work cross-functionally within and outside of your team to communicate and align on the work, tradeoffs and dependencies. Radiate changes across the organization; set and mobilize against feature goals; and provide forward-looking direction aligned with greater design philosophy.
  • Share best practices and techniques with peers to improve the overall experience

What Will Make You A Great Fit:

  • Strong experience with Unreal Engine and Blueprint visual scripting; programming experience (C++, C#, etc.) is a plus.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing gameplay features in released multiplayer games, with a strong focus on reward loops, systemic content integration, and player-driven optionality.
  • Theory-crafting skillset & past experience designing for depth and multiplayer gameplay.
  • Quantitative and analytical, with past experience building and interrogating economy models and simulations to validate and align design decisions.
  • Deep understanding of the various components (UI, Art, Engineering, Audio, VFX, etc.) that come together to achieve an unparalleled player experience.
  • A self-starter who can align with the team's goals but isn't hesitant to create solutions of their own.
  • Capable of rapidly filtering large volumes of feedback into concrete and useful improvements.
  • Ability to flexibly design, implement, and iterate under tight deadlines & production constraints.
  • Well-played in the multiplayer PvP / Competitive Space and able to deconstruct what works and why.
  • Capability to abstract designs outside of single solutions into patterns and models of player behavior; providing options and flexible design solutions

description:
At BETA Technologies, we apply our intellectual curiosity, passion for aviation, and commitment to sustainability toward a shared mission of revolutionizing electric aviation. Regardless of the position one holds, each team member brings their talent and desire to positively impact the environment and lives of others in a refreshing, vibrant, and inclusive culture.

The Aerodynamics Engineer will support the aerodynamic design, analysis, testing, and validation of BETA’s fixed-wing and vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) aircraft. You will develop aerodynamic models and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) methods; plan and execute wind-tunnel and flight-test activities; and use computational and experimental data to inform aircraft configuration, performance, stability and control, loads, and certification decisions. The engineer will work closely with Flight Sciences, Flight Test, Structures, Flight Controls, Propulsion, and Certification teams to optimize next-generation electric aircraft through a multidisciplinary, first-principles approach. This position will be based onsite at our South Burlington, VT office location, our Raleigh, NC office. Remote candidates may be considered for a hybrid role, with monthly visits to South Burlington, VT for in person work.

How you will contribute to revolutionizing electric aviation:

  • Develop and maintain aerodynamic models of varying fidelity to support aircraft design, performance, stability and control, loads, and flight-dynamics analysis
  • Prepare, execute, and post-process full-vehicle and subsystem CFD simulations
  • Develop and improve CFD pre-processing, post-processing, and automation methodologies to increase the quality, efficiency, and repeatability of aerodynamic analyses
  • Lead aerodynamic design studies, including airfoil selection, lifting-surface sizing, lofts and blends, high-lift systems, and aircraft configuration trade studies
  • Develop and maintain aircraft drag budgets and performance calculations to support design refinement and vehicle-level requirements
  • Plan and support wind-tunnel test campaigns, including development of test objectives, test matrices, instrumentation approaches, flow-visualization studies, and post-processing routines
  • Correlate CFD predictions and low-fidelity aerodynamic models with wind-tunnel and flight-test data; identify discrepancies and drive model and design improvements
  • Collaborate with Flight Test to plan, execute, analyze, and document flight-test activities that validate aerodynamic performance, handling characteristics, and vehicle-level requirements
  • Balance aerodynamic performance with structural, propulsion, flight-controls, thermal, and certification considerations to make informed aircraft-level design tradeoffs
  • Support aerodynamic loads development and work with the Structures team to ensure aerodynamic capability is accurately captured in aircraft loads and structural-sizing analyses
  • Develop aerodynamic validation and verification strategies that support aircraft development and certification milestones
  • Communicate analysis methods, results, technical findings, and recommendations through clear reports and presentations
  • Use a multidisciplinary understanding of aircraft design to proactively identify opportunities to improve vehicle performance, analysis methods, and test processes

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • At least 3–5 years of experience in aircraft aerodynamic analysis, aerodynamic design, CFD, wind-tunnel testing, flight test, or related disciplines
  • Experience with CFD analysis and aerodynamic simulation methods of varying fidelity
  • Experience developing or using aerodynamic models to support aircraft performance, stability and control, loads, or flight-dynamics analysis
  • Experience planning, executing, or analyzing wind-tunnel and/or flight-test activities
  • Experience with MATLAB, Python, and data-analysis tools
  • Experience with CAD tools and aircraft geometry development
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary teams
  • Curiosity and ability to identify and rapidly implement new analysis, modeling, and test methods for next-generation aircraft
  • Must be a US Person to be considered for the role

Above and Beyond Qualifications:

  • Experience with aerodynamic design and analysis of vertical-flight, distributed-propulsion, or other novel aircraft configurations
  • Experience with aerodynamic analysis tools with varying fidelities, such as XFOIL, MSES, AVL, Pointwise, Tecplot, etc.
  • Experience with aircraft conceptual design, configuration trade studies, airfoil development, and lifting-surface design
  • Experience leading high lift design efforts
  • Experience developing aircraft drag build-ups, performance models, or low-fidelity aerodynamic models
  • Experience correlating CFD, wind-tunnel, and flight-test data
  • Experience supporting aerodynamic certification activities, including development of compliance methods, test plans, or reports
  • Experience interpreting aerodynamic test data to support stability and control, handling qualities, aircraft loads, or flight-controls development
  • Experience managing external aerodynamic-analysis, wind-tunnel, model-shop, test, or certification suppliers
  • Experience as an FAA Designated Engineering Representative (DER)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About Pixaera

Pixaera builds immersive and AI-generated health & safety training used by industrial workforces — mining, oil & gas, energy and data centres. Our platform trains thousands of people every day for enterprise customers across Europe and the Middle East. We are a small, senior, remote-first engineering team, and we are now building an engineering presence in Amman.

The role in one line

An infrastructure engineer who can confidently own production systems end to end, and who instinctively automates anything that shouldn't need a human.

What you'll actually work on

  • Full-stack infrastructure ownership. Deep, hands-on experience across cloud, CI/CD, monitoring, security and developer experience. You make infrastructure decisions independently, drive platform modernisation, and are trusted with production.
  • Reliability leadership. You set and track SLOs (uptime, deploy frequency, recovery time), own incident response, and build the runbooks and practices that make on-call sustainable.
  • Build and pipeline architecture. You design reusable, versioned CI/CD workflows and manage self-hosted runner fleets as code, with golden images and self-healing. Unreal Engine or Windows build experience is a strong plus.
  • Scaling compute-heavy workloads. You've scaled long-running render or batch workloads and taken designs from paper to production.
  • Cloud cost strategy. You have a track record of measurable savings through tagging, right-sizing, spot and reserved capacity, and spend visibility.
  • Security and compliance. You bring expertise in secrets management, least-privilege access and patching. Experience with SOC 2, pen testing, and enterprise security reviews is valued.

Our stack

  • Cloud: AWS as primary — multi-account (management / dev / staging / production), multi-region (Frankfurt and UAE). Some GCP for rendering.
  • IaC & GitOps: Terraform with Atlantis, ArgoCD, Helm.
  • Kubernetes: Amazon EKS, Karpenter, External DNS, AWS Load Balancer Controller, IRSA, external secrets.
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions including self-hosted Windows runners for Unreal builds. TeamCity still in legacy use.
  • Observability: Datadog (APM, logs, monitors, cloud cost), CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry.
  • Security: Vanta, AWS Security Hub and Inspector, 1Password, Tailscale, Dependabot.
  • Also in the picture: Docker, PostgreSQL/RDS, Redis, S3, Lambda, GPU instances, Unreal Engine and pixel streaming.

Must-haves

  • 3–6 years in DevOps, platform, SRE or infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong hands-on AWS — you've built and operated real production infrastructure, not just consumed it.
  • Terraform in earnest: modules, state, code review, and having recovered from a bad apply.
  • Kubernetes in production — can debug a failing pod, a broken ingress or a stuck rollout without guessing.
  • CI/CD pipeline ownership, ideally GitHub Actions.
  • Confident scripting in Python, Go or Bash — enough to automate rather than repeat.
  • A monitoring and incident instinct: alerts that mean something, and the discipline to write the runbook afterwards.
  • Comfortable being the person who owns a problem in a small team, and asking for help early when it's outside your depth.
  • Strong written English — we're largely async and written, and documentation is part of the job.

Nice-to-haves

  • ArgoCD, Helm or GitOps workflows specifically.
  • Cloud cost optimisation with results you can point to.
  • Windows build agents, or game/graphics build pipelines (Unreal, Perforce).
  • GPU workloads and render infrastructure.
  • SOC 2 / ISO 27001 support, penetration test coordination, or compliance automation (Vanta or similar).
  • Datadog specifically.

Location, setup and comp

Working day should overlap UK hours; English is our working language. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the Amman market.

Interview process

Intro call with our recruiting partner → hiring manager conversation → technical interview with our platform and engineering leads → short practical exercise or troubleshooting session → final conversation with the team. We aim to move within 3–4 weeks.

How do we support and benefit our employees:

  • Competitive salary and stock options — everyone shares in what we're building
  • 25 days holiday + public holidays
  • Fully equipped setup from day one (no waiting for laptops)
  • Regular company offsites and team socials
  • A flat, transparent culture with direct access to leadership

At Pixaera, we're committed to building a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to thrive. We believe that diverse perspectives fuel creativity and innovation, which is why we celebrate individuality and foster an environment of inclusion and belonging.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer — discrimination of any kind has no place here. No matter your background, identity, or lived experience, you're welcome at Pixaera.

title: Mental Health Clinician 3 (PCN 20-8625)
description:
Job Description


The Department of Corrections, Division of Health & Rehabilitation Services, is recruiting for a Mental Health Clinician 3 position located in Eagle River, Alaska.

Watch Alaska DOC HARS video here:

Behavior Health


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Coordinate, supervise, and provide comprehensive mental health services to incarcerated individuals at Hiland Mountain Correctional Center, delivering both individual and group-based psychotherapeutic interventions.
  • Through direct interviews, clinical observations, and evaluation of existing history, apply clinical expertise to conduct mental health screenings, evaluations, treatment planning, crisis intervention, and ongoing therapeutic casework.
  • Assess an individual’s diagnosis and risk, respond effectively to emergent situations, and make clinical recommendations on appropriate treatment.
  • Perform and facilitate therapeutic group programming focused on cognitive-behavioral skills.
  • As a master’s level mental health clinician and supervisor, oversee mental health services, complete performance evaluations, conduct quality assurance measures, develop others in their abilities, and train staff on department standards and mental health disorders.


Our Mission, Values, and Culture:

The HARS Mission Statement: To provide timely access to essential care through an evidence-based multidisciplinary approach. We are committed to a culture of professionalism, quality and safety.


We seek applicants who are interested in furthering the HARS Mission and who will strive to uphold the Division's Core Values of Respect, Integrity, Compassion, Teamwork, Safety and Growth.


Benefits of Joining Our Team:

This position offers the unique opportunity to make a profound impact on a vulnerable population, supporting rehabilitation and contributing to public safety. The role provides a deeply meaningful way to serve one’s community by promoting mental wellness and reducing recidivism. Being part of our collaborative multidisciplinary team allows for shared knowledge and diverse perspectives, which support professional growth and improve patient outcomes.


The Working Environment You Can Expect:

This position oversees the mental health programming needs at the Hiland Mountain Correctional Center, a secure facility for female individuals. As the state’s only all-female facility that also serves the greater Anchorage area as a booking facility, this position will work in a collaborative environment with a multidisciplinary team to secure the best possible outcome for each individual.


Who We Are Looking For:

We are interested in candidates who possess some or all of the following position specific competencies:

  • Decision Making: Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.
  • Supervision: Plans, distributes, and monitors work assignments; sets task priorities; evaluates work performance and provides feedback to others on their performance; ensures that staff are appropriately selected, utilized, and developed, and that they are treated in a fair and equitable manner. Assignments include the authority and responsibility to recommend or independently take action to employ (i.e., appoint, transfer, promote), discipline or discharge, or adjudicate grievances of direct reports.
  • Oral and Written Communication: Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral and written presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Minimum Qualifications

Doctoral degree OR Master’s degree from an accredited college in counseling, psychology, social work, child guidance, vocational rehabilitation, or a closely related field.

AND

Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the applicant with the knowledge, skills, and abilities in:

  • Accountability: Accepts responsibility for own actions and decisions and demonstrates commitment to accomplish work in an ethical, efficient, and cost-effective manner.
  • Developing Others: Develops the ability of others to perform and contribute to the organization by providing ongoing feedback and by providing opportunities to learn through formal and informal methods.
  • Managing Human Resources: Plans, distributes, coordinates, and monitors work assignments of others; evaluates work performance and provides feedback to others on their performance; ensures that staff are appropriately selected, utilized, and developed, and that they are treated in a fair and equitable manner.
  • Psychology: Knowledge of the concepts, principles, and theories of human behavior and performance in various contexts, mental processes, or the assessment and treatment of behavioral and affective disorders.
  • Therapy and Counseling: Knowledge of diagnosis and treatment of physical and mental ailments, and career guidance.


Equivalent to those typically gained by:

Progressively responsible professional experience performing psychotherapeutic casework.


“Progressively responsible” means indicating growth and/or advancement in complexity, difficulty, or level of responsibility.


“Professional experience” means work that is creative, analytical, evaluative, and interpretive; requires a range and depth of specialized knowledge of the profession's principles, concepts, theories, and practices; and is performed with the power or right to decide or act according to one's own judgment.


"Training" and "education" in this guidance are synonyms for the process of acquiring knowledge and skills through instruction. It includes instruction through formal and informal methods (such as classroom, on-line, self-study, and on-the-job), from accredited and unaccredited sources, and long-duration (such as a post-secondary degree) and short-duration (such as a seminar) programs.


"Typically gained by" means the prevalent, usual method of gaining the competencies expected for entry into the job.


Special Note:

Some positions require the incumbent be licensed as a Clinical Social Worker or a Licensed Professional Counselor. This requirement will be addressed in the job posting.

Additional Required Information


REQUIRED DOCUMENTS

If selected for an interview, the applicant must provide the following:

  • Official or unofficial transcripts from highest level of education completed
  • Three professional references


RECRUITMENT DIFFICULTIES

Starting salary may be approved up to Step D - $3,989.60, if criteria are met.


LEGAL EMPLOYMENT

The State’s online recruitment system, Workplace Alaska, requires applicants to certify that they have a legal right to accept employment in the United States. It is the responsibility of the employee to maintain the appropriate documentation to accept or continue legal employment. The State of Alaska does not function in the role as an employer sponsor.


EDUCATION

If post-secondary education is required to meet the minimum qualifications, you must fill in the Education section of the application. If you have not obtained a degree, please indicate the number of units completed. Copies of transcripts are required to verify educational credentials if used to meet the minimum qualifications for a position. Transcripts can be attached at the time of application or provided at the time of interview.


SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR FOREIGN EDUCATION

Education completed in foreign colleges or universities may be used to meet the minimum qualifications listed above. If utilizing this education, you must show that the education credentials have been submitted to a private organization that specializes in the interpretation of foreign educational credentials and that such education has been deemed to be at least equivalent to that gained in conventional U.S. education programs; or an accredited U.S. post-secondary institution reports the other institution as one whose transcript is given full value, or full value is given in subject areas applicable to the curricula at the post-secondary institution. It is your responsibility to provide such evidence when applying.


WORK EXPERIENCE

Applications will be reviewed to determine if the responses are supported and minimum qualifications are clearly met. If they are not, the applicant may not advance to the interview and selection phase of the recruitment.


PREA NOTIFICATION

The Department of Corrections follows and maintains federal and state requirements standards including, but not limited to, Prison Rape Elimination Act (PREA) standards which apply to all public and private institutions that house adult or juvenile offenders. PREA standards preclude the department from hiring or promoting anyone who has engaged in, or been convicted of any conduct which would violate PREA standards related to sexual assault including:

  • Sexual abuse in a prison, jail, lockup, community confinement facility, juvenile facility, or other institution;

title: Security Analyst
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. Lyft’s engineering team is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Security Analysts to help us scale. Come be part of a team at Lyft focused on enabling and empowering engineering teams to deliver at scale.

Our drivers and passengers entrust Lyft with their personal information and travel details to get where they're going and expect us to keep that data safe. Lyft's security team leads efforts across the company to ensure our systems are secure and worthy of our users' trust.

Lyft Security builds systems to protect and defend infrastructure and services from cyber attacks. We consult with teams as they build and launch new products and features, proactively plans for the unexpected, and responds to incidents that occur. Our work has company wide impact and takes place at all levels of the stack, from infrastructure to web application security, as well as mobile apps, IT, bikes, scooters, etc. We believe in scaling security through engineering fundamentals, automation, and tooling. Check out our blog posts at https://eng.lyft.com/tagged/security to learn more about some of the things we’ve built.

Our Incident Response team lives at the intersection of speed and precision. We own the full lifecycle of security incidents and stay ahead of the curve with our Threat Hunting program.

We are looking for a Security Analyst who is passionate about refining feedback loops and executing proactive security actions. In this fast-paced, ever-evolving landscape, we prioritize knowledge sharing and mentorship. You will collaborate closely with Senior Analysts to sharpen your technical edge, ensuring that as our environment grows, your expertise grows with it.

Responsibilities:

  • Incident Response: Respond promptly to security incidents by orchestrating coordinated responses across engineering teams and other relevant disciplines.
  • Analyze and Prioritize High-Quality Security Alerts: Assess and prioritize security alerts of high quality with the potential to impact the organization, based on SOCLess approach.
  • Develop Automation and Tooling: Create and maintain automation tools to enhance the efficiency and impact of the incident response team's activities.
  • Collaborate with the Detection Engineering Team: Work closely with the Detection Engineering Team to identify and implement new security strategies aimed at detecting threats, reducing the attack surface, and enhancing the organization's overall cybersecurity posture.
  • Conduct Threat Hunting Operations: Define and execute threat hunting operations across the organization's systems and services, aiming to uncover detection gaps, identify weaknesses in security controls, and refine existing processes.
  • Assess the Organization's Threat Landscape: Evaluate the threat landscape specific to the organization to prioritize proactive security measures and actions.
  • Cultivate and Maintain Key Partnerships: Establish and nurture relationships with critical partners both within the organization and externally to foster collaboration and information sharing.

Experience:

  • Cybersecurity Knowledge:
    • A strong drive to learn and ambition for continuous growth within the cybersecurity domain.
    • An understanding of cybersecurity principles, including threat landscape and security best practices.
    • Familiarity with TTPs (tactics, techniques and procedures), anomaly detection, and behavior analysis.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Automation & Cloud: Scripting and automation skills, basic experience with cloud technologies such as AWS/GCP and their tech stack.
    • Systems & Networking: Strong understanding of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS) and networking, including their security features.
    • Investigative Mindset: A natural curiosity to find the 'root cause' of problems through log analysis and forensic trail-following.
    • Data Analytics: Ability to aggregate and correlate datasets to identify suspicious patterns and outliers.
    • AI Augmentation: Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to accelerate workflows, such as scripting, automating repetitive tasks or summarizing complex technical documentation.
  • Communication Skills:
    • Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with other team members, stakeholders, and management.
    • Ability to document technical activities clearly and concisely.
    • Capable of communicating technical concepts in a confident, well-organized manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Adaptability and Collaboration:
    • The ability to adapt to evolving technologies and cybersecurity threats and stay current with industry trends.
    • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, and work independently.
  • Ethical Considerations:
    • A strong ethical foundation and commitment to handling sensitive data and incidents with integrity and discretion.

Please submit your resume in English.

title: Mechanical Engineering Intern | Summer 2027
location: Dallas, Texas, United States; Houston, Texas, United States
description:
DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.

DLR Group's South Central Region has an opening for a Mechanical Engineering Summer Intern. This role could be based in the following studios:

  • Dallas, Texas
  • Houston, Texas

We have multiple positions and locations available; please refer to all openings posted and apply to the locations that are most suitable for your living situation during the course of your internship. This is not a remote position.

About EPX at DLR Group

As an intern at DLR Group, you’ll be part of our Emerging Professional Experience (EPX) Program, designed to give you a meaningful introduction to life within an integrated design firm and a strong foundation for your career in the AEC industry.

Each person at DLR Group has a design voice, and EPX gives you opportunities to develop and share yours. Through hands-on project work, mentorship, and learning experiences, you’ll gain exposure to the people, disciplines, and ideas that shape the built environment. You may participate in design discussions, project meetings, site visits, business development efforts, office activities, and other experiences that broaden your understanding of the design profession.

The program combines three core components: mentorship, project work, and weekly learning sessions. Topics may include design culture, sustainability, design technology, communication, marketing and business development, project and resource management, research, equity, career development, and more. Along the way, you’ll hear from leaders and integrated designers across DLR Group and build connections with fellow emerging professionals.

Position Summary

As a Mechanical Engineering Intern at DLR Group, you will be an important part of our integrated design team, contributing to the design of mechanical systems for buildings of various types, sizes, and complexities. Working alongside mechanical engineers and professionals across architecture, engineering, interiors, and other disciplines, you will gain hands-on experience with the design process from early concepts and system development through documentation and construction administration.

Our Summer Internship Program is a paid, full-time opportunity running May 18 through August 6, 2027, and interns are expected to participate for the duration of the program. This is an opportunity to apply what you’ve learned in the classroom, build your technical and professional skills, and contribute your perspective to design solutions that support our brand promise of Elevating the Human Experience through design.

What you will do

  • Work with a licensed engineer designing mechanical systems for new construction and/or building renovation projects
  • Attend design team meetings with a mechanical engineer and observe the coordination that occurs among the team members of a multi-disciplinary design team
  • Assist a mechanical engineer with the design and development of construction documents primarily using Revit
  • Visit an active construction site (contingent on the status of local construction projects)
  • Develop HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection designs from concept through completion

Required Qualifications:

  • Completed at least one year at an ABET-accredited Mechanical Engineering or Architectural Engineering program
  • Experience or interest in BIM (e.g. Autodesk Revit MEP) workflow

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam
  • Interest in architectural building design
  • A third-year student in an accredited engineering program

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

#LI-

DLR Group is an integrated design firm delivering architecture, engineering, interiors, planning, and building optimization for new builds, renovations, and adaptive reuse projects.

We are 100% employee-owned: every employee is literally invested in our clients’ success. At the core of our firm are interdisciplinary teams engaged in every step of project lifecycles. Our teams champion true collaboration, open information sharing, shared risk and reward, value-based decision making, and proficient use of technology to deliver exceptional design. We are pursuing the goals of the 2030 Challenge, the ME2040, and the SE2050, and are an initial signatory of the China Accord and the AIA 2030 Commitment.

Through our values – commitment, creativity, environmental stewardship, fun, integrity, ownership, sharing, teamwork – we elevate the human experience through design, together.

DLR Group follows a four-day in-office work model, with employees having the flexibility to work somewhere other than the office on Fridays.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action/M/F/Veteran/Disabled employer.

title: Sælger på deltid 8-15 timer søges til Tøjeksperten Kolding Storcenter
description:

Vi søger en engageret sælger til en deltidsstilling på 8-15 timer pr. uge.

Om os

Tøjeksperten er en del af Danmarks største herretøjskæde – kendt for god stil, høj kvalitet og personlig service. I vores butikker skaber vi inspirerende miljøer, hvor både kunder og medarbejdere trives. Her arbejder vi tæt sammen og har en kultur præget af fællesskab, engagement og udvikling.

Om jobbet

Som sælger får du en central rolle i butikken og bliver en del af et stærkt team med fokus på gode kundeoplevelser, salg og samarbejde. Du får en spændende hverdag med masser af kundekontakt, visuel butiksoptimering og mulighed for at præge butikkens udtryk og succes.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • Skabe gode og personlige oplevelser for vores kunder
  • Arbejde aktivt med butikkens salgsmål og mersalg

  • Deltage i markedsføring på sociale medier

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

  • En deltidsstilling på 8-15 timer med vagter primært hver 2. lørdag og søndag.

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår med pension, sundhedsforsikring og personalefordele
  • Løbende træning og udvikling – både fagligt og personligt

Er du interesseret?
Så send din ansøgning allerede i dag – vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi finder den rette kandidat.

Opstart
Hurtigst muligt

Spørgsmål?
Kontakt Sales Manager Ole Wogensen på tlf. 72 34 90 47.

title: Director, Package Development
description:
HOURGLASS COSMETICS — Director, Package Development (Hybrid Role)

Connected by creativity and driven by purpose. Hourglass Cosmetics is a vegan and cruelty-free beauty brand, redefining luxury cosmetics with high-performance products, innovative formulas, and award-winning franchises. Recognized by Forbes, Fast Company and Time Magazine as one of the most inventive beauty companies, Hourglass leads the industry with its breakthrough products and its commitment to animal welfare. Founded in 2004, Hourglass is globally available in 32 markets and over 4,600 doors including Sephora, Ulta, Neiman Marcus, Selfridges, Space NK and more. Hourglass became part of the Unilever Prestige division in 2017. Discover more about the Hourglass brand story and mission on our website hourglasscosmetics.com.

The Director of Package Development works collaboratively with the Founder, Product Development, and related cross-functional teams, to develop and execute new color and skincare products from concept through launch. This leadership role manages and supports a team with a solution-oriented and strategic approach to ensure projects meet the intended design, quality, cost, risk, sustainability, functionality, and manufacturability objectives.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Conduct comprehensive feasibility assessments for new packaging concepts and components, evaluating functionality, manufacturability, cost, tooling requirements, development timelines, technical risks, and global consistency.
  • Identify, communicate, and resolve project timeline challenges; provide regular milestone updates and proactively escalate technical or scheduling risks to ensure successful project execution.
  • Provide engineering technical support, expertise, and guidance to the Packaging team.
  • Drive risk mitigation throughout development and validation by partnering cross-functionally to conduct risk assessments and implement corrective actions that support project success.
  • Source and develop both stock and custom primary and secondary packaging solutions, creating detailed supplier briefs and technical specifications.
  • Review, approve, and manage technical drawings, component submissions, and packaging specifications to ensure components meet quality, fit, form function, and aesthetic expectations.
  • Create, maintain, and manage Bill of Materials and review/approve fill & assembly instructions.
  • Manage artwork development processes, including initiating artwork requests and reviewing files for technical accuracy, regulatory compliance, and production readiness prior to release.
  • Lead packaging validation and testing activities, including compatibility, transit, drop, and performance testing; analyze results and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Develop packaging test protocols, validation plans, and cross-functional Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support quality and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with contract manufacturers and production teams to ensure packaging feasibility, optimize manufacturing efficiency, and support line trials, pilot runs, and commercial production.
  • Research and identify innovative packaging formats, sustainable materials, decoration techniques, and emerging technologies that align with brand objectives and business goals.
  • Liaises with Quality and Operations determine root cause, resolution and finding alternatives as needed.
  • Coordinate and manage the development of photo-ready, retailer, and internal meeting comps for NPD.
  • Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships through regular engagement, business reviews, and attendance at industry trade shows and supplier meetings.
  • Manage packaging activities across all stages of product development, including concept evaluation, sourcing, development, sampling, validation, commercialization, line support, and resourcing initiatives.

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF:

  • You are a SELF-STARTER: You thrive in autonomy and are motivated to take initiative.
  • You are DETAIL ORIENTED: You appreciate the importance of having detailed and precise information with an impeccable eye for aesthetics.
  • You are a strong COMMUNICATOR and COLLABORATOR: You work and communicate effectively with all members of the organization, from individual contributors to executive team.
  • You are extremely ORGANIZED: You are not overwhelmed by the thought of tackling multiple tasks.
  • You are RESULTS-ORIENTED. You have a bias for action. When problems arise, you reliably produce responses and thoughtful solutions.
  • You are METICULOUS and ACCURATE. You take pride in being careful and precise with your work.
  • You are STRATEGIC and ADAPTIVE: You can efficiently anticipate, identify and articulate problems in real time. Extremely agile.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum 10 years of package development experience.
  • BA/BS in Packaging Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent.
  • Solid knowledge of the prestige/luxury beauty market and a passion for products, packaging and how they work together.
  • Understanding of packaging sustainability and global compliance.
  • Technical competency in analysis of geometric objects in 2 and 3 dimensions including understanding of clearances, fit and finish of packaging components and subcomponents.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of materials used in the construction and manufacturing of primary, secondary and tertiary packaging including knowledge of decorating techniques and materials used on primary, secondary and tertiary packaging.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of test methods used to validate component/package performance.
  • Highly adaptable and flexible to change with the ability to quickly switch gears.
  • Exceptional project management experience.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and tasks with precision and detail.
  • Solid problem-solving skills, analytical skills and business acumen.
  • Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong working knowledge of MS Suite products (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and project management platforms.
  • Must be able to work from Corporate Office at least 60% of the time.

The expected base salary range for this position is $135,000 to $145,000 per year. The exact base salary is determined by various factors including experience, skills, education, geographic location, and budget.

This position is also eligible for participation in the company discretionary bonus plan, based on personal performance and company results.

In addition to base salary, Hourglass Cosmetics offers a competitive benefits package to eligible employees, including medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, disability insurance, retirement savings plans and company match, paid family leave, education-related programs, paid holidays, discretionary vacation time, and more.

Hourglass is an organization committed to diversity and inclusion to drive its business results and to create a better future every day for its diverse employees, global consumers, partners and communities. If you are an individual with a disability and need accommodation in order to apply for a job listing, please contact us at 310-392-7799 or careers@hourglasscosmetics.com.

title: Creative Executive
description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

The Creative Executive will identify, develop, and oversee scripted film and television projects based on Japanese manga, anime, and novels, taking projects from development through packaging, production, and distribution. Working closely with Studio Japan team members, you will serve as a creative and cultural bridge between Japanese IP partners and U.S. production and studio executives, while championing the integrity of the underlying IP throughout the entire project lifecycle.

In the role of Creative Executive, you will report to the Head of Crunchyroll Storyworks.

We are considering applicants for the location of Los Angeles, CA.

Core Areas of Responsibility

  • Identify, source, and evaluate Japanese manga, anime, and novels for film and television adaptation.
  • Develop an authoritative command of each assigned IP, serving as its leading internal creative expert and advocate to guide informed creative decision-making.
  • Evaluate underlying IP, scripts, pitches, treatments, and outlines for creative quality, commercial potential, and suitability for adaptation.
  • Lead projects through the full creative lifecycle—from development and packaging through production, post-production, and distribution—maintaining a consistent creative vision and protecting the core integrity of the underlying IP at every stage.
  • Develop and package projects with the appropriate writers, directors, lead actors, and producers, and work with internal partners to establish a production scope and budget that support the project's creative vision and commercial objectives.
  • Lead stakeholder conversations toward the optimal balance of three core objectives:
    • Authenticity to the source IP, commercial success, and creative excellence.
    • Clearly articulate a creative point of view.
    • Build alignment among diverse stakeholders, and persuasively advocate for decisions that advance all three objectives.
  • Build and maintain relationships with U.S. writers, directors, producers, actors, agents and managers, while cultivating trusted relationships with Japanese authors, publishers, editors, creators and rights holders in partnership with Studio Japan team members.
  • Serve as a key liaison between Japanese IP partners and U.S. studio executives, producers, and filmmakers, bridging creative intent, cultural context, and development and production practices.
  • Develop and oversee pitches, presentations, and other creative materials, and present projects and recommendations to senior management with a clear, well-supported creative point of view.
  • Engage with fans and relevant audience communities to gather informed feedback and insights, helping identify creative choices that could materially conflict with the core DNA, expectations, and cultural significance of the IP.
  • Collaborate closely with business affairs, legal, finance, production, research, marketing, distribution, and other internal teams throughout the project lifecycle to ensure project objectives are achieved.
  • Track Japanese manga, anime, and publishing trends, audience tastes, and the global film and television marketplace.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

  • 12+ years of relevant experience in scripted film and/or television development and production at a studio, streamer, production company, agency, or management company.
  • Demonstrated ability to shepherd projects from development and talent packaging through production and post-production, with an understanding of budgeting and distribution considerations.
  • Strong creative judgment and understanding of feature-film and episodic storytelling, production, and the global entertainment marketplace.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, adapting, and shepherding established IP into compelling live-action television and/or film.
  • Strong knowledge of Japanese entertainment and the Japanese IP ecosystem, particularly manga, anime, and novels.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build alignment, influence senior executives and creative partners, and drive decisions that balance authenticity, commercial success, and creative excellence.
  • Excellent editorial, analytical, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively across Japanese and American creative and professional environments.
  • Experience adapting Japanese IP for U.S. or global audiences and established relationships within the U.S. and/or Japanese creative communities are strongly preferred.
  • Japanese-language proficiency preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

About the Team

Our Film & Television Creative team identifies, develops, and oversees scripted adaptations of Japanese IP—including manga, anime, and novels—from early development through production and distribution. Based across Tokyo and the U.S., the team partners closely with creators, rights holders, and internal stakeholders to bring culturally authentic, creatively excellent stories to global audiences.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

  • Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
  • Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
  • Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
  • Health Saving Account HSA program
  • Health care and dependent care FSA
  • 401(k) plan, with employer match
  • Employer paid commuter benefit
  • Support program for new parents
  • Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid

The Pay Range for this position is listed. Actual pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Crunchyroll’s Total Rewards offerings for employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, employer matched retirement savings, time-off programs, and progressive health benefits and perks.
Pay Transparency - Los Angeles, CA
$161,500—$201,900 USD

About our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

  • Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

  • Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

  • Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.

  • Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Professional Services Intern - IA (Spring)
description:
Trans Ova Genetics is seeking Professional Services Interns in our Plains region to assist with the beef embryo transfer season. This internship is designed to give students who have a passion for the animal science and reproduction industry, hands-on and real-world experience in reproductive technologies. The primary duty of a Professional Service Intern is to assist veterinarians in performing embryo transfers, conventional embryo flushing, and in-vitro fertilization procedures in both a clinic setting and on farm. Other duties include donor and recipient handling, data entry and assisting embryologist in the handling of fresh and frozen embryos.

Major Areas of Accountability

  • Provide excellent client service both in a clinic and on-farm setting

  • Maintain a professional image reflective of Trans Ova’s industry position

  • Prepare and travel with Professional Service Teams for on-farm transfer trips, including extended overnight stays

  • Prepare collection and transfer areas for procedures

  • Keep production areas clean and well-kept

  • Maintain accurate records of procedures and data entry

  • Maintain high level of accuracy and attention to detail while performing chute-side and lab related tasks

  • Follow Trans Ova’s Standard Operating Procedures and policies

  • Low-stress handling of primarily mature beef cattle and some dairy heifers in holding yards and working facilities

  • Participate in learning opportunities including hands-on wet labs, book club, journal club and case-study project

Qualifications

  • Undergraduate students must have completed their sophomore year and preferably a reproductive physiology course before the internship starts.

  • Current undergraduate (associate or bachelor's degree), recent graduates, graduate students, and veterinary students are encouraged to apply

  • Degrees of study should include animal science, pre-veterinary medicine, agricultural business, or related field

  • Experience with advanced reproductive technologies is recommended but not required

  • Excellent cattle handling with manual or hydraulic chutes

  • Ability to work in adverse/outdoor conditions

  • Good physical mobility and above average strength/conditioning

  • Ability to lift 50 lbs. and be on one’s feet balking or standing for long periods of time

  • Ability to travel, have a valid driver’s license and able to operate a company vehicle

Applications will close on November 6th, 2026.

title: Practitioner Residential
description:
About us

For over 150 years, Anglicare Southern Queensland has been walking alongside Queenslanders, offering care, support, and dignity to those who need it most. By providing a range of support services, including aged care, foster care, family support, homelessness services, youth support and counselling, our mission is to make a lasting impact by fostering hope, independence, and inclusion.

At the heart of everything we do is a simple belief: everyone deserves to be treated with dignity, respect, and care. Join our team today, and make a difference today, tomorrow and together. Be where you are needed. Belong right here.

About the Role:

Anglicare Youth Homelessness Services is a youth housing and support program working with young people and young families aged 16 to 25. The service provides a range of mobile support, short-term and transitional accommodation options, supporting young people to access and maintain safe and stable housing while building the skills, connections and opportunities that are important to their future.

The overall purpose of the Practitioner is to work alongside young people living in our accommodation or in the community. Practitioners provide trauma-informed, strengths-based and person-centred support that recognises each young person’s individual experiences, capabilities, strengths, goals and aspirations.

Using Advantaged Thinking and coaching approaches, the Practitioner will prioritise relationships with young people, creating a safe and respectful environment where young people are supported to identify what matters to them, make informed choices, recognise their strengths, build confidence and develop the skills and connections that support greater independence and long-term housing stability.

The Practitioner will work with young people to explore opportunities in areas such as education, employment, health, wellbeing and community participation, while supporting positive connections with family, natural supports and community where appropriate and guided by the young person.

Practitioners work collaboratively as part of a broader team, sharing responsibility for providing consistent and responsive support to young people. Our short-term accommodation services (Mount Gravatt and Beenleigh) operate within a 24/7 staffing model, recognising that young people may require support at different times. The role also includes participation in an on-call roster for one week approximately every six weeks, providing after-hours guidance and support when required.

The Practitioner will work in accordance with the values and practice frameworks of Anglicare Southern Queensland (Anglicare), bringing their knowledge, experience and professional judgement to a team committed to learning, reflective practice and achieving positive, sustainable outcomes alongside young people.

This is a full-time opportunity within Youth Homelessness Services, working 38 hours per week from our new purpose-built Youth Accommodation service in Beenleigh.

The new service includes 30 semi-independent, one-bedroom units, providing young people with their own private space while having access to support when they need it. Staff are based on the ground floor, creating a supportive presence while respecting each young person’s privacy, choice and growing independence.

The service is designed to be more than a place to stay. Practitioners will work alongside young people to create a welcoming and supportive environment where they can build confidence, strengthen life skills and connections, and work towards their housing, education, employment and personal goals.

Work hours are Monday to Friday, between 6:30am and 8:00pm, with the eight-hour workday able to be negotiated within these hours. Practitioners will work collaboratively with the broader team to provide consistent support across the service.

Responsibilities:

  • Build safe, respectful and trusting relationships with young people, recognising that strong relationships are central to effective support and positive outcomes.
  • Work alongside young people to recognise their strengths, skills, talents and aspirations, supporting them to identify their own goals, make informed choices and take meaningful steps towards the future they want.
  • Use Advantaged Thinking and coaching approaches that encourage reflection, build confidence and capability, and support young people to take increasing ownership of their decisions, goals and journey.
  • Provide trauma-informed, person-centred support that promotes safety, choice, trust, collaboration and empowerment, recognising each young person’s experiences without defining them by those experiences.
  • Support young people to build the practical skills, confidence and connections that contribute to housing stability, greater independence and successful transitions to longer-term housing.
  • Support young people to explore and access opportunities in areas such as education, employment, health, wellbeing, relationships and community participation, based on their individual goals and aspirations.
  • alongside families, natural supports and other significant people where appropriate and guided by the young person, strengthening positive and sustainable support networks.
  • Connect young people with relevant community, government and specialist services, while maintaining strong knowledge of available resources, programs and pathways.
  • Maintain high-quality, timely and respectful documentation that reflects the young person’s voice, strengths, goals, progress and achievements.
  • Work collaboratively with other Practitioners and the broader Youth Homelessness Services team to provide consistent and coordinated support across our accommodation, transitional housing and community-based services.
  • Contribute to service planning and continuous improvement by identifying emerging needs, opportunities and gaps and bringing forward insights gained through working alongside young people.
  • Contribute positively to a team culture that values learning, reflective practice, coaching, shared responsibility and continuous improvement, and supports colleagues to learn and grow together.

Qualifications, Credentials and Other Requirements

  • Current Blue Card (Working with Children)
  • Current Queensland Driver Licence
  • Degree in Social Work, Psychology, Human Services, Behavioural Sciences or similar field and demonstrated practical experience
