title: Enterprise Tools Administrator
description:
Position Details:

Job Title: Enterprise Tools Administrator

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote - occasional on-site presence may be required; participation in an on-call rotation

Dynanet Corporation Overview:

Dynanet started with a focus on IT infrastructure and operations, helping organizations enhance their networks and overcome the limitations of 1990s technology. From strengthening communication channels to introducing innovative ways to collaborate and share information, Dynanet played a crucial role in shaping the early stages of digital transformation. The company’s efforts helped organizations build the very fabric of connectivity that now powers our modern world. Over the last three decades, Dynanet has grown into a trusted partner for organizations looking to innovate boldly and transform seamlessly. While technology continues to evolve and unlock new opportunities, for nearly 30 years, Dynanet remains committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that drive lasting change for its customers. Through agility, foresight, and an unwavering dedication to excellence, Dynanet continues to empower organizations to thrive in a rapidly changing digital landscape. Our story is more than just a story of technology – it’s a story of vision, growth, and transformation that has shaped the past and continues to pave the way for the future.

About the Role:

Dynanet is seeking an Enterprise Tools Administrator to serve as designated Key Personnel on an upcoming federal health agency program providing enterprise agile and collaboration tooling.

This role owns the collaboration and agile toolset that the client's delivery organizations run on - Jira and its plugin ecosystem, Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub Enterprise, and supporting collaboration and messaging platforms - serving a large user population across many delivery teams and an extensive repository portfolio.

The position also carries subject matter expert accountability for Okta as the single sign-on and multi-factor authentication solution across the Atlassian suite and other enterprise applications, including the content management and survey platforms. Identity is the keystone of this role: it is the one component that touches every other tool in the estate.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Administer, configure, integrate, monitor, and upgrade the enterprise project management toolset and supporting plugins, supporting issue management, task management, backlogs, agile management, and reporting.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Okta, administering and maintaining single sign-on and multi-factor authentication across the Atlassian suite and other enterprise applications.
  • Manage user provisioning and deprovisioning, role-based access governance, and least-privilege enforcement across all administered tools, maintaining a current and auditable access control posture.
  • Administer GitHub Enterprise, including organization and repository governance, branch protection policy, and integration with the CI/CD platform.
  • Adopt Infrastructure as Code practice for all tool infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent, with configuration held in version control so environments can be provisioned repeatably and automatically.
  • Develop and maintain automated browser smoke and regression tests and automated API tests for all administered tools, executed through the enterprise CI/CD platform.
  • Develop deployment strategies that achieve no-downtime upgrades and software version updates across the tool estate.
  • Monitor license and TLS certificate expirations and automate certificate rotation using approved certificate authorities.
  • Maintain a catalog of tool APIs with published documentation, authentication, authorization, and monitoring, working with other teams to open APIs for automation and integration.
  • Develop and maintain the operations knowledgebase, including runbooks and standard operating procedures, and build institutional knowledge for each tool to support troubleshooting and debugging.
  • Maintain a valid Authority to Operate for administered tools, following the client's technical life cycle process and supporting security audit activities.
  • Perform security testing for managed tools, including vulnerability scanning, penetration testing coordination, and compliance validation, reporting results to the client and its security officers.
  • Draft and deliver clear user communications regarding tool upgrades, credentialing changes, licensing requirements, and sunset activities, providing advance notice and required user action steps.
  • Adopt robust monitoring and incident response practice for the tool estate and contribute to ongoing cloud cost optimization.
  • Support the phased transition of tool administration responsibility from an incumbent contractor, including configuration assessment, knowledge transfer, and cutover.

Required Professional Skills:

  • Expert-level Atlassian administration experience, including Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management at enterprise scale, with plugin and marketplace app management.
  • Hands-on experience administering an enterprise identity provider - Okta strongly preferred - including SAML and SSO federation, multi-factor authentication policy, and lifecycle provisioning.
  • GitHub Enterprise administration experience, including organization governance, access model design, and repository policy enforcement.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting a large, multi-team user base with formal access governance and auditable controls.
  • Working expertise with Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure as Code for tool infrastructure and configuration management.
  • Experience building automated test coverage for administered applications, including browser automation such as Selenium and API test automation.
  • Experience planning and executing zero-downtime upgrades for business-critical collaboration platforms.
  • Strong scripting ability and comfort working with REST APIs for integration and automation.
  • Ability to write clear end-user communications and operational documentation for a non-technical audience.

Preferred Professional Skills:

  • Prior tool administration within a federal environment subject to Authority to Operate requirements.
  • Experience administering enterprise messaging, digital whiteboard, or comparable collaboration platforms.
  • Familiarity with API gateway platforms such as Kong for API publication, authentication, and monitoring.
  • Experience with Packer, Ansible, or equivalent image and configuration management tooling.
  • Experience supporting authentication integration for content management or survey platforms.
  • Familiarity with federal technical life cycle processes and security control baselines.
  • Relevant certification such as Atlassian Certified Professional, Okta Certified Administrator or Consultant, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate.

Dynanet Team Requirements and Expectations:

  • Possess Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with the ability to prioritize, balance, and effectively advance multiple competing priorities in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to interact in a professional and collaborative manner with fellow Dynanet Teammates and the clients, and business partners that we work with.
  • Ability and desire to challenge and educate yourself to support and advance IT services delivery in the Federal agencies we serve.
  • Excellent judgment and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Respond to team member and client requests via email, MS teams, or other communication means during core business hours.
  • Active listening skills to understand clients' needs, and collaboration skills to work with other developers and designers.

Education/Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline. Additional directly relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of enterprise tool administration experience, including at least four (4) years administering the Atlassian suite at scale.
  • Minimum of two (2) years administering an enterprise single sign-on and multi-factor authentication solution.
  • Candidates must be able to provide a resume suitable for submission as designated Key Personnel.

Employee Benefits Overview:

  • Medical and Dental Insurance
  • Paid Time Off/Holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plans with Matching
  • Remote Work*
  • Paid Training
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Employee Development Program

title: Software Development Engineer - AI and Automation
description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In this role

You will build applied AI and platform solutions that transform manual, repetitive, and human-driven operational processes into reliable automated and agent-driven systems. You will identify opportunities for automation, develop AI agents and orchestration workflows, and turn successful prototypes into secure, observable, production-ready services. Working across Azure, .NET, C#, Python, React, SQL, and modern AI technologies, you will build integrations, APIs, evaluation frameworks, and automation infrastructure while partnering directly with end users and cross-functional stakeholders. This role is well suited for an engineer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity, understands both traditional software engineering and non-deterministic AI systems, and can balance experimentation with production-quality engineering standards.

Responsibilities

  • Identify high-friction operational workflows, quantify the current-state cost, and design automated or agent-driven solutions that improve efficiency, reduce errors, and increase throughput.
  • Build AI agents and intelligent workflows using Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Agent Framework, MCP, and related frameworks.
  • Design multi-step tool use, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop workflows for agentic applications.
  • Replatform prototypes and proofs of concept into secure, scalable, observable, and supportable production services.
  • Design and develop RESTful APIs, tool/function endpoints, and backend services using Azure App Services.
  • Apply prompt engineering, grounding, retrieval, Azure AI Search, and evaluation practices to improve AI system quality and reliability.
  • Build evaluation and quality infrastructure for AI systems, including offline evaluation sets, CI regression gates, drift detection, and release criteria.
  • Develop observability for AI and agentic systems, including quality, cost, latency, tool-call outcomes, and rollback capabilities.
  • Build integrations between internal and external systems while maintaining appropriate human review, approval, and intervention points.
  • Implement secure authentication and authorization using Entra ID, including workload identity, least-privilege access, and delegated permissions.
  • Support privacy, security, accessibility, responsible AI, and compliance assessments for AI-powered solutions.
  • Use Azure DevOps for source control, CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and work tracking.
  • Partner with engineers, program managers, stakeholders, and end users to understand operational processes and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, unit testing, Agile ceremonies, troubleshooting, and debugging across distributed and AI-dependent systems.
  • Evaluate emerging AI and agent technologies and provide practical recommendations for their application.
  • Document workflow architectures, agent behavior and boundaries, integration contracts, and system designs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on cloud-based applications.
  • Strong proficiency with .NET, C#, Python, and SQL for backend development.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI services, including prompt engineering.
  • Experience taking at least one AI-powered feature, agent, or automation into production or near-production and being able to discuss the technical implementation in depth.
  • Demonstrated experience automating real-world workflows through process automation, orchestration, integrations, or agentic tooling.
  • Strong knowledge of Azure App Services, Azure SQL, Logic Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps for version control, build automation, release management, and project tracking.
  • Experience designing secure applications using Entra ID for authentication and authorization.
  • Strong understanding of SQL database design, optimization, and querying.
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and troubleshooting abilities across code, data, configuration, and AI/model behavior.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work directly with end users, gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and iterate based on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience with the client's organization and familiarity with its development practices, technologies, and internal systems.
  • Experience with agent frameworks and orchestration, such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or MCP.
  • Experience with tool design and multi-agent coordination.
  • Experience developing LLM evaluation harnesses, including offline evaluation sets, LLM-as-judge approaches, and automated quality gates.
  • Demonstrated ability to take an internal prototype, hack, or proof of concept and turn it into a supported production service.
  • Experience replacing legacy manual processes through automation, particularly where organizational workflows are complex.
  • Front-end development experience with React.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed systems and multiple integration points.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices and enterprise compliance review processes.

Compensation

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated compensation range is $105000 - $115000 USD annually Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate's qualifications.

Location: Remote EST hours, ideally in the Charlotte, NC area

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Competitive paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

title: Senior/Staff Scientist - Algorithms & Data Products
description:
About SirenOpt

SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks.

SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made.

We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia.

About the job

Job Title: Senior/Staff Scientist - Algorithms & Data Products

Location: On-Site (San Leandro, CA)

Job Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Scientist, Algorithms & Data Products to join our core R&D team, working at the heart of our manufacturing intelligence platform – not in a commercial analytics role. You’ll turn rich plasma sensor signals into trusted metrics and models and to build the automation that powers our next generation of experiments.

In this role you will:

  • Design and build algorithms that map multi‑modal sensor data (optical emission spectra, electrical signals, thermal/other sensors, process context) into robust “material fingerprints” and properties.

  • Work with systems, plasma, and applications engineers to marry hardware and software: designing and automating experiment protocols for our benchtop, inline roll‑to‑roll, and robotic piece‑to‑piece platforms.

  • Shape our first generation of models and metrics for battery electrodes and ceramic barrier coatings, directly influencing what customers see and trust.

This is a high‑impact, hands‑on R&D role at the core of SirenOpt’s technology stack, shaping how we design, run, and learn from our experiments.

What You'll Do

  • Own end to end modeling pipelines from raw sensor data to customer facing metrics and alerts.

  • Develop multi modal representations of plasma-material interactions that generalize across different materials, geometries, and processes.

  • Design and implement automated experimental protocols (parameter sweeps, DOE campaigns, calibration routines) that coordinate plasma hardware, motion/robotics, sensing, and data capture.

  • Work with embedded, controls, and software engineers to design deployment architectures across edge devices, host controllers, and cloud systems.

  • Define performance metrics, validation strategies, and monitoring for models running in benchtop products and pilot manufacturing lines.

  • Own the trustworthiness of our data – interrogate raw and derived data for instrument artifacts, drift and silent pipeline failures, and build the checks that catch a bad result before it reaches a model, a customer metric, a disclosure, or a paper.

What We're Looking For

  • Advanced degree (PhD or MS with substantial experience) in a quantitative field such as physics, applied mathematics, statistics, electrical engineering, computer science, or similar, with a strong focus on data analysis and modeling.

  • 6+ years of hands on experience (industry or postdoc) building models for real world sensor or process data, not just web/NLP/recommender systems.

  • A track record of catching problems in data that others missed – artifacts, drift, miscalibration, or a pipeline quietly producing plausible nonsense.

  • Strong Python skills and experience with scientific computing/ML tooling (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit learn; familiarity with PyTorch or similar is a plus).

  • Demonstrated ability to design and execute end to end analysis workflows: data ingestion and cleaning, feature engineering, model training, validation, and reporting.

  • Experience with at least one of: spectroscopy, imaging, time series/multivariate process data, or other high dimensional measurement modalities.

  • Solid grounding in statistics (hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, experimental design, control charts, etc.) and comfort reasoning about uncertainty and robustness.

  • Experience designing or implementing automated experimental workflows or test rigs that integrate hardware and software (e.g., lab automation, instrument control, hardware in the loop setups, industrial test stands).

  • Proven ability to communicate technical results clearly, in writing and in person, to both technical and non technical stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in lab and/or industrial environments: dealing with noisy data, incomplete logging, and partially instrumented systems.

Nice to have:

  • Comfort working with hardware APIs (e.g., vendor SDKs, REST/gRPC services, serial/fieldbus interfaces) from Python or similar, and reasoning about timing, synchronization, and error handling.

  • Experience with multi‑modal data fusion (combining spectral, imaging, and process data) or related techniques in domains such as autonomous systems, medical imaging, or industrial inspection.

  • Background in plasma physics, optical diagnostics, materials science, or related fields - or strong interest and ability to learn these areas quickly.

  • Experience deploying models into edge or real‑time systems with latency and reliability constraints.

  • Familiarity with lab automation or experiment orchestration tools (e.g., custom Python control scripts, LabVIEW, PLC/SCADA, or equivalent), and interest in building lightweight, code‑driven alternatives.

  • Experience with experiment tracking, MLOps, or data‑centric tooling (e.g., MLFlow, Weights & Biases, DVC) and modern software engineering practices (Git, code reviews, CI/CD).

  • Prior work with battery manufacturing, roll‑to‑roll processes, or high‑temperature coatings (e.g., turbine components) is a strong plus.

Base Pay Range
$140,000—$190,000 USD

Benefits

  • Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience
  • Health, Dental, Vision plans provided
  • 401k matching provided
  • Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

The Opportunity:


FEMA Identity and Access Management (IAM) Modernization

CACI is seeking a Senior Okta Engineer to join our team on a contract supporting the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) - Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (OCISO), Operations Division. The Senior Okta Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise identity and access management solutions that support FEMA's mission-critical operations. This role involves strategic planning, technical design, workflow automation, and integration support across FEMA's IAM infrastructure as the agency transitions to Okta-based identity solutions.


What You'll Get to Do:

Your focus will be on Okta platform implementation, ServiceNow integration, identity consolidation, and security enhancements. Responsibilities include:

  • Design, develop, and implement Okta workflows and APIs to automate access requests, approvals, provisioning, and deprovisioning for internal and external users
  • Integrate Okta with ServiceNow to enable seamless access lifecycle management and approval routing
  • Refactor ServiceNow catalog items to leverage Okta APIs and workflows
  • Support the transition from FEIMS to Okta as the authoritative source for FEMA identity attributes
  • Design and implement attribute management processes, including bulk import templates and standardization of attribute values
  • Consolidate identities and eliminate free-form text errors through predefined attribute values
  • Extend Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) implementation across all FEMA applications
  • Implement role-based access control (RBAC) solutions aligned with Zero Trust principles
  • Support automated attestation campaigns and privileged account reviews to address Notice of Findings and Recommendations (NFRs)
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including integration guides, bulk import templates, and attribute management procedures
  • Create standard operating procedures (SOPs) for Okta administration and workflows
  • Provide knowledge transfer and training to FEMA staff to ensure sustainability of IAM operations
  • Participate in project planning sessions, status meetings, and milestone reviews
  • Provide regular progress reports and technical recommendations to client stakeholders
  • Acts as a subject matter expert resource to FEMA on Okta processes, workflows, configuration, and implementation best practices
  • Collaborates with peers to resolve technical issues and improve IAM solution quality

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field + 15 years of experience
  • Experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Hands-on experience with Okta platform implementation and administration
  • **Okta Certified Professional** or **Okta Certified Administrator** (required)
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Okta workflows and API integrations
  • Strong technical expertise in Okta Universal Directory, Lifecycle Management, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and API Access Management
  • Experience integrating Okta with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
  • Proficient in RESTful APIs, JSON, and OAuth/OIDC protocols
  • Experience with enterprise identity consolidation and migration projects
  • Strong understanding of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, and LDAP protocols
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages
  • Knowledge of NIST frameworks, Zero Trust Architecture, RBAC, and federal compliance requirements (FISMA, FedRAMP)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with clients and cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrated experience in federal government or highly regulated environments
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to changing requirements

- TS/SCI Clearance


Desired:

  • Additional Okta certifications (Okta Certified Consultant, Okta Certified Developer)
  • CISSP, CISM, Security+, or other relevant security certifications
  • Experience with FEMA systems or Department of Homeland Security (DHS) environment
  • Experience with privileged access management (PAM) solutions
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, Azure AD, and hybrid identity environments
  • Experience with attestation and access certification campaigns
  • Previous federal government contracting experience

-

title: Practitioner Residential
description:
About us
For over 150 years, Anglicare Southern Queensland has been walking alongside Queenslanders, offering care, support, and dignity to those who need it most. By providing a range of support services, including aged care, foster care, family support, homelessness services, youth support and counselling, our mission is to make a lasting impact by fostering hope, independence, and inclusion.

At the heart of everything we do is a simple belief: everyone deserves to be treated with dignity, respect, and care. Join our team today, and make a difference today, tomorrow and together. Be where you are needed. Belong right here.

About the Role:

Anglicare Youth Homelessness Services is a youth housing and support program working with young people and young families aged 16 to 25. The service provides a range of mobile support, short-term and transitional accommodation options, supporting young people to access and maintain safe and stable housing while building the skills, connections and opportunities that are important to their future.

The overall purpose of the Practitioner is to work alongside young people living in our accommodation or in the community. Practitioners provide trauma-informed, strengths-based and person-centred support that recognises each young person’s individual experiences, capabilities, strengths, goals and aspirations.

Using Advantaged Thinking and coaching approaches, the Practitioner will prioritise relationships with young people, creating a safe and respectful environment where young people are supported to identify what matters to them, make informed choices, recognise their strengths, build confidence and develop the skills and connections that support greater independence and long-term housing stability.

The Practitioner will work with young people to explore opportunities in areas such as education, employment, health, wellbeing and community participation, while supporting positive connections with family, natural supports and community where appropriate and guided by the young person.

Practitioners work collaboratively as part of a broader team, sharing responsibility for providing consistent and responsive support to young people. Our short-term accommodation services (Mount Gravatt and Beenleigh) operate within a 24/7 staffing model, recognising that young people may require support at different times. The role also includes participation in an on-call roster for one week approximately every six weeks, providing after-hours guidance and support when required.

The Practitioner will work in accordance with the values and practice frameworks of Anglicare Southern Queensland (Anglicare), bringing their knowledge, experience and professional judgement to a team committed to learning, reflective practice and achieving positive, sustainable outcomes alongside young people.

This is a full-time opportunity within Youth Homelessness Services, working 38 hours per week and primarily based at our Mount Gravatt Youth Accommodation service.

The service provides a supportive, home-like environment for young people, with a Practitioner working alongside them to build confidence, strengthen life skills and connections, and work towards their housing, education, employment and personal goals.

The role also provides support to young people living in our transitional accommodation properties in Mount Gravatt and Beenleigh, helping create continuity of support as young people move towards greater independence and longer-term housing stability.

Using trauma-informed, Advantaged Thinking and coaching approaches, Practitioners build genuine relationships with young people, recognise their strengths and aspirations, and support them to make informed choices and take increasing ownership of their future.

Responsibilities:

  • Build safe, respectful and trusting relationships with young people, recognising that strong relationships are central to effective support and positive outcomes.
  • Work alongside young people to recognise their strengths, skills, talents and aspirations, supporting them to identify their own goals, make informed choices and take meaningful steps towards the future they want.
  • Use Advantaged Thinking and coaching approaches that encourage reflection, build confidence and capability, and support young people to take increasing ownership of their decisions, goals and journey.
  • Provide trauma-informed, person-centred support that promotes safety, choice, trust, collaboration and empowerment, recognising each young person’s experiences without defining them by those experiences.
  • Support young people to build the practical skills, confidence and connections that contribute to housing stability, greater independence and successful transitions to longer-term housing.
  • Support young people to explore and access opportunities in areas such as education, employment, health, wellbeing, relationships and community participation, based on their individual goals and aspirations.
  • alongside families, natural supports and other significant people where appropriate and guided by the young person, strengthening positive and sustainable support networks.
  • Connect young people with relevant community, government and specialist services, while maintaining strong knowledge of available resources, programs and pathways.
  • Maintain high-quality, timely and respectful documentation that reflects the young person’s voice, strengths, goals, progress and achievements.
  • Work collaboratively with other Practitioners and the broader Youth Homelessness Services team to provide consistent and coordinated support across our accommodation, transitional housing and community-based services.
  • Contribute to service planning and continuous improvement by identifying emerging needs, opportunities and gaps and bringing forward insights gained through working alongside young people.
  • Contribute positively to a team culture that values learning, reflective practice, coaching, shared responsibility and continuous improvement, and supports colleagues to learn and grow together.

Qualifications, Credentials and Other Requirements

  • Current Blue Card (Working with Children)
  • Current Queensland Driver Licence
  • Degree in Social Work, Psychology, Human Services, Behavioural Sciences or similar field and demonstrated practical experience

What happens now?
Apply now by sending us your current resume, cover letter and answering a few screening questions.

We want to ensure all applicants have the opportunity to present their best selves, if you require any adjustments to the recruitment process or require further information please contact: Jacinta Fuss – jfuss@anglicaresq.org.au

Anglicare is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and encourages applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, those from cultural and linguistically diverse backgrounds, LGBTIQ+ communities, people with disabilities and people with a lived experience of mental health. We promote a child-safe environment and are committed to providing on-going care and protection.

title: Night FA Technician I, Maintenance
description:
We awaken the world with energy.

LG Energy Solution is the global leader in lithium-ion battery technology for electric vehicles and energy storage solutions. Located in Queen Creek, Arizona, LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. is LG Group's first cylindrical battery manufacturer in North America, leading the widespread distribution of electric vehicles with the most advanced battery technology in the world.

Join us as we inspire our talent with growth, challenge, action and collaboration to Empower Every Possibility!

Job Summary

The FA (Factory Automation) Technician I supports the safe, reliable operation and maintenance of factory automation and automated material-handling systems under the guidance of experienced technicians and engineers. This entry-level position performs routine inspections, preventive maintenance, basic troubleshooting, component replacement, and approved equipment recovery procedures. Complex controls, software, communication, and safety-related issues are documented and escalated to the appropriate technical owner.

Responsibilities

  • Perform routine inspections and scheduled preventive maintenance on factory automation equipment using established procedures and checklists.
  • Inspect and monitor AMRs/AGVs, conveyors, stockers, lifters, transfer equipment, sensors, motors, actuators, barcode readers, and related automation systems for abnormal conditions.
  • Assist technicians and engineers with basic mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, sensor, and equipment-control troubleshooting.
  • Perform approved alarm resets, Manual/Auto transitions, and basic equipment recovery procedures within the authorized scope of work.
  • Support replacement of worn or damaged components, as well as equipment cleaning, lubrication, and adjustment.
  • Monitor equipment screens and alarms, including PLC, HMI, ACS, MCS, MES, and CIM interfaces, and escalate issues outside the authorized scope.
  • Support equipment installation, teaching, mapping, docking, PIO, interface testing, commissioning, and production activities under supervision.
  • Accurately document equipment conditions, alarms, repairs, PM activities, test results, and open issues; communicate equipment status during shift handoffs.
  • Read and follow basic mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, equipment manuals, work instructions, and maintenance procedures.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Basic knowledge of manufacturing equipment, factory automation, industrial maintenance, or a related technical field.
  • Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical components used in automated equipment.
  • Ability to safely use common hand tools, power tools, and basic electrical measurement devices.
  • Ability to read and follow equipment manuals, electrical/mechanical documentation, safety procedures, checklists, and work instructions.
  • Basic computer skills for reviewing alarms, entering work orders, and completing maintenance documentation.
  • Ability to follow direction, communicate equipment conditions clearly, and work effectively with technicians, engineers, production, and maintenance teams.
  • Ability to identify abnormal equipment conditions and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Ability to work nights, rotating shifts, overtime, weekends, or holidays as required.
  • Commitment to safety, continuous learning, and working effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Able to frequently stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch, twist, and reach.
  • Ability to wear required PPE, including safety glasses, steel-toed footwear, hearing protection, protective gloves, clean-room garments, and other PPE required by the work area.
  • Must be able to work over night shift on compressed work schedule, including weekends (Saturday and/or Sunday) as the schedule requires.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical certificate, vocational training, or coursework in automation, electrical technology, electronics, mechanical systems, mechatronics, robotics, or industrial maintenance.
  • Previous experience in manufacturing, production, warehouse automation, equipment maintenance, or a similar technical environment.
  • Exposure to AMR/AGV, conveyor, stocker, sensor, motor, pneumatic, PLC, or HMI systems.
  • Basic familiarity with MES, MCS, ACS, CIM, or other manufacturing automation systems.

Skills

  • Basic mechanical and electrical aptitude.
  • Basic troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to follow written procedures, checklists, and escalation requirements.
  • Attention to detail and accurate documentation.
  • Clear verbal and written communication.
  • Teamwork and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Time management and task prioritization.
  • Willingness to learn new automation systems and technical processes.
  • Safety-focused approach to equipment operation and maintenance.
  • Ability to work effectively under the direction of experienced technicians and engineers.

Why should you work here?

1. Growth - You are a self-driven individual who seeks and captures the opportunities for growth we offer by acquiring and solving tasks.

2. Challenge - You reach beyond expectations and strive for innovative methods beyond the traditional.

3. Action - You are driven, take initiative, can execute decisions with agility and fulfill tasks to completion.

4. Collaboration - You are enthusiastic about teamwork while respecting the different backgrounds and experience of colleagues.

EEO Statement

LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

title: Harness Design Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
About the role

Muon seeks a Harness Design Intern to join our electrical engineering team. The ideal candidate is someone who has gained familiarity with harnessing through student clubs or internships and has some programming background. The goal is to advance your harness design skills during the internship and then use those skills to build really cool tools. Is there a way we can build an AI agent to review our harness drawings and make sure we don’t make basic errors? Is there a way we can create a harnessing agent to interact with the API of our programs and design harnesses? These are the types of questions we want you to answer during your internship!

Responsibilities

  • Work on new tooling and improve the workflows associated with harness design
  • Experiment with AI to update and modify drawings
  • Create harness drawings, BOMs and maintain system diagrams

  • Gather feedback from AIT, EE and Mechanical for initial designs and improvements
  • Work with electrical engineering to ensure compliance with signal integrity, grounding, and shielding requirements
  • Release documentation into PLM with ECO/DCO
  • Define electrical test criteria (e.g., continuity, insulation resistance, hipot) for flight and test harnesses. Support or oversee test execution and documentation

Qualifications

  • Attention to detail, strong reading comprehension and a desire for ownership
  • Familiarity with creating harness drawings in any software
  • Ability to use the linux terminal, basic git tools, LLMs with MCPs, python programming
  • Ability to build harnesses from scratch - not required daily but helps inform strip lengths, crimper positioners and settings, splicing techniques, heatshrink selection, torque values etc.
  • Excited to work in a fast-paced environment with new challenges each week

Nice-to-have Skills

  • Previous internship or co-op experience
  • Previous experience on student teams (i.e. Rocketry club, formula SAE, solar car, etc.)
  • Experience designing harnesses with high reliability requirements
  • Experience with RF cable build and characterization
  • Experience building agents and using AI to complete engineering tasks

PhD $50/hour

title: Retail Senior Client Lead

  • Identify opportunities to expand dunnhumby capabilities and contribute to revenue growth and renewals.

  • Experience owning retailer relationships in a client-facing, insight or consulting environment.
  • Strong understanding of retail priorities, customer strategy and commercial decision-making.
  • Ability to interpret insight and communicate clear, influential recommendations.
  • Confidence managing multiple stakeholders, priorities and delivery commitments.

What You Can Expect From Us

We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

title: Senior Staff Cloud FinOps Analyst
description:
Team

Join the Global Cloud Services organization and manage Public Cloud Cost & Usage governance team.

Bring your expertise in managing migration to Public Cloud and work with an exceptional team experienced in across cloud engineers, customer experience, product managers, data engineers and capture immense value.

Role

This role will be responsible for establishing long range plan and monthly forecast of public cloud cost & usage, identifying and tracking optimization opportunities, working closely with engineering teams to ensure efficient resource usage and working with sales team on customer migration planning and tracking. This role will also handle commit-based-discount coverage & utilization, cost & usage tool dashboarding. The position will report to the Director of Cloud FinOps.

  • Manage commit-based-discounts to optimize long-term costs

  • Define and implement cost allocations to measure unit-metrics of cost per customer and cost per instance
  • Define and promote best practices for cloud cost governance

title: Stability & Documentation Manager - R&D
description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We're looking for a Stability & Documentation Manager to join our Gummy R&D team. While our formulation team is focused on getting a gummy to taste and perform the way it should, this role is focused on proving it stays that way, and keeping every document that defines a SKU accurate and current.

You'll design and run the stability testing program across our gummy portfolio, determine test method compatibility, and negotiate directly with the labs we use for testing. You'll also be responsible for the full document suite on every SKU, including specs and SFPs, and you'll be the one staging specifications and signing off on them. This position reports to the Director, R&D and sits within the Product organization. Built for someone from formulation or product development who's ready to step into a role centered on judgment and accountability.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Run the stability testing program for the gummy portfolio, including setting up protocols, timepoints, tracking results against shelf-life targets, and presenting data to relevant stakeholders as it rolls in.
  • Decide whether a proposed or existing test method is actually right for a given matrix, and push back or find something better when it isn't.
  • Handle price and scope negotiations with third-party testing labs.
  • Review and maintain the document suite for every SKU, including specs, SFPs, and anything that feeds into them, so it stays accurate and audit ready.
  • Stage product specifications from draft through final sign-off.
  • Catch stability or documentation issues early, things like ingredient degradation, off-notes developing over time, or packaging interactions, before they turn into a launch or quality problem.
  • Collect and review formulation and ingredient document for assessment
  • Work with Quality, Operations, and our co-manufacturers to keep specs, test methods, and stability protocols consistent across the supply chain.
  • Keep a clean paper trail across the document suite so any SKU's history can be reconstructed if needed.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 4+ years in R&D, quality, or product development in supplements, food, or a similar regulated category, ideally with gummy or confectionery experience.
  • Has designed and run stability studies, not just reviewed them, including validating test methods for complex matrices.
  • Knows enough about gummy chemistry to tell when a test method won't hold up, whether that's a detection limit issue, matrix interference, or the wrong extraction method.
  • Has negotiated with contract testing labs before, on price, scope, or turnaround.
  • Is comfortable owning specs end to end and signing off on them.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Chemistry, or a related field.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, serve as primary owner of document accuracy.
  • Can communicate clearly with cross-functional teams, co-manufacturers, and outside labs.

Approach to the role:

This person treats stability data and documentation as the actual source of truth, not paperwork to get through. They're comfortable signing off, pushing back, or saying "not yet" on their own, without needing someone else to make the call first. They build processes that hold up across SKUs instead of solving the same problem every time it comes up, and they negotiate well with labs while keeping everyone else in the loop on where specs and stability stand.

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $115,000 -$130,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

title: Product Manager - C3 Code
description:
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: C3 AI

C3 Code is our agentic platform for building full-stack applications: describe what you want in natural language and get production software and domain-specific AI applications, with the security, governance, and scale enterprises require. Organizations use C3 Code to build the mission-critical apps that run their most complex operations, across industries such as manufacturing, energy, defense, and financial services. It's one of the fastest-growing products at C3, and we're just getting started.

This is a builder's role for someone who wants to drive one of C3's fastest-growing motions, not just plan it. You'll own how users go from idea to a working, deployed application, and you'll move fast: shipping, measuring, and iterating on the loops that turn first-time builders into daily, expanding usage. You'll shape how our agents reason and build, work shoulder to shoulder with customers and forward deployed engineering, and partner across engineering, data science, design, and go-to-market. This is the frontier of applied AI, where the best practices are still being written.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive a fast-growing product motion end to end, own the roadmap for your area, ship quickly, and iterate on what the data tells you.
  • Shape how C3 Code's coding agents reason and build: the harness that orchestrates them, the skills that extend what they can do, and the MCP connections that let them reach the tools, data, and systems enterprises run on.
  • Define evals and success metrics for agent accuracy, reliability, and task completion, and use traces and model outputs to decide what to improve next
  • Define the user journey for our ideal customer profile and target industries, through to the mission-critical apps they build on C3 Code that run on strong optimization engines and ML models.
  • Own the product-led growth loop, from activation and onboarding to conversion and retention, turning first-time builders into teams that use C3 Code every day.
  • Triage and synthesize customer feedback and feature requests, turning an influx of input into the few changes that move the product most.
  • Work directly with enterprise customers and forward deployed engineering to understand real workflows and translate them into product requirements.
  • Support day-to-day go-to-market motions, including customer demos, workshops, and marketing events, so the capabilities you ship get adopted and spread.

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years in product management, with a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence, not authority.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software and what large organizations require to trust it: security, authentication and access control (SSO, RBAC), governance and admin controls, compliance, data privacy, integrations, and flexible deployment, so the AI apps your users build on C3 Code meet that bar by default.
  • A bias for execution: you ship fast, make calls at the pace of a fast-growing product, and don't wait for perfect information.
  • Technical fluency: you reason about application architecture and APIs, understand how LLMs, agents, tool use, and evals fit together, and read model outputs and traces with confidence.
  • Hands-on understanding of agentic systems: planning loops, multi-step reasoning, tool use, and how agents fail and recover.
  • Customer-obsessed: you talk to users constantly and can synthesize a flood of feedback into the few things that matter.
  • Clear, concise communicator who aligns engineering, design, and go-to-market without formal authority.
  • Experience with developer tools, product-led SaaS, or self-serve products at scale is preferred.
  • Domain exposure in areas C3 serves (supply chain, sustainability, defense, financial services, and similar) is preferred.
  • Hands-on product-led growth experience: you've owned activation, onboarding, conversion, or retention and moved the metrics is preferred.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future company sponsorship.

C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan.

$132,000—$194,000 USD

title: UI/UX Designer | AI Powered Products
description:
Help shape the experience behind the next generation of AI powered internal tools.

We’re looking for a versatile UI/UX Designer to elevate the usability, design quality, and visual identity of a growing portfolio of AI powered tools.

You’ll join a Product Operations team working across multiple high priority initiatives and play a key role in making sure the products being built are not only functional and reliable, but intuitive, polished, visually cohesive, and easy to adopt.

This is a highly collaborative, hands on role with ownership across UX research, product design, prototyping, visual design, branding, and design systems. You’ll work directly with users, builders, product partners, and stakeholders to uncover friction, turn insights into thoughtful experiences, and create the design foundation that connects multiple products into one cohesive portfolio.

What You’ll Do

Design Research & User Insights | 40%

• Bring products directly to users, including internal teams and product partners, to gather structured feedback and uncover opportunities for improvement

• Plan and conduct usability testing for existing and in development AI tools

• Translate research findings into clear, prioritized product and design recommendations

• Identify adoption friction, usability gaps, and unmet user needs

• Build and maintain a research repository that can help inform future product and roadmap decisions

Product Design & Prototyping | 25%

• Turn research and user needs into thoughtful, actionable product experiences

• Create user flows, wireframes, design specifications, high fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes

• Design new products and features while improving existing experiences

• Lead design reviews and provide recommendations for proposed product changes

• Use prototypes to create stakeholder alignment and accelerate decision making before development

Visual & Graphic Design | 20%

• Help define and own the visual identity across a portfolio of internal products

• Create logos and visual identities for internal tools and services

• Develop graphics, illustrations, interface assets, and supporting visual content

• Design marketing and launch materials that help drive awareness and adoption of new products

Design Systems | 15%

• Build and maintain an internal design system from components and interaction patterns to style guidelines and reusable standards

• Create visual and interaction consistency across multiple products

• Develop documentation that enables builders and team members to create cohesive experiences without requiring a designer at every step

Front End Contribution

• Contribute directly to lightweight builds through vibe coding, particularly for marketing pages, brand experiences, and focused front end projects

• Help translate design intent into polished user experiences

• Establish design standards and patterns that can be applied across vibecoded web applications

Collaboration & Enablement

• Partner closely with builders, Product Operations team members, product partners, and cross functional stakeholders

• Translate user needs and adoption challenges into clearly scoped design opportunities

• Manage multiple concurrent projects and design requests while prioritizing work based on impact

• Document research methods, design standards, and system patterns so teams can apply them independently

Required Qualifications

• 3 to 5+ years of UI/UX or Product Design experience, ideally supporting internal tools, enterprise products, or B2B experiences

• Strong portfolio demonstrating experience across UX research, interaction design, product design, and visual or graphic design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma, including design specifications, prototyping, components, and design systems

• Experience establishing design standards for modern web applications, including vibecoded experiences

• Ability to manage multiple products and design requests simultaneously while prioritizing based on business and user impact

• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to clearly document design decisions and standards

• Self directed and comfortable ramping quickly in a fast moving environment

Portfolio links must be included on the resume.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building or maintaining a design system from the ground up

• Experience designing AI powered, generative AI, or agent based products

• Familiarity with front end frameworks and component libraries

• Experience creating brand identities and launch materials for product rollouts

• Experience designing internal tools used by technical, operational, or product teams

This is more than a traditional UI/UX design position. You’ll have the opportunity to influence how an expanding portfolio of AI tools looks, feels, and works.

You’ll move between research, product thinking, visual design, prototyping, and design systems while partnering directly with the people building and using these products.

For a designer who enjoys creating structure where it doesn’t yet exist, solving complex UX problems, and helping define how AI powered products should be experienced, this role offers significant ownership and visibility.

Key Skills

UI/UX Design • Product Design • UX Research • User Research • Usability Testing • Figma • Wireframing • Interactive Prototyping • High Fidelity Mockups • Design Systems • Component Libraries • Interaction Design • Visual Design • Graphic Design • AI Product Design • Generative AI • Agent Based Products • Internal Tools • B2B Products • Vibe Coding • Front End Design • Brand Identity • Product Launch Design

title: Test Pilot
description:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Conduct all elements of trip planning and dispatching transport category aircraft

YOU MUST HAVE:

• Type rating (or military equivalent) in large turbine aircraft
• Hold an FAA ATP Airplane Multi-Engine Land or can attain it with the next type rating
• Ability to hold a First-Class Medical
• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering or related field
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• DER certification

• Passion for aviation and commitment to safety
• Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic work environment

• Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
• Short-term and long-term disability coverage
• 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts

• Parental leave and 12 paid holidays

At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space. We operate through three business areas:

title: VCARB F1 Team - Junior Composite Designer (Tooling)
description:
COMPOSITE TOOL DESIGN

Design and develop composite tooling solutions, including patterns, moulds, bonding jigs, machining fixtures, lamination tools and direct moulds, to support the manufacture of F1 car components & pit equipment.

Translate component design definitions into robust, efficient and manufacturable tooling strategies, ensuring repeatability, accuracy and quality in production.

Work in close collaboration with Composite and Mechanical Design Engineers to enable parallel progression of component and tooling design, reducing overall concept-to-release lead times.

Act as the technical owner of tooling design, ensuring solutions are optimised for: manufacturability, ease of use in production, dimensional control and repeatability, durability and lifecycle performance

Drive standardisation and reuse of tooling concepts, components and methodologies, contributing to improved consistency, reduced rework and more efficient decision-making.

Collaborate closely with Production, CAD/CAM and Manufacturing Engineering teams to ensure tooling designs are aligned with manufacturing processes, machine capabilities and factory constraints.

Under supervision of leadership and more senior designers, ensure tooling designs are fully documented and released in line with project requirements, including clear definition of: manufacturing intent, assembly and usage requirements , inspection and validation criteria.

Identify and resolve tooling-related issues arising during manufacture, build and part production, ensuring timely feedback and implementation of corrective actions.

Establish and maintain strong feedback loops from production and inspection, using lessons learned to continuously improve tooling design quality and efficiency.

Support the development of tooling design standards, best practices and design rules (DORs) within the tooling team.

Contribute to the reduction of tooling lead time and overall programme risk by proactively managing workload, identifying critical paths and prioritising key deliverables in agreement and with guidance from the Line Manager.

Maintain effective and collaborative communication across all stakeholders, ensuring clear handover of tooling designs into production and alignment with project timing and objectives.

Demonstrate flexibility and commitment to delivery, supporting both planned development activities and urgent manufacturing requirements as needed.

What We Offer

Working in a young, collaborative and international environment.

Tailored training.

Company Events / Briefings.

Onsite Gym.

Bonus scheme.

Annual salary review process.

Meal Tickets.

Free additional health insurance.

Your Application

Once you’ve submitted your application, you’ll most likely receive an invitation to complete the Red Bull Wingfinder assessment. Taking the test is not mandatory for your application to be reviewed; however, we strongly recommend completing it, as it’s a great way to better understand your own strengths and potential!

Due to the very high volume of applications, we’re unfortunately not able to provide individual feedback or application status updates, except for candidates who have interviewed with our team.

In line with pay transparency regulations (Legislative Decree 96/2026), the minimum fixed salary for this role is the contractual minimum set by the National Collective Labour Agreement for the Metalworking Industry (Federmeccanica/Assistal) for classification level C3. We specify that the above mentioned level is a minimum threshold and does not correspond to the overall compensation package, which is determined by objective, measurable and gender-neutral criteria, being significantly higher than the contractual minimum indicated.

University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or a related field.

Previous working or Formula SAE experience in tooling design for composite manufacturing, with a proven track record of delivering moulds, patterns, jigs, fixtures and lamination tooling solutions.

Strong academic knowledge of composite materials and manufacturing processes, including layup, curing, bonding, machining and assembly, with the ability to apply this knowledge to the design of robust and efficient tooling.

Good understanding of tooling design principles, including dimensional control, tolerancing, material selection, durability and lifecycle considerations, and the impact of tooling on part quality and repeatability.

Good understanding of Design for Manufacture (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA), with the ability to translate component design intent into practical, manufacturable tooling solutions.

Proficiency in CAD design using Siemens NX; CATIA or similar CAD systems are acceptable although less preferred.

Familiarity with CAD/CAM integration and manufacturing workflows, including interaction with CNC machining, inspection processes and production environments.

title: Associate Scientist II, Immunoassay Development
description:
Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!

Vaxcyte is a clinical-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance.
WHAT we do is every bit as important as HOW we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values:
*RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re-innovate the way vaccines are delivered.
*AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind.
*LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives.
*MODEL EXCELLENCE: The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making.

Summary:

Vaxcyte is seeking an accomplished Associate Scientist II, Immunoassay Development to join the CMC Immunoassay group. This role will provide scientific and strategic leadership for the development, qualification, characterization, governance, and lifecycle management of critical reagents and reference materials that support immunoassays across Vaxcyte's vaccine pipeline.


The Associate Scientist will work closely with scientists, senior scientists, and laboratory leaders to execute immunoassays, support fit-for-purpose method development, assist with troubleshooting studies, and contribute to high-quality laboratory documentation and data integrity.

Essential Functions:

  • Perform hands-on assay execution to support immunoassay development, optimization, platform evaluation, routine testing, method transfer support, and under direct supervision, validation readiness, and lifecycle activities.
  • Engage daily in laboratory operations, including reagent preparation, sample handling, plate or bead preparation, instrument operation, assay setup, data capture, documentation, and laboratory organization.
  • Execute immunoassays supporting potency, antigenicity, identity, impurity, characterization, comparability, release, stability, and development-stage analytical needs.
  • Support experiments using ELISA, MSD, bead-based assays, multiplex assays, electrochemiluminescence-based assays, or other ligand-binding assay formats.
  • Prepare reagents, buffers, samples, plates, beads, assay controls, reference materials, and other materials required for immunoassay testing.
  • Generate and summarize assay data, including standard curves, sample response, dilution response, recovery, precision, assay controls, and system suitability results.
  • Under direction of a Scientist or Sr. Scientist, support troubleshooting studies by executing experiments, documenting observations, organizing data, and communicating findings to scientists and project leads.
  • Support critical reagent and reference material activities, including aliquoting, labeling, inventory tracking, reagent screening, lot comparison, stability study support, and qualification-support testing.
  • Maintain accurate and timely laboratory documentation, including ELN entries, assay worksheets, reagent records, sample records, and data summaries.
  • Support laboratory readiness, including consumable tracking, instrument use coordination, sample tracking, safety compliance, and good laboratory practices.

Requirements:

  • BS. in Biochemistry, Immunology, Analytical Chemistry, Biological Sciences, or a related discipline with a minimum of 2 years of relevant biopharmaceutical industry laboratory experience; or M.S. in a related discipline with minimum 1 year of relevant biopharmaceutical industry laboratory experience.
  • Hands-on laboratory experience with immunoassays, ligand-binding assays, analytical testing, bioanalytical testing, or related biological assay workflows.
  • Experience with assay execution, reagent preparation, sample preparation, plate-based or bead-based assay setup, instrument operation, data analysis, assay controls, and documentation.
  • Familiarity with immunoassay platforms such as ELISA, MSD, electrochemiluminescence-based assays, bead-based assays, multiplex assays, or other ligand-binding assay technologies.
  • Ability to follow protocols, execute experiments carefully, document work accurately, and communicate observations clearly.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to laboratory safety, data integrity, documentation quality, and scientific excellence.
  • Ability to manage multiple laboratory tasks, samples, reagents, and timelines in a fast-paced environment.
Reports to: Director, Immunoassay Development
Location: San Carlos, CA

Onsite (minimum of 4 days per week onsite)

The compensation package will be competitive and includes comprehensive benefits and an equity component.

title: Application Software Engineer, Manufacturing Systems

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

APPLICATION SOFTWARE ENGINEER, MANUFACTURING SYSTEMS

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. The User Retention and App Ecosystem team focuses on sustainable, long-term, and interconnected customer growth at Kikoff. We help customers stay around longer and get more value from their subscriptions. We ensure that customers are excited to explore the different consumer fintech apps across Kikoff’s growing ecosystem, with as little cross-app friction as possible.

We’re looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer to drive user-facing projects, improve existing core services, and own product domains. If you like owning both the work and the outcome of a complex project end-to-end, we’d like to talk to you!

What you’ll be doing

  1. Lead and implement data-driven and impact-focused projects around user-retention and ecosystem integration end-to-end, affecting millions of users.
  2. Be the definitive technical owner for 1 to 2 large product areas across credit report retrieval, credit disputes, customer off-boarding experience, and cross-app integration.
  3. Enhance observability, reliability, and operational excellence across existing services.

What we’re looking for

  1. B.A. / B.S. / M.S. or strong self-taught fundamentals in computer science
  2. 6+ years of industry experience, or high-slope growth, with demonstrated breadth and depth of product impact
  3. Strong fullstack development experience with a backend focus: proficient or highly proficient on the backend, and experienced in either web frontend (React) or mobile (Flutter preferred)
  4. Strong cross-functional communication and coworking skills with product, data, design, and legal partners
  5. Demonstrated ability to own and drive complex projects end-to-end, coordinating focused teams through ideation, requirements, design, implementation, launch, and post-launch.
  6. Good judgment in identifying and choosing trade-offs between business impact, delivery speed, and long-term operational excellence
  7. Strong system design skills for both new and existing systems

An ideal candidate also shows

  • Experience with financial infrastructure or regulated environments (credit bureau data, PII, SOC2)
  • Background in fintech, payments, or lending infrastructure
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs reliably and communicating with technical vendors
  • Experience with classical ML model training and production deployment
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, and alarms in customer-facing systems
  • Experience with using business metric focused A/B tests and experiments for new features
  • Experience in leveling up the team through code reviews, design docs, and technical guidance
  • Thoughtful use of AI tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining operational excellence
