title: Procurement Specialist, Infrastructure & Hardware
description:
About the Company

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

About the Job

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

Panthalassa is seeking a procurement professional to join our supply chain team. You will be responsible for developing sourcing strategies, leading negotiations, and executing key procurement activities with a strong emphasis on sourcing high-performance compute infrastructure and hardware. In this role, you will build and manage supplier relationships to ensure performance aligns with our program milestones and business objectives.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the preparation, issuance, and lifecycle management of purchase orders to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
  • Support end-to-end compute procurement, coordinating with engineering and IT teams to source, evaluate, and acquire servers and hardware.
  • Support sourcing, and quoting of new materials and services, coordinating with the engineering team to understand technical specifications and project timelines.
  • Perform rigorous Price and/or Cost Analysis to ensure competitive pricing
  • Identify and resolve material shortages, pricing discrepancies, and supply chain issues.
  • Manage full supplier lifecycle activities from initial vendor onboarding and compliance setup to active performance monitoring, ensuring all deliverables meet critical program milestones and quality standards.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of procurement experience in a high-complexity manufacturing environment
  • In-depth understanding of procurement processes and supply chain management.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Experience utilizing an ERP system to manage procurement workflows

Desired Qualifications

  • Direct experience sourcing compute hardware, data center infrastructure, or server components.
  • Experience managing Engineering Change Orders (ECO) within a faced paced, high-mix R&D or production environment
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma principles in a supply chain context.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional Engineering departments to define specifications for procurement, evaluating supplier capabilities, and sourcing specialized components.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

Additional Requirements

  • Travel to vendors and test sites as needed
  • Intermittently able to work longer hours and weekends to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours.

Compensation and Benefits

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

  • Cash compensation of $80,000 - $120,000.
  • Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.
  • A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including:
    • Flexible paid time off
    • Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
    • Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
    • Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
    • Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled)
    • Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA
  • Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

Location

This is an on-site position. Our offices, lab, and shop are located in Portland, Oregon.

title: Lager- og logistikoperatør til unik arbejdsplads ved Forsyningscenter Høvelte
description:
Har du interesse for logistik og kunne du tænke dig at blive en del af vores team i munderingsafsnittet – Så er du måske vores nye kollega!

Om os
Forsvarets Forsyningstjeneste er en moderne logistikvirksomhed, og en helt central aktør i Forsvarets forsyningskæde. Vi understøtter Forsvarsministeriets Koncern med levering af alle typer forsyninger og logistiske tjenesteydelser. Vi leverer logistik til tiden til alle forsvarets brugere med den størst mulige præcision.

Forsyningscenter Høvelte i Nordsjælland er en del af Forsyningsafdelingen, der leverer forsyninger direkte til Forsvarets indsatte enheder og soldater – indsat i operationer enten herhjemme eller uden for landets grænser. Vi betjener i hovedsagen enheder og brugere på Nordsjælland, i Høvelte samt i Storkøbenhavn.

På Forsyningscentret er vi et team på cirka 35 kolleger - både civile og militære medarbejdere. Samarbejde og medbestemmelse er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi holder en ganske uformel omgangstone, og sætter vores faglighed samt det at kunne yde en rigtig god og stabil service for vores kunder meget højt.

Om stillingen
Som vores nye kollega i munderingsafsnittet vil du, sammen med resten af teamet, have til opgave at servicere vores enheder i Nordsjælland, de ansatte på Høvelte Kaserne samt i københavnsområdet, i forhold til drift af den udleverede mundering, herunder bytning, prøvetagning og udlevering.

Du deltager ligeledes i både i- og afklædning af værnepligtige samt udlevering af særlig udrustning til soldater indsat i internationale operationer. Ydermere deltager du i den normale lagerdrift fx lagerstyring, optælling af oplagte beholdninger, kassation af udslidt mundering mv.

I munderingsafsnittet har vi en høj grad af kundekontakt - både i forbindelse med skrankebetjening inden for åbningstiden og i forhold til ekspeditioner aftalt på andre tidspunkter. Vores team bag munderingsafsnittet er Forsyningscenter Høveltes ansigt udadtil. Stillingen stiller således krav til din person og dine evner til aktivt at kunne indgå teamets opgaveløsning og – planlægning samt til at kunne bevare overblik når det går lidt stærkt.

Om dig
Vi ser gerne at du er uddannet lager- og logistikoperatør. Men er du ufaglært med lagererfaring og er du indstillet på at tage supplerende uddannelser samt kurser efter behov, kan du sagtens komme i betragtning til stillingen.

Vi ser gerne at du har kørekort og gaffeltruckcertifikat.

Ansvarlighed og kvalitet er helt grundlæggende værdier for Forsvaret og vi forventer, at du aktivt tager ansvar, i forhold til at præge de opgaver, du bliver stillet overfor.

Vi forventer, at du lægger energi i dit arbejde, at du som person er engageret og initiativrig samt kan lide at samarbejde med andre. Når situationen kræver det, evner du også at arbejde selvstændigt med de pålagte opgaver.

Har du en fortid i Forsvaret er det en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og Organisationsaftale for rengøringsassistenter, sanitører, specialarbejdere og visse erhvervsuddannede m.fl. i staten mv. (3F).

Basislønnen som faglært lager- og logistikoperatør udgør 28.911,92 kr. pr måned med svendebrev. Er du ufaglært, vil en ansættelse ske som specialarbejder, her udgør basislønnen 26.228,00 kr. pr. måned.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Høvelte.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte lederen for Forsyningscenter Høvelte, chefsergent Michael Bang Larsen på telefon 4174 0622.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Katrine Glyngbo på telefon 3266 5542.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 4. oktober og samtaler forventes afholdt i forlængelse heraf. Stillingen er til besættelse snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af svendebrev. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Forsvarets Forsyningstjeneste

Forsvarets Forsyningstjeneste blev 1. januar 2026 en del af Operativ Støttekommando, som er en stab, der planlægger, koordinerer og delvist styrer logistiske operationer på tværs af Forsvaret og udvikler det logistiske område og setup i takt med Forsvarets udvikling.

Operativ Støttekommando består, udover staben, af fire myndigheder med egne, særegne opgaver. Forsvarets Vedligeholdelsestjeneste, Forsvarets Sanitetskommando, Forsvarets Forsyningstjeneste og Joint Movement and Transportation Organisation.

title: Senior Process Scientist - LNP process development (Europe, remote, IT)
description:
About us

Chiesi is an international research-focused biopharmaceutical group with 90 years’ experience, operating in more than 30 countries, with its Headquarter in Parma, Italy. More than 8,000 employees across the group are united by a singular purpose: promoting a healthier world for our people, patients, and the planet. This is what drives us as we research, develop, and market innovative drugs across our main therapeutic areas. Discover more here.

At Chiesi we are thinking generations ahead, driving sustainable innovation with purpose. This fosters a culture of reliability, transparency, and ethical behaviour at every level. As a Benefit Corporation and a certified B Corp, we have embedded sustainability in our bylaws and continuously measure our impact.

Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of who we are. We believe our differences make us stronger. We are a vibrant ecosystem of passionate, talented individuals united by strong values, each bringing unique perspectives that help us to continuously challenge the status quo for the better.

Chiesi Global Rare Diseases

Chiesi Global Rare Diseases is a Chiesi Group’s business unit established in February 2020 and focused on research, development and commercialization of treatments and patient support services for rare and ultra-rare disorders, many of whom have limited or no treatments available.

This unit is based in Boston, Massachusetts, with a strong synergy with the headquarters in Parma.

Rare unit has a focus on research and product development for lysosomal storage diseases, rare hematology, ophthalmology disorders and rare immunodeficiencies. The unit is also a dedicated partner with global leaders in scientific research, patient advocacy and care. Discover more here.

What we are looking for

This is what you will do

Chiesi Global Rare disease is recruiting a Senior Process scientist with deep expertise in the development and production of lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulations for nucleic acid delivery.

In this role, you will be a key member of the CMC Extended Technical Team (ETT) supporting the CMC Technical leader while being responsible for process development and manufacturing oversight of gene therapy (GT) programs across GRD projects. You will contribute to advancing in vivo LNP programs from candidate selection though clinical development and toward commercial launch, while also supporting lifecycle management activities.

You will be responsible for

  • Define and lead the development plan for formulation development and lipids and exipient screening, process development, manufacturing and controls strategy for LNP platforms, acting as a subject matter expert (SME) for the assigned projects.
  • Design and oversee the LNP development workstream supporting technology transfers of manufacturing processes and acting as the lead for outsourced process development activities, including:
    • Screening, selection and onboarding of suitable CROs/CDMOs; support in auditing and qualification
    • Providing strong technical governance and oversight, Technical oversight and governance of external partners, ensuring robust and scientifically sound execution execution of external activities while driving accountability and continuous improvement. Proactive troubleshooting and risk management
    • Lead root cause investigations and deviation assessments
    • Reviewing technical plans, batch records, SOP and reports review generated at the CDMO
    • Managing process development project budgets (CROs, CDMOs, consultants).
  • Actively contribute to project advancement as a key member of the CMC team, supporting the CMC lead and ensuring alignment with overall development, budget and regulatory strategy.
  • Write, review, and approve technical documentation within the area of responsibility, including development protocols and reports, stability studies , deviation assessments, and contribute to relevant regulatory sections (IND, IMPD, IB)
  • Support the critical evaluation of external business development opportunities, focusing on process development and control for oligonucleotides.
  • Participate in continuous improvement and life cycle management activities.
  • Actively contributing to the development of the department in line with GRD and GRD R&D strategic goals, sharing knowledge, and best practices within department and to relevant adjacent functions at Chiesi.

You will need to have

  • Minimum MSc in a relevant field (biotechnology, bioengineering, biology, biochemistry, chemistry, chemical engineering or a related field)
  • 5-10 years of relevant industrial experience in the biotech/pharmaceutical industry with significant exposure to gene editing, CGT/ATMPs and development of LNP based delivery systems
  • Strong expertise in:
    • Formulation screening/optimization, process development, scale-up, tech transfer to GMP manufacturing and process validation for LNP formulations (critical requirement)
    • critical formulation and process parameters (FRR, TFR, lipid ratios) and their linkage to CQAs (size distribution, PDI, encapsulation efficiency, potency)
    • multiple manufacturing technologies (microfluidics, T-mixers, inline mixing, continuous processing) and selection rationale for scale
    • QbD-based development (DoE, CPP/CQA identification)
    • Control strategy development and risk assessment for complex biologics
  • Proven experience managing outsourced development activities (CROs/CDMOs), including:
    • Technical oversight including review and approval of batch records, SOPs, development reports, and validation protocols
    • Troubleshooting and escalation management
    • Critical and data-driven performance monitoring
  • Solid understanding of GMP, regulatory requirements, and CMC development lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a matrix organization and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Strong skills in technical writing, data review, and regulatory documentation.
  • Excellent problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, pragmatic, and results-driven approach.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills in an international environment.

Location

This position can be based anywhere in Europe, with both hybrid and remote options.

Compensation range

The package outlined below is based on the role being located in Italy. Where the role is offered in a different country, the applicable salary, bonus and benefits will be aligned to the relevant local market and internal frameworks. Full details of the applicable package will be provided at the appropriate stage of the recruitment process.

The budgeted salary range approved for this role is between €59.000 and €74.000. This range reflects the typical compensation expected for candidates with the experience and expertise required for the position.

Final offer may vary based on the selected candidate's skills, experience, qualifications, overall profile, and internal equity considerations.

This role is eligible to participate in an annual bonus scheme, subject to company and individual performance.

In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including pension, private medical insurance, wellbeing programme, flexible benefits programme and more.

What we offer

No matter where your path starts at Chiesi, it leads to inspiring possibilities. Your future is our focus, and we are committed to nurturing your development in our dynamic, friendly environment with access to resources and training every step of the way.

We provide top-class benefits, including comprehensive healthcare programs, work-life balance initiatives, and robust relocation support. Our salary package is competitive, comprising a basic salary, performance bonuses, and benefits benchmarked against the external market. title: Surgical Resource Technologist
description:
Surgical Resource Technologist provide service and support before, during, and after surgical procedures. Assists in ensuring the presence and proper arrangement of surgical equipment, supplies and instrumentation in the operating room prior to each operation. Provides assistance to the surgeon in the operating room as allowed by professional and legal standards. Assists in the turnover of the operating room after the procedure ensuring proper routing and/or processing of all specimens, equipment, instrumentation and supplies. Works as a member of the surgical team with surgeons, anesthesiologists, registered nurses, and other surgical personnel.

  • Requires a High School Diploma/GED.
  • Requires certification as a Certified Surgical Technologist obtained from the NBSTSA.
  • Requires Basic Life Support Certification.
  • Requires 17 continuing education units annually.
  • Requires successful completion of Perioperative Services Preceptor class and/or completion of 4 precepting eLMS modules and/or facility based preceptor training.
  • Requires a minimum of 1 year experience in the Skilled Technologist role or relevant experience.
  • Must be able to resource to other staff who are utilizing advanced technology in cases, including knowledge of the types of instruments utilized, what cases utilize different technologies, etc.
  • Requires knowledge of name and function of surgical equipment and instrumentation.
  • Requires strict adherence to policies and regulations regarding maintenance of sterile field.
  • Requires completion of application and recommendations as prescribed in Advancement Process.

title: Sagsbehandler til SU-tildeling med fokus på vejledning og sagsbehandling
description:
Vil du behandle SU-sager og hjælpe studerende videre i deres uddannelsesforløb? Trives du med at omsætte regler til konkrete svar og afgørelser? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Når studerende søger SU, skal deres sag behandles korrekt og effektivt. Det er her, du kommer ind i billedet.

Som sagsbehandler i SU-tildelingen behandler du sager og vejleder studerende og uddannelsesinstitutioner om regler, administration og digitale løsninger.

Dine opgaver

Du får en hverdag, hvor du blandt andet:

  • behandler ansøgninger om SU og øvrige sager efter gældende regler og praksis
  • vejleder studerende og medarbejdere på uddannelsesinstitutioner via telefon og mail
  • besvarer spørgsmål om regler, administration og brug af de systemer, der understøtter SU-området
  • journaliserer og dokumenterer henvendelser og afgørelser
  • bidrager til, at sager bliver behandlet effektivt og med høj kvalitet
  • deltager i arbejdet med at forbedre arbejdsgange og understøtte en ensartet sagsbehandling.

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke kende SU-reglerne på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du allerede har erfaring med at hjælpe borgere, træffe afgørelser eller arbejde med regelbaseret sagsbehandling.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • arbejder som sagsbehandler, kunderådgiver eller i en anden borgernær funktion
  • har erfaring med at omsætte regler og processer til konkrete svar og løsninger
  • er vant til at have dialog med borgere på telefon og skrift
  • arbejder systematisk og sikrer, at kvalitet og dokumentation er på plads
  • bidrager til fællesskabet ved at dele viden og sparre med kolleger
  • er nysgerrig på et nyt fagområde og motiveret for til at lære nyt

Hvem er vi?
Du bliver en del af sektionen SU-tildeling. Her behandler vi ansøgninger fra elever og studerende om SU til uddannelser i Danmark, yder skriftlig og telefonisk support til SU-medarbejdere på uddannelsesinstitutionerne på alle niveauer fra folkeskoler til universiteter og sagsbehandler forskellige typer af SU-sager.

SU-administrationen er i høj grad automatiseret via it-understøttede processer. I sektionen er det vores opgave at hjælpe uddannelsesinstitutionerne med at forstå og anvende regler og it-systemer, så de bedst muligt kan understøtte elever og studerendes vej gennem uddannelserne.

I teamet er vi i alt seks engagerede kolleger, som aktivt deltager i prioritering og planlægning af opgaveløsningen og har fokus på løbende at forbedre og effektivisere vores arbejdsgange.

Sådan ansøger du
Send os dit CV senest søndag den 18. oktober. Når du sender dit CV via vores system, får du mulighed for kort at beskrive din motivation for at søge stillingen.

I ATP arbejder vi for en fair rekrutteringsproces, og derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte billede i dit CV eller angive din alder, når du søger.

Vi ansætter på baggrund af kompetencer og potentiale og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset køn og kønsidentitet, etnicitet, national, social og kulturel baggrund, religion eller tro, seksuel orientering, funktionsnedsættelse og alder.

Du kan læse mere om rekrutteringsforløbet her:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte områdeleder Betina Jensen på tlf. 41473176 eller mail bmje@atp.dk.

Af sikkerhedsmæssige årsager og for at beskytte værdier og datainfrastruktur beder vi om straffeattest, kopi af dit pas og eventuelt eksamensbevis. Straffeattesten må ikke give anledning til bemærkninger, og dokumenterne slettes umiddelbart efter vurdering.

Til annoncører og rekrutteringsbureauer: ATP frabeder sig uopfordrede henvendelser om annoncering, kandidater, produkter og ydelser i forbindelse med stillingsopslag og rekrutteringer. Vi beder om, at dette respekteres, og at vores ledere og medarbejdere ikke kontaktes i den henseende.

title: operatør
description:
Trives du med rutineprægede opgaver, hvor kvalitet og sund fornuft er i højsædet? Vil du være med på en vækstrejse, hvor teamet går fra 5 til over 20 ansatte, og hvor dit arbejde gør en direkte forskel for miljøet? Så er det nu, du skal slå til!

om stena recycling

Stena Recycling er førende inden for bæredygtige affaldsløsninger. De lever af at give ressourcer nyt liv, og på deres lokation i Roskilde har de stort fokus på batterisortering. De er en arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerheden altid kommer først, og hvor man vægter et godt fællesskab højt. De står over for en spændende udvidelse – særligt i forhold til håndtering af elbilsbatterier – og mangler de rette hænder til at hjælpe dem med at bygge fundamentet for fremtiden.

om jobbet

Som operatør hos Stena Recycling bliver du en central del af deres sorteringsflow, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre korrekt håndtering og sortering af batterier direkte ved produktionsbåndet. Arbejdet kræver både koncentration og fysisk indsats, da batterierne sorteres manuelt for at sikre, at de værdifulde nikkelmetaller kan udvindes og genbruges.

Sideløbende med sorteringsarbejdet vil du stå for den interne logistik, hvor du betjener mindre gaffeltrucks, stablere og klemmetrucks til at afhente, transportere og placere materialerne de rette steder på pladsen.

Da afdelingen er i vækst, vil hverdagen også byde på diverse ad hoc-opgaver og forfaldent arbejde.

Arbejdstider:

Vi kører pt. skiftehold med dertilhørende tillæg.
- Daghold: Man-tors 07:00–15:15, fredag 07:00–13:00.
- Aftenhold: Man-tors 14.30 til 23.45, fredag fri.

din profil

Vi leder efter dig, der møder ind med en positiv indstilling og en god portion sund fornuft. Da vi arbejder med materialer, der skal behandles på en speciel måde, er det vigtigt, at du er kvalitetsbevidst.

vi forestiller os, at du:

Du kan have en baggrund som procesoperatør, produktion, lager eller lignende.
Du taler og forstår dansk.
Du har almindeligt kørekort B.
Du har truckcertifikat

Som person trives du i et arbejdsmiljø med faste rutiner, hvor du sætter en ære i at levere en ensartet høj kvalitet i din sortering. Da sikkerhed er højeste prioritet, forventer vi, at du møder ind med sund fornuft og en ansvarsbevidst indstilling til dit arbejde og dine kolleger.

vi tilbyder

Hos Stena Recycling bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor din sikkerhed, tryghed og trivsel altid kommer i første række. Vi tilbyder et job med gode rotationsmuligheder og hjælpsomme kolleger i et stærkt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet og hjælpsomhed er i højsædet. Du får rig mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle dig personligt i takt med, at deres afdeling vokser.
Stillingen starter som et Try & Hire-forløb med gode muligheder for efterfølgende fastansættelse for den rette kandidat. Som ansat får du naturligvis stillet arbejdstøj til rådighed.

ansøgning og kontakt

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på "ansøg". Randstad varetager rekrutteringsprocessen på vegne af Stena Recycling. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt, og der afholdes løbende interviews. Så send gerne din ansøgning så hurtigt som muligt, hvis du vil med på holdet.

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Liv Nielsen på liv.nielsen@randstad.dk.

om randstad

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle, uanset baggrund, og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.
Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.
Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

title: Women's Firearms Instructor
description:
Job Summary

The incumbent will be responsible for providing classroom instruction to students on all platforms (pistol, rifle, shotgun) and be able to teach additional classes (family firearms safety, youth firearm training, ccw and preparedness). The incumbent must be able to maintain a safe environment in the classroom during dry practice and practical exercises. The incumbent will be responsible for setting and re-setting classrooms to Training Department standard before and after each class as well as completing all necessary paperwork for class feedback from students. The incumbent will positively represent C2 Tactical while a member of the C2 Instructor Team.

Responsibilities and Duties

Professional Instruction (70%) The Instructor will able to teach all CORE classes (100-300 in all platforms: pistol, rifle, shotgun) as well as specialty classes (youth and family safety, ccw and preparedness). Deliver oral presentations while utilizing PowerPoint and other classroom technology and kit. Provide safety briefings and basic training in all aspects of firearms use and ownership.

Customer Assistance (10%) The Instructor will be able to assist customers with the safe operations of their equipment, provide tips and training as well as recommendations concerning technique, equipment and training.

Maintenance of Classrooms (10%) The Instructor will ensure that the classroom is set and prepped prior to students arrival. Area should be clean, books set on tables, all technology up and running, training aids out and ready and that NO live ammo or loaded firearms are in the room during instruction. Also, to leave the room in a ready state for the next class scheduled.

Professional Development/Remuneration (10%) The Instructor asked to maintain and improve their personal skills sets. Safe firearms handling, marksmanship and communications skills should be improved at every opportunity. Log all teaching hours using the instructor reporting form in order to ensure payment for services rendered.

title: New Product Development Engineer II - Process
description:
Company Description


Biomerics is a world-class manufacturer and innovative polymer solutions provider for the medical device and biotech industries. As a vertically integrated company, we specialize in designing, developing, and producing medical devices for diagnostic and interventional procedures. We are focused on next-generation solutions for vascular access, electrophysiology, cardiac rhythm management, neurovascular, structural heart, and cardiovascular markets.


At Biomerics, we are dedicated to our diverse employee base. We understand that a strong, skilled, and engaged workforce is the foundation of our continued success as a business. We strive to live up to the Biomerics values in all our interactions. It is an exciting time to be part of our collective team, and there is no limit to the impact that can be achieved here at Biomerics.


We improve and advance our employees' lives and the lives of the patients who depend on our products.


At Biomerics, we are guided by our core values of integrity, partnership, empowerment & accountability, trust, agility, teamwork, and excellence. We deeply care about our team members and customers, and our team-oriented, customer-focused corporate culture places a premium on building strategic, mutually beneficial partnerships. Joining our team means becoming part of a dynamic, innovative, and caring community.


Job Summary

The NPD Engineer II – Process is responsible for independently executing the design, development, and transfer of medical devices from concept through production, with a focus on manufacturing processes, tooling, and design for manufacturability.

This role works closely with customers and cross-functional teams to define requirements, develop robust and scalable processes, and ensure products meet quality, cost, and performance objectives. The Engineer II demonstrates increased technical proficiency, ownership of workstreams, and the ability to lead process development activities with minimal supervision.


Job Responsibilities


Product & Process Development

  • Supports design, development, and validation activities throughout the product lifecycle in alignment with project scope and objectives.
  • Applies design control processes to ensure products are manufacturable, cost-effective, and compliant with applicable standards.
  • Translates customer requirements into engineering specifications and process
  • requirements.
  • Supports design for manufacturability (DFM) and design for assembly (DFA) activities early in development.

Manufacturing & Process Implementation

  • Develops and implements manufacturing processes, tooling, and fixturing to support production.
  • Creates and maintains manufacturing procedures, test methods, and inspection plans to ensure quality and reduce risk.
  • Supports engineering change implementation, including documentation updates and training of production personnel.

Testing, Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Designs and executes experiments (DOE), testing, and characterization to evaluate and improve process performance.
  • Applies statistical tools and engineering analysis to improve process capability and product performance.
  • Evaluates new technologies and implements improvements to enhance efficiency and quality.


Collaboration & Project Execution

  • Collaborates with engineering, operations, quality, and customers to support successful product transfer to production.
  • Provides guidance and support to technicians and operators in prototyping, testing, and process development activities.
  • Contributes to project deliverables and timelines through effective communication and coordination.


Business & General Support

  • Provides input into quotes to ensure accuracy and quick turnaround.
  • Performs other duties as assigned in support of business and organizational objectives.

title: Graduate Central Execution Trader
description:
About Graviton Research Capital: Graviton Research Capital is a cutting-edge high-frequency trading (HFT) firm that leverages technology, quantitative research and algorithms to trade in global markets. Our team consists of world-class technologists, researchers and traders who collaborate to push the boundaries of automated trading.

Role Overview: We’re looking for a Central Execution Trader to join our Singapore team and become a key player on the Central Trading Desk. This team interfaces with, and acts as the communication hub for all brokers and exchanges on behalf of the firm externally, as well as technology, quantitative researchers, risk management, compliance, and business development teams internally. In this role, you’ll be building and refining systems that keep our live trading running flawlessly. From designing real-time monitoring tools to automating critical workflows, you’ll be at the heart of ensuring smooth and efficient trade execution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own one or more markets and the day-to-day execution and operational health of the live strategies in them.
  • Start strategies at the open, track their state, positions and PnL through the session, and close the day with correct positions and files for the next session.
  • Act as the first line of defense for alerts, order rejects and outages in those markets, and as the primary contact for brokers and exchanges on live issues. Diagnose the issue, contain the impact and hand the root cause to the owning quant or technology team.
  • Build and enhance real-time monitoring and safety tooling for live and post-trade environments.
  • Design checks that detect abnormal order flow, position and PnL moves, and surface them to the desk in time to act.
  • Work on live data from the firm's trading systems and from brokers, and take the tooling from idea to production on the desk.
  • Communicate clearly on incidents, resolutions, and process improvements with cross-functional teams, ensuring zero ambiguity.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (Computer Science/Electrical/Mathematics/Finance/Business Analytics, or related fields preferred).
  • Internship experience in trade operations, trade support, data engineering, or trading developer is an advantage.
  • Strong programming skills in Python automation and data analytics.
  • Solid understanding of financial markets and instruments, electronic and algorithmic trading.
  • Ability to stay calm and sharp under pressure and make quick decisions in a live trading environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Why Join Graviton?

  • Work in a high-performance, data-driven trading environment.
  • Gain exposure to high-frequency trading strategies and risk management.
  • Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in quantitative finance and technology.
  • Competitive compensation and opportunities for professional growth.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Graviton Research Capital will always come from Graviton Research Capital’s Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never provide sensitive, personal information to someone unless you’re confident about who the recipient is. Our email domain is @gravitontrading.com. The official website to find and apply for job openings at Graviton Research Capital is https://www.gravitontrading.com/careers.html.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to define product strategy and lead delivery across major client engagements. This role is ideal for a seasoned product leader who can own the full product lifecycle, build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, and bring both strategic vision and hands-on delivery discipline to the engagements they support.

In this role, you will work as the senior product voice on a cross-functional team, setting direction, driving alignment, and owning outcomes from discovery through delivery. You'll partner closely with client leadership, mentor other PMs, and bring the experience and judgment to navigate the most complex product challenges.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Define product strategy and vision for major client engagements, setting direction in alignment with client goals and business outcomes
  • Own the product roadmap end-to-end, driving prioritization across business value, technical constraints, and delivery timelines
  • Lead complex discovery and problem framing with senior client stakeholders, ensuring the right problems are defined before solutions are built
  • Define product success metrics and use data to evaluate outcomes, inform priorities, and drive continuous improvement
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, delivery, and strategy to keep complex engagements moving
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to drive product discovery, research synthesis, and documentation at speed

Collaboration & Communication

  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client leadership, serving as a reliable strategic partner on product direction
  • Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly and confidently at the executive level
  • Lead complex stakeholder working sessions, workshops, and decision-making forums across large, multi-stakeholder organizations

Leadership & Influence

  • Establish product delivery standards and practices on the engagements you support
  • Mentor senior and mid-level PMs, helping them grow their product thinking, client skills, and delivery impact
  • Act as a technical escalation point on complex product, scope, and prioritization challenges

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, with a strong consultative background
  • Demonstrated ability to define product strategy and vision for complex digital engagements
  • Deep experience leading discovery, roadmapping, and delivery across multi-stakeholder environments
  • Strong executive communication and client advisory skills
  • Track record of driving cross-functional alignment and influencing without authority
  • Experience defining and tracking product success metrics
  • High accountability, ownership, and follow-through
  • Proficiency with product tools across discovery, roadmapping, and delivery (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Amplitude, Miro)
  • Deep applied experience with AI tools to drive product discovery, research synthesis, and documentation at speed (e.g., Claude)
  • Experience in a consulting or professional services environment, or exposure to AI/ML product development or data platforms, is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

title: Senior Content Governance & Knowledge Specialist
description:
CONTENT QUALITY FRAMEWORKS AND PROCESS

You'll own and continuously improve AI-assisted ex ante and ex post quality-assurance processes across the lifecycle of unstructured content and knowledge assets, from creation to retirement. Combine preventive standards and monitoring to improve accuracy, consistency, completeness, and trustworthiness.

You'll also define and maintain measurable AI-readiness criteria and certification for unstructured content and knowledge assets, covering structure, metadata, ownership, currency, accessibility, and semantic clarity. Apply them across priority repositories and content types to qualify trusted sources for search, retrieval, and agentic AI.

STRUCTURED CONTENT AND AI-ASSISTED CREATION

You'll own machine-readable templates and AI assisted authoring standards for priority content types, including policies, procedures, guidelines, knowledge articles, and contracts. Convert business, governance, metadata, and structural requirements into reusable templates that improve authoring consistency and enable automated validation, classification, retrieval, and AI reuse.

Furthermore, you'll establish and drive adoption of standards and guardrails for AI-assisted content creation, including approved use cases, authoring guidance, prompt patterns, human review, source traceability, and quality controls. Work with content communities, domain experts, content owners, Data & AI Science, and IT to embed them in workflows without compromising accuracy, compliance, ownership, or editorial accountability.

INSIGHTS, MONITORING AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENTS

You’ll own persona-based reporting across priority repositories and domains for framework owners, content managers, content owners, and content editors. Define indicators for quality, ownership, lifecycle, usage, compliance, and AI-readiness, and provide actionable dashboards for prioritisation, governance decisions, and accountability.

You'll also monitor unstructured content and knowledge assets against agreed standards, identify systemic gaps and root causes, and coordinate corrective action with content owners, business communities, domain experts, Data & AI Science, and IT. Track remediation and use insights to improve governance, quality checks, templates, training, and platform capabilities.

GOVERNANCE, OWNERSHIP AND COMMUNITY ENABLEMENT

You'll operate a federated governance model for unstructured content and knowledge assets across priority repositories and domains. Define decision rights, ownership, accountability, escalation paths, lifecycle controls, and minimum quality requirements, embedding them consistently in repository processes and platforms.

You'll build and coordinate business content communities of framework owners, content managers, content owners, and content editors. Provide guidance, training, reusable standards, and collaboration forums, working with domain experts, Data & AI Science, and IT to drive adoption, share practices, and resolve cross-functional governance issues.

TAXONOMY, ONTOLOGY AND SEMANTIC MANAGEMENT

You'll operate operate taxonomy and ontology management for unstructured content and knowledge assets across priority repositories and domains. Define modelling standards, semantic ownership, approval, versioning, and maintenance so controlled vocabularies, concepts, relationships, classifications, and metadata remain consistent, interoperable, and aligned with business terminology.

You'll partner with domain experts, content owners, Data & AI Science, and IT to develop and extend machine-readable semantic models using RDF, OWL, SKOS, and SHACL. Translate business concepts and relationships into governed structures supporting metadata enrichment, classification, knowledge graphs, semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and reliable agentic AI.

INNOVATION AND CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

You'll champion continuous innovation by monitoring emerging practices, technologies, and market developments in content governance, knowledge management, and agentic AI. Regularly assess the effectiveness of implemented solutions, identify opportunities for optimisation, and translate relevant advances into scalable improvements that keep platforms, processes, and standards effective, user-focused, and aligned with state-of-the-art capabilities.

Proven knowledge of W3C standards, OWL, RDF, SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL, and OKF (Open Knowledge Format).

Proven programming skills in Python and/ or SQL.

Proven experience in establishing content quality assurance processes for agentic AI.

A good understanding of data quality, process quality, and the role of structured content in AI-enabled knowledge retrieval.

Strong communication skills and the ability to work with different business functions and stakeholder groups, explain concepts, and implement solutions.

Ability to translate business needs into ontologies, clear content structures, governance rules, and practical standards.

Experience in content governance, knowledge management, intranet management, digital workplace, enterprise content management, or a related field.

Experience working with Power BI is an advantage.

Experience in creating ontologies and/or knowledge graphs using AI tools.

Practical experience with AI-enabled content workflows, semantic search, automated classification, metadata enrichment, or the development of AI features for knowledge platforms is an advantage.

An analytical mindset, with the ability to assess content performance, identify gaps, and drive improvements.

Experience in project management and the ability to manage external partner resources effectively.

title: Ansøgning til "Bliv fuldtidssælger i Danmarks største Tøjeksperten"
description:
Vil du være en del af vores flagship store i hjertet af Aarhus – og give vores kunder en oplevelse, der er lidt ud over det sædvanlige?

Vi søger en engageret fuldtidssælger til vores team i Tøjeksperten Aarhus Centrum.

For os handler god service om mere end at sælge tøj. Vi betragter vores kunder som gæster, og når de træder ind ad døren, gør vi os ekstra umage for at få dem til at føle sig velkomne, forstå deres behov og hjælpe dem godt videre.

Derfor leder vi efter dig, der får energi af mennesker, har kunden i fokus og trives med, at ingen dage – eller kunder – er helt ens.

Om os

Tøjeksperten er en del af Danmarks største herretøjskæde – kendt for god stil, høj kvalitet og personlig service. I vores butikker skaber vi inspirerende miljøer, hvor både kunder og medarbejdere trives. Her arbejder vi tæt sammen og har en kultur præget af fællesskab, engagement og udvikling.

Butikken er i vækst, og det giver dig en spændende mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen, og være med til at sætte dit præg på både butikken og kundeoplevelsen.

Vi har ambitioner, et højt serviceniveau og går ikke på kompromis med den oplevelse, vi ønsker at give vores kunder.

Din hverdag hos os

Som sælger bliver du en vigtig del af butikkens team og ansigtet udadtil over for vores kunder.

Din vigtigste opgave er at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og salg gennem nærværende og personlig rådgivning. Samtidig er du sammen med resten af teamet med til at sikre, at butikken altid står skarpt og inspirerende.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • skabe salg gennem personlig rådgivning og høj service
  • forstå den enkelte kundes behov og finde de rigtige løsninger
  • bidrage til butikkens salgsmål og fælles resultater
  • sikre, at butikken altid er salgsklar, inspirerende og indbydende
  • arbejde med merchandising og butikkens visuelle udtryk
  • bidrage til aktiviteter og markedsføring på sociale medier
  • skabe relationer til vores kunder og hverve nye medlemmer til vores kundeklub

Hvem er du?

Det vigtigste for os er ikke nødvendigvis, hvad der står på dit CV. Det afgørende er, at du har den rette indstilling og lysten til at lære.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • trives i mødet med mange forskellige mennesker
  • motiveres af salg og den gode kundeoplevelse
  • er nysgerrig på kundens behov og har lyst til at gøre en forskel
  • tager ansvar og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet
  • har energi, gåpåmod og lyst til at tage fat

Vi klæder dig godt på

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Du får en grundig oplæring, så du bliver klædt godt på til rollen som sælger og lærer både vores sortiment, vores måde at arbejde på og vores tilgang til den gode kundeoplevelse. Og har du ambitionerne og lysten til at tage mere ansvar, er der mulighed for det. Vi vil gerne udvikle mennesker, der viser engagement og initiativ.

Det får du hos os

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med højt tempo, godt humør og kolleger, der løfter i flok.

Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen
  • pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring
  • en struktureret vagtplan 12 uger frem
  • løbende træning og udvikling af dine kompetencer
  • mulighed for mere ansvar og udvikling
  • en uformel arbejdsplads med et stærkt fællesskab
  • muligheden for at blive en del af Danmarks største Tøjeksperten

Skal du være vores nye kollega?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Send din ansøgning allerede i dag. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Stillingen: 37 timer pr. uge. Vagtplan fordelt over hele butikkens åbningstid.

Opstart: Gerne allerede 1. november eller efter aftale

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Sales Manager Jesper Christensen på tlf. 7234 9089.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Many of LTSC’s projects will be developed in partnership with other community-based nonprofits based in communities throughout Los Angeles.


Responsibilities Include:


Manage and oversee key phases of assigned new construction, rehabilitation, and/or refinancing projects within the development pipeline:

  • Carry out site control and entitlement/permitting submittals
  • Monitor project financials including budgeting and tracking of flow of funds, projecting potential financing gaps, and ensuring timely loan payoffs
  • Oversee project team and ensure completion of project milestones by third-party consultants (including architects, predevelopment consultants, and general contractors)
  • Submit financing applications, including review of funding regulations, due diligence for threshold items, project competitiveness, and completion of application workbooks and narratives
  • Manage loan closings, including due diligence, financial projections, and loan agreements
  • Provide construction oversight and administration, including change order, contingency, and schedule review
  • Manage external partnerships with public entities, community partners, and others


Contribute to the day-to-day operations of the Real Estate Development Department and LTSC as a whole:

  • Facilitate inter-organizational collaboration as needed (especially for mixed-use developments and sites with onsite LTSC services and staff)
  • Embody the department’s guiding practices to maintain and create opportunities for departmental and organizational development and progress
  • Participate, volunteer, and attend organization and community events including weekends, when necessary and/or expected
  • Support activities to advance the mission of LTSC to create positive change for people and places
  • Contribute to other activities related to the agency as a whole as deemed necessary and appropriate
  • Other duties as may be assigned by supervisor


Qualifications, Experience, and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree in Urban Planning, Real Estate, Business, or related field preferred
  • Minimum 2 years experience in affordable housing development or related field required; additional experience with mixed-use development or community-based commercial development preferred
  • Strong quantitative and computer skills; proficiency in financial proforma analysis using Microsoft Excel required
  • Strong working knowledge of basic developer requirements and milestones within the affordable housing development lifecycle required; prior experience with architectural design oversight or construction administration preferred
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, writing, and written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience managing relationships with various stakeholders, including public funding agencies, community organizations, building and planning departments, and private lenders
  • Interest in real estate development at a community-based nonprofit in a multicultural environment
  • Ability to travel locally to multiple housing project and partner sites using an approved mode of transportation; ability to drive when required for job duties, including transporting supplies and traveling between sites where public transportation or rideshare is not a reasonable alternative
  • Proof of eligibility to work in the United States


Equivalent education or experience can be substituted for all minimum qualifications, except when legal requirements, such as a license/certification/registration, are required.


Essential Functions Statement: This position requires regular local travel to fulfill essential job duties. In some circumstances, driving is necessary due to time sensitivity, cost efficiency, or lack of comparable public transportation options. title: Copy of Senior Systems Designer
description:
WE ARE GAME MAKERS

Who We Are:

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

What We Need:

We’re looking for a Senior Systems Designer to join our team and help us shape the future of online multiplayer gaming. In this role, you’ll be a key feature driver, partnering with various cross functional teams to shape how players grow, are rewarded, and evolve over time! You have proven expertise in game economy design, reward systems, and the intentional design work needed to balance the complex relationship between them. You can both communicate and document design features, intent and specs clearly and work in-engine to bring those experiences to reality. You seamlessly form strong working relationships among peers of different disciplines, bring others with you towards a shared vision, and proactively work with production & game leadership to make it a reality. We’re a studio that values autonomy and self-drive in developers who are empowered to do the best work of their careers. If this is you, let’s talk!

What You'll Do:

  • Drive a small portfolio of complex features through initial creative input, stakeholder buy-in and alignment, consistent design reviews, and day-to-day execution.
  • Respond quickly to feedback with stable in-engine updates and iterate rapidly.
  • Provide design leadership within your feature area while contributing to broader game quality by mentoring others and sharing insights.
  • Reliably source ideas from around the studio, combining with own proposals and references to other products, in order to quickly solve and innovate within design challenges.
  • Work cross-functionally within and outside of your team to communicate and align on the work, tradeoffs and dependencies. Radiate changes across the organization; set and mobilize against feature goals; and provide forward-looking direction aligned with greater design philosophy.
  • Share best practices and techniques with peers to improve the overall experience

What Will Make You A Great Fit:

  • Strong experience with Unreal Engine and Blueprint visual scripting; programming experience (C++, C#, etc.) is a plus.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing gameplay features in released multiplayer games, with a strong focus on reward loops, systemic content integration, and player-driven optionality.
  • Theory-crafting skillset & past experience designing for depth and multiplayer gameplay.
  • Quantitative and analytical, with past experience building and interrogating economy models and simulations to validate and align design decisions.
  • Deep understanding of the various components (UI, Art, Engineering, Audio, VFX, etc.) that come together to achieve an unparalleled player experience.
  • A self-starter who can align with the team's goals but isn't hesitant to create solutions of their own.
  • Capable of rapidly filtering large volumes of feedback into concrete and useful improvements.
  • Ability to flexibly design, implement, and iterate under tight deadlines & production constraints.
  • Well-played in the multiplayer PvP / Competitive Space and able to deconstruct what works and why.
  • Capability to abstract designs outside of single solutions into patterns and models of player behavior; providing options and flexible design solutions

The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $112,700 and $166,820 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program.

Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have the unrestricted right to work in the UK to be considered**

Overview

You’ll be a senior member of the Engineering Reliability Team that will work closely with Zen’s development, engineering, and operations centre teams. You’ll Work alongside the Development and engineering teams, to support, maintain, and consistently improve the development estate so the development teams can focus and innovate constantly to drive Zen’s business and the teams’ priorities.

Reporting to the DevOps team manager, you must have an excellent track record in DevOps roles and the drive and attitude to succeed. Zen are committed to investing in and developing you – we believe that everyone can lead and the way we do has a huge impact on our people and play a vital part in our success.

The DevOps team will be responsible for the design and implementation of applications' build, release, deployment and configuration activities. Other responsibilities include working within multi-functional teams to gather requirements, evaluate tools, implementing/updating solutions, building and executing test plans, provision environments, application performance reviews, assist migration of Legacy systems, and triaging and fixing operational issues.

You’ll ensure incidents are run smoothly and ensure that operational knowledge is available and shared. As a senior you will be a point of escalation, demonstrating problem solving skills, the ability to learn quickly and adapt your skills and knowledge.

As a service provider we operate many technologies, so you’ll have the skills to work with experienced Lead DevOps engineers, Systems Engineers and developers leveraging frameworks, standards, and defined operational process to make the unfamiliar comfortable and familiar. Over time we’ll increasingly leverage SRE principles to further optimize and enhance capabilities – it’s a great opportunity to get in at the start and shape this journey.

Objectives

  • Deliver continuous incremental improvement of systems and infrastructure
  • Take end to end ownership and responsibility for development infrastructure and systems
  • Be a technical escalation point and eventually be part of a 24/7 escalation rota
  • Document as you go – enough so your colleagues can follow what’s been done and why
  • Drive tasks forward with energy and enthusiasm
  • Create proactive monitoring solutions using standard tooling - mainly Zabbix and Elastic
  • Conduct RCA (Root Cause Analysis) for incidents
  • Develop standard operational procedures and documentation
  • Develop and maintain self-managing infrastructure services and dashboards.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities
  • Provide advice on DevOps standards and practices
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to Software and DevOps Engineer peers

Key Responsibilities

Experience

  • Worked and succeeded as a DevOps Engineer
  • Ideally, experience working in an ISP, Telco or other Managed Services environment or able to demonstrate experience in a complex heterogeneous environment
  • Comfortable working with automation tools (Azure DevOps, GitLab, Puppet)
  • Worked in complex networking and firewall environments
  • Production use of multiple AWS capabilities and Kubernetes debugging
  • Demonstratable experience in dealing with technical debt effectively
  • Comfortable working with SRE principles and lean methodologies
  • Very strong problem-solving skills are essential – understanding of DevOps and SRE concepts with the ability to apply key techniques to unfamiliar problems
  • Ability to influence others in matters of standards and best practice, especially individuals outside of our team
  • Comfortable working with automation tools (Puppet, Git) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps) with complex integrations and test frameworks
  • Comfortable with Elasticsearch log standardisation, Kibana dashboard creation and data analysis skills
  • Able to code to a good level - this isn’t a developer role but you need scripting skills to succeed
  • AWS hands on – Cloud formation, Route53, S3, DynamoDB, Cloud-watch, Lambda, Security, and troubleshooting
  • Certificate management and automation
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnosis skills
  • Able to write documentation that covers what your peers and operations need to know
  • Knowledge of Database systems and models
  • Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS and Linux

Interpersonal Skills

We value interpersonal skills and responsible teamwork. You should be able to:

  • Patient & friendly with excellent interpersonal skills - demonstrate a natural aptitude for dealing with people
  • Influence and lead
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Happy working and supporting a small closeknit team
  • Take and give feedback to tune future actions and behaviours
  • Embrace and demonstrate Zen values
  • Be kind, understanding, and listen to others
  • Be organized

Impact You'll Make

You will be influencing and contributing to Zen’s long-term goals and joining a family that believes business should be a force for good. We’re a company committed to improving the lives of our people, creating a better future through our community and charity work, and ensuring that we look after our environment.

Perhaps that’s why we’re officially a Great Place to Work and have achieved Carbon Neutral Plus status and B Corp Certification!

title: Senior Audio Design QA Analyst
description:
CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Audio Design QA Analyst to take ownership of quality across key areas of our game audio experience.

In this role, you will work closely with Sound Design, Music and other Audio teams throughout development, helping define the quality bar, identify risks and ensure that audio supports gameplay, storytelling and the intended creative experience. You will combine a highly developed critical ear with strong QA expertise and a practical understanding of interactive audio implementation.

As a Senior, you will go beyond identifying individual issues. You will drive complex audio quality topics to completion, establish effective testing approaches, provide informed quality recommendations, improve our QA practices and support the development of other team members.

Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for complex audio features, from early development through final release.
  • Define test plans, coverage, and quality benchmarks across all audio domains (SFX, music, dialogue, ambience, systems, mix).
  • Assess audio for both technical functionality and creative goals, prioritizing gameplay readability, immersion, and emotional impact.
  • Diagnose complex issues across assets, logic, and systems using Wwise, Unreal Engine, and Blueprints.
  • Partner with sound/music designers and programmers to communicate risks, offer feedback, and drive solutions.
  • Lead testing efforts for major audio features, establishing priorities, validation approaches, and dedicated test environments.
  • Provide data-driven quality recommendations and highlight critical blockers requiring pre-release fixes.
  • Identify inefficiencies in audio QA processes and drive improvements to testing methodologies and tools.
  • Elevate bug reporting quality, maintain documentation, and mentor junior team members on audio testing practices.
  • Research advances in interactive audio and modern QA practices to continually refine evaluation methods.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in game QA, audio, or a relevant development discipline, with a track record of owning quality for complex systems throughout the production cycle.
  • Critical listening skills to evaluate audio beyond basic functionality, ensuring consistency, balance, creative intent, and alignment with the player experience.
  • Deep understanding of interactive game audio systems, including sound effects, ambience, music, and dialogue, and how they interact during gameplay.
  • Proficiency in Wwise (or comparable middleware) and modern game engines like Unreal Engine, with the ability to investigate implementation-related audio issues.
  • Experience creating and maintaining robust test strategies, test plans, and structured coverage for complex features.
  • Ability to assess quality risks and player impact, prioritize issues effectively, and communicate clear recommendations.
  • Ability to provide detailed, constructive, and actionable feedback to both creative and technical specialists.
  • Experience improving QA workflows, testing approaches, and mentoring less experienced team members.
  • Strong spoken and written English.

Nice to have

  • Professional background in Sound Design, Technical Sound Design, or Audio Implementation, with experience shipping at least one PC or console title.
  • Strong command of audio production fundamentals, including mixing, dynamics, and signal flow.
  • Experience with standard DAWs like Reaper or Pro Tools.
  • Expertise in 3D/spatial audio systems and testing complex interactive audio (music, dialogue, ambience).
  • Experience with accessibility and gameplay readability considerations, as well as evaluating audio across diverse hardware and playback environments.
  • Proven ability to coordinate testing with external QA teams and build custom test maps or debug tools for audio validation.

Working mode

Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time or hybrid mode.

Relocation Support

  • Relocation package – flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet, shipping your belongings — it’s all covered.
  • Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you, assistance with finding residence, tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of.
  • Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too.

Health & Well-Being

  • Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
  • Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
  • Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
  • Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives.
  • Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
  • Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain.
  • RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events.
  • RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company.

Perks & Professional Growth

  • A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
  • Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
  • REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.
  • Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!

Social Activities & Life in the Office

  • Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
  • Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
  • Healthy selections — ​​canteens.
  • Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
  • Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog.
  • A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.
  • An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes.
  • No dress-code — we like to keep it casual.

Estimated pay range for this position: 14 200 - 24 400 PLN gross monthly.
Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications.
