title: Senior Tech QA Analyst
description:
CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Tech QA Analyst to join our team working on Cyberpunk 2, the next mainline Cyberpunk 2077 game. In this role, you will be a senior individual contributor within Technical QA, helping translate the project QA strategy into effective technical testing approaches, quality assessments, and measurable outcomes.

You will take ownership of complex technical quality initiatives, support reliable milestone verification, maintain visibility on technical quality status and risks, and continuously improve QA workflows, tools, reporting, and technical testing practices within your areas of ownership.

You will collaborate closely with QA Managers, Production, Development, Tech, Shared Development Services, QA Experts, and cross functional teams to support technical integrity, engine and tools quality, performance, stability, gameplay consistency, and development pipeline reliability.

As a Senior Tech QA Analyst, you will be expected to manage your areas of responsibility with confidence and initiative, navigate ambiguous or evolving technical problems, influence quality practices across disciplines, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to other QA team members.

Responsibilities

  • Technical QA Ownership: Take ownership of complex technical QA initiatives, testing areas, or quality problems from initial assessment through validation, reporting, and resolution.
  • Strategic QA Execution: Translate the overarching Cyberpunk 2 QA strategy into practical technical testing approaches, coverage, measurable outcomes, and priorities within your areas of ownership.
  • Quality Execution & Delivery: Plan and execute technical testing and milestone verification, ensuring quality objectives are completed on time and meet expected technical quality standards.
  • Risk Based Test Strategy: Assess technical changes, systems, and features to identify risk, determine appropriate coverage, and focus testing effort where it provides the greatest quality value.
  • Data Driven Risk Management: Analyze technical quality metrics, KPIs, defect trends, crashes, performance data, and other signals to identify emerging risks and recommend practical mitigation.
  • Technical Investigation & Analysis: Lead or support complex technical investigations involving crashes, performance, stability, memory, engine behavior, tools, platforms, integrations, and development pipelines.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with Development, Production, Tech, QA, and external QA partners to align on technical quality expectations, validation requirements, risks, and outcomes.
  • Quality Advocacy: Establish clear quality expectations within areas of expertise, challenge insufficient coverage or unacceptable risk, and help development partners make informed quality decisions.
  • Transparent Quality Reporting: Produce clear, data informed reporting on technical quality status, blockers, risks, testing outcomes, and readiness for relevant stakeholders.
  • Process & Tool Optimization: Identify and drive improvements to QA workflows, tools, testing frameworks, technical documentation, dashboards, metrics, and validation practices.
  • Technical Guidance & Mentorship: Share technical knowledge, review testing approaches, provide feedback, and mentor less experienced QA team members.
  • Cross Team Technical Support: Act as a senior QA partner for complex technical problems requiring coordination across multiple teams, disciplines, systems, or locations.
  • 5+ years of professional QA experience within game development, with significant experience in Technical QA or comparable technical testing roles.
  • Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, defect management, bug workflows, test planning, risk based testing, test coverage, technical QA practices, and quality reporting.
  • Strong understanding of game development lifecycles and experience developing and executing testing strategies covering integration, stress, performance, stability, tools, engine, platform, and technical feature validation.
  • Experience developing and executing testing strategies for development tools, editors, content pipelines, build systems, and other technical development workflows.
  • Experience with game engines and editors, preferably Unreal Engine.
  • Experience using QA metrics, KPIs, defect trends, and technical data to identify quality risks and inform testing priorities.
  • Experience with performance analysis, profiling tools, crash analysis, memory investigations, platform specific testing, or console development environments.
  • Experience with Unreal Insights, engine profiling, crash debugging, or comparable technical investigation tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive investigations into complex technical issues and work with developers to identify reproduction conditions, impact, risk, and potential root causes.
  • Experience partnering with QA Engineering, Automation, Development, or Tech teams to identify automation and testing tooling opportunities, define testing requirements, and develop scalable technical validation solutions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical quality status, risks, blockers, priorities, and recommendations.
  • Experience identifying and driving improvements to QA workflows, reporting models, dashboards, technical metrics, or test management processes.
  • Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to other QA professionals.
  • Strong ownership, accountability, emotional maturity, and ability to operate effectively under pressure, ambiguity, and changing priorities.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working on AAA titles.
  • Experience with programming or scripting, preferably C++, Python, or similar languages.
  • Experience with automation frameworks, automated test authorship, build verification, CI/CD pipelines, or technical validation workflows.
  • Experience designing or improving technical QA tooling, telemetry, dashboards, or automated reporting.
  • Experience partnering directly with engine, rendering, tools, platform, performance, or build/infrastructure engineering teams.
  • Interest in The Cyberpunk universe and passion for delivering high quality player experiences in large scale RPGs.

Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time or hybrid mode. Relocation is required.

Health & Well-Being

  • Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
  • Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
  • Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
  • Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives.
  • Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
  • Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain.
  • RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events.
  • RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company.

Perks & Professional Growth

  • A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
  • Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
  • REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.
  • Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!

Life in the Office

  • Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
  • Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
  • Healthy selections — ​​canteens.
  • Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
  • Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog.
  • A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.
  • An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes.
  • No dress-code — we like to keep it casual.

Estimated pay range for this position: 14 200 - 24 400 PLN gross monthly. Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications.

Type of contract: Employment Contract ("Umowa o pracę").

title: Staff QA Software Engineer
description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: This role is based at our Santa Clara, CA office, with the option to work a few days a week remotely.
Travel: Up to 15%, domestic or international.
Job ID: 1913

The Role:

We're hiring a QA Engineer to own quality for our SaaS-based Quantum Security Posture Management platform. This role is focused on rigorous, product-level testing — functional correctness, regression coverage, and automation — for a platform that models Layer 2/Layer 3 networks and evaluates security posture. You'll work closely with developers to catch defects early and build confidence in every release.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and execute detailed test cases and test plans for platform features: network discovery, topology mapping, policy/rule analysis, posture scoring, alerting, and reporting.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, and API testing across releases and sprints.
  • Validate correctness of Layer 2/Layer 3 network modeling (VLANs, routing, ACLs, NAT, firewall rules) as represented and analyzed by the product.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites (UI and API level – Selinium, REST Assured, Pytest) to increase regression coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
  • Set up and maintain test environments/labs, including virtual network topologies (e.g., GNS3, EVE-NG, containerlab) and multi-vendor device configs (Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet).
  • Log, triage, and track defects; work with engineering to reproduce, root-cause, and verify fixes.
  • Participate in sprint planning, story grooming, and release readiness reviews, providing a quality/risk perspective.
  • Contribute to test strategy improvements, including shift-left testing practices and CI/CD test integration.
  • Maintain clear, thorough test documentation (test cases, coverage matrices, defect reports).

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in software QA/testing, ideally for SaaS or enterprise infrastructure products.
  • Working knowledge of Layer 2/Layer 3 networking (VLANs, subnetting, routing protocols, ACLs, NAT, firewall logic).
  • Foundational security knowledge — firewall policies, segmentation, common vulnerabilities/misconfigurations.
  • Experience with manual and automated testing (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Postman/Newman) and defect tracking tools (Jira, etc.).
  • Comfortable testing REST APIs and validating JSON/data payloads.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write clear, reproducible bug reports.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Scripting experience (Python, Bash) for test automation.
  • Experience with virtual network labs (GNS3, EVE-NG) or cloud networking (AWS VPC, Azure VNet).
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and test integration.
  • Certifications such as ISTQB, CCNA, or Security+.

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

If this role has a commission structure, the compensation range below just reflects the base compensation range.

$152,000—$190,000 USD

title: Laminator - FRP Nights
description:
About Nautique Boat Company

With over 100 years of excellence, Nautique Boat Company, a subsidiary of Correct Craft, is recognized globally for building the world’s finest ski and wake boats. Since 1925, we’ve led the marine industry through innovation, superior craftsmanship, and a dedication to quality.

Beyond our boats, we’re driven by purpose. Through Nautique Cares, we contribute to causes both locally and around the globe improving that performance, people, and philanthropy go hand-in-hand.

Job Title: Laminator

Classification: Non-Exempt

Reports To: Lamination Manager/Supervisor


Job Description: Lamination/Gunrunner/FRP - Applies and rolls initial layers of fiberglass and resin to hulls and decks. Applies and rolls fiberglass and resin to hulls and inserts metal reinforcing pieces.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify the different hulls and decks that are to be laminated.
  • Use rollers, brushes, and fiberglass guns.
  • Eliminate bubbles in fiberglass once it has been applied.
  • Use small hand tools, including scissors, razors knife, etc.
  • Light sanding and grinding of parts when necessary.
  • Must be flexible and willing to cross-train within the department.
  • Keep the work area clean and orderly.
  • Follow instructions of the Manager/Supervisor/Lead

· Inspects all parts so that they are complete and up to quality standards.

· Any other duties as assigned by management.

· Must comply with all OSHA and safety procedures.

Skills and abilities for success in this position:

  • Give full attention to what other people are saying, take time to understand the points being made, and ask questions as appropriate.
  • Understand written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.
  • Manage one’s own time and respect the time of others.
  • Consider the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.
  • Must be able to work effectively individually or with a team.
  • Must be able to perform tasks under time pressure deadlines.
  • Must have strong attention to detail.
  • The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand.
  • The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong.

Tools used in this occupation include but are not limited to:

  • Personal Protective Equipment- Safety Glasses, half-mask respirator, Tyvek protection suit.
  • Hand Tools- Rollers, Fiberglass chop gun, sanders, and scissors.
  • Working directly with fiberglass and resin.
  • Be able to use and maintain a variety of hand tools.

Knowledge, Education, and Experience include but are not limited to the following:

  • Must be able to work effectively individually or with a team. Be able to use and maintain a variety of hand tools.
  • Some Knowledge of FRP and composites
  • Be able to complete basic installations.
  • Knowledge of production processes and quality control.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to work in a non-climate-controlled environment where ambient air temperature can exceed outside air temperature.
  • Must be able to bend at the waist and knees and stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to see and identify small quality defects.
  • Position requires repetitive arm, hand, and shoulder movements.
  • Fine motor skills required for multiple tasks.
  • Must be able to climb into and out of the interior of boats.
  • Must be able to wear proper safety equipment, including a respirator when necessary.
  • Must be able to lift 50 pounds when necessary.
  • This is a safety-sensitive position.

title: Principal Product Designer, Jira
description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Jira is the beating heart of Atlassian’s System of Work, evolving from a system that helps teams manage work into an intelligent partner for how modern work gets done.

Unifying organizational context, capabilities, and agentic workflows - and enriched by the Teamwork Graph and powered by Rovo, 1P, and 3P agents - Jira turns everyday collaboration into a blend of human creativity, enterprise-grade reliability and agent-driven execution.

Your future team

The Jira Design team’s remit is to continuously evolve Jira into the modern choice for work management and to unleash the power of every team.

We are looking for a Principal Product Designer to be a key leader within the Jira Design team. In this role, you will report into a Senior Design Manager, and join an organization consisting of multiple teams in Australia and North America. As a high level individual contributor, you'll lead and execute visionary work across Jira, Atlassian’s flagship product within the Teamwork Collection app suite.

Responsibilities

What you'll do:

As a Principal Product Designer, you will conceptualise and deliver industry-leading experiences. You’ll mentor our Jira design team, lead strategic initiatives, set cohesive vision, and manage interconnected projects so Jira feels designed by one hand.

As a Product Designer at Atlassian, you'll:

  • Make a substantial impact at scale. We have more than 10M users worldwide, and teams both large and small depend on our software. As a designer involved from product strategy to UI implementation, your work will have direct customer impact.

  • You will own the entire design process. Instead of designing isolated features, you will define end-to-end product experiences and user journeys.

  • Collaborate with some of the industry’s smartest and kindest people. You’ll work on a multidisciplinary product team with engineers, product managers, content designers, researchers, brand and marketing experts, and analysts to advocate for the user experience and ship industry-leading work.

  • Amplify Atlassian’s System of Work and Jira’s role within the Teamwork Collection app suite. You will help usher in a new era of connected context, powerful Rovo capabilities and third-party agent tooling and integrations.

  • Champion our users and great design. We run a world-class design organisation and aim to make customers love our products, measuring our work against competitors and industry standards.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Design end-to-end experiences that integrate AI into Jira workflows and collaboration.

  • Design journeys and patterns that modernise Jira’s design language and create cohesion across our platform, Rovo and 1P/3P agentic workflows.

  • Partner with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to define a unified vision for modern work management at Atlassian.

  • Lead design projects from concept to delivery, owning customer value, outcomes, and impact.

  • Define success metrics to ensure designs deliver customer value and business impact.

title: Team Leader
description:
Join Our Growing Team!

West Coast Convenience is the parent company of Loop Neighborhood Market, Poppy Market, and other gas brands. Headquartered in Union City, CA, we operate a growing network of convenience stores, fuel stations, and car washes across California. Founded in 1978, the company also develops real estate and owns and operates its locations.


West Coast Convenience continues to expand and is seeking customer-focused individuals who want to make an impact. We are committed to delivering high-quality, better-for-you products, and an exceptional store experience, guided by our core values: People, Teamwork, Communication, Training, Results Matter, Fun, Customer-Centered, and Safety.


If you enjoy a fast-paced environment and are driven by service, innovation, and teamwork, we invite you to join us in redefining convenience for our customers every day.


Position Summary:

As Team Leader, you are responsible for the store’s overall success in a hands-on leadership role focused on performance, operations, and customer experience.

· Lead the team with strong business acumen

· Drive sales and profitability across all departments

· Ensure operational excellence in a fast-paced environment

· Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience

· Maintain focus on inventory, retail technology, and safety

The Team Leader sets the tone for the store by modeling our Core Values, building a strong team culture, and ensuring every shift runs efficiently and safely. We win as one, and living our brand is essential in every role.


Primary Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Development

· Hire, train, coach, and retain a strong team

· Set expectations, drive accountability, and build a positive team culture

· Create schedules that support the business and control labor costs


Operations Management

· Oversee daily operations, cash handling, and store readiness

· Maintain cleanliness, safety, and equipment functionality


Sales & Profitability

· Drive sales through merchandising, availability, and service

· Manage inventory, expenses, and store performance


Customer Experience

· Deliver excellent service and resolve customer issues promptly

· Maintain a welcoming, customer-first environment


Compliance & Safety

· Follow company policies and all safety and regulatory standards

· Promote a safe, secure environment for employees and customers

· Perform additional duties as assigned


Requirements & Qualifications:

· High school diploma or equivalent

· 9–12 months of leadership experience in retail, convenience, or a similar fast-paced environment, or equivalent education and experience

· Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and basic math skills

· Ability to multitask, adapt quickly, and manage sales, expenses, and inventory

· Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and insurance

· Willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays

· Motivated to contribute to a performance-driven team

· Must be 21+ years of age


Physical Requirements:

The Team Leader position requires constant standing, bending and reaching with a moderate amount of manual dexterity, and frequent lifting up to 50 pounds. The Team Leader must be comfortable working in varied environments, which include outdoor areas during hot summer conditions as well as cold indoor spaces, such as walk-in freezers.


Employee Incentives:

· Employees that are with us for 6 months to 3 years = 0.10 cents off a gallon of fuel

· Employees that are with us for 3 years to 5 years = 0.30 cents off a gallon of fuel

· Employees that have been with us for 5+ years = 0.40 cents off a gallon of fuel

· MAXIMUM 20 GALLONS AND 2 FILL UPS PER WEEK

description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Solutions Engineering Team
We believe Solutions Engineers at Okta are involved in all stages of the customer’s digital transformation. Solutions Engineers are experienced using presentations, email, phone and social media to connect with customers virtually and in-person. We are looking for great teammates who can build and deliver sales presentations and customized product demonstrations to help educate Okta’s Customers (everyone from developers to product managers to C-level executives) on best practices during their cloud security technology journey. We believe Okta’s Solutions Engineers empathize with Customers and quickly discern their true technical needs by asking detailed, clarifying questions while presenting solutions that specifically address those needs. Okta Solution Engineers have the rare combination of technical acumen and business insight; in a career where you can utilize both. As a Solutions Engineer at Okta, you will further develop each of these skills by advising a diverse set of customers on the value they will gain by using Okta’s Identity Platform.

The Solutions Engineer, Auth0 Opportunity
Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Solutions Engineering, Auth0, the Solutions Engineer is a functional business consultant, with a passion for technology and the advanced ability to develop, position and demonstrate product-specific solutions during sales cycles, while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory.

What you’ll be doing

  • Work alongside the sales team as the technical and domain expert of a customer-facing sales team to help Enterprise Customers understand the value of Okta’s solutions
  • Understand customer challenges and business issues and provide product demonstrations to align our solutions with customer needs
  • Answer product feature and technical questions from customers, partners and Okta colleagues
  • Plan and deliver Proof Of Concepts for customers who have more complex use cases, collaborating with other Okta engineering teams as needed
  • Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer needs and provide additional value
  • Share and learn best practices and re-usable assets with other Solutions Engineers to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
  • Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
  • Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows
  • At times, be asked to learn and lead your team as a subject matter expert (SME) with various product solutions and/or competitive knowledge

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM) Expertise:
    • 5+ years of pre-sales engineering experience in IAM.
    • Strong understanding of IAM concepts, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML.
    • Experience with lifecycle management, role-based access control (RBAC), and provisioning/deprovisioning.
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Hands-on experience in one or more of the following development areas: web (JavaScript, HTML, frontend frameworks), mobile (iOS, Android), backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby), or IP-based real-time communications.
    • Experience working with REST APIs, API Gateways, and SDKs.
    • Deployed applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Vercel, etc.).
    • Understanding of core security concerns in applications (password hashing, SSL/TLS, encryption at rest, XSS, XSRF).
  • Customer Engagement & Communication:
    • Passion for serving customers, demonstrated in a customer-facing role (ideally pre-sales, but consulting or support also valued).
    • Ability to quickly communicate complex technical ideas, including on-the-fly whiteboard explanations.
    • Elite communication skills, confident in dispensing knowledge and presenting to highly skilled and experienced audiences.
  • Strategic & Organizational Skills:
    • Territory management skills, including pipeline building and collaboration with sales counterparts for execution excellence.
    • Diagramming experience for user journey flows, complex architecture diagrams, etc.
  • Education & Travel:
    • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS, or a comparable field is preferred.
    • Typically 25% travel.

You might also have (not mandatory):

  • Experience with Auth0, Auth0 FGA, or OpenFGA.
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI or LLM technology (LangChain, GenKit, LlamaIndex, etc.).
  • Experience integrating with micro services, data lakes, or customer data platforms.
  • Developed ReBAC or Fine-Grained Authorization models.

title: Advanced Composite Engineer
description:
As an Advanced Composite Engineer here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will participate in all phases of product development and serve as a technical point of contact for less experienced engineers.

You will report directly to our Engineering Manager, and you’ll work out of our Phoenix, AZ location on a hybrid work schedule.

This position supports new and existing aerospace gas turbine products, engines, and assemblies involving composite structures, bonded assemblies, and advanced material systems, and will involve approximately 10-20% travel.

• Develop, characterize, and qualify composite material systems including prepregs, adhesives, resins, core materials, and reinforcement fabrics (carbon, glass, aramid).
• Support composite suppliers through manufacturing processes
• Evaluate composite defects and drive root‑cause investigations and corrective actions.
• Lead testing activities generate material allowables and validate process capability.
• Interpret engineering drawings and ensure composite process requirements are properly flowed down to suppliers.
• Support supplier assessments, audits, and development activities in alignment with Honeywell special process controls.
• Partner with ISC, Quality, SDE, Design Engineering, and suppliers to resolve composite processing issues and maintain production continuity.
• Generate and maintain process documentation, specifications, and fixed processes in alignment with Command Media and program requirements.
• Provide guidance, mentorship, and technical support to early‑career engineers within Materials Engineering.

YOU MUST HAVE
•Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics
• 3 or more years of experience in composite materials or composite manufacturing processes.
• Experience with composite fabrication methods (layup, cure, bonding, molding) and associated inspection techniques.
• Familiarity with industry standards related to composite materials and processing.
• Understanding of mechanical behavior of composites, failure mechanisms, and material characterization.

WE VALUE
• Advanced degree in Materials Engineering or related field.
• Experience qualifying composite materials or supporting aerospace composite production.
• Experience with NADCAP audits, special process approvals, and supplier capability assessments.
• Hands‑on background in non-metallic materials, adhesive bonding, and surface preparation requirements.
• Familiarity with FEA, laminate theory, and classical composite analysis methods.
• Strong communication skills, ability to influence cross‑functional teams, and comfort interacting with internal and external suppliers.
• Lean, Six Sigma, or process‑improvement experience applied to composite manufacturing.
• Ability to lift up to 35 pounds occasionally.

title: Teamleder for Budget og Styring i Økonomi og Indkøb - Sorø Kommune
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for et fagligt stærkt team og skabe retning, overblik og sammenhæng i den kommunale økonomistyring? Og motiveres du af en lederrolle, hvor du både er tæt på medarbejderne, den faglige opgaveløsning og samarbejdet på tværs af organisationen?

Sorø Kommune søger en teamleder til Budget og Styring. Kommunen er kendetegnet ved en flad struktur med korte beslutningsveje og et tæt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen. Du bliver en del af Økonomi og Indkøb, der består af tre teams, som arbejder tæt sammen om at understøtte kommunens økonomistyring og administrative opgaver. Du får en central rolle i den daglige ledelse af et fagligt stærkt team og i den fortsatte udvikling af kommunens økonomistyring. Stillingen er nyoprettet og giver dig mulighed for at sætte retning for en vigtig teamlederfunktion med stor betydning for både medarbejdere, samarbejdet på tværs af organisationen og den fortsatte udvikling af området. I tæt samarbejde med økonomichefen og kommunens ledere skal du bidrage til at skabe sammenhæng mellem økonomiske prioriteringer, strategiske mål og den kommunale opgaveløsning.

Opgaverne - det du skal hos os
Som ny teamleder får du ansvar for at skabe klare rammer om teamets opgaver, ressourcer og deadlines og for at sikre en hensigtsmæssig prioritering og fordeling af arbejdet. Du varetager den nære personaleledelse gennem løbende dialog, sparring, feedback og opfølgning og understøtter et arbejdsmiljø præget af tillid, faglig udvikling og fælles ansvar.

Du bliver samtidig et vigtigt bindeled mellem Budget og Styring, de øvrige teams i afdelingen, økonomichefen og kommunens øvrige centre. Her skal du bidrage til tydelige roller og velfungerende samarbejdsflader samt formidle økonomiske problemstillinger, så de bliver relevante og anvendelige for forskellige målgrupper. Du skal bringe teamets økonomifaglige perspektiver ind i de tværgående samarbejder og bidrage til løsninger, hvor økonomiske rammer og faglige behov tænkes sammen.

Rollen som teamleder kombinerer teamledelse med egne økonomikonsulentopgaver. Du skal derfor både varetage den daglige ledelse af teamet og have en selvstændig opgaveportefølje inden for økonomistyring. Samtidig skal du være tæt på teamets leverancer, bidrage aktivt til komplekse opgaver og bringe din egen økonomifaglighed i spil. Det betyder, at du ikke alene sætter retning for opgaveløsningen, men også selv bidrager med faglige analyser, sparring og løsninger i centrale økonomiske opgaver. Den konkrete opgaveportefølje tilpasses dine kompetencer og teamets behov.

Profilen - det vi forventer af dig
Vi forventer, at du har en relevant økonomifaglig uddannelse og solid indsigt i kommunal økonomistyring, budgettering, planlægning og ressourcestyring. Du har forståelse for de vilkår og beslutningsprocesser, der kendetegner en politisk ledet organisation. Erfaring fra en kommune vil være en klar fordel.

Du kan have ledelseserfaring, men det er ikke en forudsætning. Det afgørende er, at du har et tydeligt ledelsesmæssigt potentiale, lyst til personaleledelse og evne til at skabe følgeskab. Du er nærværende og tilgængelig, sætter en klar retning og giver samtidig dygtige medarbejdere rum til ansvar og faglig udfoldelse.

Du skaber stærke samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af fagområder og organisatoriske niveauer ved at møde forskellige perspektiver med nysgerrighed og respekt. Din kommunikation er tydelig og imødekommende, og du kan omsætte komplekse økonomiske analyser og prioriteringer til forståelige budskaber og brugbare beslutningsgrundlag. Samtidig arbejder du struktureret, analytisk og løsningsorienteret og har blik for både detaljen og den samlede kommunale opgaveløsning.

Andet
Du kan læse mere om Sorø Kommune og stillingen i den uddybende stillings- og kompetenceprofil.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not for a specific role, but a way for you to express interest so we can engage and identify a placement opportunity for you here.

By joining Blue Cross NC’s SkillBridge Program, service members can deploy their leadership, problem-solving skills, and mission-driven mindset in a civilian setting. This internship provides a bridge between military service and a meaningful career in healthcare, allowing participants to continue their tradition of service—this time, by helping make healthcare better for all.

We are honored to support transitioning military professionals as they navigate this next chapter and invite you to explore how your skills can make a difference at Blue Cross NC.

**This program is open to only active military service members.**

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Applicants must be active-duty service members within their last 180 days of service at the time of internship start.

  • Participants must receive approval from their commanding officer and service branch to engage in SkillBridge. Blue Cross NC does not determine eligibility for participation.

  • A minimum of 12 weeks of commitment is required for internship placement at Blue Cross NC.

  • Candidates must have a clear end-of-service date that aligns with the internship timeline.

  • For more information visit DoD SkillBridge Program.

Internship Placement & Selection:

  • Internship placement is not guaranteed and is based on available learning/training opportunities and the alignment of the service member’s skills and interests with organizational needs.

  • Selected candidates will undergo a formal interview process to determine fit for available roles.

  • Internships are unpaid and intended for training purposes only, with no guarantee of post-program employment.

  • Participation is contingent upon approval from the service member's commanding officer and is not determined by Blue Cross NC.

  • Interns can work remotely from any of the 50 U.S. states; however, at this time, we cannot accommodate U.S. territories.Note: To be eligible for full-time employment at Blue Cross NC, individuals must reside and work in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin, or Wyoming.

Application Process:

  • Interested applicants must submit a current resume outlining military and civilian experience.

  • Command and service branch approval documentation (if available).

  • A statement of interest or cover letter describing career goals and SkillBridge program objectives.

  • Final selection is contingent upon Blue Cross NC’s internal review and business need alignment.

Program Compliance:

  • The Blue Cross NC SkillBridge Program is conducted in accordance with Department of Defense (DoD) policies, guidance, and regulations. Participation is subject to DoD approval, and all service members must adhere to applicable program requirements throughout their internship.

Additional Considerations

  • Service members are responsible for their own housing, transportation, and living expenses during the internship.

  • Participation in the internship does not imply a future employment offer but provides valuable industry experience.

  • Interns must adhere to all company policies and professional conduct standards throughout the program.

title: Director, HR + Legal Technology & Transformation
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Director, HR & Legal Technology and Transformation to lead technology strategy, enterprise applications, and transformation initiatives supporting the Human Resources and Legal organizations. This role will serve as a trusted technology partner to HR and Legal leaders, translating business priorities into an integrated application, data, and transformation roadmap. The leader will oversee a portfolio of HR and Legal systems and services, drive modernization and simplification, and ensure that technology investments improve employee experience, operational effectiveness, risk management, and business agility.

The ideal candidate brings strong industry experience in HR and Legal technology, a track record of implementing and transforming enterprise systems, and the ability to influence across business and technology organizations. They are equally comfortable shaping strategy, leading complex programs, improving operational discipline, and developing high-performing teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Proactively identify and champion innovative ideas to transform HR processes by leveraging emerging technologies and solutions, such as AI.
  • Define and execute the HR & Legal technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap in partnership with HR, Legal, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data, and Digital Transformation leaders.
  • Act as a strategic technology partner to HR and Legal leaders, shaping priorities, investment decisions, operating models, and transformation plans.
  • Lead the implementation, modernization, integration, and ongoing evolution of enterprise applications supporting HR and Legal processes, employee experiences, legal operations, compliance, and corporate services.
  • Help establish a clear portfolio strategy across core platforms, business-owned applications, integrations, data products, automation, and emerging technologies, including responsible adoption of AI.
  • Drive end-to-end transformation from current-state assessment and business capability mapping through future-state design, delivery, adoption, and value realization.
  • Build and maintain an integrated roadmap that balances business outcomes, user experience, speed, scalability, technical debt, security, privacy, compliance, and operational resilience.
  • Partner with HR and Legal process owners to simplify workflows, reduce manual work, improve self-service, and create consistent experiences for employees, managers, HR partners, attorneys, and other stakeholders.
  • Establish effective governance for application ownership, architecture, integrations, data quality, vendor relationships, service levels, risk, and lifecycle management.
  • Oversee strategic vendors and implementation partners, ensuring delivery quality, commercial accountability, performance against commitments, and alignment to Everpure’s roadmap.
  • Create executive-ready communications that clarify progress, decisions, risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and realized business value.
  • Develop operating mechanisms and metrics to measure portfolio health, adoption, service quality, delivery predictability, user experience, and return on investment.
  • Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of technology, product, program, and application leaders; create an environment of accountability, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Represent HR & Legal technology needs in enterprise planning, architecture, security, data governance, and transformation forums.
  • We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of progressive experience leading enterprise technology, business applications, digital transformation, or technology-enabled operations, including meaningful experience supporting HR and/or Legal organizations.
  • Proven success leading complex implementations and transformations across enterprise HR and Legal applications, platforms, integrations, and data ecosystems.
  • Experience translating business strategy into technology strategy, multi-year roadmaps, investment cases, operating models, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of HR technology domains such as HCM, talent, recruiting, compensation, employee service delivery, workforce management, employee experience, and HR analytics.
  • Strong understanding of Legal technology domains such as legal service delivery, contract lifecycle management, matter management, e-billing, eDiscovery, intellectual property, compliance, privacy, or legal operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment and build trusted relationships with executives, functional leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience managing or governing packaged applications, custom solutions, integrations, data flows, and vendor relationships in a global or complex enterprise environment.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technology decisions to employee experience, productivity, risk reduction, compliance, and business performance.
  • Experience establishing governance, service management, application ownership, delivery standards, and operational metrics across a diverse application portfolio.
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational change, stakeholder adoption, communications, and process redesign—not just technology delivery.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, negotiation, and executive storytelling skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Production Technician
description:
**Worker Type**

Contractor

**Job Description**

**Summary**

The primary responsibility of the Production Technician is to test/assemble electro-mechanical systems and sub-system products in our manufacturing facility following released engineering drawings and assembly instructions using our work order system.

**Position Responsibilities**

- Primary duty is the mechanical assembly of sub-assemblies using small hand and/or power tools. Some soldering may be required
- Works with other Production Technicians and Engineering to correct and improve upon any documents related to the assembly process at the required high quality standard
- Works with manufacturing engineers to improve assembly efficiency, improve product quality, reduce manufacturing costs and validate released assembly/ fabrication documentation
- Responsible for ensuring that work order protocols are followed and that work order paperwork is completed as the work is performed
- May conduct in-process quality checks to ensure that items built are to established high quality standards.
- Follows established procedures on routine work and may require instruction on new assignments
- Maintains a clean and safe work environment
- Other duties as assigned

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience)**

- High School diploma or GED Equivalent
- Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a manufacturing or production environment in either electronics or electro-mechanical assembly and test or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
- Experienced with hand tools, including crimpers, drills, taps, torque wrenches, power tools and air tools is required
- Ability to solder as part of assembly function and duties
- Must have good manual dexterity and basic computer operation skills
- Must have strong oral and written communication skills to communicate effectively with employees in the Company
- Strong analytical, problem-solving skills and attention to detail with ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form

**Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies**

- Vocational training in Electronics or Solder Certification is preferred
- Ability to read blueprints and schematics is desired
- Versed in Lean Manufacturing methodologies is desired
- Familiarity with Safety and ESD practices is desired
- Work with engineering on new product development efforts where documentation and assembly instructions are not yet finalized
- Able to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, where small teams share a broad variety of duties
- Displays strong initiative and drive to accomplish goals and meet company objectives
- Takes ownership and responsibility for current and past work products
- Is committed to learning from mistakes and driven to improve and enhance performance of oneself, others, and the company
- Focuses on teamwork, collaboration and puts the success of the team above one's own interests

**Physical Demands**

- Ability to work in a manufacturing environment
- Ability to frequently use hand tools (e.g. clamps) using light, minimal force
- Regularly required to sit for long periods and occasionally stand for short periods
- Frequently lift and/or carry objects of small size between 2lbs and 5lbs
- Frequently required to use hand to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls and balance
- Occasionally required to walk
- Occasionally required to reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear

No Clearance

title: Extreme Light, Matter, and Fusion Graduate Intern - Summer 2027
description:
The Extreme Light, Matter, and Fusion Directorate (formerly NIF&PS) has multiple openings for graduate level students and students who have received a bachelor’s or master’s degree to engage in practical research experiences to further their educational goals. You will have opportunities to work in a wide array of fields, such as lasers, laser-plasma physics, electro-optics, software development, and optical, x-ray, and nuclear instrument development and testing. For more information, please visit: References may be required.

Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

You will

  • Work alongside scientists conducting research at onsite laser and nuclear facilities in the areas of advanced laser development, fusion energy technologies, laser plasma interactions, hydrodynamics, materials science, radiation physics and various advanced diagnostic systems.
  • Conduct research (experimental, theoretical, or modeling) in assigned areas, under close supervision.
  • Gather and analyze data or information in support of scientific research.
  • Communicate research results: document work, present and discuss findings.
  • Attend relevant seminars and prepare a poster for the Student Intern Poster Symposium.
  • Perform technical assignments of a basic degree of complexity and provide advanced technical support to scientist in scientific research and development projects.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). See Additional Information section below for details.
  • Must be a college or university student in good academic standing, enrolled in an accredited institution, and pursuing a Ph.D. or master's degree in engineering, physics, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated exposure through coursework or relevant experience with tools related to your field of study. For experimental work this can include data reduction and manipulation, image processing, computer-aided drafting, or similar; for theoretical/computational work this includes numerical methods and scientific programming languages (Python, MATLAB, etc.).
  • A sustained record of outstanding academic performance.
  • Ability to work full time for ten to twelve weeks during the summer months.
  • Ability to apply basic engineering or scientific principles to solve technical problems.
  • Ability to present and communicate concepts and ideas.
  • Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to work in a team environment.
  • Experience working with personal computers and familiarity with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Prior experience in physics or engineering laboratory settings for experimental assignments, and in cluster/high-performance computing or plasma physics codes for computational assignments.
  • GPA of 3.0 or above.

Pay Range

$6,752 - $8,201 Monthly

This position is under a step structure. Please note that the step placement is determined by your most recent completed academic year.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

  • Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
  • Holiday Pay
  • Sick leave accrual
  • Individual 401(k) contributions
  • Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

None required. However, if your assignment is longer than 179 days cumulatively within a calendar year, you must go through the Personal Identity Verification process. This process includes completing an online background investigation form and receiving approval of the background check.

National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA)

The 2025 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), Section 3112, generally prohibits citizens of China, Russia, Iran and North Korea without dual US citizenship or legal permanent residence from accessing specific non-public areas of national security or nuclear weapons facilities. The restrictions of NDAA Section 3112 apply to this position. To be qualified for this position, Candidates must be eligible to access the Laboratory in compliance with Section 3112.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How to identify fake job advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.

To learn more about recruitment scams:

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Reasonable Accommodation

Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.

California Privacy Notice

The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

title: Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer (Freelance)
description:
Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

The Senior Platform Engineer builds the onboard software platform on which all Neros autonomy software runs. Working within the Autonomy Platform & Runtime team, this role is responsible hands-on for runtime and middleware integration, real-time scheduling and latency accounting, high-rate on-vehicle logging, hardware time-stamping and time synchronization, and the layer that delivers imagery and inertial data into the autonomy stack.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain the autonomy runtime and middleware integration layer, including module interfaces, process and thread structure, message passing and execution rates, that all other autonomy software is developed against
  • Own real-time scheduling, latency accounting and deadline monitoring on target hardware, including end-to-end sensor-to-actuator latency measurement under sustained thermal load, and deliver the instrumentation required for latency to be enforced as a release gate
  • Design and implement high-rate on-vehicle logging, including ring buffer and triggered capture, multi-sensor and video streams, storage and bandwidth budgeting, and log integrity verification, without degrading control loop timing
  • Implement hardware time-stamping and time synchronization across sensors, mission compute and flight controller, and ensure clock domains and synchronization state are represented in logged data such that flight logs support deterministic replay
  • Support hardware-in-the-loop bench infrastructure and field test operations, including on-site flight test support, and resolve platform-level timing, logging and integration defects identified in flight data

You should have the following

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing production embedded, robotics or real-time software, with a track record of individual technical delivery on systems that operate outside a laboratory
  • Demonstrated delivery of software onto a physical vehicle or embedded platform, such as unmanned aircraft, ground or aerial robotics, autonomous vehicles, automotive or aerospace systems, including responsibility through bring-up, integration and field operation rather than simulation or research alone
  • Expert proficiency in modern C++ on embedded Linux, and working proficiency in Python for tooling, analysis and automation, developed under real-time and resource-constrained requirements
  • Hands-on development within a robotics or vehicle software runtime or middleware layer, covering inter-process communication and message passing, module interface definition, process and thread structure, and execution scheduling, using ROS 2, DDS, Zenoh, LCM, or a proprietary equivalent
  • Depth in real-time systems engineering, including scheduling policies and priorities, CPU affinity and isolation, lock-free or zero-copy data paths, jitter and deadline analysis, and measurement of end-to-end latency distributions on target hardware rather than in simulation
  • Experience building high-rate on-vehicle data logging, including ring buffer and triggered capture, multi-sensor and video streams, storage and bandwidth budgeting, and log integrity, delivered without degrading control loop timing
  • Experience implementing time synchronization and hardware timestamping across sensors, compute and a flight or vehicle controller, using PTP or gPTP, PPS, sensor trigger lines, or equivalent, and reconciling multiple clock domains in logged data
  • Experience developing and debugging sensor drivers and data paths for cameras and inertial sensors, including interfaces such as MIPI CSI-2, GMSL, USB3 Vision, GigE Vision, SPI or I2C, and management of calibration data alongside the sensor streams it applies to

Nice to have

  • Unmanned aircraft experience specifically, including integration between an onboard mission computer and a flight controller or autopilot using PX4, ArduPilot and MAVLink or a proprietary equivalent, and familiarity with arming logic, flight modes and failsafe behavior at that boundary
  • Experience with thermal or other non-visible imaging payloads, including sensor selection support, driver bring-up, and the calibration and data-handling differences relative to visible-spectrum cameras
  • Design or build of hardware-in-the-loop benches, including sensor simulation and injection, hardware timestamp instrumentation, and integration of a HIL bench into automated release gating
  • Experience supporting deterministic log replay for downstream evaluation, including log schema design, provenance and versioning of recorded data, and reconciling recorded sensor timing with offline ground truth such as RTK GNSS post-processing

US Salary Range

$163,500 – $228,500 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Neros' total compensation package.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Software Engineer II DevEx
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Software Engineer II DevEx

Location: San Mateo (Hybrid)

DevEx team builds simulation tools that help PlayStation engineers develop, test, and troubleshoot software in a reliable, repeatable environment. These tools shorten feedback cycles, support earlier validation, and make complex development workflows easier to use.

As a Software Engineer II, you will design and deliver capabilities that improve the accuracy, reliability, and usability of our simulation environment. Your work will include simulator functionality, integration with development and test workflows, automation, diagnostics, and the tools engineers use to configure and interact with the environment.

You will own well-defined features from design through rollout, collaborate with engineering and quality teams across PlayStation, and turn recurring development and testing challenges into reliable, maintainable product improvements.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, implement, test, and document production-quality C++ features for simulation and developer tooling.
  • Build and maintain software abstractions, simulated services, and client/server integrations that reproduce important system behaviors in a development environment.
  • Improve core developer workflows such as environment setup, simulator startup, configuration, input handling, debugging, log collection, and failure recovery.
  • Improve and contribute to build, dependency, packaging, and release workflows for the simulation platform using modern build tools, dependency managers, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Create unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that catch regressions early and move high-value validation into continuous integration.
  • Diagnose failures that cross process, library, container, and platform boundaries; produce clear root-cause analysis and durable fixes.
  • Contribute to shared libraries and developer-facing interfaces including versioning, compatibility, migration guidance, and coordination with consuming teams.
  • Write architecture notes, setup guides, troubleshooting steps, and release documentation that developers can use without direct support from the team.
  • Partner with engineers, QE, product owners, and adjacent platform teams to define integration contracts, sequence cross-team changes, and deliver complete features.
  • Participate in design and code reviews, give actionable feedback, and improve the team’s engineering practices through the work you ship.

What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of professional software-development experience building systems software, platform software, developer tools, infrastructure or similar technical products.
  • Strong modern C++ development skills and practical experience developing and debugging software on Linux.
  • Experience debugging multi-process, client/server, or platform-integrated software using logs, traces, debuggers, and reproducible test cases.
  • Experience building automated tests and integrating them into CI/CD workflows.
  • Working knowledge of build systems, dependency management, source control, and release practices for a multi-repository codebase.
  • Ability to take a defined problem from technical design through implementation, validation, documentation, and rollout.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially when coordinating interfaces or diagnosing issues across team boundaries.

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with simulation, emulation, hardware abstraction, service virtualization, or comparable development environments.
  • Experience with containerized development using Docker, dev containers, WSL, or comparable tooling.
  • Familiarity with CMake, package-management tools, CI systems, collaborative source-control workflows, or cross-platform build toolchains.
  • Experience designing or integrating IPC, client/server API’s, shared libraries, or SDK’s.
  • Experience developing complex platform software or software for resource-constrained environments.
  • Experience supporting developer tools as a product: gathering feedback, measuring friction, improving diagnostics, and simplifying onboarding.
  • Working knowledge of one or more additional languages used in tooling or platform development, such as Python, Rust, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.
$163,700—$245,500 USD

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.
