title: Data engineer (VDAB)
description:
VDAB zoekt een Data Engineer voor het data intelligence team. Dit team telt zo'n 40 collega’s. Zij voorzien interne en externe data gebruikers van oplossingen. Denk aan management rapportering en business analyse. Ook leveren ze input voor AI toepassingen. Je werkt bijvoorbeeld mee aan de transitie van een klassieke data toolset (data warehouse) naar een recenter platform op cloudera technologie (data lake).

Functieomschrijving

Waarom zou de kandidaat voor deze functie moeten kiezen?

Je komt terecht in een uitdagende omgeving, in een team met een joviale en inclusieve cultuur waar je kan werken met moderne technologie. Bovendien bouw je mee aan een betere ondersteuning van de Vlaamse arbeidsmarkt

Wat is het doel van de functie ?

  • Je zal een belangrijke rol spelen in een uitgebreide portfolio aan projecten die gepland staan om het bestaande dataplatform te vernieuwen en verder uit te breiden.
  • Je werkt in een compact agile team met een scrum aanpak. Je configureert de nodige ELT stromen in DBT en/of NIFI om data te transformeren.
  • Je voegt data elementen toe aan de datavault met de Vaultspeed automator.
  • Je stelt dimensionele datamodellen op om de gewenste datasets te ontwerpen.
  • Je schrijft SQL-queries om de gewenste datasets voor dataproducten te creeëren.
  • Je test en valideert dataproducten om de kwaliteit en integriteit te waarborgen en testbevindingen op te lossen.
  • Je documenteert de end-2-end oplossing
  • Je geeft ondersteuning bij problemen, performance issues en werkt mee aan procesverbeteringen- en optimalisaties.
  • Je verfijnt, samen met de functioneel analist, de gevraagde requirements voor een dataproduct en vertaalt deze naar een concrete oplossing.
  • Je evalueert de technische haalbaarheid, beheersbaarheid en kostefficiëntie van een dataproduct en stelt hieromtrent verbeteringen voor.

De 3 belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Correct opbouwen van datapipelines die een oplossing biedt aan de beschreven user story
  • Zorgen dat de geschreven code correct getest en gedocumenteerd is.
  • Het scrum team versterken door een actief teamlid te zijn.

Wat zijn de belangrijkste taken?

  • Bouwen van data pipelines in moderne ETL/ELT tools zoals DBT en NIFI
  • Het onderhouden van het data platform van VDAB
  • Schrijven en uitvoeren van unit tests om de gebouwde code te valideren
  • Opvolgen en ondersteunen van de operationele processen in het team, inclusief oplossen van voorkomende bugs

Profiel

Vaardigheden

  • Bachelor of gelijkwaardig door ervaring
  • Je hebt minimum 5 jaar praktische werkervaring als data engineer.
  • Je kan bijvoorbeeld zelfstandig SQL-queries schrijven om testdata te selecteren of flows te begrijpen. Je kent de componenten en kritische tussenstappen in zowel data warehouse als event-gedreven datastromen. En je kan documentatie opstellen.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het maken en ontwikkelen van data pipelines in DBT.
  • Je hebt kennis van Nifi en Kafka.
  • Je bent thuis in GIT en weet hoe je metadata kan beheren. Je hebt ervaring met Hadoop en big data.
  • Bewezen kennis van CDP (Cloudera dataplatform) in een data & analytics context is een troef. Je kan die kennis staven door de nodige certificaties, relevante ervarin of een speciefiek leertraject.
  • Je weet hoe datasets performant gemaakt kunnen worden.
  • Je hebt al kennis gemaakt met data load refresh strategieën en met CI/CD.
  • Je begrijpt de basisconcepten van Agile en Scrum.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen van applicaties of services in Python geeft jou net dat streepje voor op de anderen.
  • Kennis opbouw van een DWH en datamodellering (3e NV, data vault, dimensioneel)
  • Praktische kennis van javascript zien we als een plus
  • Event driven architectuur - begrijpen wat dit betekent op gebied van data
  • Je bent een echte teamplayer en sparring partner voor de functioneel analist en architecten, waar je sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (in het Nederlands) je helpen.
  • Je bent proactief ingesteld, houdt van een pragmatische aanpak en vindt het heerlijk na te denken over de data oplossingen van morgen.

Waar ga je werken

Je werkt 2 dagen in Brussel, op wandelafstand van het station Brussel Noord.

Jouw toekomstig team

40 personen, bestaande uit functioneel analisten, data engineers, front end developers en testers.

Wat zijn typische projecten van deze functie/afdeling?

Data integreren in het VDAB data platform, datasets aanbieden aan de verschillende klanten binnen en buiten VDAB.

Aanbod

Vlaanderen connect biedt een contract van 38 uur voor onbepaalde duur en een competitief salarispakket met:

  • Een aantrekkelijke bruto verloning (salaris tussen 3920 EUR en 5300 EUR, afhankelijk van ervaring, competenties en potentieel)
  • Een bonussysteem op basis van vast te leggen doelstellingen
  • 28 dagen verlof en extra wettelijke feestdagen (11/07, 02/11 en 15/11).
  • Een mobiliteitsbudget van 810 EUR/maand
  • Maaltijdcheques van 8 euro/dag (eigen bijdrage 1,09 euro/dag)
  • Een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding van 165 EUR/maand
  • Een hospitalisatieverzekering (je kan gezinsleden aansluiten)
  • Een groepsverzekering (4% werkgeversbijdrage en 1% werknemersbijdrage)
  • Een arbeidsongevallenverzekering
  • Een opleidingsbudget
  • Flexibele werkuren
  • Mogelijkheden tot thuiswerk
  • Tegemoetkoming in de kosten van schoolvakantieopvang

Redenen om voor Vlaanderen Connect te kiezen!

Werk bij Vlaanderen Connect en maak elke dag tastbaar verschil voor 6,5 miljoen mensen, van je straat tot de toekomst van heel Vlaanderen. Duik in uitdagende projecten waar kwaliteit, resultaat en de nieuwste technologieën centraal staan. Groei tussen digitale experten, deel je talent en krijg de ruimte om je ambities waar te maken. title: HR Assistant - Remote Insurance Team
description:
This is a remote position.

HR & Recruitment Assistant
Remote | South African Hours | Entry Level with Growth Potential
We are looking for a highly dependable, professional and detail-oriented HR & Recruitment Assistant to work directly alongside our Head of Recruitment.
This is an entry-level remote position with significant room to learn and grow. The successful candidate will act as the right hand to the Head of Recruitment, assisting with the day-to-day administrative and operational work that keeps our recruitment function running smoothly.
This role is ideal for someone who takes pride in being reliable, enjoys structured administrative work, and is comfortable taking ownership of the small details that matter.
Working Hours
Monday–Friday | 08:00–17:00 SAST
This is a full-time remote position. You must be consistently available and ready to work during these hours.

Requirements

What You’ll Be Doing
Your responsibilities will include:
Capturing, updating and maintaining candidate and recruitment data
Completing repetitive administrative and data-capturing tasks accurately
Assisting with candidate screening and recruitment administration
Making and receiving phone calls when required
Following up with candidates and other relevant parties
Updating recruitment systems, spreadsheets and internal records
Keeping information organised and ensuring tasks do not fall through the cracks
Assisting the Head of Recruitment with day-to-day tasks and priorities
Following established processes and identifying when something requires attention
Taking ownership of assigned work and following tasks through to completion
Handling candidate and company information professionally and confidentially
Taking on additional HR and recruitment responsibilities as your skills and experience grow
Who We’re Looking For
We care more about attitude, reliability and work ethic than years of experience.
You should be:
Extremely dependable - if you say you are going to do something, it gets done
Professional and trustworthy
Loyal and interested in growing with the company
Highly organised and detail-oriented
Comfortable with data capturing and repetitive administrative work
Able to maintain accuracy even when a task is tedious
Comfortable speaking to people on the phone
Able to communicate professionally in writing and verbally
Comfortable receiving feedback and taking accountability for mistakes
Proactive enough to follow up rather than waiting to be reminded
Able to work independently without constant supervision
Comfortable learning new systems and processes
Willing to ask questions when unsure rather than guessing
Technical Requirements
Because this is a fully remote position, applicants must have:
A reliable fibre internet connection of at least 50 Mbps
Reliable loadshedding/power-outage provisions that allow you to continue working during outages
A suitable computer and professional remote-working environment
A reliable phone and the ability to make calls when required
These requirements are essential for the position.
Experience
This is an entry-level role, so extensive HR or recruitment experience is not required.
Previous experience in administration, recruitment, customer service, data capturing or a professional office environment will be advantageous, but we are willing to train the right person.
What matters most is that you are reliable, teachable, accountable and consistent.
Growth Opportunity
This position is intended to grow with the right person.
You will work closely with the Head of Recruitment and gain hands-on exposure to recruitment operations, candidate management, HR administration and internal processes. As you demonstrate competence and take ownership of more responsibilities, there will be opportunities to expand your role.
We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted long-term member of the team, not simply someone looking for something temporary.
The Person Who Will Thrive Here
You don’t need to know everything on day one.
You do need to be the kind of person who can be trusted with a task, pays attention to the details, communicates when something goes wrong, learns from mistakes and becomes increasingly capable without needing to be chased.
If you are looking for an opportunity to get your foot in the door in HR and recruitment and are willing to prove yourself through consistency and hard work, we would like to hear from you.

title: Mechanical Engineering Intern | Summer 2027
description:
DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.

DLR Group’s Cleveland studio has an opening for a Mechanical Engineering Summer Intern.

We have multiple positions and locations available; please refer to all openings posted and apply to the locations that are most suitable for your living situation during the course of your internship. This is not a remote position.

About EPX at DLR Group

As an intern at DLR Group, you’ll be part of our Emerging Professional Experience (EPX) Program, designed to give you a meaningful introduction to life within an integrated design firm and a strong foundation for your career in the AEC industry.

Each person at DLR Group has a design voice, and EPX gives you opportunities to develop and share yours. Through hands-on project work, mentorship, and learning experiences, you’ll gain exposure to the people, disciplines, and ideas that shape the built environment. You may participate in design discussions, project meetings, site visits, business development efforts, office activities, and other experiences that broaden your understanding of the design profession.

The program combines three core components: mentorship, project work, and weekly learning sessions. Topics may include design culture, sustainability, design technology, communication, marketing and business development, project and resource management, research, equity, career development, and more. title: Senior QA Engineer I
description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer I to join our team! You will be responsible for ensuring the quality of a suite of tools for providers, patient workflows, and diagnostic reporting. Successful candidates will be ambitious, self-driven, and organized, deeply invested in both the user experience and the real-world functionality of our products.

This role is fully remote; however, we have a preference for candidates able to work in the Pacific Time Zone (PST) hours to better align with team collaboration.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and developers to shape quality from the ground up.
  • Analyze and evaluate business requirements with product managers and translate them into test strategies.
  • Create, execute, and maintain test documentation and test plans.
  • Create and execute manual and automated testing of web applications: exploratory, functional, acceptance, regression, and UI testing.
  • Test APIs and backend services (REST, GraphQL) for robustness and correctness.
  • Ensure that quality issues and defects are appropriately identified, documented, prioritized, and tracked.
  • Lead root cause analysis with developers to accelerate defect resolution.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and help instill best practices across the team.
  • Be an active voice in process improvements to raise product quality and engineering performance.
  • Integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality.
  • Ensure web applications meet accessibility standards (WCAG/ADA) through manual and automated testing.
  • Contribute to performance and security testing efforts where applicable..

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of professional experience in software QA.
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Experience with test design techniques and practical implementation.
  • Strong knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, client-server architecture, and APIs.
  • Experience testing RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Awareness of accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and experience testing with tools like Axe, Lighthouse, or screen readers.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Appium, Espresso, XCUITest).
  • Solid experience with bug tracking systems (e.g., JIRA).
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with proven problem-solving abilities.
  • A collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering high-quality, user-centered products.
  • BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing native mobile applications (iOS and/or Android).
  • Familiarity with mobile app testing tools such as Xcode, Android Studio, Appium, Detox, or BrowserStack.
  • Understanding of mobile app distribution workflows (TestFlight, Google Play Console) and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience designing and executing accessibility test strategies to ensure inclusive user experiences.
  • Experience contributing to performance and security testing initiatives.
  • Experience testing healthcare applications, electronic health record (EHR) systems, or products handling sensitive health data (HIPAA, PHIPA, or similar compliance environments).

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • Retirement made easy! Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $140,000-$153,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Splunk Administrator
description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Senior Splunk Engineer to join our rapidly growing and innovative cybersecurity team!

The Splunk Engineer will design, implement, and maintain secure, reliable data ingestion pipelines and integrations across Splunk environments, supporting logs, metrics, events, and other cybersecurity data sources. This role is responsible for Splunk administration, infrastructure performance, data integrity, system upgrades, custom Technical Add-Ons, alerting, and troubleshooting across on-premises and cloud-based environments. The Engineer will collaborate closely with SOC and cross-functional teams to optimize cybersecurity tools, support access controls, resolve technical issues, and improve operational processes and documentation. The ideal candidate brings strong Splunk engineering and SPL expertise, Linux experience, and the ability to manage high-volume data pipelines while ensuring performance, security, and compliance.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Required Experience

  • 4 years of Information Technology Experience
  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, related degree or an additional two (2) years of experience.
  • 3+ years of Splunk administration or engineering experience.
  • Proficiency in configuring and managing Splunk inputs, setting up data ingestion pipelines, and establishing system connections.
  • Knowledge of Splunk's Search Processing Language (SPL), data parsing techniques, and the use of regular expressions for data extraction and transformation.
  • Skilled in optimizing data pipelines for performance and efficiency, handling large data volumes, and implementing best practices for data integrity and consistency.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Splunk Core Certified Consultant or Splunk Enterprise Certified Architect certification preferred.
  • Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud Certified Admin acceptable.
  • Experience as an engineering team lead (representing the team's work to clients).
  • Experience working with Splunk, syslog, syslog-ng or systems designed to collect and centralize logs.
  • Experience leveraging Cribl to optimize Splunk ingest
  • Experience assisting teams with Fraud Analytics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and implement processes for ingesting data from various sources into Splunk, ensuring seamless integration and minimal data loss. Processes may include HTTP Event Collector (HEC), Splunk Stream, Splunk Technical Add-Ons (TAs), Universal Forwarder (UF) Collections, custom APIs and other ingest mechanisms.
  • Configure and manage data inputs to accommodate different types of data sources, including logs, metrics, and events to determine compliance with M-26-14 requirements at the FISMA system boundary level.
  • Establish and maintain secure and reliable connections between Splunk and external systems or data sources.
  • Create, monitor, and maintain alerts for failed data inputs.
  • Create and maintain custom Technical Add-Ons for non-standard ingest paths leveraging API connections.
  • Ensure proper authentication and authorization mechanisms are in place for data transfer and system communication.
  • Oversee the configuration and maintenance of Splunk infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and security of the Splunk environment.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Splunk functionality.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for incidents and implement preventive measures.
  • Utilize Linux skills to manage and maintain the underlying operating system or Cloud based containers of Splunk servers and other security applications.
  • Monitor tool health and performance to identify issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Develop, review, and update existing operational documentation (SOPs, Job Aids, application checklists, playbooks, etc).
  • Support system access controls, including Account Management, Access Enforcement, Information Flow Enforcement, Least Privilege, and workflow for all user account requests and account recertifications.
  • Collaborate with the Security Operations Center (SOC) teams for process optimization, tool tuning, tool integration, information sharing, playbook development, and incident response.
  • Perform implementation, administration, operations and maintenance, optimization, & integration of cybersecurity tools, technologies, and services
  • Conduct regular Splunk Enterprise upgrades for deployment servers, heavy forwarders, and syslog servers.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions is a security-focused IT solutions provider with public clients nationwide. Named one of the fastest growing privately held companies by Inc. 5000, Washington Technology’s Fast 50, and Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in the D.C. area, Valiant Solutions prides itself on providing its employees with great benefits and career development opportunities. As a company, we are just as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class IT solutions, all while enjoying an unparalleled work-life balance. We are in a phase of tremendous growth and building the team that will take us to the next level. We seek people whose talents and accomplishments will contribute to a thriving company, who have the character to support their capacity, and can make a positive impact on our culture. Alongside our talented team, you’ll learn to think quickly on your feet and expand your own personal and professional skill set. Our management team will inspire you to consider new perspectives and challenge you to become a better practitioner in the fast-paced industry of IT security. We hire people we respect – and we trust them to deliver results leveraging their expertise. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment as part of a stellar team of professionals, then we invite you to apply online today.

Benefits Snapshot (includes, but not limited to)Valiant pays 99% of the Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage for Full-time EmployeesValiant contributes 25% towards Health Coverage for Family and Dependents100% Paid Short Term Disability and Life Insurance Policy for Full-time Employees100% Paid Certifications401K Matching up to 4%Paid Time OffPaid Federal HolidaysWellness & Fitness ProgramValiant University – Online Education and Training PortalFSA programs for: Medical Costs, Dependent Care, Transit, and ParkingReferral Bonuses

The salary range for this position is a general guideline and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. It has been benchmarked in relation to the scope of the role, market rate, and internal equity. The salary for this role is expected to be in the $140,000 - $170,000 range. Where a candidate falls within the band can be determined based on one or more of the following: skillset, experience level, achievements, education, geographic location, security clearance, involvement in corporate tasks, and other non-discriminatory factors. In addition to the base salary, this role will include benefits as described above. Valiant reserves the right to adjust the salary range, experience requirements, and position responsibilities at any time without prior notice.

Remote Work Policy

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that align with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or veteran status, in accordance with applicable law.

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods of time and consistent operation of a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. title: Chief Engineer- Targets
description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

Stratolaunch is seeking a high-impact technical leader to be Chief Engineer to support its growing hypersonic targets portfolio. This position will support the Office of the Chief Engineer for targets, with a focus on development programs. In this role, you will be trusted to lead people, develop and execute technical strategies for open-ended problems, manage risk, and communicate successfully with internal and external customers. The ideal candidate is a demonstrated technical leader and team player with significant experience pertinent to air-launched missile and/or target system development.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with Stratolaunch and customer leadership to drive successful program execution
  • Apply Systems Engineering principles to control scope, manage risk, and drive quality technical execution
  • Facilitate successful technical meetings and reviews such as Engineering Review Board and technical gate reviews. (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR)
  • Lead trade studies and make final technical decisions, requiring balance across a wide breadth of disciplines to include: aerodynamics, propulsion, avionics, airframe, GNC, and payloads
  • Create engineering staffing plans and identify skillset gaps in the team
  • Support whitepapers, proposals and other business development activities

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated success as an engineering team leader with experience balancing cost, schedule, and technical performance considerations when making decisions
  • Experience acting as a system integrator
  • Experience leading a technical team through missile and/or hypersonic flight vehicle development
  • Technical subject matter expertise in at least one technical domain of relevance (aerodynamics, propulsion, avionics, airframe, GNC), which sufficient breadth to lead a multi-disciplinary development team.
  • Ability to effectively manage relationship with key stakeholders, including government customers
  • Demonstrated success applying analytical and critical thinking skills to solve multi-disciplinary, open-ended technical problems
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment to achieve business goals
  • Experience supporting defense contracts
  • US Citizen with the ability to obtain a DOD security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Demonstrated success as a Chief Engineer on missile and/or hypersonic flight vehicle development programs
  • Hypersonic/high-speed tactical missile experience highly desirable (e.g. multi-stage systems, hot structure airframes, launch platform integration)
  • Experience with solid rocket motor propulsion systems
  • Experience transitioning developmental systems to production
  • Active TS/SCI security clearance

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Principal-Level ($163,000 - $229,352): Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) from accredited institution and 20-25 years of relevant experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Principal-Level ($205,000 - $294,200): Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) from accredited institution and 25+ years of relevant experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience.

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable:

  • This position is located in Mojave, CA.
  • Applicants must be a US Person able to obtain a security clearance to be considered for this role.
  • Travel estimated to be <10% in support of the program.

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s):

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave
  • 50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

title: Senior Software Engineer C# - FLEXIBLE WORKING
description:
Onze klant is een vooraanstaande speler in de internationale technologiesector, gespecialiseerd in geavanceerde softwarebeveiliging en digitale bescherming. In een landschap waarin digitale transformatie razendsnel gaat en moderne softwareontwikkeling steeds complexer wordt, biedt dit bedrijf innovatieve oplossingen die organisaties wereldwijd grip geven op de kwaliteit en veiligheid van hun applicaties. Met een ijzersterke staat van dienst en een wereldwijde aanwezigheid vertrouwen talloze toonaangevende ondernemingen op hun expertise. Het werk van dit bedrijf vormt een essentiële pijler onder de betrouwbaarheid van de digitale toepassingen die we dagelijks gebruiken. Als Senior Software Developer speel je een sleutelrol in het bouwen en verfijnen van dit toonaangevende platform. Je versterkt een hecht, internationaal team van gedreven vakgenoten waar transparantie, wederzijds respect en een open feedbackcultuur de norm zijn. Neem het voortouw bij het ontwerp en de realisatie van krachtige backend-services met talen zoals Go, Java of Node.js. Waarborg de schaalbaarheid en prestaties van het platform door potentiële knelpunten in de architectuur proactief op te lossen. Begeleid junior collega's via gerichte code reviews en kennisdeling om zo het niveau van het gehele team naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Lever een actieve bijdrage aan architectonische keuzes die de langetermijnkwaliteit en onderhoudbaarheid van de software garanderen.

In de rol van Senior Software Developer combineer je een grondige kennis van softwarekwaliteit met de zelfstandigheid om uitdagende projecten van begin tot eind op te leveren. Ruime ervaring met full-stack ontwikkeling binnen een moderne omgeving, waarbij je vlot navigeert tussen frontend en backend. Uitstekende beheersing van TypeScript en React, aangevuld met grondige ervaring in ten minste één backendtaal zoals Go, Java of Node.js. Affiniteit met geautomatiseerd testen, CI/CD-pipelines en cloud-infrastructuur zoals Kubernetes of Infrastructure as Code is een mooie plus. Een aantrekkelijk marktconform brutoloon (€4300-€4800) dat recht doet aan jouw opgebouwde ervaring en senioriteit als Software Developer. Een uitgebreid pakket aan extralegale voordelen, waaronder maaltijdcheques en een representatief budget voor dagelijkse onkosten. Een representatieve bedrijfswagen met laadpas of een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, afgestemd op jouw persoonlijke voorkeur. Maximale wendbaarheid dankzij een hybride werkregeling waarin je de vrijheid krijgt om kantoor- en thuiswerk optimaal te combineren. Een ruim aantal jaarlijkse vakantiedagen om geregeld de batterij weer helemaal op te laden. Talloze mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen via trainingen, workshops en het bijwonen van vakgerichte conferenties. Solliciteer zeker en we contacteren je ASAP.

title: Leader, Customer Adoption & Experience
description:
AdvancedMD

AdvancedMD is a unified cloud suite of medical office software hosted on Amazon Web Services/AWS including practice management, electronic health records, and patient engagement, and offers managed medical billing services for independent practices. AdvancedMD serves an expansive national footprint of 65,000 practitioners across 14,000 practices and 900 independent medical billing companies. 8.8M insurance claims are processed every month on the AdvancedMD billing platform!

Role Summary

Are you a customer-obsessed leader who sees the whole journey and knows how to turn what customers tell you into changes that help them succeed? AdvancedMD is entering a defining chapter. We are building a customer success organization that can support both our established enterprise motion and a new product-led offering launching this year. The Leader, Customer Adoption & Experience will hold the end-to-end view of how our customers move from sale to full adoption, owning the customer journey map and insights, the voice-of-the-customer program, and the Enablement team.

This is a builder's role that leads through insight and influence. You will turn customer signals into clear recommendations and partner with the line leaders who run each stage of the journey, defining adoption milestones with CS leaders, shaping playbooks and engagement levels with CSM leadership, improving time-to-value and efficiency with Implementation leadership, and informing digital customer success with the CSM onboarding team. You will report to the Sr. Director, Customer Success Operations and work closely with Product, Marketing, Support, BI, and CS Systems on a regular basis. This role is equal parts strategy and execution: you will be expected to set the direction and roll up your sleeves to see it through. In collaboration with those leaders, you will be accountable for measurable improvement in adoption, time-to-value, and gross revenue retention across our post-sale customer base.

If you enjoy mapping the customer experience, turning feedback and data into decisions, and building education that helps customers get productive faster, we'd love to meet you.

Essential Job Duties

Customer Journey & Insights:

  • Own the end-to-end post-sale customer journey map, covering implementation, first-year onboarding, long-term CSM ownership, and support — and use it as a practical tool, not a slide in a deck
  • Identify where customers stall and bring those findings to the leaders who own each stage — don't just surface the problem, help drive the fix
  • Define adoption milestones and key customer moments in partnership with CS leaders, so every team works toward the same picture of an adopted customer

Partnership Across the Customer Lifecycle:

  • Partner with CSM leadership on lifecycle playbooks and the right level of engagement by segment, providing the journey insight, VoC findings, and data that help CSM teams succeed
  • Partner with Implementation leadership to reduce time-to-value — identifying friction, recommending efficiency improvements, and determining where automated or self-serve training can replace manual effort
  • Shape digital customer success with the CSM onboarding team, who runs the program — you contribute journey insight, adoption milestones, and content
  • Apply AI and automation to scale the team's impact, partnering with CS Systems to avoid duplicated tools and effort

Enablement:

  • Lead the Enablement function across four audiences: customers, Professional Services, CSMs, and Support
  • Shift the team from request-driven training to proactive education tied to journey gaps, product releases, and regulatory changes
  • Work in partnership with instructional design, technical writing, and video teams to deliver content and programs at scale

Voice of the Customer:

  • Build and run the voice-of-the-customer program with Product, Marketing, Support, and other departments
  • Share insights across the organization so decisions reflect the customer experience

Reporting & Analystics:

  • Define and report adoption and experience metrics, and shape the customer health score, in collaboration with CS leaders, BI, and CS Systems
  • Connect outcomes to GRR and present results and recommendations to the Sr. Director, Customer Success Operations

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and develop the team, directly managing the Enablement team and the Program Manager, Customer Journey & Insights
  • Build a culture of rigor, accountability, and continuous improvement

What You'll Need to Get the Job Done:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in customer success, customer experience, customer education, or related post-sale functions — with at least 3 years in a people leadership role (Director-level candidates typically bring 10+ years of experience and 5+ years of people leadership)
  • Background in B2B SaaS or healthcare technology
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Education, or a related field required; equivalent experience considered. Advanced degree preferred
  • Proven success designing and scaling a digital or tech-touch customer success program that measurably improved adoption or retention
  • Experience mapping an end-to-end customer journey and driving improvements through the teams that own each stage
  • Track record leading customer education or enablement teams that produced content and programs at scale
  • Experience building or running a voice-of-the-customer program and turning qualitative and quantitative feedback into action
  • Data fluency — you can define metrics, frame analytical questions, interpret results, and direct analysts — and you know how to tie program outcomes to GRR, NRR, and time-to-value
  • Strong executive communication and cross-functional influence skills, including with Product, Marketing, and Sales leadership, without direct authority
  • You can operate as both a strategic leader and a hands-on builder during periods of organizational change
  • You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and don't hide behind complexity

What Will Make us LOVE You

  • You have hands-on experience with CS platforms (e.g., Planhat, Gainsight) and digital adoption platforms (e.g., Pendo) at a program-ownership level
  • You have applied AI to content creation, customer feedback analysis, or customer engagement at scale — and have a clear point of view on where it helps most
  • You've built a function from an early stage before, including defining roles and headcount needs
  • You bring hands-on analytical skills (e.g., SQL, BI tools, advanced Excel) or hold a certification in customer success or customer experience (e.g., CCXP)
  • You have a background in healthcare technology, practice management, or EHR software, with an intuitive understanding of what drives adoption and churn in medical practices
  • You obsess over the customer journey and naturally translate customer feedback and operational data into decisions that improve it
  • You lead with clarity and calm in ambiguous environments, and the teams around you — from Product to Sales to the C-suite — trust you as a true partner

Life at AdvancedMD: The BURST Way to Be - Learn more about our Company culture.

  • Be Intentional – We act with clarity, focus, and purpose in everything we do.
  • Urgency with Purpose – We move fast on what matters and deliver meaningful results.
  • Respect Always – We lead with integrity, value every voice, and build each other up.
  • Strive for Greatness – We set high standards, embrace innovation, and never stop improving.
  • Together with Clients – We collaborate deeply, build trusted partnerships, and win as one team.

About AdvancedMD

AdvancedMD, now part of the Francisco Partners (“FP”) portfolio, revolutionized medical office software in 1999 with the introduction of the industry’s first true cloud solution. Today, the company continues to lead HealthTech innovation with a complete cloud suite of smart applications that work in unison, accelerating collaborative workflow for every role of the practice. With AdvancedMD, medical office staff are empowered to thrive in the online age of healthcare and value-based reimbursement with essential clinical, financial, patient engagement and reputation management applications that are unified and available anytime, anywhere on any device. AdvancedMD strives to be the technology heartbeat of healthcare for providers, patients, and payors for a healthier world. For more information on AdvancedMD, please visit

Work Environment

Many positions offer meaningful remote work opportunities based on individual performance, team structure, and alignment with role KPIs. Certain teams, however, require a Full In-Office presence due to the nature of their work or collaboration needs.

    Specific expectations for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation and total rewards benefits

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with generous company match

  • Paid time off and holidays

  • Hybrid and remote work opportunities

  • Career growth and development support

  • Collaborative, team-oriented culture

title: ABA Supervisor
description:
Title: Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) Hybrid Remote

Location: The Woodlands, TX and Surrounding Areas (Hybrid Option Available)

At Cortica, our Board-Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) use a strength-based, holistic approach to clinical programming for children with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences. Our valued BCBAs are leaders who make a difference and create a supportive environment where all clinicians in our transdisciplinary team can thrive, grow, and make a meaningful, long-term impact for families.

You’ll provide groundbreaking, neurodiversity-affirming care, while enjoying the flexibility and support you deserve.


Why Choose Cortica?

We’re excited to support your continued professional development, growth, well-being, and ability to make a meaningful impact as part of a transdisciplinary team. That's why our compensation and benefits package has been designed to support you personally and professionally:

  • Earning Potential (Salary +Productivity Bonus): $90,439 - $112,932
    • Plus earn up to an additional 10% of your monthly salary with our second bonus – that’s right, TWO bonuses to increase your earning potential!

  • Generous Time Off to Recharge and Maintain Work-Life Balance: Up to 22 days off in your first year, increasing to 26 days after 12 months.

  • Flexible Hybrid Role: We offer remote flexibility, allowing you to balance your clinical work and administrative tasks on your terms. Telehealth is determined by the BCBA when it's clinically effective for the client and BT.
  • CEU Stipend: $2,000 annually to support your continued professional development.

  • License Reimbursement: We cover the cost of your BCBA license renewal.

  • 401(k) Matching: Helping you plan for your future with matching contributions.

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, plus pet insurance—because we care about your entire family, furry friends included!

  • Set Scheduling: Predictable work hours help you balance your work and personal life.

Your Role and Impact

As a BCBA at Cortica, you’ll play a pivotal role in overseeing neurodiversity-affirming clinical programming for patients receiving ABA treatment. You'll lead a team of behavior technicians (BTs) empowering them to make a lasting difference in the lives of children with developmental differences.

What you’ll love about this role:

  • Achievable Targets: You’ll average 26 billable hours per week, with reduced targets during shorter weeks to ensure a manageable workload.

  • Industry-Leading Dual Bonus Program: Enjoy two separate bonus opportunities that reward your impact and leadership. -
    - Productivity Bonus: Increase your earning potential through flexible productivity incentives designed to reward additional billable hours while maintaining work-life balance.
    - ABA Caseload Bonus: Earn additional monthly bonus opportunities based on ABA direct service hours billed and converted within your POD, with bonus potential up to 10% of monthly base salary.

  • Growth and Advancement Opportunities: You'll have the chance to advance through BCBA levels I, II, III, and IV, increasing your leadership impact along the way. At BCBA levels III and IV, productivity targets are reduced to 22, allowing you to focus on developing leadership skills, cultivating other talents, and exploring broader professional interests.

  • Autonomy over Your Schedule: You’ll have full control over when and where you supervise your cases, empowering you to design a schedule that works for you.

  • Administrative Support: Focus on what you do best—clinical care—while our dedicated team handles scheduling, billing, and credentialing, leaving you with more time to focus on your work and patients.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Master’s degree in human services or a related field.

  • Current BCBA (Board-Certified Behavior Analyst) Certification required.

What Makes Cortica Different from Other ABA Companies?

At Cortica, we believe in going beyond traditional ABA practices to offer a more comprehensive, patient-centered approach that is different from other ABA companies:

  • A Transdisciplinary Approach to Care: Unlike many ABA companies that focus solely on behavior therapy, Cortica offers a holistic, multidisciplinary model of care. Our team includes experts from a wide range of fields—occupational therapy, speech pathology, pediatrics, and more—allowing us to address the whole child and deliver more integrated, effective care.

  • Focus on Collaboration: At Cortica, we don’t just implement therapy—we collaborate with families, caregivers, and other clinicians to create individualized care plans that empower everyone involved. This approach ensures that each child’s unique needs are met, and that the entire team is aligned in their goals for success.

  • Quality Over Quantity: We take pride in value-based care partnerships with health plans that prioritize quality over quantity. Our patients benefit from the time we dedicate to collaborative, integrated care, and our clinicians are supported with more time for thoughtful clinical decision-making. Unlike other providers, we are reimbursed based on outcomes, not just the number of sessions delivered.

By joining Cortica, you’ll be part of a team that’s redefining ABA therapy—combining compassion, innovation, and collaboration to deliver results that matter.

Ready to make a difference? Apply today to learn more.

description:
Photonic is looking for an experienced, results-driven leader to own the mechanical engineering of our cryogenic sample space and the precision assemblies that surround it. This role covers the mechanical assemblies and quantum modules that transform Photonic’s quantum integrated circuits into operating quantum modules, and the sample space environments inside our existing cryostats where those modules are cooled, aligned, and measured. These assemblies operate at cryogenic temperatures, in high magnetic fields, and must meet customer expectations for data centre reliability.

Photonic is entering a growth phase following a successful fundraising round. In this role you will transform our mechanical engineering organization and development process. You will scale the team to balance a set of experienced project leads while adding foundational mechanical engineering competencies to meet exacting engineering and precision manufacturing requirements.

Please send your resume and a short cover letter in one file. Tell us why this role caught your attention, how you have helped an emerging technology find its market, and what you would bring to Photonic. We are interested in how you think, not in a perfectly polished application.
  • Own mechanical design and delivery of the cryogenic sample space in our existing cryostats: chip mount assemblies, thermal links and thermalization, optical and electrical IO interfaces, magnetic field subassemblies, and gas tuning hardware.
  • Own the mechanical assemblies that package Photonic's quantum integrated circuits into quantum modules.
  • Own the interfaces between the sample space and the cryostat, the optical excitation and RF delivery segments, and upstream chip pre-qualification systems.
  • Build and lead the mechanical engineering organization, setting technical direction, the hiring bar, levelling, and delivery objectives as the team grows.
Technical Leadership
  • Lead the team to engineer complex assemblies, in collaboration with external development and manufacturing partners.
  • Build and grow mechanical engineering competence across core disciplines, including structures, dynamics, thermal, fluids, materials, cryogenics, automation and robotics, CAD, and Product Lifecycle Management.
  • Own the competency framework for the team, identifying skill gaps and driving targeted development plans as the organization scales.
  • Set and defend requirements for the sample space, including thermal resistance and cooling budgets, alignment and positioning tolerances, heat load budgets on each cryostat stage, and operation in high magnetic fields.
  • Define the requirements, interfaces, and integration strategies that connect mechanical subsystems with the optical, electrical, and cryogenic elements of Photonic’s quantum modules.
  • Set the standard for analysis, simulation, and design methodology, and hold the team to it.
  • Foster collaboration between mechanical leads, test and assembly leads, suppliers, and project management to drive execution.
Development Process
  • Enhance the design process with a focus on design, build, and test deliverables, underpinned by Requirements definition and management.
  • Ensure the design process is supported by design documentation, design reviews, trade studies, and FMEA.
  • Lead design choices with a strong focus on long-term product viability; enforce strict DFX methodologies so systems are optimized for scalable volume manufacturing, ease of field maintenance, and robust testability.
  • Strengthen project planning discipline, including resource estimation, scheduling, risk management, and make-versus-buy assessment.
  • Ensure projects have the necessary resources, infrastructure, and processes to succeed, proactively identifying and removing blockers.
  • Enhance design automation workflows and methodologies to accelerate development and meet product cadence.
  • Establish key performance indicators to measure and optimize development productivity, schedule adherence, and quality outcomes.
  • Collaborate with test and assembly development teams on flows, equipment, and capacity and quality improvements to accelerate yield learning and cycle times.
Process Optimization and Compliance
  • Maintain departmental process workflow and refine it with learnings to drive continuous improvement.
  • Ensure adherence to departmental workflow and project management practices.
  • Stimulate intellectual property development and secure protection.
  • Identify high-value digital transformation initiatives to enhance data-driven decision-making and use of AI.
People and Career Development
  • Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing technical teams.
  • Foster a culture of technical curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Identify training opportunities to enhance employee skills and productivity.
  • Conduct regular technical reviews and feedback sessions to promote professional growth.
  • Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of leadership experience in precision mechanical, integrated circuit test and assembly, or cryogenic systems engineering, preferably within an R&D, technology, or innovation-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated ownership of hardware operating in extreme environments: cryogenic temperatures, vacuum, or high magnetic fields.
  • Proven track record of leading innovative product development teams resulting in high volume production.
  • Strong systems-thinking ability, with experience defining requirements, interfaces, and integration strategies across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Expertise in design process methodologies such as simulation, progressive prototypes, test, documentation, and issue tracking systems like Jira.
  • Experience hiring, scaling, and mentoring multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry certification practices.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience with dilution or closed-cycle cryostats, thermal link design, and cryogenic materials selection.
  • Familiarity with cryogenic optical alignment, fibre arrays, or RF signal delivery into a sample space.
  • Experience managing engineering projects with external development and manufacturing partners.
  • Experience working with technology partners, supply chain providers, and customers.
  • Experience delivering against government or agency-funded program milestones.
  • Familiarity with intellectual property management and technology commercialization.
  • Experience in a high-growth or startup environment.
  • Work side by side with scientists, engineers, commercial leaders, and executives who are building the technologies, partnerships, and markets that will shape quantum computing.
  • Join a team that values good ideas, fast learning, and people who make things happen. You will have room to experiment, try new approaches, and see your work reach the market.
  • Bring your perspective. We value people who challenge assumptions, share ideas openly, and make the work better through collaboration.
  • Competitive compensation package including base salary, stock options, and comprehensive benefits.

title: Lead Systems Engineer, MCA – Fleet Innovation & Transformation
description:
Who will you be working with?

Our Freight Services Division provides locomotive maintenance services to our customers, the country’s largest freight railroads, helping them keep their locomotives running at optimal levels. The mission of the Fleet Innovation & Transformation team is to accelerate fleet transformation by consistently providing compelling solutions and innovative technologies that improve reliability, sustainability, and performance.

How will you make a difference?

The Lead Systems Engineer, MCA – Will partner with a team of engineers focused on delivering software solutions for Wabtec’s growing fleet of MCA based control system locomotives. In this role, you will lead the technical requirements definition, verification, validation and implementation phases of MCA software release(s) to ensure customer satisfaction.

You will initiate software releases starting with System level requirements definition & flow-down through the sub-system level, followed by internal sub-system & system level validation. Provide primary support for installation on our customer locomotives in the field and in the factory. This includes ensuring system and sub-system level validation planning and tests are appropriate for the defined requirements and scope. Your leadership will help ensure that the software will deliver a product that exceeds customer expectations, is installed with as little disruption to the customer as possible, and with minimal support needed from Wabtec.

What do we want to know about you?

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelors Degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years safety-critical controls or embedded controls experience
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve product problems in a ‘high-pressure’ environment
  • Ability to estimate engineering effort for defined tasks
  • High level of integrity
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate technical people with a high level of urgency
  • Proven ability to strengthen teams, increase effectiveness, and broaden responsibilities
  • Project/Program Management experience
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive projects to completion by setting and meeting key milestones
  • Strong Verbal & Written communication skills

Desired Characteristics:

  • Masters Degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science.
  • Working knowledge of INCOSE systems engineering best practices and Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
  • Demonstrated experience in motivating employees and creating an atmosphere of acceptance and teamwork
  • Detailed knowledge of MCA control system(s) including software development & release processes
  • 5+ years Locomotive Systems Engineering Experience which includes time spent on New Product Development, Requisition, and Installed Base product support.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Define MCA Software revision/release scope with appropriate requirements definition, documentation updates, design review planning, verification and validation plans.
  • Provide end-to-end oversight of MCA software release process ensuring system level requirements are met through appropriate validation testing.
  • Identify risks and develop mitigation activities to reduce risks to acceptable levels prior to software release.
  • Communicate program & project progress to all levels of the organization.

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The salary rate for this role is currently $79,100 -112,800. The actual salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

title: Senior Perception Engineer
description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

The Senior Perception Engineer develops the perception software that allows Neros unmanned aircraft to detect, classify, and track targets from the air, working across the full perception stack rather than a single component. This role covers detection, classification, image-space tracking, and aimpoint selection on both EO and thermal imagery, delivered onto constrained onboard compute and validated against logged flight data. As one of the most senior individual contributors in the perception group, this engineer also provides design and code review across the team's work.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver detection, classification, and image-space tracking for small, low-contrast targets at long standoff in cluttered terrain
  • Extend the perception stack to IR and low-light imaging in support of night operations, including sensor frontend integration, performance characterization, and the imagery collection required to support subsequent learned components
  • Develop onboard target search and candidate generation that enables operator authorization of engagements over narrowband or degraded communications links
  • Implement discrimination of valid targets from civilian, friendly, and neutral objects, and set detection operating points jointly with the state estimation and engagement authorization owners
  • Define the perception output contract, including calibrated confidence and explicit signaling of no detection, suppressed detection, and degraded sensor conditions
  • Deploy perception software to embedded compute in partnership with the platform team, owning the accuracy and latency trade-off and compliance with end-to-end latency budgets
  • Define and maintain perception evaluation and regression cases against logged flight data, and provide senior technical review across the perception team

You should have the following

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing production computer vision or perception software, with demonstrated ownership of a perception component from prototype through fielded deployment
  • Demonstrated delivery of perception software onto a physical system operating in an uncontrolled outdoor environment, such as unmanned aircraft, ground robotics, autonomous vehicles, or aerospace platforms, rather than research or benchmark work alone
  • Expert proficiency in C++ and Python, including production experience under real-time or resource-constrained requirements
  • Depth in both classical and learned perception, spanning correlation, template, and optical-flow tracking, feature matching and data association, alongside modern detection and classification networks
  • Experience deploying neural networks to embedded accelerators, including quantization and characterization of the resulting accuracy and latency trade-off
  • Working knowledge of EO and IR/thermal imaging, camera calibration, and sensor characteristics, with direct experience in small-object detection at long range, in low light, or under high dynamic range
  • Experience defining perception evaluation, including dataset and labeling requirements, detection and tracking metrics such as precision, recall, track continuity, and identity switches, and regression testing against logged flight or field data
  • Experience selecting detection thresholds and operating points against an explicit cost of false positives versus missed detections in a safety-critical or mission-critical system
  • Familiarity with coordinate frames, sensor timing and synchronization, and uncertainty representation at the interface between perception and state estimation

Nice to have

  • Experience with air-to-ground EO/IR imagery, or with airborne target acquisition, seeker, or automatic target recognition systems
  • Experience selecting or integrating thermal/LWIR sensors, including the imaging and procurement trade-offs involved
  • Experience building or contributing to a data engine for a fleet, covering large-scale log capture, indexing and search, dataset versioning, and labeling operations that feed model training

US Salary Range

$163,500 – $228,500 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Neros' total compensation package.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Product Management Lead, Communication Platform
description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position

You’ll own the product strategy and roadmap for Teladoc Health’s service communications and orchestration layer: the capabilities that determine when, why, and how members receive the right message across their care journey.

This role sits at the intersection of product, marketing, clinical programs, data, engineering, and operations. You will lead the evolution from distributed communications systems toward a scalable, data-driven orchestration platform that can support service communications, clinical nudges, onboarding journeys, communication preferences, and future AI-driven engagement.

A major focus on the role will be shaping Teladoc Health’s next-generation communication automation and orchestration strategy, including evaluation and adoption of best-in-class platforms that enable this strategy. You’ll need enough product and technical fluency to separate narrow internal builds from true platform capabilities, influence vendor and architecture decisions, and ensure the chosen path supports both near-term delivery and long-term member engagement needs.

This role demands more than delivery management. You’ll need to connect communications infrastructure to measurable business outcomes: visit growth, repeat engagement, reduced member friction, improved care-program activation, and operational efficiency. You’ll operate with high autonomy, bring a strong point of view in ambiguous cross-functional environments, and move teams toward a coherent strategy even when ownership is distributed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own the member communications orchestration product strategy: define and drive the roadmap for member communications capabilities across service, clinical, and engagement use cases, with clear linkage to member experience and business outcomes.

  • Lead build-vs-buy and vendor strategy: evaluate orchestration/CDP platforms; shape POC scope; partner with procurement, marketing, data, and engineering to make informed platform decisions.

  • Advance the migration path from distributed communications infrastructure; help define the transition from distributed paths toward a more scalable orchestration model.

  • Own communication preferences and consent experience: drive the product roadmap for member-facing communication preferences, data integrations, campaign remapping, and end-to-end testing so members have clear, trustworthy control over how Teladoc communicates with them.

  • Enable data-driven and AI-powered engagement: partner with data, AI, clinical, and product teams to support personalized nudges, journey-based messaging, suppression logic, segmentation, and next-best-action capabilities.

  • Translate complex architecture into product direction: work deeply with engineering, data, marketing ops, and platform teams on Snowflake, CDP, content management, orchestration logic, APIs, and downstream delivery systems; make tradeoffs visible and actionable.

  • Build the measurement framework: define success metrics for communications capabilities, including delivery performance, member engagement, booking conversion, repeat visits, suppression accuracy, preference adoption, and operational efficiency.

  • Navigate complex stakeholders: operate as a credible senior product voice across marketing, DAI/data, engineering, clinical services, operations, legal/privacy, design, and executive leadership; synthesize competing priorities into a coherent product direction.

  • Raise the bar on member trust and experience quality: ensure communications are timely, relevant, clinically appropriate, consent-aware, and not just operationally convenient; protect the member experience in areas where metrics alone do not capture trust or frustration.

The time spent on each responsibility reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No

Qualifications Expected for Position

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with significant experience in consumer-facing, platform, engagement, lifecycle, growth, CRM, or marketing-technology domains.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect product roadmap decisions to business outcomes, including activation, conversion, retention, visit growth, operational efficiency, or revenue impact.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, integrating, configuring, or owning communications, lifecycle, CRM, marketing automation, journey orchestration, or customer engagement platforms such as Braze, Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Customer.io, or similar systems.

  • Strong technical fluency, including the ability to engage substantively with engineering and data teams on architecture tradeoffs, APIs, event triggers, data pipelines, segmentation, consent/preference logic, and implementation complexity.

  • Experience leading build-vs-buy decisions, vendor evaluations, POCs, platform migrations, or large cross-functional capability investments.

  • Strong product judgment in ambiguous environments: able to distinguish narrow feature delivery from durable platform capability, and able to sequence work across near-term releases and long-term architecture needs.

  • Deep comfort working across marketing, product, data, engineering, operations, legal/privacy, and executive stakeholders in a matrixed organization.

  • Strong analytical orientation, including comfort defining measurement frameworks, interpreting funnel or engagement data, and translating insights into product decisions.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to synthesize complex technical and organizational issues into a clear point of view for senior audiences.

  • Proven ability to influence without formal authority and drive alignment across teams with competing incentives.
