title: Lead Data & AI Engineer
description:
COMPANY BACKGROUND:

SLINGCO is an award-winning supplier of high-quality tools and accessories for the installation and handling of cable, with over 40 years of industry heritage. We serve customers in over 70 countries worldwide from our head office in Lancashire, UK, and bases in Georgia, USA, and Bengaluru, India.

Our products are used in safety critical applications for a wide range of markets. With sectors including oil & gas, civil engineering, aerospace, transport, utilities, marine/offshore and the military – there’s no room for error. That’s why we do everything with the utmost care and precision.

We design and manufacture to the highest specifications and test to destruction. If our products don’t meet and exceed the most stringent national and international standards, they’re not good enough for our customers.

At Slingco, our goal is to create innovative high-quality products that our customers can depend on, whilst providing a positive experience for our customers and our employees. Every aspect of our work, culture and commitment to innovation is driven by our core values.

BENEFITS:

  • Salary Dependent on Experience

  • 30 days’ annual leave including Bank Holidays, rising to 35 with service

  • Option to buy 5 additional holidays

  • Your birthday off

  • Hybrid working options

  • Enhanced employer pension contribution

  • Life assurance cover x4 salary

  • Gym membership

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Employee loan scheme

  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are looking for an experienced lead data engineer to build our first group data platform on Microsoft Fabric. The aim is to bring together data from our business systems, replace fragmented reporting and give colleagues reliable information they can use to make decisions.

This is a hands-on role and our first senior data hire. There is no dedicated data team in place yet, so you will take responsibility for the architecture and the build. You will work directly with senior leaders and business teams to agree requirements and priorities, establish how data is managed and help plan the future team. The role also includes developing conversational AI tools and a self-service BI layer that let colleagues ask questions of approved business data.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own data requirements gathering across the group and prioritize a single visible backlog against capacity

  • Design, build and run the Microsoft Fabric platform, including pipelines, capacity, running costs and reliability

  • Integrate Business Central, CRM, HR and all other operational systems across global business entities

  • Gather business requirements and maintain a single prioritised backlog that reflects delivery capacity

  • Put source control, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring and alerting in place. Document the standards and ways of working for the future team

  • Set pragmatic data governance, security and quality standards — proportionate to a business moving from low data maturity

  • Agree common KPI definitions with business owners and build certified Power BI semantic models to support executive and operational reporting

  • Set practical standards for data ownership, quality and security, including access controls, row-level security, classification and masking of sensitive data

  • Deliver executive and operational reporting from the governed layer, and define the standardized KPI set behind it

  • Assist key business users in analysing data from approved datasets, with appropriate training, access and support

  • Prepare semantic models for AI use, with clear definitions, relationships and rules for interpreting the data

  • Build secure ways for AI agents and conversational tools to retrieve and query approved data, enforcing each user's access permissions

  • Act as technical counterpart to the AI & Automation Partner, ensuring agents and conversational AI consume governed data

PERSON SPECIFICATION:

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to technical and non-technical colleagues

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with senior leaders and business teams

  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage competing priorities, gather requirements and work within agreed capacity

  • Able to work independently, take ownership and use initiative within a developing data environment

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, security, accuracy and continuous improvement

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

Essential

  • Experience designing and building a data platform from scratch, with responsibility for architecture and delivery in a business with limited existing data capability

  • Strong SQL and Python or PySpark skills, with practical experience of ELT pipelines, dimensional modelling, source control and CI/CD

  • Experience putting data governance and self-service BI into practice, including ownership, quality standards, training and user adoption

  • Microsoft Fabric experience, or transferable Azure Synapse or Databricks Lakehouse experience, including an understanding of medallion architecture

  • Strong Power BI semantic modelling and DAX skills, sufficient to take responsibility for shared datasets and business measures

  • Ability to work as the sole senior data specialist, gather requirements from senior stakeholders, resolve conflicting definitions and explain priorities and technical decisions clearly

Desirable

  • Experience connecting AI tools to governed business data, such as Copilot, natural-language querying or agent-based retrieval, and testing the accuracy of their answers

  • Experience with Business Central or a comparable ERP, particularly in manufacturing or distribution

  • Multi-entity and multi-currency group reporting

  • Relevant Microsoft Azure or Fabric certifications

title: Logistics/Transportation Router (Temp to Perm)
description:
Company & Culture:

At GT’s Living Foods, LLC, we’ve stayed true to the authentic brewing process for over 30 years. Our #1 selling Kombucha is raw, organic, naturally effervescent, and handcrafted in small batches – always cultured, never compromised. We’re proud to remain a family owned & operated company. As our GT’s family continues to grow, we are deeply humbled and sincerely grateful for every moment of this journey with you.

Requirements:

  • 2 years’ experience in Transportation/Logistics or food/beverage manufacturing
  • Bilingual; speak, read & write Spanish (Preferred)

Job Description:

The Transportation Router is responsible for reviewing and optimizing customer orders following each order cycle to develop efficient outbound shipping plans. The role reviews customer-requested delivery dates and adjusts order due dates, when appropriate, to create consolidation opportunities, maximize trailer utilization, and support transportation efficiency while protecting customer service requirements. The Transportation Router targets full truckload shipments and ensures routing decisions do not compromise service expectations for VIP and other priority customers.

Essential Duties:

  • Reviews customer purchase orders submitted by Customer Service following the established order cycle close, including requested delivery dates, order weight, destinations, customer requirements, lead times, and applicable order cadence.
  • Reviews and modifies order due dates, within approved customer and business parameters, to improve shipment consolidation and maximize trailer utilization without negatively impacting customer service.
  • Develops and maintains optimized outbound routing plans based on customer delivery requirements, order volume, product availability, warehouse capacity, transit time, delivery appointments, warehouse shipping hours and stabilized transportation parameters.
  • Identifies opportunities to consolidate orders by destination, geographic area, delivery schedule, and available lead time to improve transportation efficiency and reduce partially utilized truckloads.
  • Communicates fulfillment status, updates, and delays to internal and external departments such as Warehouse, Demand Planning, Logistics, Sales, Customer Service and partner carriers.
  • Targets truckload shipments of 40,000 lbs or greater whenever operationally feasible, balancing trailer utilization with customer requirements, product availability and service commitments.

Park City, UT | On-site | Full-Time

title: Director, Data Partnerships
description:
About Snorkel

Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes.

Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!

About the Role

We're hiring a Director of Data Partnerships to lead a new function at Snorkel. You'll own the supply side of our data partnerships end-to-end: setting the strategy for how we source and procure private data, building the partner / supplier pipeline, structuring agreements, and working with the business to bring it all to life. It is an entrepreneurial, external-facing role that will drive top-of-funnel and convert opportunities into real value. The market for training data partnerships is nascent and rapidly changing - business judgment is key to success in this role. Finally, cross-functional collaboration and a sense of overall ownership are key to ensuring we get value from the partnerships we strike.

This role will require hands-on, zero to one work. You'll be sourcing, qualifying, and negotiating directly. You'll own the funnel, form a sound but swift view on whether an opportunity is worth pursuing and know which terms to offer and how to negotiate them to close. You'll carry those relationships forward after signature rather than handing them off. As the function proves out, you'll build a small but mighty team behind you and shift toward setting direction, standards, and performance expectations.

This is a high-impact role for someone with sharp commercial judgment, meaningful experience in licensing and IP, the creativity and range to operate in a market whose economics and value chain are still being defined - and, critically, hustle. You'll be a key advisor to leadership on strategy and execution, and you'll shape how Snorkel acquires data as a matter of company practice. The Business Operations team will help build the internal systems, analytics, and operating cadence alongside you. Success will be measured by the growth of our private data partnerships and the value they create for our business.


What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy and long-term plan for data supply: what we source, from whom, on what terms, and against what downstream demand
  • Spend a lot of time in the market: source and qualify holders of proprietary data and own the funnel end-to-end (inbound and outbound). This will start as hands-on work, not oversight
  • Define and execute the qualification bar. Personally drive opportunity sourcing and qualification at each stage of the funnel, working with cross functional partners in Research, GTM, Delivery, and Legal
  • Match opportunities to the right commercial structure and make the business case
  • Lead negotiations end-to-end at the executive level, including business terms and partnering with Legal on critical terms such as sublicensing, etc.
  • Manage partnerships past signature through activation, development, sale, and renewal — act like an owner
  • Establish the standards, operations, and metrics the function runs on — qualification gates, pricing framework, standard paper — then hire and develop a small team against them as the business scales
  • Act as a key advisor to leadership with an opinionated view of the market: what's available, what it's worth, who else is bidding, and where we shouldn't play

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience leading commercial dealmaking roles — data or content licensing, strategic partnerships, in-licensing, or complex commercial contracting — with direct ownership of negotiations
  • Experience across meaningfully different business models or industries is critical. The economics of this market are still being invented, and we need someone who can blend experience, best practices, first principles, and market feedback
  • Working fluency in content licensing, IP, and data rights. You don't need to be a lawyer, but you need to know which terms determine whether a deal is worth doing, and to partner with Legal on where the key points sit
  • Proven track record of managing partnerships past the signature, with results you can quantify: deals closed, value created, relationships you grew rather than inherited
  • Experience building and leading teams with high ownership and autonomy. You have taken an ambiguous mandate, built the pipeline, set the bar, and delivered impact
  • Solid analytical and quantitative skills; comfortable building the simple model that tells us what an asset is worth to us and defending the assumptions in it
  • Passion for unlocking new capabilities with modern AI is a must
  • Demonstrated interest and a strong point of view on the AI training and evaluation data market
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can tailor a message from IC to executive audience, and you're credible both in leadership discussions internally and as the first person a prospective partner's leadership team meets

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

Salary range(s) for this role
$215,000—$315,000 USD

Be Your Best at Snorkel

Joining Snorkel AI means becoming part of a company that has market proven solutions, robust funding, and is scaling rapidly—offering a unique combination of stability and the excitement of high growth. As a member of our team, you’ll have meaningful opportunities to shape priorities and initiatives, influence key strategic decisions, and directly impact our ongoing success. Whether you’re looking to deepen your technical expertise, explore leadership opportunities, or learn new skills across multiple functions, you’re fully supported in building your career in an environment designed for growth, learning, and shared success.

Snorkel AI embraces diversity and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Snorkel AI prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. title: Metallurgist
description:
Idaho National Laboratory is hiring a geologist/metalllurgist to drive innovation in metallurgical processing to support domestic critical materials production. The position, housed within the Critical Minerals and Geothermal Energy Department, will work closely with a team of geologists, chemists, chemical engineers, materials scientists, and computational scientists to develop new feedstock beneficiation pathways and separations technologies to unlock unconventional domestic critical material resources, such as mine tailings. A priority will be placed on candidates with a strong vision of how Artificial Intelligence tools can be applied to revolutionize domestic critical material supply chains. The chosen scientist will be expected to build a thriving, externally-funded research portfolio, disseminate research results through technical presentations at conferences and high-impact peer-reviewed publications, and work closely with industry partners to deploy critical mineral and material production technologies at scale.

Our team works a 9x80 schedule located out of our Idaho Falls facility with every other Friday off.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Plan and conduct geological or geochemical field studies, sample collection, and testing programs used to collect data for research or application.
  • Plan and execute research programs focused on the development of novel comminution and beneficiation methods to improve critical materials production.
  • Work closely with other geologists, chemists, chemical engineers, and materials scientists to integrate novel feedstocks and downstream processing methods.
  • Actively pursue and secure funding through proposals and industry partnerships.
  • Write peer-reviewed publications and technical reports and represent INL through programmatic and technical presentations to sponsors and peers at conferences and symposia.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Required Qualifications:

  • Level 4: Masters of Science degree in geology, metallurgical engineering, or related field and 6+ years of professional experience in geology, metallurgical engineering or related field or a PhD in a related field and 4+ years of related experience.
  • Level 5: Masters of Science degree in geology, metallurgical engineering, or related field and 8+ years of professional experience in geology, metallurgical engineering or related field or a PhD in a related field and 6+ years of related experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct technical research and participate actively in R&D strategy.
  • Experience in engaging program sponsors at DOE, industry and other federal agencies
  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy "Q" clearance, which requires US Citizenship.

The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Ph.D. in geology, metallurgical engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience at a DOE national laboratory, DOE, or experience in engaging with DOE.


Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, and work in an office and field/laboratory environment. Field work includes working in remote locations within radioactive boundary areas (RBA), and overnight travel for extended field work. The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. The job requires operation of job-related equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with the public is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Product Operations Lead
description:
About Sirona Medical

At Sirona Medical, we’re building software that enables physicians to work as fast as they can think.

Each year in the U.S., billions of patient images are captured—and nearly all of them are reviewed and diagnosed by radiologists. These specialists are the central hub of diagnostic medicine: over 80% of all healthcare data flows through radiology IT systems. Yet despite their pivotal role, radiologists are overburdened by outdated, fragmented software which limits their efficiency and ultimately the quality and efficiency of care that health systems can provide patients. That’s where Sirona comes in.

We’re a San Francisco-based, cloud-native software company with employees around the world. Our deep understanding of both the practice and business of radiology has allowed us to build RadOS—a unified, AI-powered operating system powering the entire radiology workflows.

How Sirona Solves the Problem

Sirona is uniquely positioned to transform the way radiology is practiced. We're delivering the organizational shift that both individual radiologists and entire practices urgently need:

  • A unified, intuitive, and platform-agnostic solution

  • A streamlined workspace that makes every part of the radiologist’s workflow faster and easier

  • The freedom to read from anywhere, for anyone

By cutting clicks, optimizing diagnostic time, and unlocking efficiencies that extend far beyond the reading room into all care settings, Sirona empowers radiologists—and in doing so, we help the entire healthcare system move faster, smarter, and with greater impact on patient outcomes.
For more information, please visit .

Sirona Medical is looking for a Product Operations Lead to collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership on how those teams work together day to day. This role is focused on process: helping shape ceremonies, estimation practices, and review/approval flows that let other teams execute well. You won't own roadmap priorities, decide what gets built, or manage reporting on execution status. That responsibility sits with the Director of Product and flows up to the VP of Product. Your job is to work alongside leadership and the teams themselves to help drive process decisions to a good conclusion, not to dictate the outcome, but to bring structure, facilitation, and follow-through to conversations that might otherwise stall.

This is a consultative role. You succeed by building consensus and helping others arrive at process improvements they'll actually adopt, not by imposing a system on them.

What success in this role looks like:

  • Product, Design, and Engineering feel like their shared ceremonies were shaped with them, not handed to them
  • Leadership has a trusted collaborator to work through process questions with, rather than another decision-maker to align with
  • Review and approval checkpoints are clear because the affected teams helped define them
  • The Director of Product and Engineering leads have a thinking partner on process, without ceding ownership of their teams' ways of working

This role reports to our VP of Product and ideally works out of our San Francisco, CA or Burlington, VT office.

Key Responsibilities:

Ceremonies & Cadence

  • Work with Product, Design, and Engineering leads to evaluate and evolve working ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, retros, and similar sessions
  • Help facilitate these ceremonies and propose structural improvements, bringing options to leadership rather than making unilateral changes
  • Continuously check in with teams on what's working and help guide adjustments collaboratively as needs change

Estimation Practices

  • Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to shape a shared estimation approach that fits how the teams actually work
  • Bring historical data (velocity, cycle time, estimate-vs-actual) into planning conversations to help teams calibrate their own estimation over time
  • Help design a clearer intake process in collaboration with the teams who'll use it

Reviews & Approvals

  • Facilitate conversations with Product, Design, Engineering, and QA leadership to help clarify review and approval checkpoints across the development process
  • Help surface and resolve ambiguity around who approves, who's consulted, and who's informed at each checkpoint, proposing options rather than dictating structure
  • Maintain lightweight tracking, developed in partnership with the teams, so work status is easy to see without anyone needing to ask around

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Serve as a process-focused thought partner between Product, Design, and Engineering, surfacing where handoffs feel unclear and working with those teams to find a fix together
  • Help maintain and refine the tooling that supports agreed-upon processes (Jira, Linear, Notion, or similar), in collaboration with the teams using it
  • Offer process-level observations (e.g., cycle time, ceremony health, bottleneck patterns) that give the Director of Product and Engineering leads useful input for their own decisions, distinct from roadmap or execution status reporting
  • Potentially assist with coordination and management of clinical development partners and customer development partners, along with other product operations duties as assigned
  • Collaborate with the Product Documentation Lead on internal and external enablement, as well as the early adopter/beta program, helping ensure feedback and readiness activities are coordinated with the broader product process

Key Qualifications:

  • 4-6 years of experience in product management/operations, program/project management, or a similar process-facilitation role within a product/engineering organization
  • Experience facilitating agile ceremonies, estimation practices, or review/approval conversations
  • A natural collaborator, comfortable working across Product, Design, and Engineering without formal authority over any of them; this role runs on trust and influence, not hierarchy or mandate
  • Comfortable working with product/engineering tooling (Jira, Airfocus, Asana, or similar) to support team-agreed processes
  • Strong listener and systems thinker who can help a group reach consensus rather than pushing a predetermined answer
  • Comfortable operating in a regulated, clinical, or enterprise B2B environment (healthcare or health IT strongly preferred)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the judgment to know when to lead a conversation and when to support someone else's

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with radiology, PACS/RIS, medical imaging, or clinical workflow software
  • Experience coordinating with external technical partners on scoping or scheduling of collaborative work
  • Scrum Master, PMP, or similar process/delivery certification

Benefits

  • Stock
  • Competitive salaries
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Maternity and Paternity Leave
  • 401(k) matching
  • Apple equipment
  • Sponsorship for conferences, continuing education

The annual US base salary range for this full-time position is $145,000 to $175,000 + equity + benefits. Pay is flexible depending on experience, work location, and job-related skills.

title: Specialist, Client Experience & Enablement

Flipp partners with the largest North American retailers and brands to deliver local promotions and savings to millions of engaged shoppers daily, driving superior returns on investments.

Our Shopper Consideration Platform allows retailers and manufacturers to create digital experiences from their savings & deals content, aiding shoppers in deciding what to buy and where to buy it. Maintain flawless subject-matter expertise across varying banner rules, distinct weekly content cycles, and unique regional consumer behaviours.

Formulate high-fidelity, engineering-grade bug reports, serving as the trusted link between enterprise accounts and internal Software Engineering teams.

What you'll bring to the team:

  • 1-3 years of experience working with clients/customer service and building relationships

Our Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure that you are rewarded for impact, take part in accelerated career growth, thrive with highly flexible benefits, and are empowered to do your best work in a remote-first environment. In alignment with our overall Total Rewards Philosophy, we believe compensation should be fair, clear, consistent, and aligned to growth.

What you'll do
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist – Risk Modeling to join Clara’s Risk Data Science team. In this role, you will combine advanced analytics, machine learning, and credit risk expertise to develop and improve models and strategies that support underwriting, portfolio management, and risk decision-making across Clara’s markets.
You will work closely with Risk, Data, Engineering, Finance, and Operations, taking analytical problems from exploration and model development through validation, monitoring, and business implementation.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Develop credit risk models: Design, build, validate, and maintain predictive models for credit origination, behavioral risk, portfolio management, and other risk use cases.
  • Own the modeling lifecycle: Work across the full model lifecycle, including problem definition, population and target construction, feature engineering, model development, validation, backtesting, calibration, monitoring, and recalibration.

  • Improve data and modeling quality: Validate data sources, implement data quality controls, assess feature stability, and identify potential issues such as leakage, selection bias, or population drift.
  • Work with rejected and unobserved populations: Contribute to methodologies for addressing reject inference, selection bias, thin-file populations, and limited performance information where relevant.
  • Develop in a modern ML environment: Use Databricks, MLflow, GitHub, Python, SQL, scikit-learn, and other appropriate modeling tools to build reproducible and well-documented analytical solutions.
  • Support model implementation: Collaborate with Data and Engineering teams to ensure models developed by Risk Data Science can be reliably deployed and integrated into business decision flows.
  • Translate analytics into business decisions: Communicate complex analytical findings clearly to Risk leadership and non-technical stakeholders and help turn model outputs into actionable business strategies.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - C++
description:
About SirenOpt

SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks.

SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made.

We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia.

About the job

Job Title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - C++

Location: On-Site (San Leandro, CA)

Role Overview

SirenOpt is seeking a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to design and build the high-performance C++ and systems software that powers our manufacturing intelligence platform. Working closely with firmware, hardware, and application engineering teams across every phase of product development, you will design and optimize multi-threaded, asynchronous software on Linux, analyze and improve performance across CPU, memory, storage, networking, and I/O, and debug complex issues that span software and hardware boundaries. You will also read, maintain, and extend existing Python tooling used for automation, testing, and data analysis, and take ownership of software components throughout the full product development lifecycle.

This position is well suited for a self-driven engineer who takes ownership of their work, writes clean and maintainable modern C++ (C++17/20), and enjoys understanding how software interacts with operating systems and hardware to achieve exceptional performance. You will contribute at a high level in a collaborative, fast-moving engineering environment, participating in architecture, technical design, and code reviews as you help ship robust software for commercial products.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is passionate about building high-quality commercial software and solving challenging systems problems.

You take ownership of your work, write clean and maintainable code, and enjoy understanding how software interacts with operating systems and hardware to achieve exceptional performance.

Experience building and shipping software for commercial products is highly valued.

You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working across software, firmware, and hardware disciplines to build products used in real customer environments.

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20)

title: Advancing Imaging Spectroscopy Measurements by EMIT on the International Space Station
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

NASA's EMIT Instrument on the International Space Station is an advanced visible-shortwave infrared imaging spectrometer providing state of the art radiance, reflectance, and advanced data products to a growing user community. Since its launch in 2022, the instrument has acquired hundreds of thousands of images spanning terrestrial and coastal regions on Earth between +/- 52 degrees latitude.  Continual advances in calibration, radiative transfer modeling, and inversion algorithms have refined these products for diverse science and applications communities.  Uses include agriculture and natural resources, hydrology and water quality, geology and prospecting, atmospheric studies, and more.  By providing a near-global dataset of solar reflectance data at 60 m sampling, EMIT provides the power of field-grade spectroscopy at a human scale which is useful for local decisions.

The postdoctoral researcher will participate on the EMIT core team to improve EMIT data products for the next mission phase and support of the growing science community.  Relevant studies span the whole range of EMIT mission activities, including, but not limited to:

- Automation of instrument calibration maintenance, including in-flight radiometric calibration from invariant surfaces;

- Improvements in atmospheric correction to use refined spectral calibration understanding;

- Radiative transfer modeling and inversion to support novel application areas in hydrology and aquatic studies;

- Assessment of open source radiative transfer models (ERADIATE, ARTS, etc.) for use on EMIT data;

- Investigations to study, validate, and/or refine existing EMIT products, such as global maps of mineral composition, photosynthetic and non-photosynthetic vegetation fraction;

- Investigations using novel EMIT datasets such as spectroscopic time series;

EMIT is an interdisciplinary team, with a wide range of backgrounds ranging from physics to mathematics, to field science.  Rather than prescribe specific qualifications, we anticipate forming a research plan that matches mission needs with the specific expertise and interests of the individual.

More generally, however, we seek candidates with:

- A demonstrated track record of publication using remote sensing or imaging spectroscopy data.

- Technical ability including a strong foundation in the mathematical and computer science principles of remote measurement.

- The ability to work with a larger research and development team, contributing to common code and manuscripts.

- Creativity and initiative in initiating and developing new research directions.

Required Qualifications:

- PhD

The appointee will carry out research in collaboration with the JPL advisor, resulting in publications in the open literature.

Applicants may be subject to additional program requirements by NASA. Postdoctoral Scholar positions are awarded for a minimum of one-year period and may be renewed up to a maximum of three years. Candidates should submit the following to this site: CV, representative publications, contact information for three references, and a cover letter stating their research accomplishments and interests.

JPL has a catalog of benefits and perks that span from the traditional to the unique. This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. Our focus is on work-life balance, and living healthy, fulfilling lives as we Dare Mighty Things Together. For benefits eligible positions, benefits are effective the first day of the month coincident with or immediately following the employee’s start date.

For further benefits information click [Benefits and Perks](https://www.jpl.jobs/benefits-perks)

Da området er i rivende udvikling, forventer vi ikke, at du er ekspert i højspændingsbatterier fra dag ét – Stena sørger for grundig oplæring og faglig opkvalificering. Det vigtigste er din faglige nysgerrighed, din høje sikkerhedsforståelse og dit engagement i at tage ansvar for opbygningen af et nyt felt.

dine primære opgaver

- Modtagelse, tilstandstest og registrering af elbilsbatterier fra hele Danmark.
- Styre og overvåge sikker afladning samt energihåndtering af højspændingsbatterier.
- Præcis af- og demontering af batteripakker ned på modul- og celleniveau.
- Klargøring af batterikomponenter til henholdsvis genanvendelse, destruktion eller second-life brug.
- Medvirke til at udvikle og optimere sikkerhedsrutiner, testudstyr og daglige arbejdsgange på værkstedet.

hvad leder vi efter hos dig?

- Du er uddannet elektriker, automatiktekniker eller har en lignende el-teknisk baggrund.
- Du har en høj sikkerhedsforståelse og arbejder struktureret og omhyggeligt.
- Du trives i en pionerrolle, hvor procedurer og arbejdsgange løbende udvikles og tilpasses.
- Du tager naturligt initiativ og er en god holdspiller.

Stena tilbyder:

- En unik chance for at opbygge en specialistprofil inden for et område i massiv vækst.
- En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet, frihed under ansvar og stærkt sammenhold.
- Grundig oplæring, relevante kurser og løbende kompetenceudvikling.
- Oprigtig frihed under ansvar og stor tidslig fleksbilitet

praktisk info

- Lønnen afgøres efter dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer
- Arbejdstiderne er på daghold - 07:00 - 15:15 mandag - torsdag og fredag 07:00 - 13:00 (Stena betaler din pause)
- Arbejdet er dækket under Industriens Overenskomst
- Arbejdet foregår på Stenas lokation i Farum, men forventes at rykke til deres lokation i Roskilde, når det tekniske anlæg er oppe og køre.

vi tilbyder

Hos Stena Recycling bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor din sikkerhed, tryghed og trivsel altid kommer i første række. Vi tilbyder et job med gode rotationsmuligheder og hjælpsomme kolleger i et stærkt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet og hjælpsomhed er i højsædet. Du får rig mulighed for at tage ansvar og udvikle dig personligt i takt med, at deres afdeling vokser.

Stillingen starter som et Try & Hire-forløb med gode muligheder for efterfølgende fastansættelse for den rette kandidat. Som ansat får du naturligvis stillet arbejdstøj til rådighed.

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Liv Nielsen på liv.nielsen@randstad.dk.

om randstad

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle, uanset baggrund, og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.
Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

title: Principal, Partner GTM Systems & Technology
description:
Intuit is undergoing a major transformation to modernize, unify, and scale our global partner ecosystem. The Global Partner Program (GPP) is our unified GTM framework designed to standardize enrollment, tiering, commercial benefits, and support experiences for all partner tracks — including Accountants, Value-Added Resellers (VARs), Developers, and ISVs — under a single platform: the Intuit Partner Suite (IPS).

As the Principal, Partner GTM Systems & Technology, you will shape the technical strategy and execution engine of this program. You will serve as the single operations interface into the data and systems engineering teams, translate high-level program strategy into robust technical direction, own the roadmap and Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) that govern it, and build the capability and operating mechanisms that let this model scale across partner tracks, regions, and teams.


Responsibilities

  • Own the Technical Strategy & Roadmap: Shape and drive the multi-year technical strategy and prioritized delivery roadmap for the Intuit Partner Suite (PRM/Portal) and integrated GTM tools (Salesforce, DocuSign, Quickbase, and Varicent), aligning system architecture decisions with long-term GTM strategy across business units.
  • Business Requirements (BRD) Authorship & Lifecycle: Author, own, and evolve enterprise-grade Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), translating complex partner strategies, multi-tier revenue share structures, lead registration/protection rules, and tier-aware support routing into implementation-ready logic — while establishing the BRD standards and templates other BSAs and TPMs use across the program.
  • Single Operations Interface to VEP/Engineering: Serve as the centralized point of contact for all technical requirements, unifying communication channels across business, ops, and engineering, and building the operating mechanisms that let this model scale to new partner tracks and regions.
  • Cross-Functional & Cross-BU Alignment: Partner with GPP Program Strategy, PMO, and senior technical/business leaders to synthesize strategic intent into system dependencies, ensuring technical plans support GPP launch-readiness — while identifying where partner systems strategy should influence decisions in adjacent business units.
  • Technology & Innovation Assessment: Proactively evaluate emerging technologies, automation opportunities, and AI/GenAI applicability (e.g., for BRD generation, requirements analysis, or UAT acceleration) to identify where new approaches can meaningfully improve delivery speed or system quality — and champion adoption where it creates a competitive advantage.
  • Technical Risk & Blocker Mitigation: Foresee and define systemic risks — not just track known ones — including data residency/GDPR requirements for international markets (UK, Canada, Australia) and the legacy-to-platform data migration, and drive resolution paths that prevent recurrence across future rollouts.
  • System Validation & UAT Governance: Define the enterprise 'Definition of Done' and quality bar for technical deliverables across the program; lead UAT and system validation, and build the reusable validation frameworks other teams adopt.
  • Capability Building & Mentorship: Build capability across the broader BSA/TPM community supporting GPP — mentoring less senior BSAs and TPMs on BRD craft, stakeholder negotiation, and technical risk framing, and guiding technical leaders outside your immediate team.

Qualifications

  • Systems Implementation Expertise: 8+ years leading complex, large-scale systems implementations across CRM (Salesforce/SFDC), Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, Billing/Commerce engines, or Enterprise Data Warehouses, including experience setting technical direction at a multi-team or organizational level.
  • Exceptional Business Analysis (BRD Writing): A proven track record of authoring exceptionally detailed, logic-driven BRDs governing complex automation (e.g., tiered point accruals, referral payouts, API-driven integrations) — and of establishing BRD standards or practices adopted by other analysts.
  • Technology Strategy & Innovation: Demonstrated ability to assess emerging technologies and automation/AI approaches for strategic fit, and to influence technical direction beyond a single program.
  • Technical Translator & Executive Influencer: Exceptional capability to bridge abstract business strategy and core engineering requirements, comfortably negotiating scope and trade-offs with Executive Directors and System Architects, and independently building a data-backed case for change with senior stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional & Cross-BU Collaborator: Experience navigating highly matrixed enterprise organizations, aligning diverse stakeholder groups (Sales, Ops, Product, Success, Finance, Legal), with evidence of influence extending beyond your immediate program.
  • Detail-Oriented & Risk-Aware: High analytical rigor with experience using structured risk-management frameworks to foresee, not just react to, operational constraints, system bugs, and process inefficiencies.
  • Agile/Scrum Experience: Strong familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, backlog grooming, and Jira-based sprint management at a multi-team scale.
  • Mentorship: Experience mentoring or guiding other analysts/TPMs, with a track record of raising the bar on BRD quality or technical requirements practice across a team.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Project Manager - Gas Skid Solutions
description:
The Project Manager – Gas Skid Solutions leads the end-to-end delivery of integrated gas skid and station solutions that support safe, reliable fuel-gas supply for mission-critical data center gas power infrastructure. Fuel gas skids and station solutions include fuel gas conditioning skids, gas flow metering skids, pressure regulation and monitoring skids and gas composition analysis stations.

This role owns scope, budget, schedule, risk, quality, and customer communication for projects valued at more than $10 million each. The Project Manager coordinates cross-functional teams and external partners from project kickoff through engineering, procurement, fabrication, testing, delivery, commissioning, and closeout.

Success will be measured by projects being delivered safely, on time, within the approved budget, and in accordance with contractual scope and quality requirements. Success also includes accurate forecasting, timely escalation of risks, and effective management of project changes. Strong customer satisfaction and clear, consistent communication with stakeholders are expected throughout the project. Finally, projects should have complete and timely documentation, along with an orderly turnover to operations or the customer.

You will report directly to our Genera Manager, and you’ll work out of our Houston, TX location on a Hybrid work schedule.

Hybrid Work Schedule Note: For the first 90 days New Hires must be prepared to work 100% onsite Monday – Friday.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage gas skid or station projects valued at $10 million or more, while maintaining accountability for scope, cost, schedule, quality, and customer commitments.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, budgets, forecasts, resource requirements, and performance reporting.
  • Serve as the primary customer liaison, providing clear status updates, managing expectations, resolving issues, and coordinating technical and commercial decisions.
  • Lead project execution across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality, logistics, site support, commissioning, and project closeout.
  • Coordinate delivery of metering, regulation, gas quality, detection, pressure, and temperature measurement solutions for packaged skids and stations.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, constraints, dependencies, supplier delays, and schedule impacts; escalate critical issues with recommended actions.
  • Control project changes through disciplined review of scope, cost, schedule, contractual requirements, and customer approvals.
  • Monitor financial performance, including budget adherence, cost-to-complete, cash flow, margin, invoicing milestones, and change-order opportunities.
  • Facilitate project reviews with customers, suppliers, contractors, and internal stakeholders; document decisions, actions, and accountable owners.
  • Ensure solutions meet applicable customer specifications, engineering standards, quality requirements, and safety expectations.
  • Coordinate factory acceptance testing, documentation, shipment readiness, installation support, startup, commissioning, and turnover.
  • Maintain complete and accurate project records, including schedules, risk registers, action logs, status reports, commercial correspondence, and closeout documentation.

Product and Solution Portfolio

  • Integrated skid and station packages for fuel gas conditioning, flow metering, pressure monitoring and regulation and gas composition analysis
    • Gas flow measurement solutions
    • Pressure regulation and monitoring solutions
    • Gas quality measurement, analysis and flow computing solutions.
    • Gas leak detection systems.
    • Pressure and temperature measurements

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, business, project management, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 6 or more years of project management experience delivering complex engineered equipment, packaged systems, industrial infrastructure, energy, oil and gas, or mission-critical projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project of $10M or more with responsibility for budget, schedule, forecasting, risk, and customer communication.
  • Working knowledge of engineered gas systems, metering and regulation, mechanical packages, instrumentation, controls, or comparable process equipment.
  • Experience coordinating engineering, procurement, fabrication, testing, logistics, commissioning, and closeout activities.
  • Proficiency with project scheduling, financial reporting, risk tracking, and standard productivity tools.

WE VALUE

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, make sound decisions, and lead cross-functional teams in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to travel to customers, suppliers, manufacturing, and project sites as business needs require.
  • Strong commercial judgment, contract awareness, negotiation skills, and disciplined change-management practices.
  • Active Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification

Relocation support may be provided

Travel up to 25% domestically

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. Learn more (https://benefits.honeywell.com/)

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Job Posting Date: October 1, 2026

ABOUT HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. THE BUSINESS UNIT

Honeywell Industrial Automation enables process industry operations, creates world-class sensor technologies, automates supply chains, makes warehouses smarter, and improves worker safety. This combination builds on our core strengths in controls and automation technologies which in turn allows us to deliver better commercial outcomes for our customers. We enable customers to enhance the safety, sustainability, resiliency and productivity of their people, plants and assets.

title: Contract Crew Supervisor I
location: East Los Angeles Site - Los Angeles, CA 90023
description:
Position Summary

Reporting to the Program Coordinator [Manager or Director], the Crew Supervisor I implements the mission of the LA Conservation Corps by using his/her leadership, supervisory and technical skills to develop the educational and work skills of young people enabling them to advance their own educational, personal and career opportunities.

The Crew Supervisor I is responsible for the supervision, work project coordination, recruitment, education support, and other leadership responsibilities for a team of 3-14 program participants aged 18-26 years old. The Crew Supervisor I provides the closest personal contact with corpsmembers in the work environment. It is their ability to relate, train and motivate that enables the corpsmembers to create stronger ties to their communities through community involvement and service, explore avenues for personal growth and development in a respectful and nurturing environment, and develop leadership skills to contribute to the advancement of all people.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Manage, supervise, and participate in all aspects of crew work.
  • Crew Supervisor I’s work cooperatively with their crew and delegate responsibilities to crew members, maintain crew discipline, resolve conflicts, and establish/maintain crew morale.
  • Crew Supervisor I’s provide formal and informal feedback to Corpsmembers with specific attention to work productivity and quality, teamwork, and leadership. Crew Supervisor I’s receive feedback on their performance and are challenged to develop their own leadership skills within this program.

Conservation

  • Crew Supervisor I’s effectively learn and apply new environmental conservation skills.
  • Crew Supervisor I’s lead, train, and supervise a team during conservation based work projects, which may include but are not limited to: general maintenance, community beautification (e.g. recycling, litter abatement), food rescue, composting, graffiti removal, constructing and maintaining trails, constructing and maintaining fences and outdoor facilities, restoring wildlife habitat, maintaining public parks, campgrounds, and recreation areas, planting trees, conducting native plant revegetation, eradicating exotic/invasive plant species, surveying, conducting ecological testing and monitoring, mapping and monitoring using GPS technology, wildfire restoration, and restoring forest health and reducing wildfire risk through tree thinning using powered equipment.
  • The Crew Supervisor I supports environmental education activities and opportunities and helps inspire the next generation of conservation and public lands stewards.

Safety & Risk Management (Workplace Safety)

title: Structural Dynamics Engineer – Advanced Concepts
location: Plattsburgh, New York, United States; Raleigh, North Carolina, United States; South Burlington, Vermont, United States
description:
At BETA Technologies, we apply our intellectual curiosity, passion for aviation, and commitment to sustainability toward a shared mission of revolutionizing electric aviation. Regardless of the position one holds, each team member brings their talent and desire to positively impact the environment and lives of others in a refreshing, vibrant, and inclusive culture.

The Structural Dynamics Engineer will develop and apply structural dynamic models and analyses for an advanced narrowbody aircraft. The role will support airframe and propulsion-integration design through modal, vibration, forced-response, aeroelastic, and test-correlation work. This position will be based onsite at our South Burlington, VT office location, our Raleigh, NC office. Remote candidates may be considered for a hybrid role, with monthly visits to South Burlington, VT for in person work.

How you will contribute to revolutionizing electric aviation:

  • Develop and maintain mass- and stiffness-representative finite element models for structural dynamics and aeroelastic applications
  • Perform modal, harmonic, random-vibration, transient, and base-input analyses for aircraft structures and installed equipment
  • Evaluate wing, pylon, propulsion, control-surface, and aircraft-system dynamic response and identify governing sensitivities
  • Convert analysis results into clear structural, mass-property, damping, isolation, instrumentation, and interface requirements
  • Support ground vibration, component vibration, and structural coupling test planning and model correlation
  • Work with Loads, Aeroelasticity, Flight Controls, Propulsion, Stress, Design, Test, and Manufacturing teams
  • Document methods, assumptions, uncertainty, results, and design recommendations for technical reviews

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • Three or more years of structural dynamics, vibration, aeroelasticity, finite element analysis, or related test experience
  • Strong fundamentals in modal analysis, structural dynamics, and finite element methods
  • Experience with NASTRAN, FEMAP, MATLAB, Python, or comparable engineering tools
  • Ability to communicate technical results and work effectively across engineering disciplines
  • Must be a US Person to be considered for the role

Above and Beyond Qualifications:

  • Aircraft wing, pylon, propulsion-installation, control-surface, flutter, or forced-response experience
  • Experience supporting ground vibration or component vibration testing and model correlation
  • Knowledge of aircraft certification considerations for structural dynamics or aeroelasticity

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

This role requires extended computer work and regular access to office, laboratory, hangar, and test environments. Occasional travel and use of standard personal protective equipment may be required.

The wage listed here reflects our best faith estimate for this role. We pay competitively and base compensation on a variety of factors including skills, experience, industry background, and the evolving needs of the role. Build electric airplanes with us!

  • Ability to communicate research findings to non-technical audiences

title: CORRECTIONAL OFFICER PRIVATE
description:
Nature and Variety of Work



Come join our team!

Prince George’s County Government provides a dynamic and inclusive workplace where employees can thrive, learn, and grow across its 30 diverse agencies, all dedicated to serving the County's residents with essential resources and services. Nestled just minutes away from Washington, DC, Prince George's County combines urban vibrancy with serene surroundings, offering an ideal setting to live, work, and enjoy life.

SIGN-ON BONUS $10,000!

Bilingual applicants are encouraged to apply!

The Prince George's County Department of Corrections is currently seeking qualified individuals to fill multiple full-time Correctional Officer Private positions, Grade D-21, for its January Correctional Officer Entrance Level Training Academy. This is a rewarding entry-level position and an opportunity to make a difference in the lives of others.


This vacancy announcement is for entry-level Correctional Officer vacancies for the 2027 fiscal year ending in June 2027.
Once vacancies fill for the January academy, interested applicants will need to reapply for additional positions for the fiscal year.

About the Position:

As an essential worker, Correctional Officers provide quality incarcerated individual care in a secure environment while positively impacting their community. As an integral part of the criminal justice system, Correctional Officers maintain security, safety, and control at the County facility. Correctional Officers must be able to effectively communicate verbally and in writing, exercise good judgment in controlling incarcerated individuals, and act calmly and decisively in stressful and emergency situations while utilizing interpersonal skills and techniques to direct incarcerated individuals,


About the Agency:

The Department of Corrections is an adult correctional center with a direct supervision design operating under the unit management concept. We have 18 Housing Units, and the daily inmate population is 1,039. We offer alternative incarceration programs for eligible offenders as well as provide educational services and programming to incarcerated individuals.


Examples of Work

  • Provide care, custody, and control of incarcerated individuals in a direct supervision environment.
  • Conduct regular head counts of incarcerated individuals on assigned posts.
  • Monitor inmate behavior and report unusual activity to ensure safety and security.
  • Assist other Correctional Officers in the management of incarcerated individuals.
  • Conduct regular searches of incarcerated individuals' areas such as cells, recreation rooms, and showers for contraband.
  • Manage confrontational situations as they arise to maintain security.
  • Perform CPR and/or first aid when necessary.
  • Investigate and respond to emergencies within the Department of Corrections.
  • Prepare routine reports and records electronically.
  • Maintain the inventory of various security equipment.
  • Provide counsel and assistance to incarcerated individuals.
  • Ensure inmates are afforded fair and equitable treatment.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Candidates must meet all minimum qualifications listed below to be eligible for additional consideration:

  • U.S. Citizen or Resident Alien Status
  • High School graduate or possess a GED certificate recognized by the Maryland State Board of Education
  • At least 18 years of age
  • Valid driver's license issued in the United States plus 6 months of post-license driving experience
  • Be willing to be an ESSENTIAL employee. Essential employees are expected to report to work or remain at work when other County employees are granted administrative leave. Employees in this classification may be assigned to any of the three shifts to ensure 24-hour coverage to maintain the facility's security.

EACH APPLICATION MUST INCLUDE INFORMATION THAT CLEARLY DEMONSTRATES THE ABOVE QUALIFICATIONS FOR THIS POSITION.




Additional Information

Salary Range Transparency: The salary range listed in this announcement reflects the offer range for this position. Offers made within this range are based on qualifications, experience, and internal equity.


Job Location: Department of Corrections, Upper Marlboro, MD


The next academy class is anticipated to start January 2027; however, candidates may be hired after meeting all background requirements are successfully met.

Conditions of Employment: Upon selection, the candidate must:
  • Be willing to work onsite in a correctional facility
  • Be available for shift work, which includes weekends and holidays, as required
  • Be willing and able to wear issued uniforms and use agency protective apparel and equipment in the performance of their assigned duties
  • Pass the Department of Corrections Correctional Entrance Level Training Academy
  • Meet all training and performance standards and demonstrate proficiency as required by the agency
  • Submit to and successfully pass required preemployment checks which may include reference checks, background investigations, drug screenings, COPAT, medical examination, polygraph, psychological evaluation, etc.
  • Be willing and able to serve as an essential employee. This position is designated essential. The employee must be willing to participate as a critical/essential employee during emergencies, such as natural or manmade disasters or special activities/events. Essential employees are expected to report to work or remain at work when other County employees are granted administrative leave. Employees in this classification may be assigned to any of the three shifts to ensure 24-hour coverage to maintain the facility's security.

ONLY ONLINE APPLICATIONS WILL BE ACCEPTED

title: Vehicle Operator Specialist (1st Shift), Autonomy Systems Validation
description: About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary The Vehicle Operator Specialist plays a vital operational, hands-on, and instructional role in the testing, safety validation, and ground support of Autonomy Systems Validation. Reporting directly to the Operations Coordinator, this role bridges the gap between field-testing drivers and ground logistics/facilities. In addition to serving as a senior driver operating prototype vehicles across public roads and private test tracks, you will act as on-shift floor lead and driver trainer/coach. You will oversee vehicle prep, ground support, data offloading, pre/post-trip operations, and shift handovers, while actively onboarding, training, and coaching vehicle operators to maintain top-tier safety and testing execution. Responsibilities Operator Training, Coaching & Mentorship Assist the Operations Coordinator in preparing training materials, conducting onboarding programs, and delivering hands-on driving and safety instruction for new vehicle operators. Continuously evaluate vehicle operator performance, provide real-time coaching on disengagement protocols, defensive driving, and test procedures, and reinforce high safety standards. Guide operators on standard operational workflows, proper logging procedures, software flashing methods, and vehicle prep standards. Act as the primary on-shift floor point of contact for driver questions, fostering a culture of continuous learning, psychological safety, and open feedback. Testing Operations Safely operate prototype test vehicles in autonomous, semi-autonomous, and manual modes across diverse weather, traffic, and road conditions for up to 8 hours daily. Maintain constant situational awareness and safety vigilance, executing manual disengagements and safety interventions seamlessly when necessary. Perform pre-defined test cases, specialized driving scenarios, and edge-case evaluations on public roads and closed-course test facilities. Ground Support & Fleet Operations Support the Operations Coordinator by assisting with daily shift handovers, driver shift readiness, route assignments, and vehicle allocations. Conduct and supervise pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections, basic system checks, hardware setups, and sensor calibrations/cleanings prior to test runs. Track vehicle health, coordinate routine maintenance or repair appointments with service technicians, and manage fleet charging logistics to ensure maximum vehicle availability. Oversee the daily end-of-shift data logging process, managing onboard hardware, offloading system data to local edge hardware/cloud servers, and verifying transfer integrity for engineering analysis. Maintain site/shop floor readiness, test equipment, tooling, and sensor platforms to ensure a safe, clean, and efficient testing environment. System Diagnostics & Technical Escalation Perform basic system diagnostics, guide operators through initial troubleshooting and perform/verify Over-The-Air software updates. Identify, isolate, and debug hardware, software, and sensor anomalies, creating detailed tickets (via Jira/issue-tracking systems) and escalating critical issues to cross-functional engineering teams. Compose clear, thorough, and concise post-drive reports, operational logs, and safety feedback to communicate system behavior and edge cases. Must be able to work 1st Shift (6:30a - 2:00p) Qualifications 2+ years of professional automotive driving, autonomous vehicle testing, or vehicle fleet operations, with demonstrated informal or formal experience coaching, mentoring, or training peers. Excellent interpersonal, coaching, written, and verbal communication skills; ability to deliver constructive feedback and explain complex technical concepts simply. Proven ability to maintain high focus while driving or monitoring autonomous systems (solo or with a partner) for 6–8 hours per day in a fast-paced environment. Ability to lift, maneuver, and move up to 50 lbs and remain active across shop floors, proving grounds, or field testing sites. Willingness to travel up to 20% for off-site field testing campaigns and flexibility to work overtime, non-standard shifts, or weekends as testing schedules require. Proficiency with laptops, smartphones, and enterprise collaboration tools (Google Docs, Sheets, Maps). Preferred / Bonus Qualifications Prior formal experience as a Driver Trainer, Lead Safety Driver, or Operations Lead in AV testing, proving grounds, or commercial fleet environments. Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, or equivalent engineering ticketing platforms. Familiarity with Linux/Unix navigation, embedded software flashing, CAN networks, and hardware/electrical diagnostics. Prior experience testing or supporting Level 4 autonomous driving systems. Pay Disclosure The hourly pay range for this role is $35.32 - $39.24/hour for San Francisco, CA based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com. This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Through hands-on project work, mentorship, and learning experiences, you’ll gain exposure to the people, disciplines, and ideas that shape the built environment. You may participate in design discussions, project meetings, site visits, business development efforts, office activities, and other experiences that broaden your understanding of the design profession.

The program combines three core components: mentorship, project work, and weekly learning sessions. Topics may include design culture, sustainability, design technology, communication, marketing and business development, project and resource management, research, equity, career development, and more. Along the way, you’ll hear from leaders and integrated designers across DLR Group and build connections with fellow emerging professionals.

Position Summary

As a Mechanical Engineering Intern at DLR Group, you will be an important part of our integrated design team, contributing to the design of mechanical systems for buildings of various types, sizes, and complexities. Working alongside mechanical engineers and professionals across architecture, engineering, interiors, and other disciplines, you will gain hands-on experience with the design process from early concepts and system development through documentation and construction administration.

Our Summer Internship Program is a paid, full-time opportunity running May 18 through August 6, 2027, and interns are expected to participate for the duration of the program. This is an opportunity to apply what you’ve learned in the classroom, build your technical and professional skills, and contribute your perspective to design solutions that support our brand promise of Elevating the Human Experience through design.

What you will do

  • Work with a licensed engineer designing mechanical systems for new construction and/or building renovation projects
  • Attend design team meetings with a mechanical engineer and observe the coordination that occurs among the team members of a multi-disciplinary design team
  • Assist a mechanical engineer with the design and development of construction documents primarily using Revit
  • Visit an active construction site (contingent on the status of local construction projects)
  • Develop HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection designs from concept through completion

Required Qualifications:

  • Completed at least one year at an ABET-accredited Mechanical Engineering or Architectural Engineering program
  • Experience or interest in BIM (e.g. Autodesk Revit MEP) workflow

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam
  • Interest in architectural building design
  • A third-year student in an accredited engineering program

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

#LI-

DLR Group is an integrated design firm delivering architecture, engineering, interiors, planning, and building optimization for new builds, renovations, and adaptive reuse projects.

We are 100% employee-owned: every employee is literally invested in our clients’ success. At the core of our firm are interdisciplinary teams engaged in every step of project lifecycles. Our teams champion true collaboration, open information sharing, shared risk and reward, value-based decision making, and proficient use of technology to deliver exceptional design. We are pursuing the goals of the 2030 Challenge, the ME2040, and the SE2050, and are an initial signatory of the China Accord and the AIA 2030 Commitment.

Through our values – commitment, creativity, environmental stewardship, fun, integrity, ownership, sharing, teamwork – we elevate the human experience through design, together.

DLR Group follows a four-day in-office work model, with employees having the flexibility to work somewhere other than the office on Fridays.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action/M/F/Veteran/Disabled employer.
