title: Project Manager, Market Operations
description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars, but we are not salespeople. We have made it our mission to create a hassle-free way for people to buy and sell cars. We saw a huge problem with how much of a headache it is to buy a car the traditional way, so we committed ourselves to put customer satisfaction at the core of our business, we have built a no-pressure, no-haggle online car buying experience that saves our customers time and money. Customers can search through thousands of vehicles online, see full 360-degree views of both the interior and exterior of the vehicles before deciding to go through the purchasing process. Our Customer Advocates will then either deliver the purchased vehicle to our customer’s driveway using one of our kick-ass one car haulers, or they will meet our customers at one of our amazing coin-operated Vending Machines.

For more information on Carvana and our mission, sneak a peek at our company introduction video.

About the team and position

Carvana’s Market Operation department is known for its team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

We expect bright people, willing to roll up their sleeves, take on new assignments, mentor and train others, assume additional responsibilities as needed while juggling multiple projects. Don’t forget to bring your personality! We thrive from each unique perspective. Our strength is in our diversity of opinions.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead multiple high-priority initiatives and projects by successfully collaborating, communicating and prioritizing across essential stakeholders to ensure goals are achieved.
  • Build strong relationships and work cross-functionally (internally and externally) with the necessary partners to support project initiatives.
  • Successfully execute full-cycle project management duties to meet project goals within given constraints (define goal, scope, deliverables, resources, budget and timeline; planning, monitoring and controlling during execution and finally, closing), with minimal guidance.
  • Effectively work through areas of ambiguity and complexity; demonstrating initiative and identifying the ideal process to achieve our business needs.
  • Dive deep into operations and utilize knowledge of the business and the Market Operations organization to support viable and lasting project management methodologies, frameworks and solutions across the organization.
  • Identify operational weaknesses and risks, and help innovate or improve processes.
  • Use data to make operational decisions, uncover insights, and provide direction to senior management.
  • Train and coach teams on project management methodologies, processes and applications.
  • Effectively partner with stakeholders to determine the needs of their departments and create/deliver communication plans to leadership; build, maintain, and communicate portfolio and/or project performance and progress across Market Operations platform and stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned

What you should have

  • Bachelor’s degree required and a minimum of 3 years working experience in Project Management (preferably in a fast-paced, production environment)
  • Experience leading cross-functional project teams through Initiation, Design, Planning, Execution and Close phases for large-scale, complex and ambiguous initiatives
  • Experience working across different business units (specifically HR, IT/technology, construction, engineering, procurement, operations) to communicate project vision, develop plans and drive change
  • Self-starter attitude with the ability to drive excellence and meet high standards
  • Fast learner with the ability to make decisions, problem solve, prioritize, and multi-task in an analytical and organized manner
  • Superior interpersonal skills, ability to interface with a variety of personalities with professionalism
  • Experience utilizing, performing administrative tasks, and training others on project management software
  • Ability to take an entrepreneurial approach to project management and commitment to team support
  • Ability to learn quickly, transfer knowledge and provide valuable and actionable feedback
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time while maintaining high attention to detail
  • Ability to operate at a high level in a dynamic, collaborative, goal-oriented and ever-changing production environment
  • Must promote the company culture and mission to all employees, vendors, clients, and business partners
  • Must be willing to travel when necessary (up to 10% of the time)

What we’ll offer in return

  • Full-Time Salary Position.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
  • 401K with company match.
  • A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
  • A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
  • Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
  • A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
  • A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.
  • The ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours).
  • Must be able to stay in stationary positions for extended periods of time (when driving) up to 3 hours at a time.
  • Frequently communicates with customers and must be able to exchange accurate information.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Production Coordinator
description:
About Mach Industries

Founded in 2023, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms. At the core of our mission is the commitment to delivering scalable, decentralized defense systems that enhance the strategic capabilities of the United States and its allies. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees, we operate with startup agility and ambition.

Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security.

The Role

Mach Industries is seeking a Production Coordinator to help translate production plans into daily factory execution. This role coordinates work order priorities, material readiness, and hardware movement to keep production teams aligned and ensure key milestones are met.

Working closely with Production, Supply Chain, Inventory, Engineering, and Quality, the Production Coordinator identifies constraints, tracks progress, and follows through on issues affecting delivery. The ideal candidate enjoys working directly with technicians, stays organized as priorities change, and takes a hands-on approach to keeping the factory moving.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily and weekly production priorities with vehicle program leaders, supervisors, and department leads to support schedule execution and delivery milestones.
  • Track work orders and hardware through manufacturing, inspection, and final integration, maintaining accurate status in production systems and trackers.
  • Review upcoming work for material, documentation, and resource readiness; identify constraints early and coordinate resolution with cross-functional partners.
  • Partner with Inventory and Supply Chain to coordinate kitting, lineside replenishment, material transfers, and shortage recovery while maintaining part, revision, and configuration accuracy.
  • Communicate production progress, priority changes, and delivery risks across departments and shifts, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through on recovery actions.
  • Support work order readiness and closure by verifying required transactions and documentation are complete.
  • Improve material flow and coordination processes to reduce delays and support new programs, configuration changes, and increasing production volume.
  • Provide hands-on factory and material handling support as needed while following safety, quality, traceability, and inventory control requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • At least two years of experience in production coordination, production control, material planning, inventory operations, or a related manufacturing role.
  • Experience tracking work orders, material availability, and production priorities.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing requests in a changing environment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technicians, department leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets and experience using an ERP, MRP, or MES.
  • Strong attention to detail when working with part numbers, revisions, quantities, and production records.
  • Willingness to work directly on the production floor and provide hands-on support when needed.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, or another manufacturing environment with strict quality and traceability requirements.
  • Experience supporting composites, fabrication, avionics, or final integration.
  • Familiarity with bills of material, engineering changes, configuration control, and material traceability.
  • Experience in high-mix/low-volume manufacturing and transitioning programs into repeatable production.
  • Experience coordinating material and hardware movement across multiple departments or facilities.
  • Interest in developing into production planning or scheduling

Additional Requirements

  • Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Level I
$25—$30 USD
Level II
$30—$35 USD
Level III
$35—$40 USD

At Mach, we believe that compensation is more than just a paycheck. It's a comprehensive package designed to reward the time, skills, and expertise you bring to our team. We are committed to offering competitive compensation that is equitable, transparent, and aligned with market trends.

Key Elements of Our Compensation Philosophy:

  • Competitive Salaries: We continuously research market rates to ensure our salaries are competitive with those in our industry and geographic location.
  • Performance-Based Incentives: Our bonus structure is tied to both individual and company performance, creating a win-win scenario that motivates our team members to excel.
  • Equity Participation: We offer stock options or equity to employees, ensuring that you share in the success and growth of the company.
  • Benefit Packages: Our benefits include healthcare, dental and vision plans, retirement savings, and paid time off, because we understand that your well-being extends beyond the office.
  • Professional Development: We allocate funds for continuing education, training, and career growth.
  • Transparency: We are committed to openness about our compensation tiers and how decisions are made, ensuring trust and mutual respect.

By joining Mach, you’re not just accepting a job—you’re becoming a key part of a team that values your contributions and invests in your growth. Together, we aim to create a rewarding environment that sets the stage for long-term success.

Data Privacy
To view Mach Industries candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

Disclosures

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

Mach participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offers may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and training, critical skills, and business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in most offers and are considered part of Mach’s total compensation package. Mach offers benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, and opportunities for professional development.

Mach is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws. If you’d like to defend the American way of life, please reach out!

title: Casino Table Game Auditor - Full-time and Part-time
description:
San Jose, CA | Full-time and Part-time | $23–25/hour | $1,000 Signing Bonus

The Role

If you enjoy learning and thrive in fast-paced environments, we want you. You'll audit live casino games using strong mental math, memorization, and attention to detail - perfect for candidates with tutoring, teaching, accounting, cashiering, or other numbers-heavy experience.

Schedule & Shift Details

  • Training Schedule (Full-time): Mon–Fri, 12pm–8pm.
  • Training Schedule (Part-time): Mon/Wed/Fri, 12pm–8pm.
  • Shifts: Be prepared to work late-night and overnight hours.
  • Weekend Requirements: Friday, Saturday, and Sunday availability is required.

What You'll Do

  • Monitor live casino table games accurately and consistently
  • Correct dealer directly when a rule or procedure is broken
  • Perform rapid mental math to calculate payouts, wagers, and bet verification
  • Memorize rules, payout structures, and game procedures for each game you’re certified on
  • Manage chips at the table (stacking, sorting, passing)
  • Reconcile table banks and chip inventory
  • Maintain accuracy under pressure while delivering excellent guest experience
  • Earn new game certifications through paid training, tied to pay increases
  • Maintain your state gaming license

Want to see the Gaming Associate role in action? Press play to watch a video.

If the video doesn't appear, search "Gaming Associate" on YouTube.

Qualifications

  • 21+ years old
  • Authorized to work in U.S.
  • Proficient in mental math (addition, multiplication, division and subtraction)
  • Pass background check, credit check, and drug screen

Physical Requirements

  • Able to sit or stand at a gaming table for 3–4 hours at a time
  • Able to use hands and fingers in a dexterous manner (rotating wrists, grabbing, pulling, pushing, pinching, tapping)
  • Able to lift 5–10 pounds for chip management and bank reconciliation (varies by location)
  • Able to see, speak, and hear clearly during gameplay
  • Necessary vision capabilities: close, distance, color, peripheral, and depth perception
  • Comfortable with direct communication and giving corrections when needed
  • Able to stay focused and manage stress effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments

Why Join Knighted?

  • Paid training; no casino experience needed
  • Pay raises with new game certifications
  • 401(k), health/dental/vision, paid time off (Full-Time)
  • Career advancement: 99% of leaders started here
  • Community service opportunities
  • Low physical demand work
  • Steady hours, long-term work

How It Works

Interview Process

Initial Interview (30 min) → Final Interview (30–45 min) → Onboarding (3–4 hours)

One application covers all our California locations, so please submit only one. If you have a location preference, let your recruiter know.

Signing Bonus Payout

  • $250 at 3 months
  • $250 at 6 months
  • $500 at 12 months

About Knighted

Knighted is California's #1 third-party gaming provider, delivering best-in-class Gaming Associates to the state's top card rooms. Founded by industry veterans with deep roots in the California card room world, the company has grown to over 1,000 employees and continues to expand rapidly - which is exactly why we're hiring.

That growth isn't slowing down. As we take on new casino clients across California, we're building out teams in multiple markets and developing the next generation of gaming professionals. If you're looking for a company that's on the rise and promotes from within, the timing couldn't be better - 99% of our supervisors, managers, and trainers started exactly where you'd be starting.

#SanJoseGA

Knighted Ventures and similar organizations are regulated by the California Gambling Control Commission, ensuring compliance with state gaming regulations.

title: Environmental Planning Intern
description:
Overview

Kimley-Horn is looking for Planning students to join our Sacramento, California (CA) office in Summer 2027! This is not a remote position.

Responsibilities

The ideal candidate has had exposure to environmental laws and regulations including California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), National Environmental Protection Act (NEPA), and/or the Clean Air Act, and a passion for applying sound scientific research and judgment to guide our clients through the environmental clearance and permitting process. With fine dining as a cornerstone of the membership offerings, our culinary philosophy is best described as a place “Where Global Flavors Meet Dallas Elegance.” Bringing more than 40 years of culinary expertise, including tenure at some of the most prestigious steakhouses in Texas, Executive Chef Connie Trujillo seamlessly blends global inspiration with classic Dallas steakhouse flare to create an unforgettable dining experience.

Beyond the culinary experience, Champions Social Club comes alive with curated entertainment for our members — from music to comedy to magic shows — and special events such as wine tastings, cigar and bourbon pairings, networking events and more. At Champions, culture is everything. We believe in limitless possibilities and building a team that values people above all. We’re driven by creativity, integrity and a shared passion for delivering exceptional experiences in every detail.

About the Role

Champions Social Club is looking for a polished, relationship-driven Member Experience Director to lead the member experience and help grow a vibrant, engaged community. This role oversees the full membership journey. From welcoming and onboarding new members to strengthening engagement, retention, and long-term relationships. The Member Experience Director serves as a key ambassador for Champions, building meaningful connections, understanding member preferences, and ensuring every interaction feels personalized and elevated. Working closely with teams across the Club, this leader connects members with dining, poker, events, and experiences while developing the Member Services team to deliver the exceptional hospitality that defines Champions.

Responsibilities

  • Create a warm, welcoming, and professional environment for all members and guests entering the Club.
  • Build genuine relationships with members by learning their names, preferences, interests, and overall Club experience.
  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource for members regarding dining, poker, events, membership benefits, and other Club offerings.
  • Anticipate member needs and provide personalized assistance to create memorable experiences.
  • Respond to member questions, requests, concerns, and feedback promptly and professionally.
  • Assist with reservations, event information, membership questions, and general Club inquiries.
  • Maintain a polished and professional presence that reflects Champions' standards of hospitality.
  • Support prospective and new members throughout the membership application and onboarding experience.
  • Assist with membership applications, account information, member records, and other membership-related processes.
  • Help introduce new members to the Club, its amenities, events, experiences, and membership benefits.
  • Promote upcoming events, programming, dining experiences, poker activities, and other opportunities for members to engage with the Club.
  • Proactively engage with members to strengthen relationships and encourage continued participation in the Champions community.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance member satisfaction, engagement, and retention.
  • Communicate member feedback, preferences, and opportunities to leadership and appropriate departments.
  • Work closely with Membership, Food & Beverage, Poker Operations, Events, Marketing, and overall Club Leadership to provide a seamless member experience.
  • Maintain accurate and organized member information within designated membership and CRM systems.
  • Assist with member communications, outreach, event registration, and other membership initiatives as needed.
  • Maintain an organized, professional, and welcoming Member Services area.
  • Support Club events, member activations, special programming, and VIP experiences.
  • Follow all Champions policies, procedures, service standards, and confidentiality expectations.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned based on the needs of the Club.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Previous experience in hospitality, luxury service, private clubs, hotels, restaurants, concierge services, customer service, or a similar member-facing environment preferred.
  • 2-5 Years of relative experience required.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with a genuine passion for hospitality.
  • Professional, polished, and confident when interacting with a wide variety of members and guests.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to provide personalized service while maintaining professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable learning and utilizing membership, reservation, CRM, and other Club systems.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across departments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and special Club events as needed.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation along with PTO & Paid Sick Leave available to employees after meeting initial eligibility requirements.
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including a flexible medical plan with customizable options for eligible positions, 401k with company matching and employee assistance/wellness programs.

title: Doctoral Researcher in election data (SDC-35)
description:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.

Starting on January 1, 2027, our Department Survey Data Curation, Team Survey Data Augmentation, located in Cologne, is looking for a

Doctoral Researcher in election data
(Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 75 %, limited to 3 years)

The department “Survey Data Curation“ processes and prepares social science research data across a diverse range of data types to support sociological and political science research, especially in comparative perspectives across space and time. The curated data include long-running national (e.g., ALLBUS, GLES) and international (e.g., ISSP, CSES) survey programs, which are documented and curated to the highest quality standards, but also research data products derived from or connected to these surveys, such as geo referencing services or trend files. Electoral Spaces is a project of our team Survey Data Augmentation that develops a research data infrastructure for making geocoded electoral data more findable, accessible, interoperable, and re-usable.


Your tasks will be:

  • Identifying election data with sub-national resolution for ingestion into Electoral Spaces
  • Developing and documenting the data ingestion procedure of the Electoral Spaces-infrastructure
  • Testing Electoral Spaces' framework, data model, and technical platform for compatibility with existing election data
  • Supporting the development of data quality tools
  • Conducting methodological or applied research showcasing the added value of the infrastructure


Your profile:

  • Master’s degree in political science or a related discipline
  • Strong interest in geocoded electoral data, data collection, harmonization, and management
  • Training in quantitative empirical methods for the social sciences, including good skills in the statistical software R
  • Motivation to complete a PhD thesis closely aligned with the project
  • Excellent English language skills


Our Benefits:

  • Opportunity to contribute to a research data infrastructure with substantial impact on the future of democracy research
  • Work in an integrated yet flexible team of quantitative social scientists with substantial synergies between survey augmentation projects specializing in geospatial data applications and democracy
  • Flexible working hours and regulations for mobile working
  • Very good conditions for reconciling work and family life, e.g. subsidies for childcare for children who have not yet attained the age of compulsory schooling
  • Holistic company health management and discounted participation in the university's sports programme
  • Generous support for your pension provision as a direct insurance policy
  • Promotion of your skills through further training measures


Contact

For further information concerning the tasks please contact Lea Kaftan via E-Mail (). If you have questions about the application process, please contact Christine Laßmann via E-Mail ().


Interested?

Please apply by submitting a motivation letter, a CV, and a writing sample via our online-application portal until October 2, 2026.

title: LIQUID EGG PROCESSOR
description:
Job Summary:

The Liquid Egg Processor is responsible for ensuring the proper handling, inspection, and processing of eggs in the transfer room, cups room, and related processing areas. The role involves operating machinery, inspecting eggs for quality, removing damaged or spoiled eggs, and maintaining cleanliness and organization in the work areas. Adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP), and Safe Quality Food (SQF) guidelines is essential. This position may involve various tasks based on the specific role assigned (e.g., Flat Tapper, Cherry Picker, or Cups Room duties).

Duties/Responsibilities:

Flat Tapper Responsibilities:

  • Stack and tap flats as they come off the conveyor.

  • Remove excess broken or stuck eggs from the flats.

  • Maintain the pace with the machine while being aware of surrounding conditions.

  • Ensure the work area and surrounding areas remain clean.

  • Assist the Loader by removing tic-tac cardboards or flats from pallets when necessary.

  • Wrap finished pallets of pulp flats for disposal.

Cherry Picker Responsibilities:

  • Visually inspect the egg quality before it enters the breaking machine.

  • Discard any broken, leaking, or dirty eggs.

  • Slow down the production conveyor if necessary to perform thorough inspections.

  • Notify management immediately if the water flow to the final egg rinse stops or if eggs are excessively dirty or broken.

  • Communicate any issues promptly to ensure smooth production.

Cups Room Responsibilities:

  • Ensure that cracked eggs entering the pasteurization machine are wholesome and of good quality.

  • Discard eggs with shell fragments, blood, or spoilage, and retrieve solid cracked shells as needed.

  • Notify the pasteurizer operator of any issues in the cups room, such as leaks, overflows, or machine malfunctions.

  • Stop the production line when heavily spoiled or black eggs are found so the machine can be cleaned and sanitized.

  • Follow proper PPE requirements, including wearing scrubs or a lab coat, a surgical face mask, and arm sleeves. Hearing protection is required.

General Responsibilities:

  • Operate and monitor equipment in each assigned area while ensuring product quality and adherence to safety protocols.

  • Follow all GMP, SOP, HACCP, and SQF guidelines during daily tasks.

  • Ensure all work areas are clean, safe, and organized.

  • Report any machine issues, quality concerns, or safety hazards to the supervisor or management.

Resumen del Puesto:

El Procesador de Huevo Líquido es responsable de asegurar el manejo, inspección y procesamiento adecuados de los huevos en la sala de transferencia, sala de tazas y áreas de procesamiento relacionadas. El puesto implica operar maquinaria, inspeccionar huevos para asegurar su calidad, retirar huevos dañados o en mal estado y mantener la limpieza y organización de las áreas de trabajo. Es esencial cumplir con las Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP), Procedimientos Operativos Estándar (SOP), Análisis de Peligros y Puntos Críticos de Control (HACCP) y las directrices del programa Safe Quality Food (SQF). Este puesto puede incluir diversas tareas según el rol específico asignado (por ejemplo, Flat Tapper, Cherry Picker o funciones en la sala de tazas).

Funciones / Responsabilidades:

Responsabilidades de Flat Tapper:

  • Apilar y golpear las bandejas (flats) a medida que salen del transportador.

  • Retirar huevos rotos o atascados de las bandejas.

  • Mantener el ritmo con la máquina mientras se está atento al entorno.

  • Asegurar que el área de trabajo y alrededores permanezcan limpios.

  • Ayudar al Loader retirando cartones o bandejas de los pallets cuando sea necesario.

  • Envolver los pallets de bandejas de pulpa terminadas para su desecho.

Responsabilidades de Cherry Picker:

  • Inspeccionar visualmente la calidad del huevo antes de que entre en la máquina de ruptura.

  • Desechar huevos rotos, con fugas o que esten sucios.

  • Reducir la velocidad del transportador si es necesario para inspecciones detalladas.

  • Notificar a la gerencia inmediatamente si el flujo de agua del enjuague final de huevos se detiene o si los huevos están muy sucios o rotos.

  • Comunicar cualquier problema de manera inmediata para asegurar la producción fluida.

Responsabilidades de la Sala de Tazas:

  • Asegurar que los huevos agrietados que ingresan a la máquina pasteurizadora estén en buen estado y sean de calidad.

  • Desechar huevos con fragmentos de cáscara, sangre o en mal estado, y recuperar cáscaras agrietadas sólidas según sea necesario.

  • Notificar al operador de pasteurización sobre cualquier problema en la sala de tazas, como fugas, desbordes o fallas en la máquina.

  • Detener la línea de producción si se encuentran huevos muy dañados o negros para limpiar y sanitizar la máquina.

  • Seguir los requisitos de PPE, incluyendo batas o scrubs, mascarilla quirúrgica y mangas protectoras. Se requiere protección auditiva.

Responsabilidades Generales:

  • Operar y monitorear el equipo en cada área asignada, asegurando la calidad del producto y el cumplimiento de protocolos de seguridad.

  • Cumplir con todas las normas GMP, SOP, HACCP y SQF durante las tareas diarias.

  • Mantener todas las áreas de trabajo limpias, seguras y organizadas.

  • Reportar cualquier problema de maquinaria, preocupación de calidad o riesgo de seguridad al supervisor o a la gerencia.

  • Mantener comunicación abierta con el operador de pasteurización, loaders y otros miembros del equipo para garantizar operaciones eficientes.

title: Senior Finite Element Vehicle Architect
description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a Finite Element Vehicle Architect reporting to the Senior Manager, Dynamics and Loads to support the development of the systems that will be required for the design and build of human-rated space stations.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach location.

The Structural Dynamics team is responsible for low and high-frequency load & environment predictions for all Vast space stations during ground transportation, ascent, and on-orbit operations. This role will be responsible for building, maintaining, and managing the vehicle systems-level Finite Element Model of our Haven space station program, and oversee future FEA engineering needs across Vast’s future product portfolio.

Responsibilities:

  • Create and maintain FEA models of vehicle level systems and space station program
  • Perform structural dynamics analysis that informs structural sizing for strength, mass, and cost optimization
  • Collaborate closely with design engineers in dynamics and static analysis methods
  • Communicate with design organization to ensure vehicle prediction models match design intent
  • Expand company capability in analysis through validating and establishing methods and practices
  • Work with hardware owners and test engineering to plan and execute vibration tests, as well as perform supporting analyses

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering (or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in commercial FEA software (ie Femap/Nastran, Abaqus, Ansys )
  • Strong grasp of structural mechanic fundamentals used for dynamic response prediction (single degree of freedom systems, damping, beam bending)

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Spacecraft and/or Payload background with experience through the entire system lifecycle from concept, design, production, integration, test, launch, to operation support
  • Demonstrated expertise with Nastran
  • Automation and Workflow Generation for FEA softwares
  • Working understanding of a design load cycle and how it relates to analysis and test
  • Knowledge of spacecraft analysis and launch load environments and industry standard documents (NASA-STD-5001, SMC-S-016, etc.)
  • Establishment of of company internal specifications or best practices

Pay Range: California
$137,760—$230,472 USD

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. title: Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure (Starshield)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, AI INFRASTRUCTURE (STARSHIELD)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy the Starshield constellation. Starshield is the world’s largest US government satellite constellation and is tasked with providing immediate access to critical intelligence and national security data for the US government anywhere on the globe. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – receivers that allow users to connect within minutes, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starshield's global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help us further our ambitious goals.

As an engineer focused on Starshield's software and GPU infrastructure, you will design, operate and scale the infrastructure that supports critical national security missions. These positions cover a variety of areas ranging from Site Reliability Engineering, Developer Operations, and GPU platforms. You will develop automation to deploy and manage on-premise compute resources, create highly scalable and maintainable software products, and directly collaborate with engineering across the board.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage GPU/CPU infrastructure deployments to Top Secret data centers
  • Manage and provide support for GPU as a service for external customers on bare metal hardware and virtualized platforms
  • Design, validate, and productize solutions for AI clusters (100k+ GPU scale)
  • Develop automation to deploy and manage on-premise Kubernetes\AI clusters, and operating systems
  • Deploy and manage core infrastructure such as databases, monitoring and distributed storage
  • Closely collaborate with AI engineers to create highly scalable, operable, and maintainable products
  • Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services -- from inception and design, through deployment, operation and refinement
  • Monitoring and alerting supporting systems to have high availability
  • Identify areas for improvement and create innovative solutions that enable high system availability

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems/IT, or an engineering discipline and 1+ years of professional experience in site reliability engineering or DevOps; OR 3+ years of professional experience in site reliability engineering or DevOps in lieu of a degree
  • 1+ years of professional experience with Linux operating systems
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or other infrastructure tools
  • Experience with containerization technologies (i.e. OCI containers, Kubernetes)
  • Experience scripting in Bash, Python, or other similar languages
  • Development experience in Python, C++, or Go

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 1+ years of experience with Python and Python-based development frameworks
  • Experience managing Kubernetes clusters, not just using them
  • Knowledge of Linux boot process and systems configuration
  • Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & continuous monitoring
  • Understanding of relevant build technologies, such as Bazel and Makefiles
  • Focus on performance bottlenecks and performance improvement techniques
  • Understanding of distributed databases and data modeling
  • Experience with automatically managing thousands of servers (eg: Terraform or Ansible)
  • Strong networking knowledge of TCP/IP
  • Cloud virtualization experience (as the cloud provider)
  • Experience using NVIDIA GPU deployment stacks (Blackwell/Rubin)
  • Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with customers, peers, management etc. in both formal and informal situations
  • Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed
  • Must be willing to travel domestically and globally in the future when needed
  • This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, SpaceX reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $160,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $195,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

title: Manager, Software (Embedded & Digital Products)
description:
Who will you be working with?

As the Manager, Software (Embedded & Digital Products), you will report to the Manager, Engineering & Products and lead a multidisciplinary software organization responsible for embedded software, digital platforms and backend services, customer-facing applications, and independent software test and validation.

You will work closely with product management, hardware engineering, quality, operations, cybersecurity, sales, and customer support. Together, you will develop reliable rail-electronics solutions and scalable digital products that solve real customer challenges.

This is an opportunity to shape how software is developed, delivered, and commercialized across a growing portfolio of embedded and digital products.

How will you make a difference?

You will help evolve the software organization from a primarily project and maintenance-focused function into a product-line organization that supports differentiated hardware products, recurring digital services, and sustainable business growth.

You will set the technical direction and establish the operating model needed to deliver today’s customer commitments while building reusable platforms and capabilities for the future.

In this role, you will:

  • Shape and maintain the software product vision, technology roadmap, and investment plan for embedded and digital products, aligning priorities with the business STRAP, customer needs, market opportunities, and financial objectives.
  • Lead the Embedded Software, Digital Platforms and Backend, UX and Application, and Software Test and Validation functions, creating clear priorities, strong collaboration, and shared accountability for results.
  • Guide the development of a common, modular software platform across Monitoring, Test Equipment, Locomotive Control Systems, Remote Access, and related products to increase reuse, shorten development cycles, and improve long-term maintainability.
  • Expand capabilities in remote access, fleet analytics, connected-asset services, predictive maintenance, cloud services, APIs, licensing, and secure over-the-air updates.
  • Balance customer-funded NRE work with investment in reusable product platforms, SaaS offerings, and future digital services.
  • Establish practical software architecture and engineering standards covering modular design, hardware abstraction, communications, cybersecurity, configuration management, documentation, CI/CD, and testing.
  • Help teams deliver products that meet applicable cybersecurity, functional-safety, quality, customer, regulatory, and Wabtec requirements, including ISO 9001, CMMI, and applicable Safety Integrity Level requirements.
  • Improve delivery predictability by strengthening estimation, capacity and release planning, risk and dependency management, effort tracking, and delivery reporting.
  • Build effective requirements-management practices using IBM Engineering Requirements Management DOORS, including requirements baselines, traceability, change control, review workflows, and linkage to design and verification evidence.
  • Strengthen release quality through independent verification and validation, automated regression testing, hardware-in-the-loop testing, cybersecurity testing, and formal release qualification.
  • Use business, product, quality, and engineering information to guide roadmap priorities, investment decisions, and continuous improvement.
  • Connect software priorities and product-roadmap decisions to customer value and business performance, including revenue, orders, book-to-bill, gross margin, EBIT, installed-base growth, utilization, and recurring revenue.
  • Explore automation and AI-enabled engineering practices that can reduce time to market while maintaining appropriate review, validation, documentation, and configuration control.
  • Collaborate with product management and sales on market analysis, proposals, business cases, customer commitments, pricing, and commercialization strategies.
  • Support the growth of software architects, technical leads, developers, test engineers, and validation specialists through coaching, meaningful goals, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development.
  • Create an inclusive and collaborative environment that values accountability, technical excellence, innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

What would make you successful in this role?

We are looking for a software leader who combines technical depth with a strong product and business mindset. You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed, but you should be comfortable leading multidisciplinary teams and making informed technical and commercial decisions.

The following experience will help you succeed:

  • A bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related technical discipline. An advanced degree would be an asset.
  • Eight (8+) or more years of progressive software engineering experience, including at least three (3+) years leading software teams, technical programs, or product-platform delivery.
  • Experience leading embedded software development, along with experience in at least one or mored of the following areas:
    • Cloud or backend platforms
    • Web or desktop applications
    • Data platforms
    • Software test automation
  • Strong knowledge of C/C++, embedded Linux or RTOS environments, device communications, firmware lifecycle management, hardware and software integration, and debugging practices.
  • Familiarity with modern digital-platform technologies. Relevant technologies may include C#, .NET, Python, REST APIs, SQL, MQTT, Docker, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, or AWS.
  • Experience developing modular architectures, reusable software platforms, software product lines, APIs, secure update mechanisms, or configuration-management practices.
  • Experience improving software delivery through a combination of requirements management, estimation, Agile planning, CI/CD, automated testing, engineering metrics, and release governance.
  • Experience using IBM Engineering Requirements Management DOORS or a comparable requirements lifecycle-management system.
  • An understanding of cybersecurity-by-design, secure communications, authentication and authorization, vulnerability management, and software-product risk mitigation.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 and CMMI in an engineering environment. Experience with safety-critical or regulated transportation products would be an asset.
  • A product and business mindset, with the ability to connect software investment to customer value, product performance, lifecycle cost, and profitable growth.
  • Experience using data and metrics to assess business cases, prioritize product roadmaps, and evaluate commercial and engineering outcomes.
  • Strong communication, people-leadership, stakeholder-management, and change-management skills.
  • The ability to travel to customer or Wabtec sites, including international locations, approximately 10 to 25 percent of the time.
  • If your experience does not align with every item but you believe you can bring strong software leadership, sound judgment, and a passion for building successful products, we encourage you to apply.

What might your typical day look like?

No two days will be exactly the same. Your activities will vary depending on customer commitments, product priorities, and where teams are in the software development lifecycle.

On a typical day, you may:

  • Meet with team leads to review portfolio priorities, sprint and release progress, capacity, risks, dependencies, quality indicators, and customer commitments.
  • Make resource and sequencing decisions that balance current customer deliveries with investment in reusable product platforms and future digital services.
  • Coach architects and technical leads as they work through software architecture, hardware and software interfaces, cybersecurity, test strategy, and platform decisions.
  • Help teams remove delivery barriers and ensure they have clear requirements, acceptance criteria, estimates, milestones, and verification plans.
  • Review requirements quality, traceability, baselines, and change control in DOORS.
  • Discuss business, product, delivery, quality, and engineering performance with stakeholders and agree on actions where results are outside target.
  • Collaborate with product management, hardware engineering, quality, operations, sales, and customer support on roadmaps, proposals, releases, field issues, and commercialization plans.
  • Engage with customers and business leaders to understand operational needs and translate them into scalable product capabilities.
  • Support the team through hiring, coaching, delegation, performance discussions, succession planning, and targeted technical development.
  • Promote effective documentation, revision control, design reviews, test evidence, and compliance with applicable Wabtec processes and policies.

What about the physical demands of the job?

The role may require occasional travel to customer sites, which may involve standing, observing small writing and labels, climbing, and wearing personal protective equipment (PPE) as necessary.

· Ability to lift, carry, and move test hardware and equipment up to 50 lbs.

· Ability to work at a lab bench performing hands-on testing, setup, and troubleshooting.

· Ability to connect and interact with small components, cables, and test fixtures.

· Ability to stand or sit for extended periods depending on testing needs.

· Ability to visually inspect hardware devices and test systems.

· Ability to work in an electronics lab environment following ESD and safety protocols.

· Ability to use hand tools (e.g., screwdrivers) for assembling and maintaining test setups.

· Have manual dexterity to be able to work with various hardware for testing purposes.

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

title: Senior Medical Safety Scientist
location: Princeton, New Jersey, United States; San Diego, California, United States
description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals
Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

Please note that this position is based in either San Diego, CA, or Princeton, NJ. Acadia's hybrid model requires this role to work in our office three days per week on average.

Position Summary

The Senior Medical Safety Scientist is a scientific safety expert within Drug Safety & Pharmacovigilance (PV), reporting to the Executive Director, Drug Safety & Pharmacovigilance, Medical Safety. This role serves as the primary scientific safety lead for assigned products across the Acadia portfolio, driving safety surveillance, signal detection and evaluation, aggregate safety assessments, and benefit-risk evaluations throughout the product lifecycle. The Senior Medical Safety Scientist collaborates closely with Safety Physicians and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively identify, evaluate, communicate, and manage safety risks while supporting regulatory submissions and safety governance activities.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as the scientific safety lead for assigned products, providing pharmacovigilance expertise across clinical development and post-marketing activities
  • Conduct routine and ad hoc review of safety data from clinical trials, post-marketing sources, literature, business partners, and other relevant sources to support ongoing safety surveillance
  • Lead signal detection, validation, evaluation, tracking, and aggregate safety analyses, including review of case series, adverse event trends, data mining outputs, and benefit-risk assessments
  • Author and maintain key safety deliverables including signal assessments, safety evaluations, benefit-risk assessments, safety narratives, AOSEs, Safety Surveillance Plans (SSPs), and signal management documentation
  • Support aggregate safety reports, regulatory submissions, health authority responses, core safety information, Risk Management Plans (RMPs), REMS activities, and other product risk management initiatives
  • Provide scientific safety expertise to governance committees and cross-functional teams, including Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Epidemiology, Medical Affairs, and Quality
  • Review safety listings, line listings, adverse event summaries, and retrospective safety data analyses to identify and evaluate emerging safety concerns and risks
  • Support audits, inspections, and regulatory authority inspections by ensuring safety documentation is accurate, complete, and inspection ready while maintaining compliance with global pharmacovigilance regulations and Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (GVP)
  • Maintain current knowledge of safety science methodologies, signal management practices, and evolving global regulatory requirements
  • Other duties as assigned

Education/Experience/Skills

  • PharmD, PhD, MS, MSN, MPH, RN, NP, PA, or equivalent degree from an accredited institution
  • 7+ years of experience in drug safety, pharmacovigilance, clinical safety, or risk management within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry
  • Experience in safety surveillance, signal detection and management, aggregate safety data review, benefit-risk assessment, and product safety evaluation
  • Experience authoring regulatory safety documents including signal assessments, DSURs, PBRERs, safety sections of clinical documents, aggregate reports, and health authority responses
  • Advanced knowledge of FDA, EU, and ICH regulations and guidelines related to pharmacovigilance, clinical trial safety monitoring, signal management, aggregate reporting, and post-marketing surveillance
  • Expertise in safety signal detection, validation, evaluation, and risk assessment methodologies
  • Experience with pharmacovigilance databases and safety systems, including Argus Safety, as well as signal detection tools
  • Strong knowledge of MedDRA coding conventions, safety data review methodologies, and adverse event analysis
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required

title: Associate Principal Scientist –Analytical, Inhalation products
location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America
description:
Join us at AstraZeneca, where we put patients first and strive to meet their unmet needs worldwide. We have an exciting opportunity to join our Technical Operations Science & Innovation (TOSI) team which is part of the

Pharmaceutical Technology & Development (PT&D) organisation. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact on people's lives with life-changing medicines. This is an Associate Principal Scientist role.

The Pharmaceutical Technology & Development (PT&D) organisation, part of Operations, is responsible for drug product design, development and technical support for drug substance and products throughout the life cycle.

This role will have a significant impact on the overall success of Operations as well as ensuring the commercial viability of current products. The activities of the group help to ensure availability of all AstraZeneca products to the commercial organisation. The role therefore has a substantial impact on both financial and reputational aspects of the business.

This role is based at AstraZeneca’s Durham, US site.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will provide expert technical analytical support to commercial Inhalation Products manufactured internally at AZ sites and externally at contract facilities. You will be responsible for the provision of technical expertise to aid in the resolution of method/manufacturing/formulation issues and complaints impacting supply or manufacturability. You will also be delivering technical expertise to support product supply strategy projects and business continuity plans through delivery of the drug product control, manufacturability strategy and product quality risk management activities throughout the lifecycle. There will also be opportunities to represent the QC units during the New Product Introduction phase, working with the development team and manufacturing sites.

Other responsibilities:

  • Support AZ manufacturing and QC testing sites, CMOs, and import labs to ensure performance, robustness and compliance of AZ commercial drug products and related analytical methods. This will involve practical problem-solving activities in support of issue investigations (OOS/OOT) and analytical methods lifecycle management.
  • Support major changes, business continuity plans and market access projects in collaboration with multiple functions (e.g., Global external sourcing, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, and Manufacturing). This will involve analytical technology transfers of commercial products to multiple locations as well as support to local registrations and regulatory variations, including preparation of analytical parts of regulatory dossiers.
  • Assist in defining technical standards impacting commercial products specific to regulatory expectations and analytical standards (including pharmacopeial standards)
  • Executing Technical leadership and influencing in Pharmaceutical Teams and within TOSI
  • Analytical methods improvements and analytical innovation projects for commercial products, in collaboration with other technical teams and Expert Working Groups. This includes performance improvements, sustainability improvements, lead time reduction, enhanced control strategy, automation etc. in alignment with Ops 2030 and PT&D 2030 targets.

Essential requirements

  • Bachelor of Science in an appropriate subject area (e.g. Chemistry, Pharmacy, Analytical and Pharmaceutical Sciences) with proven experience relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, ideally on inhalation medicines. MS or PhD desirable.
  • 5+ years of experience in multiple pharmaceutical development subject areas, such as, analytical, formulation, process engineering, stability, modelling and validation
  • An understanding of the overall drug development and commercialisation process from development, launch and life cycle management
  • Experience in Operations and/or R&D with a track record of successful project leadership and delivery within a matrix organization
  • Detailed understanding of principles, applications and management of SHE and cGMP

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That’s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we’re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

At AstraZeneca, we are driven by our commitment to deliver accelerated growth and to make people's lives better. We are part of an inclusive and giving community, we support and help each other on our journeys. We are intellectually stimulated by constant learning. There's potential for multiple, global careers and great rewards, for those who embrace the diverse opportunities.

Are you ready to make a positive impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to deliver more medicines to patients, quicker and more affordably.

We welcome your application no later than October 15th, 2026.

Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. Benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.
