title: Director, International Business Analytics
description:
At Viridian, we work with a sense of urgency for patients, creating unity with our team, the industry, and the community. We are committed to using proven science and engineering to improve the lives of people living with serious and rare diseases, and we are getting closer to achieving this goal every day.

Reporting to the Vice President, International, the Director/Senior Director International Business Analytics will be accountable for market insight development, competitive intelligence, forecasting, analytics, and market assessments across International markets.

This role will be responsible for informing, challenging and tracking international strategies and execution, across launch readiness, and in-market performance for two Phase 3 assets, providing critical insights and analytics to inform key decisions with significant financial, organizational, and multi-year business impact.

Operating as part of the International Leadership Team and partnering closely with cross-functional leaders, this role will engage across priority launch markets to create a launch platform for the successful commercialization of the Viridian portfolio.

A close partnership with US/Global Commercial Effectiveness & Planning (Market Research, Forecasting, Analytics and Competitive Intelligence) will be critical. Within the International team structure this role will develop key partnerships with International Commercial Operations & Marketing, International Medical Affairs and International Market Access & Government Affairs to align strategy to drive differentiation and adoption in priority markets. This is a foundational role with significant responsibility for shaping Viridian’s international capabilities from launch planning through commercialization and lifecycle management. This position will be based in the UK.

Responsibilities (including, but not limited to):

  • Conduct in-depth market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks to inform regional strategies and country specific plans. Provide actionable insights to support strategic planning and decision-making.
  • Linking with US/Global forecasting, implement comprehensive forecasting models for current and future product lines, ensuring accurate revenue/market projections.
  • Lead the execution of primary and secondary research to glean key stakeholder insights related to attitudes, beliefs and behaviors across the Viridian portfolio.
  • Present complex market insights and forecast data to leadership and stakeholders in a clear manner, ensuring effective communication across the organization.
  • Identify opportunities, risks, and implications within the competitive landscape with a focus on forward-looking competitor events, competitor activities and major congresses, providing strategic recommendations to maintain our competitive edge.
  • Inform development of target product profiles and forecasts to inform International projections for the future pipeline.
  • Build an internal operating model to support harnessing CRM insights, analytics delivery and data management.
  • Generate insights into the effectiveness of commercial strategies and recommend strategic and tactical shifts to optimize impact of commercial investments.
  • Identify opportunities to adopt innovation, new tools and technologies to gain insights, differentiate and retain a competitive advantage.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand internal customer needs and align forecasting, analytics, CI and market insight plans with overall business strategies.

Collaboration & Governance:

  • Partner closely with US/Global Commercial Effectiveness & Planning (Market Research, Analytics, Forecasting, Competitive Intelligence), International Commercial, International Medical Affairs, International Market Access etc.
  • Establish planning and tracking to ensure high-quality, on-time delivery of launch milestones within budget and ‘on strategy’.
  • Provide regular updates to the VP, Head of International on strategy, risks, and progress
  • Requires a Bachelor’s degree and 12+ years commercial biotech/pharma experience, with a track record of career progression with deep SME in commercial effectiveness & planning
  • Proven track record of understanding, tracking & challenging performance and launch thinking for specialty or rare disease products, ideally in ophthalmology or endocrinology in highly competitive, complex markets
  • Proven experience and success demonstrating strategic thinking, collaborative mindset, “can do” attitude and demonstrating superior abilities for the tactical plan execution
  • Strong analytical skills, demonstrated by the ability to identify and interpret complex issues and provide appropriate recommendations to senior management and across functional areas
  • Ability to collect, synthesize, and present data to leadership and across the organization.
  • Outstanding planning, organizing and management skills with an ability to excel in a dynamic, lean, scaling environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication and presentation skills with the ability to lead and influence cross-functionally and to interface seamlessly with other parts of organization.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain relationships with internal and external partners.
  • Proven mindset of proactive continuous improvement.
  • Strong commitment to ethical standards.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as required (approximately 20%).
  • The salary range for this position is commensurate with experience.

title: Retail Client Lead
description:
À propos de dunnhumby

dunnhumby est le leader mondial de la Data Science appliquée aux clients, aidant les enseignes et les marques les plus ambitieuses au monde à placer le client au cœur de chaque décision. Avec près de 3 000 experts répartis en Europe, en Asie, en Afrique et dans les Amériques, nous collaborons avec des entreprises emblématiques telles que Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble et Metro afin de transformer les données en croissance, en innovation et en valeur mesurable pour leurs clients.

Leadership Client

Nos équipes Leadership Client constituent le moteur commercial de dunnhumby. Elles développent des partenariats de confiance à long terme qui transforment les données clients en croissance mesurable pour les plus grandes enseignes et marques mondiales. Nous travaillons dans les secteurs de l’alimentation, de la grande distribution et du commerce spécialisé, en transformant les insights en actions concrètes sur des sujets tels que l’assortiment, la tarification, les médias et les promotions.

À propos du poste

Nous nous préparons à un éventuel nouvel engagement client et renforçons nos capacités de leadership client Retail au Canada. Ce poste soutiendra les relations avec les parties prenantes du distributeur qui lui seront confiées et contribuera à transformer les données et insights clients en recommandations concrètes pour les décideurs du commerce de détail.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous soutiendrez les relations avec le distributeur et la livraison des insights, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la présentation des résultats, tout en contribuant à une exécution fiable des projets et à la création d’une valeur client claire.

  • Soutenir les relations quotidiennes avec les parties prenantes du distributeur qui vous seront confiées.
  • Comprendre les questions du distributeur et les traduire en analyses, livrables et actions ciblés.
  • Interpréter les insights clients et consommateurs et contribuer à l’élaboration de présentations et de recommandations claires.
  • Coordonner les calendriers, les actions et les suivis de projets avec les équipes internes.
  • Contribuer à la planification des comptes, au suivi de la valeur créée pour le client et à l’identification d’opportunités de croissance adaptées.

Ce que nous recherchons

Vous apporterez une réelle curiosité pour le commerce de détail et les clients, un sens de l’organisation solide et la capacité de communiquer clairement des analyses.

  • Expérience dans l’utilisation des données ou des insights pour répondre à des problématiques liées au commerce de détail ou à des enjeux commerciaux.
  • Excellentes compétences écrites, orales et de présentation.
  • Capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec les clients et les collègues.
  • Expérience dans la gestion organisée de plusieurs projets et priorités simultanément.
  • Approche collaborative et orientée client dans la résolution de problèmes.

Ce que vous pouvez attendre de nous

Nous ne nous contenterons pas de répondre à vos attentes. Nous les dépasserons. Vous bénéficierez ainsi d’un ensemble complet d’avantages digne d’une entreprise technologique de premier plan, mais aussi d’un niveau de flexibilité personnelle auquel vous ne vous attendiez peut-être pas. Vous profiterez également d’avantages pensés avec attention, tels que des horaires de travail flexibles et un jour de congé pour votre anniversaire.

Et nous ne faisons pas que parler de diversité et d’inclusion. Nous les vivons au quotidien grâce à nos réseaux dynamiques tels que dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled et dh Thrive. Nous souhaitons que chacun ait la possibilité de révéler tout son potentiel et de donner le meilleur de lui-même tout au long du processus de recrutement. N’hésitez pas à informer votre recruteur des aménagements qui pourraient vous être utiles.

Avantages chez dunnhumby Canada

  • Santé : Couverture médicale et dentaire privée par l’intermédiaire de Desjardins. dunnhumby prend en charge 90 % du coût total de la prime et l’employé contribue à hauteur de 10 %.
  • Protection et retraite : Assurance vie, assurance décès et mutilation accidentels, assurance invalidité de courte durée et de longue durée par l’intermédiaire de Desjardins, ainsi qu’une allocation en espèces équivalente à 5 % du salaire de base destinée à un régime personnel de retraite ou d’épargne-retraite.
  • Congés : 25 jours de congés payés par année, en plus des jours fériés tombant pendant la semaine de travail, fins de journée anticipées le vendredi, journées de fidélité et une journée de congé pour votre anniversaire.
  • Bien-être : Allocation annuelle Santé et Bien-être de 500 $, accès au dh Wellness Hub et programme d’aide aux employés comprenant des ressources de soutien et jusqu’à six séances gratuites de consultation professionnelle pour les employés et leur famille.
  • Style de vie et avantages complémentaires : Récompenses pour ancienneté et programme de recommandation Talent Scout. Une allocation automobile est accordée aux postes de niveau G4 et plus.

Notre approche du travail flexible

Chez dunnhumby, nous valorisons et respectons les différences et nous nous engageons à bâtir une culture inclusive en créant un environnement où vous pouvez concilier une carrière réussie avec vos engagements et centres d’intérêt en dehors du travail.

Nous sommes convaincus que vous donnez le meilleur de vous-même lorsque vous bénéficiez d’un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Certains postes se prêtent davantage à des modalités de travail flexibles que d’autres. Si cela est important pour vous, veuillez en discuter avec votre recruteur. Nous sommes ouverts à l’exploration de solutions de travail flexibles tout au long du processus de recrutement.

Pour plus d’informations sur la manière dont nous collectons et utilisons vos renseignements personnels, veuillez consulter notre avis de confidentialité :

About dunnhumby

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, helping the world's most ambitious retailers and brands put the customer at the heart of every decision. With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.

Client Leadership

Our Client Leadership teams are dunnhumby's commercial engine - building the long-term, trusted partnerships that turn customer data into measurable growth for the world's biggest retailers and brands. We work across grocery, mass and specialty retail, translating insight into action on everything from ranges and pricing to media and promotions.

About the Role

We are preparing for a potential new client engagement and building retail client leadership capability in Canada. This role will support assigned retailer relationships and help translate customer data and insight into practical recommendations for retailer decision-makers. [Add: retailer function, business area or category scope.

What You'll Be Doing

You will support retailer relationships and insight delivery from brief through presentation, helping ensure dependable project delivery and clear client value.

  • Support day-to-day relationships with assigned retailer stakeholders.
  • Clarify retailer questions and translate them into focused analysis, deliverables and actions.
  • Interpret customer and shopper insights and help create clear presentations and recommendations.
  • Coordinate project timelines, actions and follow-up across internal teams.
  • Contribute to account planning, client value tracking and appropriate growth opportunities.

What We're Looking For

You'll bring curiosity about retail and customers, organised delivery and the ability to communicate analysis clearly.

  • Experience using data or insight to answer retail or commercial questions.
  • Clear written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • Confident relationship-building with clients and colleagues.
  • Organised project delivery across multiple priorities.
  • A collaborative, customer-first approach to problem solving.

What You Can Expect From Us

We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

And we don't just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day - with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process - please let your recruiter know what adjustments would help.

Benefits at dunnhumby Canada

  • Healthcare: Private medical and dental coverage through Desjardins. dunnhumby funds 90% of the full premium cost and the employee funds 10%.
  • Protection and retirement: Life insurance, Accidental Death & Dismemberment, Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability through Desjardins, plus a 5% cash allowance of base salary for personal pension or retirement provision.
  • Time off: 25 days holiday per holiday year in addition to public holidays that fall during the working week, Early Friday finishes, loyalty days and a birthday day off.
  • Wellbeing: A $500 annual Health & Wellness allowance, the dh Wellness Hub and an Employee Assistance Program with support resources and up to six free professional counselling sessions for employees and their families.
  • Lifestyle and extras: Long Service Awards and the Talent Scout referral programme. A car allowance is provided to G4+ roles.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

title: Reservedelsekspedient til kundeservice
description:
Til vores kundeservice på hovedkontoret i Middelfart søger AD Danmark en dygtig og serviceminded reservedelsekspedient, der har lyst til at arbejde med salg og rådgivning af autoreservedele til vores professionelle B2B-kunder i autobranchen.

Vi forestiller os, at du har interesse for og et godt kendskab til biler og autobranchen. Vigtigst er dog, at du har lyst til at sælge, rådgive og yde god service til vores værkstedskunder – primært via telefonen. Du får en grundig oplæring i vores produktsortiment, systemer og arbejdsgange, så du er godt rustet til de opgaver, du møder i hverdagen.

Din dagligdag vil primært bestå af salg og support til vores mange kunder, opfølgning på ordrer og tilbud samt forskellige administrative og praktiske opgaver. Du bliver en del af et stærkt team af dedikerede kolleger, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, tager ansvar og ved, hvor vigtigt det er at løfte i flok.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har erfaring fra autobranchen – f.eks. som uddannet mekaniker, reservedelsekspedient eller fra en lignende stilling
  • har kendskab til TecDoc og partslink24, som er værktøjer, vi benytter i det daglige arbejde
  • har interesse for biler, autoreservedele og tekniske løsninger
  • trives med salg og kundekontakt – særligt telefonisk
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig sætter pris på at være en del af et team
  • er god til at kommunikere og lytte til kundernes behov
  • er serviceminded og løsningsorienteret
  • behersker dansk og kan kommunikere på engelsk i skrift og tale
  • har flair for IT og er fortrolig med at arbejde i forskellige IT-systemer
  • trives i en travl hverdag med højt tempo og mange forskellige opgaver

Du bliver en del af en ambitiøs virksomhed og et team af engagerede kolleger, hvor vi arbejder sammen om at give vores kunder en professionel og effektiv service.

Dine primære opgaver

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Besvare telefoniske henvendelser fra vores værkstedskunder
  • Salg og rådgivning om autoreservedele og relaterede produkter
  • Rådgivning og support via e-mail, chat, sms og øvrige relevante kanaler
  • Oprettelse og håndtering af kundeordrer
  • Brug af TecDoc og partslink24 til at identificere og finde de korrekte reservedele
  • Support til vores butikker
  • Opfølgning på kundernes ordrer på tværs af vores afdelinger
  • Løbende opfølgning på egne ordrer
  • Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på kunde- og salgstilbud
  • Praktiske opgaver, herunder håndtering og forsendelse af varer
  • Optimerings-, opfølgnings- og ad hoc-opgaver i den daglige drift

Om AD Danmark

AD Danmark er Danmarks eneste universaldistributør til autobranchen og leverer autoreservedele til det professionelle marked i hele Danmark.

Kunderne er omdrejningspunktet for vores forretning, og vores ambition er at være en attraktiv, seriøs og anderledes samarbejdspartner for den professionelle autobranche.

Vi tilbyder et bredt udvalg af kvalitetsreservedele og har adgang til mere end 300.000 forskellige reservedele. Herudover tilbyder vi blandt andet værkstedsudstyr, tilbehør, dæk og fælge samt en række løsninger og koncepter målrettet professionelle værksteder.

Gennem attraktive priser, gennemsigtige rabatordninger og innovative løsninger ønsker vi at bidrage til udviklingen af vores kunders forretning.

Autobranchen er i konstant udvikling, og derfor arbejder vi målrettet med løsninger og koncepter, der skaber værdi for vores kunder. Det er grundlaget for vores tilgang:

**“Partnerskab – der betaler sig!”
**Vi har en travl og spændende hverdag – og vi keder os aldrig.

Vi tilbyder

Hos AD Danmark får du:

  • en spændende stilling med stor kontaktflade til den professionelle autobranche
  • en grundig oplæring i vores produkter, systemer og arbejdsgange
  • mulighed for at udvikle din faglige viden inden for autoreservedele, salg og kundeservice
  • en hverdag med ansvar, variation og højt tempo
  • et stærkt team af engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger
  • en uformel omgangstone og et godt fællesskab

Vi lægger vægt på, at alle bidrager til holdet og sammen sikrer en høj service over for vores kunder.

Arbejdstid og løn

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen.

Arbejdstiden placeres mandag til fredag mellem kl. 07.00 og 18.00 efter nærmere aftale med ledelsen.

Løn aftales individuelt efter kvalifikationer.

Kontakt

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig, og kan du se dig selv som en del af AD Danmark, er du velkommen til at kontakte kundeservicechef Lennert Jensen på 30 30 40 44 for yderligere information om stillingen.

Vi inviterer løbende relevante kandidater til samtale, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Din ansøgning

Send din ansøgning via vores elektroniske ansøgningsskema ved at benytte knappen “Udfyld ansøgning”.

Vedhæft din ansøgning og dit CV i PDF- eller Word-format.

Mærk din ansøgning “Reservedelsekspedient til kundeservice”.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Registered Midwife - Child Health and Parenting Service (534204)
description:
The Team

The Child Health and Parenting Service (CHaPS) provides important health and wellbeing services to families across Tasmania with children aged 0 to 5. The service promotes the healthy development and wellbeing of children, providing growth and developmental assessments, health-focused early intervention, referrals and connections with other early childhood providers.

The CHaPS Residential Parenting Unit (lilinga) supports early intervention and support to families to navigate the adjustments and broad range of challenges that can arise during early parenting, equipping them with the confidence, knowledge and tools needed to support family wellbeing.

lilinga means Tasmanian Myrtle Beech (Nothofagus cunninghamii) in palawa kani, the language of Tasmanian Aborigines.

The Role

Registered Midwives within lilinga work alongside Registered and Enrolled Nurses and the wider multidisciplinary team to deliver comprehensive care that supports the careplan, and promotes the wellbeing and confidence of families admitted to the unit.

You will need

  • Experience and/or knowledge of the principles of primary healthcare and delivery of holistic care that supports family efficacy.
  • Proven ability to work in a multidisciplinary team to meet health outcomes.
  • Ability to work in partnership with families to deliver high-quality midwifery care in the post-natal period and beyond.
  • Note: - Please refer to the Statement of Duties for all the selection criteria of this position to address in your application.

Why Tasmania

The Department of Health Tasmania oversees various hospitals across the state, including the Royal Hobart Hospital, Launceston General Hospital, Northwest Regional Hospital, and Mersey Community Hospital, as well as district hospitals and ambulance services. Additionally, it provides community health, mental health, and primary healthcare services to the Tasmanian community through more than 300 sites.

Tasmania, Australia's only island state, offers unparalleled natural beauty and a luxurious lifestyle. Pursuing your health career in Tasmania’s public health system means building strong connections with colleagues and patients. It also means embracing a lifestyle where you can enjoy extraordinary experiences outside of work while making a significant impact on the community during work.

title: Freight System Engineer (h / f)
description:
How will you make a difference?

As a Freight System Engineer, oversee the integration of braking and/or digitalization systems to ensure delivered solutions meet customer requirements. You will serve as the primary point of contact between project teams, Wabtec sites, and customers, both in France and internationally.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Design and develop railway braking systems and digitalization solutions.
  • Manage technical specifications and interfaces between various subsystems.
  • Ensure requirement traceability and technical project consistency.
  • Participate in customer technical reviews and project milestone meetings.
  • Analyze technical risks and propose appropriate solutions.
  • Manage customer-requested modifications by evaluating their technical and economic impacts.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary, multi-site teams in an international environment.
  • Assume technical responsibility for projects and ensure the overall consistency of the solution through to commissioning.
  • Manage technical requirements and their traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

What do we want to know about you?

Required education and experience:

  • Higher education in mechanics or engineering.
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in an industrial environment.

Required skills/qualities:

  • Knowledge of mechanical, pneumatic, electrical, or electronic systems.
  • Ability to draft technical specifications and work on complex projects.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical, pneumatic, electrical, or electronic blueprints and schematics.
  • Professional Italian and English (French is considered a plus)
  • Analytical mindset, attention to detail, and a strong sense of responsibility.
  • Strong interpersonal skills for collaborating with various internal and external stakeholders.
  • Availability for regular travel within Europe and occasional international travel.

Legal authorization to work in EU is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

Please note that we do not accept agency candidate submissions without a formalized agreement with Wabtec Talent Acquisition. If you are an agency/third party Recruiter and have not been engaged by Wabtec for this search, we do not owe you a fee if you submit a candidate to the applicant tracking system that is ultimately hired.

#LI-LF1

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.


We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: Produktionsmedarbejder søges til foderproducent på daghold i Ans
description:
Vi søger på vegne af en samarbejdspartner en produktionsmedarbejder til produktion af foder- og mineralprodukter til landbruget. Du bliver en del af produktionen, hvor du arbejder med betjening af produktionsanlæg samt håndtering og opfyldning af bigbags og siloer.


Arbejdstider

  • Mandag til torsdag: kl. 06.00 - 14.30
  • Fredag: kl. 06.00 - 13.00


Løn: 155kr/t


Arbejdsopgaver

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært bestå af:

  • Betjening og overvågning af produktionsmaskiner
  • Opfyldning af bigbags og siloer
  • Truckkørsel og varehåndtering
  • Sikring af kvalitet og orden i produktionen

Faglige Kvalifikationer

Det forventes, at du har:

  • Erfaring fra produktionsarbejde
  • Gerne erfaring med maskinbetjening
  • Gyldigt truckcertifikat
  • Forståelse for sikkerhed og kvalitetskrav

Vi tilbyder
  • Try & Hire-stilling med henblik på fastansættelse
  • Pension, fritvalgsordning og overenskomstmæssige vilkår
  • Et uformelt og støttende arbejdsmiljø
  • Gode kollegaer og en arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel

Ansøg nu

Lyder dette som noget for dig? Send dit CV til herning-u@jobteam.dk, mrk. "HEU-U40-AY1".

Alle ansøgninger gennemgås løbende, så tøv ikke med at søge.


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Industrial Painter
description:
Who will you be working with?

L&M Radiator, Inc. is a global designer, manufacturer, and distributor of MESABI cooling and heat transfer solutions that are custom-made for heavy equipment in the mining, oil, gas, construction and heavy industrial industries. We are looking for an individual to join our Paint Department. This position will work directly with other painters and the Paint Supervisor on a daily basis to ensure production goals are met. This role may also work with our Research and Development department as well as our Engineering department to test equipment, tools, and products.

How will you make a difference?

As a member of the team, you will be responsible for painting products, using customer specifications for paint colors. This paint is unique as different customers require different paints for their products to ensure the paint does not chip or rust in the weather conditions. In this role you will also be responsible for changing paint filters, keeping track of paint supplies, and letting your supervisor, Quality, and Purchasing know what needs to be ordered. This role has opportunities to work with many tools including, but not limited to industrial paint guns, pressure washer, scissor lift, overhead crane, sandblasters, and more! The position reports directly to the Paint Supervisor.

This shift is Monday-Friday 6:00am to 2:00pm. OT is possible depending on production needs.

What do we want to know about you?

  • 18 years or older.
  • Valid driver’s license.
  • High school diploma or GED with 1 year of work experience.
  • Industrial Painting skills.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Ensure accuracy and quality, following company procedures and specifications.
  • Maintain an accurate timekeeping record.
  • Report problems to supervisor.
  • Maintain a clean and safe work area.
  • Maintain inventory.
  • Prepare parts for painting.
  • Follow SP for customer product.
  • Maintain and clean spray gun.
  • Assist in other areas of production as needed if qualified.
  • Perform work in a safe manner and follow all safety guidelines and procedures.
  • Domestic and international travel possible depending on the project.
  • Perform related work or job duties as required by supervisor.

What about the physical demands of the job?

  • Wear correct PPE – earplugs, protective eye wear, steel-toed boots, and work provided uniform (gloves when necessary).
  • Wear a paint suit, a hood, respirator, and gloves.
  • Keep a clean-shaven face.
  • Lift a minimum of 50lbs.
  • Stand on concrete for 8-10 hours.
  • Work in high heat conditions.
  • Use power tools while standing, twisting, crouching, standing on step ladder, or holding them above your head.
  • Practice and maintain safe work conditions.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required for Entry Level:

  • Regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to use mil thickness gauge.
  • Knowledge of painting and spraying.
  • Ability to use hand and power tools.
  • Ability to communicate, in English, effectively and clearly by both written and verbal means.
  • Physical strength sufficient to perform job duties.
  • Ability to understand and carry out simple oral and written instructions.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude.
  • Required to wear a respirator and PPE uniform.
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment written math test, physical, drug and background test.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1 of year painting experience.
  • Knowledge of Epicor or similar ERP system.
  • Experience in Lean Manufacturing.

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

This role is also eligible for a performance bonus.

More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, is available at mywabtecbenefits.com.

Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen and fitness for duty test.

The hourly range for this role is between $23.00 - $35.00. The actual hourly rate offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands, and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

title: Lead Systems Engineer, MCA – Fleet Innovation & Transformation
description:
Who will you be working with?

Our Freight Services Division provides locomotive maintenance services to our customers, the country’s largest freight railroads, helping them keep their locomotives running at optimal levels. The mission of the Fleet Innovation & Transformation team is to accelerate fleet transformation by consistently providing compelling solutions and innovative technologies that improve reliability, sustainability, and performance.

How will you make a difference?

The Lead Systems Engineer, MCA – Will partner with a team of engineers focused on delivering software solutions for Wabtec’s growing fleet of MCA based control system locomotives. In this role, you will lead the technical requirements definition, verification, validation and implementation phases of MCA software release(s) to ensure customer satisfaction.

You will initiate software releases starting with System level requirements definition & flow-down through the sub-system level, followed by internal sub-system & system level validation. Provide primary support for installation on our customer locomotives in the field and in the factory. This includes ensuring system and sub-system level validation planning and tests are appropriate for the defined requirements and scope. Your leadership will help ensure that the software will deliver a product that exceeds customer expectations, is installed with as little disruption to the customer as possible, and with minimal support needed from Wabtec.

    What will your typical day look like?

    • Define MCA Software revision/release scope with appropriate requirements definition, documentation updates, design review planning, verification and validation plans.
    • Provide end-to-end oversight of MCA software release process ensuring system level requirements are met through appropriate validation testing.
    • Identify risks and develop mitigation activities to reduce risks to acceptable levels prior to software release.
    • Communicate program & project progress to all levels of the organization.

    • Ability to troubleshoot and solve product problems in a ‘high-pressure’ environment
    • Ability to estimate engineering effort for defined tasks

    • Proven ability to strengthen teams, increase effectiveness, and broaden responsibilities
    • Project/Program Management experience

    • Strong Verbal & Written communication skills

title: Senior Data & Integrations Engineer – People & Finance
description:
Senior Data & Integrations Engineer – People & Finance

  • Full-time

High performance isn't a given. It’s built on standards.
Standards that have driven McLaren for over 60 years.
And if you’re ready for the challenge, that standard is yours to own.
Burning enthusiasm. Constant improvement. The thrill in the pursuit of better.
That’s how we build a legacy. And how you build a career here.
Because racing isn’t just something we do. It’s who we are.
We are racers.
Are you?

This is a hands-on technical role within the Business Performance function, helping connect McLaren Racing’s People and Finance platforms with the wider enterprise technology landscape.

Working under the direction of the Associate Director, People & Finance Technology & Data, you will design, build, maintain and improve secure, reliable and scalable integrations. Your work will enable data and transactions to move accurately between Workday and other McLaren systems.

You will also work with enterprise technology teams to clarify system dependencies, ownership, controls and data flows, reducing manual hand-offs and enabling joined-up processes, reporting and decision-making across the organisation.

Principal Accountabilities

Data Engineering and Integration

  • Design, build, test, deploy and support secure inbound and outbound integrations across People, Finance and wider McLaren technologies.
  • Develop and maintain robust data pipelines that provide timely, accurate and trusted datasets.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into scalable integration designs, covering data mappings, transformation logic, scheduling, security, error handling and reconciliation.
  • Extract, transform and exchange data through SQL, APIs, web services, file-based interfaces and approved integration tools.
  • Assess the upstream and downstream impact of changes to systems, processes, data structures and interfaces.
  • Develop monitoring, validation, alerting and reconciliation controls that identify integration failures and data-quality issues.
  • Investigate incidents, complete root-cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Replace manual extracts, uploads and reconciliations with controlled, automated integrations where appropriate.
  • Support integrations between Workday and enterprise systems including Salesforce, SmartRecruiters, Clockify, Microsoft Azure and Power Automate.
  • Work with system owners to define sources of truth, integration direction, frequency, data ownership and support models.
  • Contribute to integration architecture, identifying dependencies, transition requirements and opportunities to simplify the application landscape.
  • Support data migration and interface activity associated with Workday Financials and other transformation programmes.
  • Ensure integrations align with McLaren standards for enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data governance and access control.
  • Maintain clear documentation covering interfaces, endpoints, schedules, dependencies, data mappings, runbooks and support procedures.

Collaboration and Project Delivery

  • Partner with People, Finance, IT and Commercial technology teams to deliver joined-up system and data solutions.
  • Support integration discovery with business owners, technical teams, vendors and implementation partners.
  • Translate end-to-end process requirements into integration needs that support the complete workflow.
  • Coordinate integration design, testing, deployment and handover across internal teams and external partners.
  • Support Workday releases, configuration changes and technology deployments through impact assessments and regression testing.
  • Clarify ownership and support responsibilities, escalating material risks, unresolved dependencies and control gaps.
  • Contribute to reusable integration standards, patterns and governance.

You will bring experience as a Data Engineer, BI Developer, Data Analyst or in a similar role within a data-driven environment, or hold a relevant degree or qualification.

You will also have:

  • Good SQL skills for data extraction, transformation and troubleshooting.
  • A practical understanding of APIs, REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, SFTP, web services, authentication methods and ETL/ELT patterns.
  • Exposure to data modelling and preparing datasets for reporting environments, ideally Power BI.
  • The ability to build and maintain data pipelines and integrations in structured, repeatable ways.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy.
  • An awareness of data privacy, security and the careful handling of confidential information.

Experience with Workday HCM, Workday Financials, Workday Prism or Adaptive Planning would be advantageous. Familiarity with Power Automate or Power Apps would also be beneficial.

Personal Attributes

You will be analytical, organised and proactive, with strong problem-solving and communication skills. You will be able to translate technical data concepts for non-technical People and Finance users and build positive working relationships across teams.

You will remain calm and effective under pressure, adapt quickly to new systems and bring curiosity, attention to detail and a commitment to continuously improving data processes.

Success in racing comes from bringing together talented people with different skills, perspectives and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels supported and empowered to deliver their best work.

Every role has the potential to drive high performance. You'll be part of a team united by a shared ambition to push boundaries and embody our racing mindset. We invest in our people through opportunities to develop and grow, creating an environment where individuals and teams can thrive.
Alongside a range of wellbeing initiatives and development opportunities, we're committed to helping you build a rewarding career and make your mark at McLaren Racing.

Work with the founding team and deploy services on AWS using Terraform, Python, ECS/Lambda, and Postgres. Ideal candidates have 2–3 years in backend development, strong CS fundamentals, cloud-native experience (AWS/GCP/Azure), and a passion for data quality and scalable architectures.

title: Electrical Engineering Intern | Summer 2027
description:
DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.

DLR Group’s Cleveland studio has an opening for an Electrical Engineering Summer Intern.

We have multiple positions and locations available; please refer to all openings posted and apply to the locations that are most suitable for your living situation during the course of your internship. This is not a remote position.

About EPX at DLR Group

As an intern at DLR Group, you’ll be part of our Emerging Professional Experience (EPX) Program, designed to give you a meaningful introduction to life within an integrated design firm and a strong foundation for your career in the AEC industry.

Each person at DLR Group has a design voice, and EPX gives you opportunities to develop and share yours. Through hands-on project work, mentorship, and learning experiences, you’ll gain exposure to the people, disciplines, and ideas that shape the built environment. You may participate in design discussions, project meetings, site visits, business development efforts, office activities, and other experiences that broaden your understanding of the design profession.

The program combines three core components: mentorship, project work, and weekly learning sessions. Topics may include design culture, sustainability, design technology, communication, marketing and business development, project and resource management, research, equity, career development, and more. Along the way, you’ll hear from leaders and integrated designers across DLR Group and build connections with fellow emerging professionals.

Position Summary

As an Electrical Engineering Intern at DLR Group, you will be an important part of our integrated design team, contributing to the design of electrical systems for buildings of various types, sizes, and complexities. Working alongside electrical engineers and professionals across architecture, engineering, interiors, and other disciplines, you will gain hands-on experience with the design process from early concepts and system development through documentation and construction administration.

Our Summer Internship Program is a paid, full-time opportunity running May 18 through August 6, 2027, and interns are expected to participate for the duration of the program. This is an opportunity to apply what you’ve learned in the classroom, build your technical and professional skills, and contribute your perspective to design solutions that support our brand promise of Elevating the Human Experience through design.

What you will do

  • Work with a licensed engineer designing electrical systems for new construction and/or building renovation projects
  • Attend design team meetings with an electrical engineer and observe the coordination that occurs among the team members of a multi-disciplinary design team
  • Assist an electrical engineer with the design and development of construction documents primarily using Revit
  • Visit an active construction site (contingent on the status of local construction projects)

Required Qualifications:

  • Completed at least one year at an ABET-accredited Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering program
  • Experience or interest in BIM (e.g. Autodesk Revit MEP) workflow

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam
  • Interest in architectural building design

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

#LI-

DLR Group is an integrated design firm delivering architecture, engineering, interiors, planning, and building optimization for new builds, renovations, and adaptive reuse projects.

We are 100% employee-owned: every employee is literally invested in our clients’ success. At the core of our firm are interdisciplinary teams engaged in every step of project lifecycles. Our teams champion true collaboration, open information sharing, shared risk and reward, value-based decision making, and proficient use of technology to deliver exceptional design. We are pursuing the goals of the 2030 Challenge, the ME2040, and the SE2050, and are an initial signatory of the China Accord and the AIA 2030 Commitment.

Through our values – commitment, creativity, environmental stewardship, fun, integrity, ownership, sharing, teamwork – we elevate the human experience through design, together.

DLR Group follows a four-day in-office work model, with employees having the flexibility to work somewhere other than the office on Fridays.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action/M/F/Veteran/Disabled employer.

title: Analyst, BI Engineering
location: Burbank, California, United States of America
description:
Are you curious, creative, and love data? Do you enjoy collaborating with colleagues and using data to drive actionable insights? Do you want to be on the cutting edge of breakthroughs in data and analytics, encouraged to discover, challenged to think bigger, and supported to learn new things personally and professionally?

Disney seeks an Analyst, BI Engineering specializing in YouTube data and analytics to join the Enterprise Research & Analytics team. The Brand Analytics team is a highly visible department that is charged with finding the best methods to understand consumer thoughts, feelings, and behaviors across digital and social channels. They play an integral part in aiding key business decisions for the Walt Disney Company, encompassing Corporate, Disney Entertainment and Disney Experiences through our core brands; Disney+, Hulu, Marvel, Lucasfilm, 20th Century Studios, Pixar, Disney Live Action, Walt Disney Animation, Disney Parks & Disney Cruise Line, and many more. You will join a dynamic group who are passionate about bringing the consumer voice into decision-making every day.

You will play a crucial role in advancing the team's YouTube data and Business Intelligence capabilities by engineering data pipelines, analytical tools, software solutions, and scalable BI products that drive informed business decisions. You will contribute to YouTube analytics architecture, data integration and governance, vendor relationships, and UX/UI standards. This role requires hands-on technical fluency with YouTube’s APIs and reporting systems, as well as a passion for developing innovative solutions and optimizing data workflows.

The role reports to the Manager, BI Engineering and is based in Burbank, CA. This role requires in-person collaboration from Monday to Thursday and remote work on Friday.

You Will / Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain analytical tools, data solutions, and software that enable existing analytics & marketing teams at The Walt Disney Company to scale their work, accelerate delivery, and create capacity for continued innovation

  • Develop YouTube analytics frameworks and BI products that translate evolving business questions into standardized data models, metrics, dashboards, and insights products; partnering closely with other Data Analytics and Business Intelligence team members
  • Establish and maintain YouTube data governance, technical documentation, validation, and quality control assurance practices to ensure data accuracy, consistency and reliability
  • Develop and maintain data visualization and UX/UI standards across dashboards and reports to ensure consistency and clarity across analytical products

  • Deliver executive‑level data storytelling by translating complex YouTube datasets, performance metrics, and analytics outputs into clear, concise, and actionable insights for senior leadership
  • Serve as the YouTube analytics expert and thought leader for Disney digital marketing team, bringing the voice of the consumer into decision-making through timely, relevant, and actionable quantitative and qualitative insights

You Will Have / Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data engineering–adjacent roles, including research, social media, consumer data, and digital marketing, with direct ownership of analytical systems, reporting pipelines, or insight products
  • Hands-on experience extracting, managing, and analyzing data through YouTube’s analytics and content management ecosystem, including API access, YouTube Studio and CMS
  • Experience with YouTube-specific data structures, dimensions, metrics, and reporting schemas
  • Knowledge of platform‑native analytics APIs across additional social platforms: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X/Twitter
  • Familiarity with digital marketing, social media, and consumer behavior datasets, including high‑volume, multi‑source data feeds
  • Knowledge of business intelligence methodologies including Data Analysis, Data Integration, Data Migration, Data Warehousing, and Data Visualization
  • Proficiency with SQL, and the ability to extract and combine disparate data sources into coherent analytical outputs
  • Proficiency with business intelligence and data visualization software (such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Domo), including dashboard performance optimization and UX standardization
  • Knowledge of AI‑powered analytics, leveraging large language models (LLMs) to accelerate analysis, enhance data exploration, and improve insight generation through effective prompt engineering and agentic workflows

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) using AI pair‑programming to accelerate SQL, Python, or analytics engineering tasks
  • Familiarity with Python, R, or similar programming languages
  • Proficiency with enterprise social analytics and listening platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Quid, RivalIQ) including query logic, taxonomy construction, and data normalization
  • Knowledge of data workflows across various stages, from backend sourcing to ingestion pipelines
  • Experience working with a major entertainment/media company and digital media teams
  • Ability to simplify complex data into clear and actionable insights
  • Experience collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels, including presenting data and insights to senior leadership

Required Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Marketing, Psychology, or a related quantitative field or equivalent work experience

title: Signal/Power Integrity Hardware Engineer
description:
About the Company:

At SK Hynix Memory Solution, we're at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, developing advanced memory solutions that power everything from smartphones to data centers. As a global leader in DRAM and NAND flash technologies, we drive the evolution of advancing mobile technology, empowering cloud computing, and pioneering future technologies. Our cutting-edge memory technologies are essential in today's most advanced electronic devices and IT infrastructure, enabling enhanced performance and user experiences across the digital landscape.

We're looking for innovative minds to join our mission of shaping the future of technology. At SK Hynix Memory, you'll be part of a team that's pioneering breakthrough memory solutions while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. We're not just adapting to technological change – we're driving it, with significant investments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and eco-friendly solutions and operational practices. As we continue to expand our market presence and push the boundaries of what's possible in semiconductor technology, we invite you to be part of our journey to creating the next generation of memory solutions that will define the future of computing.

About the Team
SK hynix memory solutions America Inc. (SKHMS America), a subsidiary of SK hynix NAND Product Solutions (D.B.A Solidigm), provides industry-leading controller hardware, advanced flash management systems, and firmware for NAND and post 2D-NAND based storage solutions spanning Enterprise, Client and Mobile market segments. We are part of the world's top tier semiconductor supplier, SK hynix, offering Dynamic Random Access Memory chips (DRAM), Flash memory chips (NAND Flash) and CMOS Image Sensor (CIS) for a wide range of distinguished customers globally.

Description

We are looking for a driven, team-oriented Signal/Power Integrity Engineer to develop next generation Solid State Drive (SSD) products. This position requires experience in hardware design and signal and power integrity design. A successful candidate will have a good knowledge of state of the art memory device technologies and interfaces such as PCIe Gen 4, 5 and 6, DDR4/5, ONFI NAND and implementation techniques required for high-speed interfaces. This candidate will need to have a good working knowledge of simulation tools, schematic capture tools and lab equipment (scopes, analyzers, etc.). Expertise in design for optimum signal and power integrity as well as hands-on lab measurements experience is a must.


Responsibilities

  • Mentoring of engineers.
  • Provide SI/PI expertise for SSD controller package (SoC) substrate design and SSD PCB design.
  • Participate in the design of SSD products which includes: design guidelines, reviewing designs, validation of designs and final reports of work designs.
  • Support PCB back-end process: defining stack-up and HDI via technologies, part placement, setting routing constraints and reviews.
  • Interface with cross functional teams to ensure the design meets all system level requirements through verification/validation in the lab.
  • Work closely with SoC, FW, package, and circuit design engineers.
  • Documentation and communication to design, product and executive teams.
  • Debug and root cause analysis at all product development stages, as well as customer escalations.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering required; MS in Electrical Engineering is a plus.
  • 4-8+ years of relevant working experience.
  • High-speed SSD board designs, pre layout simulation, post layout simulation and design layout guide generation for PCIe Gen4/5/6, DDR4/5, LPDDR4/4x, NVIO and PDN.
  • Strong fundamentals in 3D/2D EM simulation tools and transmission line theory.
  • Required experience of EM field solvers, time and frequency domain simulation tools like Sigrity, Allegro, ADS, HFSS, SIWAVE, and HSPICE.
  • Simulation followed by measurement correlation using Oscilloscope, VNA and TDR equipment.
  • Excellent understanding of PCB design fundamentals: single end and differential signaling, cross talk (near end and far end), signal loss and impedance control.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical leader experience.
  • Familiar with generating and interpreting data & eye diagrams at PCIe GENx speeds: NRZ, PAM3, PAM4, PAMx.
  • High Frequency pcb low loss board material experience.
  • Experience with flex circuit design for high speed signaling.
  • Familiarity with PCIe operation and DRAM operation for optimizing driver and receiver equalization schemes.
  • Knowledge of IBIS and ability to take common simulation outputs such as S-parameters from various components and determine at the system level that PRD requirements are met.
  • Optimizing PDN and extracting PDN for PSIJ Analysis.
  • Familiar with PCISIG, JEDEC and ONFI specifications and compliance.

REGARDING COMPENSATION:

SK hynix memory solutions America Inc. offers you the opportunity to apply your skills to exciting projects while working with innovative teams. Our compensation package is complimented by a generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance and a company 401(k) match, as well as cafeteria, onsite gym and much more. If you are motivated by technical challenges, we offer a collaborative work environment that encourages career growth.

The salary offered to a selected candidate will be tailored based on several factors, including the location, job grade, relevant knowledge, skills, and experience. We also take into account the internal equity among our current team members to ensure fairness and competitiveness

title: Structural Engineering Intern | Summer 2027
description:
DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.

DLR Group’s Omaha studio has an opening for a Structural Engineering Summer Intern.

We have multiple positions and locations available; please refer to all openings posted and apply to the locations that are most suitable for your living situation during the course of your internship. This is not a remote position.

About EPX at DLR Group

As an intern at DLR Group, you’ll be part of our Emerging Professional Experience (EPX) Program, designed to give you a meaningful introduction to life within an integrated design firm and a strong foundation for your career in the AEC industry.

Each person at DLR Group has a design voice, and EPX gives you opportunities to develop and share yours. Through hands-on project work, mentorship, and learning experiences, you’ll gain exposure to the people, disciplines, and ideas that shape the built environment. You may participate in design discussions, project meetings, site visits, business development efforts, office activities, and other experiences that broaden your understanding of the design profession.

The program combines three core components: mentorship, project work, and weekly learning sessions. Topics may include design culture, sustainability, design technology, communication, marketing and business development, project and resource management, research, equity, career development, and more. Along the way, you’ll hear from leaders and integrated designers across DLR Group and build connections with fellow emerging professionals.

Position Summary

As a Structural Engineering Intern at DLR Group, you will be an important part of our integrated design team, contributing to the design of structural systems for buildings of various types, sizes, and complexities. Working alongside structural engineers and professionals across architecture, engineering, interiors, and other disciplines, you will gain hands-on experience with the design process from early concepts and system development through documentation and construction administration.

Our Summer Internship Program is a paid, full-time opportunity running May 18 through August 6, 2027, and interns are expected to participate for the duration of the program. This is an opportunity to apply what you’ve learned in the classroom, build your technical and professional skills, and contribute your perspective to design solutions that support our brand promise of Elevating the Human Experience through design.

What you will do

  • Work with a licensed engineer designing structural systems for new construction and/or building renovation projects
  • Attend design team meetings with a structural engineer and observe the coordination that occurs among the team members of a multi-disciplinary design team
  • Assist a structural engineer with the design and development of construction documents primarily using Revit
  • Visit an active construction site (contingent on the status of local construction projects)
  • Coordinate structural design requirements with architecture and other disciplines

Required Qualifications:

  • Completed at least one year at an ABET-accredited Structural Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Architectural Engineering program
  • Experience or interest in BIM (e.g. Autodesk Revit MEP) workflow

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam
  • Interest in architectural building design
  • A third-year student in an accredited engineering program

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

DLR Group is an integrated design firm delivering architecture, engineering, interiors, planning, and building optimization for new builds, renovations, and adaptive reuse projects.

We are 100% employee-owned: every employee is literally invested in our clients’ success. At the core of our firm are interdisciplinary teams engaged in every step of project lifecycles. Our teams champion true collaboration, open information sharing, shared risk and reward, value-based decision making, and proficient use of technology to deliver exceptional design. We are pursuing the goals of the 2030 Challenge, the ME2040, and the SE2050, and are an initial signatory of the China Accord and the AIA 2030 Commitment.

Through our values – commitment, creativity, environmental stewardship, fun, integrity, ownership, sharing, teamwork – we elevate the human experience through design, together.

title: Maintenance Apprentice
description:
Overview

Avanath is proud to be named one of the top community management companies that provide affordable housing for the workforce.

Cultivating the American Dream is the team's purpose. At Avanath, every day is an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life. Whether helping residents call one of our communities’ homes, providing excellence in customer service, or championing our workforce, we are committed to creating an unforgettable experience as a great place to live, work, and be.

The Role: The Maintenance Apprentice is an essential member of the maintenance team, directly reporting to the Community Manager. This role demands a high level of professionalism, effective communication, and positive interactions with both residents and staff. A proactive approach is critical to preserving the community's appearance and ensuring its smooth operation. The successful candidate will be entrusted with various responsibilities, including performing minor repairs, managing time efficiently, and prioritizing tasks to maintain the communities to the highest standards for the benefit of residents.

The incumbent in this role must demonstrate professionalism and positive engagement with our residents and the workforce.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of grounds or porter experience.
  • Knowledge of and ability to safely operate communities' maintenance equipment (e.g., pressure washer, leaf blower, snowblower).
  • Ability to perform minor maintenance and repairs as needed.
  • Detail-oriented and thorough.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills to handle multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Thorough understanding of safety hazards and proper use of various cleaning and sanitizing solutions.
  • Good interpersonal skills with polite demeanor toward staff, prospects, residents, vendors, and all visitors of the communities.
  • Must have basic knowledge of Fair Housing Laws and OSHA requirements.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent

Key Accountabilities

+ Customer Service and Maintenance

    • Provides exceptional customer service with every interaction and delivers high-quality maintenance service.
    • Complete assigned work orders generated from resident requests for service, as well as preventative maintenance on the communities by diagnosing the source or cause of the defect or problem and making repairs in accordance with established policies, procedures, safety standards, and code requirements.
    • Completes the “make-ready” process to prepare vacant apartment homes for leasing and new move-ins by completing the pre-move-out inspection, creating a “punch” list of maintenance work needed, scheduling vendors and contractors as needed, obtaining needed supplies and materials, completing all maintenance tasks, and inspecting completed work.
    • Assists in maintaining the grounds, common areas, and amenities by picking up trash and debris, pressure-washing breezeways and pool areas, performing general cleaning, and painting curbs and signage as needed.
    • Supports cost-cutting and expense control programs by fixing rather than replacing parts, when possible, not being wasteful with materials and supplies, and practicing the correct use of tools and equipment. Assists in conducting routine and periodic communities' inspections to identify safety and risk management concerns, keep the communities in good repair, and communicate concerns about the physical needs of the communities to management.
    • Follows procedures for accessing and obtaining materials, supplies, equipment, tools, and other items from the communities’ maintenance department by tracking inventory used, returning unused items to the established location, and notifying the maintenance supervisor about re-ordering needs.

+ Adherence to communities Management Rules, Regulations, and Guidelines

    • Practices proper safety techniques in accordance with Company, communities, and departmental policies, procedures, and standards by immediately reporting any mechanical or electrical equipment malfunctions, employee/visitor/resident injuries or accidents, or other safety issues to the appropriate individual(s).
    • Complies with Avanath’s safety and risk-management policies by attending and participating in the communities’ routine safety meetings, completing required training on OSHA and other safety-related laws and requirements, and reporting accidents and incidents promptly and accurately.
    • Follows established policies and procedures by monitoring and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, organizational standards, and operational processes related to area(s) of responsibility and reporting violations or infractions to appropriate individual(s).
    • Conduct all business in accordance with company policies and procedures, Fair Housing, Americans with Disabilities Act, and all other laws about the apartment industry.

+ Physical Demands & Working Conditions

    • The incumbent in this position is classified as essential staff and is expected to report to work and adhere to all safety and business protocols.
    • May be required to report to work during inclement weather conditions.
    • Frequent standing and walking.
    • Reading, comprehending, writing, performing calculations, and communicating verbally.
    • May work in an elevated site, may walk on uneven ground.
    • Occasional squatting, bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, pushing, and pulling.
    • Maybe required to travel to sister communities to provide maintenance support.

We know that our teams are at the heart of our success and growth, and we are committed to showing our appreciation.

We offer:

  • Growth that is based on achievement and an emphasis on promoting from within our ranks versus just external candidates.
  • Development – a commitment to creating opportunities to learn and expand your knowledge in the industry, from online training platforms to training classes to one-on-one coaching.

Diversity & Inclusion

Our human capital is the most valuable asset we have, and Diversity, equity, and inclusion (“DEI”) are at the very core of Avanath’s operating and investment philosophy. We believe that bringing together people with diverse thoughts, backgrounds, talents, and experiences at all levels of our organization, including the executive team, enables us to proactively and creatively achieve our mission to enable opportunities for hard-working American families. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, inventiveness, innovation, self-expression, unique capabilities, and talent that our employees bring to their work is a significant part of our culture, our reputation, and our achievements. Our organization’s diversity initiatives include—but are not limited to—our practices and policies on recruitment and selection, compensation and benefits, professional development and training, promotions, transfers, and the ongoing development of a work environment built on the premise of gender and diversity equity that encourages and enforces:
