Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Contexto y justificación

La Organización Internacional para las Migraciones (OIM), Misión en el Perú, acompaña al Estado peruano, en sus iniciativas para promover una migración segura, ordenada y regular con protección de las personas más vulnerables. El Perú cuenta con una Política Nacional Migratoria 2017-2025 que ha considerado principios, objetivos y lineamientos del Marco de Gobernanza sobre Migración, aprobado por los Estados miembros de la OIM en 2015. De esta manera, reconoce la normativa internacional de los derechos humanos y coloca en el centro de la atención el bienestar y la inclusión social de las personas migrantes.

La región Tumbes constituye un espacio estratégico para la movilidad humana en el norte del Perú debido a su ubicación fronteriza con la República del Ecuador y a la dinámica permanente de ingreso, tránsito, permanencia y salida de población nacional y migrante. Esta condición fronteriza genera importantes oportunidades de integración y cooperación, pero también expone a determinadas poblaciones a situaciones de vulnerabilidad frente a la explotación, la trata de personas y la violencia basada en género (VBG).

En este contexto, las mujeres, niñas, niños y adolescentes, así como las personas que realizan desplazamientos individuales o en condiciones de especial vulnerabilidad, pueden enfrentar mayores riesgos de explotación, violencia física y psicológica, así como otras formas de abuso.

La trata de personas constituye una de las principales amenazas de protección asociadas a los contextos de movilidad humana. En este sentido, la trata de personas y la violencia basada en género no deben ser entendidas como fenómenos aislados. Las barreras de acceso a los servicios de protección pueden incrementar la exposición de las mujeres y otras personas en situación de vulnerabilidad a diferentes formas de violencia y explotación.

La OIM ha trabajado de manera sostenida en la prevención y respuesta frente a la trata de personas en contextos de movilidad humana en Tumbes, incluyendo el fortalecimiento de capacidades de actores estatales y de la sociedad civil, la identificación de factores de riesgo, la orientación a población migrante y la promoción de mecanismos de derivación y atención integral.

En este marco se plantea la intervención a traves de la Sub-Oficina de OIM en Tumbes, buscará contribuir al fortalecimiento de una respuesta institucional articulada frente a la trata de personas y la violencia basada en género en Tumbes, con especial atención a las personas en movilidad humana y a aquellas que enfrentan mayores factores de vulnerabilidad.

La consultoría se desarrollará bajo un enfoque de derechos humanos, interseccionalidad, interculturalidad, protección y acción sin daño, promoviendo la coordinación entre instituciones públicas, organizaciones de la sociedad civil y actores humanitarios. Asimismo, procurará fortalecer la respuesta frente a casos de protección y los mecanismos existentes, evitando la duplicación de esfuerzos y contribuyendo a la sostenibilidad de las acciones más allá del periodo de implementación del proyecto.


Proyecto de la OIM o departamento de la OIM al que el consultor presta servicios

Bajo la cooperación de la Sub - Oficina en Tumbes, la/el consultor contribuirá a los objetivos del proyecto “Women's Economic and Social Empowerment Program in Tumbes, Peru.” En alianza con ONUSIDA con el apoyo económico del Global Affairs Canada. Enfocado en la atención de protección, prevención de la violencia basada en género y la trata de personas con instituciones del Estado y organizaciones de base comunitaria.

El honorario por todo concepto (honorarios, transporte, visibilidad e impuestos u otros) que la OIM abono a la consultora por las actividades a estipular en el contrato por S/ 39,000 por periodo de 6 meses con un monto mensual de S/ 6500

Cabe precisar que esta propuesta se encuentra alineada al rango de honorarios para consultorías locales bajo el Nivel 2-1 de categoría, conforme a la escala armonizada compartida con la Misión para asegurar la competitividad institucional.

Objetivos

Brindar asistencia técnica y apoyo especializado a la OIM para fortalecer las acciones de protección, prevención y respuesta frente a la trata de personas y la violencia basada en género de las organizaciones de base comunitaria en la región Tumbes, con especial énfasis en personas migrantes y otras poblaciones en situación de vulnerabilidad, contribuyendo al fortalecimiento de las capacidades de los actores del sistema de protección, la articulación interinstitucional y los mecanismos de identificación, derivación y atención integral, bajo un enfoque de derechos humanos, género, interseccionalidad, movilidad humana y acción sin daño.

Consultores de categoría “A” Tareas por desempeñar en el marco del presente contrato:

  • Diseñar e implementar un programa de capacitación y fortalecimiento institucional dirigido a 20 organizaciones comunitarias de base (OBC) de Tumbes, orientado al desarrollo de capacidades en derechos humanos, prevención y respuesta frente a la trata de personas, violencia basada en género y gestión integral de crisis, mediante metodologías participativas y herramientas prácticas.

  • Brindar acompañamiento técnico para la elaboración e implementación de planes de gestión de crisis, incluyendo identificación y análisis de riesgos, mapeo de actores y servicios, protocolos de actuación, mecanismos de comunicación, sistemas de referencia y contrarreferencia, protección de datos, seguridad del personal y estrategias de continuidad operativa.

  • Fortalecer la articulación comunitaria e institucional para la protección de personas migrantes y comunidades de acogida, promoviendo la participación inclusiva de grupos en situación de vulnerabilidad y el acceso oportuno a rutas de atención, protección, justicia y servicios especializados frente a vulneraciones de derechos, trata de personas y violencia basada en género incluyendo el Ministerio Publico.

  • Brindar orientación sobre acceso a derechos de la población migrante, población en situación de vulnerabilidad con especial énfasis en población LGTBQ+, población en riesgo de ser víctima de violencia basada en género, trata de personas y tráfico ilícito de migrantes en espacios de atención de la OIM.

  • Brindar apoyo en la planificación, desarrollo de otras actividades comunitarias relacionadas el proyecto, asegurando la adecuada implementación.

  • Elaborar informes y reportes de indicadores vinculados a las actividades del proyecto, asegurando el registro y la presentación oportuna de avances y resultados.

  • Realizar otras tareas asignadas por la coordinación.

Indicadores de desempeño para la evaluación de los resultados

  • Entrega de los reportes: Se espera del consultor o consultora puntualidad en la entrega de los reportes mensuales. No se aceptarán productos fuera del plazo establecido, si esto no ha sido previamente justificado, coordinado y aprobado por la OIM Perú.

  • Calidad de los productos y/o documentos: Todos los productos y/o documentos elaborados por el/la consultor/a deberán cumplir con criterios de calidad, respetando la normativa nacional y de propiedad intelectual. Asimismo, el formato para la entrega de documentos deberá ser fuente Arial, tamaño 10 a espacio y medio.
  • Enfoque inclusivo: Todos los productos entregados por el/la consultor/a deberán contemplar inclusión de la población con discapacidad, indígenas, refugiada y migrante, afectada por trata de personas y/o delitos afines. En la misma línea, se deberá incluir enfoques de género, interculturalidad, territorialidad y derechos humanos.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Licenciatura o grado de Bachiller en ciencias políticas, relaciones internacionales, derecho, trabajo social, sociología y carreras a fines de las ciencias sociales. Deseable contar con cursos de especialización relacionados con protección comunitaria y capacitaciones a OBS.
  • Experiencia general mínima de dos (2) años en el sector público o privado en el ámbito de trabajo comunitario.
  • Experiencia específica de un (2) año en temas de acceso a derechos, violencia basada en género, trata de personas y tráfico ilícito de migrantes.
  • Experiencia comprobada trabajando con población refugiada y/o migrante en el Perú.
  • Deseable experiencia previa en ONG y/o en el Sistema de Naciones Unidas.
  • Manejo de herramientas de Microsoft Office y ofimática a nivel intermedio.
  • Alta motivación por contribuir a la paz, el desarrollo y el servicio a las comunidades.
  • Se valorara conocimiento en monitoreo y evaluación.
  • Excelentes habilidades interpersonales, comunicación efectiva y capacidad para generar redes de trabajo.
  • Voluntad para contribuir y trabajar de manera colaborativa dentro de un equipo multidisciplinario.

Cronograma de pago consultoría tipo A.

La OIM abonará al consultor(a) un honorario total de S/ 39,000 (treinta y seis mil soles), por todo concepto, por las actividades estipuladas en los Términos de Referencia. El pago se efectuará en cuotas mensuales de S/ 6,500.

Cualquier información, incluida aquélla de carácter personal, que esté en posesión o conocimiento del Proveedor de servicios con relación al Contrato o a la prestación de Servicios, deberá ser tratada con estricta confidencialidad. El Proveedor de servicios no comunicará dicha información a terceros sin la previa autorización escrita de la OIM. El Proveedor de servicios se atendrá a los Principios de Protección de Datos de la OIM (https://publications.iom.int/books/iom-data-protection- manual) en caso de que reúna, reciba, utilice, transfiera o almacene cualquier dato personal en el cumplimiento del presente servicio. Esta obligación subsistirá tras la expiración o rescisión del servicio.

Sin perjuicio del párrafo precedente, la OIM podrá revelar información relacionada con el Contrato, como el nombre del Proveedor de Servicios, y el valor del Contrato, el título del contrato/proyecto, la naturaleza y el propósito del contrato/proyecto, el nombre y la localidad/domicilio del Proveedor de Servicios y el monto del contrato/proyecto, en toda la medida que sea requerida por los donantes de la OIM o en relación con cualquier obligación que tenga la OIM bajo el contexto de cualquier iniciativa, en favor de la transparencia y la responsabilidad para con los fondos recibidos por la OIM, de conformidad con las políticas, instrucciones y regulaciones de la OIM.

title: Civil Engineering Intern - Canberra
description:
About the Host & Role Overview

Our host companies operate across various areas of civil engineering, construction, infrastructure, and related sectors. This internship provides an opportunity to gain practical industry exposure, apply academic knowledge to real-world projects, and develop technical and professional skills while working alongside experienced industry professionals.

Key Learning Responsibilities:

  • Assist engineers with the planning, design, documentation, and delivery of civil engineering projects.

  • Assist in preparing technical reports, proposals, presentations, and project documentation.
  • Collaborate with engineers, project managers, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders while participating in team meetings and project discussion.

Benefits of our Voluntary Professional Career Internship Program

  • Hands-on industry exposure to bridge the gap between education and employment with flexibility on a part-time basis.

title: Restaurantchef til Mauritz Svendborg
description:
Vi søger en ansvarsfuld Restaurantchef

Som Restaurantchef hos Mauritz er det dig der sammen med Restaurantchefen har ansvaret for driften af Cafeen.

Vi tilbyder alt fra brunch, frokost, burgere til lækre steaks.

Velkommen til Mauritz

Cafe Mauritz er en hyggelig og trendy Cafe-kæde. Kæden består i dag af 6 cafeer: Skibhusvej (Odense), Svendborg, Middelfart, Fredericia, Sønderborg og Silkeborg. Vi elsker at servere kvalitetsmad af lækre råvarer. Vi har alt fra burgere,

steaks og lette caféretter. Vil du med på holdet?

Brænder du for at give gæsterne en uforglemmelig oplevelse, og har du et naturligt flair for service? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye tjener!

Vi bliver glade hvis du:
  • Er positiv og har et godt overblik
  • Kan arbejde effektivt og selvstændigt
  • Er serviceminded og udadvendt
  • Har minimum 2 års ledererfaring fra lignende job
  • Kan lide at arbejde
  • Kan fremvise en straffeattest


På en typisk vagt er det dig, der:


  • Laver vagtplan
  • Sammen med det øvrige personale servicere de mange gæster.
  • Bestiller vare.
  • Leder og fordeler opgaverne i restauranten.
  • Motivere personalet til altid at yde den bedste service.
  • Tager ejerskab på de opgaver der er i forbindelse med cafeens drift.
  • Professionel servering i restauranten, baren og ved arrangementer.
  • Oplæring af nye kollegaer.
  • Sikre en høj standard af hygiejne og præsentation i alle serveringsområder.


Vi tilbyder:


  • 37 timer med god løn
  • En hyggelig arbejdsplads med højt til loftet
  • Arbejdstider som ligger i tidsrummet 08:00-00:00
  • Indflydelse på egne arbejdsdage
  • Hjælpsomme kollegaer
  • En udfordrende hverdag med et fast koncept
  • Attraktiv medarbejderrabat.
Vi søger dig, som
  • Har en høj faglighed og erfaring som tjener.
  • Får energi af at yde en nærværende service med et smil.
  • Har sans for detaljen og sikrer, at gæsterne altid træder ind i en veldækket restaurant.
  • Er en teamplayer, men også kan arbejde selvstændigt og løsningsorienteret.
  • Trives med skiftende arbejdstider – både dag, aften og weekend.
  • Kan begå dig på både dansk og engelsk.


Ansøgning: Vi modtager kun ansøgninger online. Klik på ‘Søg stillingen’, udfyld ansøgningsformularen og vedhæft ansøgning, CV og evt. bilag.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

title: Customer Loyalty Advocate
description:
Do you enjoy helping customers feel heard, supported, and confident in their service? Do you enjoy listening, solving problems, and finding creative ways to keep customers connected?


IdeaTek is looking for a Customer Loyalty Advocate to join our dedicated retention team. In this role, you'll work directly with customers at key moments in their IdeaTek experience — understanding their needs, resolving concerns, and finding solutions that strengthen the relationship.


This is more than a traditional call center role. You'll work across inbound calls, emails, texts, and proactive outreach while managing a retention queue and using customer insights to determine where your efforts can make the biggest impact. You'll also leverage AI-powered tools and customer profiles to proactively identify customers who may be at risk and provide a more personalized, white-glove experience when they need us most.


A Day in the Life

Your day may begin by reviewing your retention queue, responding to customer calls and messages, and identifying accounts that need additional attention. You may then review a customer profile flagged by our AI tools, dig into the account history, and determine what solution could make the biggest difference.


Throughout the day, you'll work through billing questions, service concerns, installation challenges, and other obstacles while balancing customer needs with business goals. Some conversations will be straightforward, while others will require creativity, negotiation, and persistence. You'll know you've done your job well when a customer feels heard, supported, and confident with their IdeaTek services.


What You'll Do

Key responsibilities include:

  • Manage a dedicated retention queue across inbound calls, emails, texts, and customer support tickets.
  • Review customer profiles, account history, and AI-generated insights to identify opportunities to contact customers and develop personalized retention strategies.
  • Listen to customer concerns, overcome objections, and negotiate solutions that address customer needs while supporting IdeaTek's retention goals.
  • Provide a white-glove customer experience by guiding customers through billing, service, installation, and other concerns with care and clear communication.
  • Use basic technical troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve common issues, escalating more complex technical needs to the appropriate team.
  • Maintain accurate customer information, notes, and outcomes within CRM and customer support systems.
  • Monitor retention performance metrics and manage activity to meet individual and team goals.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and share insights that can help improve the customer experience and retention strategies.

What We're Looking For

To be considered for this role, you'll need the following required qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in customer service, call center, retention, or another high-volume customer-facing environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify customer needs and develop thoughtful solutions.
  • Basic technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot common internet or service issues
  • Familiarity with CRM, ticketing, or customer support systems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple customer interactions, priorities, and follow-up activities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to navigate customer objections and negotiate solutions professionally.

What Will Help You Stand Out

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in technical support or help desk environment.
  • Experience in customer retention, save teams, or escalation-focused customer service.
  • Experience working with AI-powered customer service or lead management tools.
  • Telecommunications or broadband industry experience.

Desired Attributes

Beyond the qualifications, these attributes are what make someone a great fit for our team:

  • Customer-Focused – You genuinely care about creating positive experiences and finding ways to help customers succeed.
  • Empathetic – You listen carefully, understand different perspectives, and make customers feel heard.
  • Resourceful – You dig into the details and find creative solutions when the answer isn't obvious.
  • Resilient – You can handle challenging conversations professionally and move forward with the same focus and energy.
  • Persuasive – You can confidently navigate objections and negotiate solutions that create value.
  • Adaptable – You thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities and customer needs can change quickly.
  • Relationship-Driven – You focus on building long-term customer relationships, not just resolving the immediate issue.

Why Join IdeaTek?

IdeaTek is a cutting-edge telecommunications company dedicated to bringing fast, reliable internet to underserved communities. We're a passionate team of innovators and problem-solvers committed to making a difference in the lives of our customers. At IdeaTek, we value our employees and foster a culture of collaboration, growth, and community involvement.


A few of the key ways we strive to make employees feel valued include:

  • Competitive pay + quarterly performance bonuses
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and 401(k) with match
  • Free coaching/counseling for employees & families
  • Free internet service (if available in your area) or internet reimbursement
  • Tuition reimbursement for personal and professional growth
  • Community engagement opportunities
  • Culture that values results, effort, and integrity

Our Core Values

  • We are Trustworthy – We build confidence through transparency, follow-through, and dependability.
  • We count on Big Thinkers – We don't just imagine the future—we create it with bold, actionable ideas.
  • We have a Resilient Spirit – We embrace challenges, bounce back from setbacks, and keep striving for more.
  • We stand on Belief – We believe everyone deserves access to technology that helps them learn, grow, and thrive.
  • We foster Connectedness – Our work goes beyond broadband—we build real connections within our team and our communities.
  • We drive Innovation – We're always looking for ways to improve and redefine what's possible.

Ready to Apply?

If you're someone who loves solving problems, building relationships, and helping customers find a reason to stay, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!


This role is not eligible for Visa sponsorship.

This role is not eligible for relocation.

Salary and benefits commensurate with experience.

Equal Opportunity Employer.

This employer uses E-Verify.

title: Financial Literacy & Wealth Building Instructor
location: ITAV Leadership Academy in Bronzeville - Chicago, IL 60615
description:
About It Takes A Village Family of Schools (ITAV)

It Takes A Village Family of Schools (ITAV) is a beacon for educating and uplifting Black children and families across Chicago. We provide a culturally responsive, social justice–centered education that empowers students to become confident learners, critical thinkers, and changemakers.

At ITAV, learning is joyful and transformative, teaching is innovative, and classrooms extend far beyond four walls. We are committed to nurturing the whole child—academically, socially, and emotionally—while building strong, connected communities.

Position Overview

It Takes A Village Leadership Academy is seeking an experienced educator to co-design and lead a year-long Financial Literacy & Wealth Building program for approximately 80 middle school students in grades 6–8.


The successful candidate will create an engaging, project-based learning experience that helps students develop the knowledge, confidence, and habits needed to make informed financial decisions throughout their lives. Lessons should be interactive, relevant, and connected to authentic, real-world experiences.

This position offers a unique opportunity to launch and shape a signature program that empowers students with financial knowledge while preparing them for future academic, career, and entrepreneurial success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Teach four middle school classes one day each week throughout the school year.
  • Design and implement a year-long financial literacy curriculum aligned with the developmental needs of middle school students.
  • Create engaging, project-based learning experiences that encourage critical thinking, collaboration, and problem-solving.
  • Teach concepts including budgeting, saving, banking, credit, investing, entrepreneurship, wealth building, and responsible financial decision-making.
  • Develop authentic student projects, simulations, case studies, presentations, and collaborative learning experiences.
  • Assess student learning through performance tasks, presentations, portfolios, and other meaningful measures of student growth.
  • Coordinate a culminating showcase where students present business ideas, financial plans, investment strategies, or other capstone projects demonstrating their learning.
  • Foster a positive, engaging classroom culture that encourages curiosity, creativity, and student voice.
  • Collaborate with school leadership to continuously strengthen and improve the program.

Why Join ITAV?

Make an Impact: Play a pivotal role in shaping students’ academic and leadership development

Grow Your Career: Access ongoing professional development, leadership pathways, and tuition assistance

Be in Community: Join a team of passionate educators committed to excellence, equity, and innovation

Innovate in Education: Contribute to a model that integrates social justice, community engagement, and academic excellence

Community & Industry Partnerships

Students will have opportunities throughout the year to learn from professionals working in banking, finance, and investment management through partnerships with organizations including DPIMC and JPMorgan Chase.


The instructor will work collaboratively with ITAV leadership and community partners to coordinate guest speakers, classroom visits, career exploration experiences, mentorship opportunities, and other authentic learning experiences that enhance classroom instruction.

Position Details

  • Location: Bronzeville Campus (Chicago, IL)
  • Employment Type: Independent Contractor (Part-Time)
  • Term: 2026–2027 School Year (Approximately 40 Weeks)
  • Schedule: One day per week (four instructional periods)
  • Compensation: $10,000–$12,000, commensurate with experience

title: Data & Insights
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data & Insights based in Germany.

This is a highly autonomous data role at the intersection of product, business, engineering, and analytics.
You will turn complex and sometimes ambiguous questions into actionable insights that improve product and company performance.
Your work will directly influence product priorities, experiments, growth initiatives, metrics, and data-driven decision-making.
You will contribute both to hands-on analysis and to the evolution of data foundations, models, pipelines, instrumentation, and tooling.
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, and leadership while helping teams become more effective and self-sufficient with data.
The role also offers the opportunity to shape how AI and internal data tools are used across the organization.
With broad ownership and freedom to build, buy, or simplify solutions, you will have substantial influence over both the data strategy and how data creates measurable impact.

Accountabilities

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to identify opportunities, define meaningful metrics, run experiments, and influence roadmap decisions.

  • Translate ambiguous or complex business and product questions into rigorous analysis, actionable insights, and measurable improvements.

  • Collaborate with the Head of Data on data architecture, foundations, tooling, and the long-term evolution of the data environment.

  • Develop and improve data models, pipelines, instrumentation, and analytics workflows as business and product requirements evolve.

  • Evaluate when to build internal solutions, purchase existing tools, or adopt lightweight approaches to solve data challenges efficiently.

  • Help advance the internal data agent, making it more useful, accessible, and valuable to teams across the organization.

  • Enable teams across the business to become more autonomous and effective in accessing, understanding, and applying data.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the reliability, accessibility, and usability of data and analytics.

  • Balance technical depth with practical business judgment, prioritizing solutions based on their expected impact.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of data practices, processes, and tooling within a modern, evolving data environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong experience in data analytics, insights, data engineering, product analytics, or a closely related discipline.

    • Strong SQL skills and solid knowledge of data modeling, analytics, and modern data tooling.

    • Ability to work comfortably across both analytical problems and data foundations, including models, pipelines, instrumentation, and practical internal tools.

    • Product-oriented mindset with genuine curiosity about user behavior, product performance, and how data can improve decision-making.

    • Strong ownership and judgment, with the ability to take an ambiguous problem, determine the right approach, and move it toward a practical solution.

    • Ability to assess when to move quickly, investigate deeply, build, buy, or keep a solution intentionally simple.

    • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to turn raw or messy data into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, and senior leadership.

    • Confidence challenging assumptions constructively and communicating complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • Strong bias toward measurable impact, with a focus on what changes as a result of your work rather than simply what gets delivered.

    • Experience with modern data technologies is valuable, particularly GCP, BigQuery, Composer, dbt, Tableau, Count, Amplitude, Segment, or similar tools.

    • Familiarity with AI-powered data tools, internal data agents, or data applications is a plus.

    • Willingness and ability to learn new technologies and continuously evolve your technical toolkit.

      • Benefits

      • Highly autonomous role with significant freedom to identify opportunities and shape solutions.

      • Broad scope spanning product analytics, business insights, data foundations, experimentation, and AI-enabled data tools.

      • Direct influence on product strategy, company metrics, roadmap decisions, and growth initiatives.

      • Opportunity to shape data architecture, tooling, processes, and the way teams across the organization use data.

      • Remote-first working environment across Europe, with flexibility around location.

      • Opportunity to work with a modern data stack including GCP, BigQuery, dbt, Replit, Tableau, Count, Amplitude, and Segment.

      • Collaborative environment spanning Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, Data, and leadership.

      • Opportunity to work at a profitable, growing technology company serving thousands of teams and millions of users.

      • Significant opportunity for professional growth through ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives.

      • A culture centered on autonomy, experimentation, practical problem-solving, and measurable impact.

title: Health Coordinator FT/NOC
description:
If you are looking for employment with a purpose where you can help improve the daily lives of the members of your community, then consider a career with Pioneer Human Services!

We are currently looking for a Health Coordinator (FT-Nights) with a passion for human services. This is an exciting opportunity to be involved with an organization focused on racial justice, second opportunities, diversity, equity and inclusion.

WHO WE ARE

We empower justice-involved individuals to overcome adversity and reach their full potential.

For over 60 years, we have proudly serviced our clients with professionalism and empathy. We are a nationally recognized non-profit with 35+ locations across Washington state that provided a chance for change to over 9,500 individuals in 2024.

WHAT WE OFFER

At Pioneer, our employees are important. That’s why we offer a Total Rewards package that includes compensation and benefits to support employees' health, security, and balance.

Compensation:

New hires start between $20.77 and $23.35 based on experience, qualifications, skills, competencies, internal equity, and market factors. While the full pay range is listed for this position for pay transparency, individual compensation is determined by various factors and may vary within the posted range.

Benefits That Invest in You

At Pioneer, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and continued growth.

Health & Wellness Benefits

  • Medical coverage
  • Dental coverage
  • Vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account

Financial Protection

  • Employer-provided life insurance
  • Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) insurance
  • Disability coverage

Invest in Your Future

  • Front-Loaded Tuition Assistance
  • Retirement Plan
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Public transportation discounts
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Join Pioneer and build more than a career. Be part of a team that supports your well-being, recognizes your contributions, and invests in your future.

Benefit eligibility, coverage, contributions, and program provisions are subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans and policies.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The Health Coordinator supports Pioneer Human Services’ mission by coordinating and monitoring client physical and behavioral health services within residential treatment facilities. This role assists in ensuring continuity of care by facilitating communication between clients, nursing staff (where present), medical and behavioral health providers, pharmacy services, and program staff.

The Health Coordinator supports the intake process, coordinates internal and external medical and behavioral health appointments (including telehealth), assists with medication monitoring and documentation accuracy in the electronic medication administration record (eMAR/MAR), and gathers and communicates relevant health information to appropriate clinical staff. At sites with licensed nurses, the Health Coordinator works under the direction of nursing staff to support care coordination and implementation of provider orders. At sites without nurses, the Health Coordinator works under the direction of Health & Resource Coordination (HRCU) Manager.

In addition to care coordination, the Health Coordinator provides direct client support within a structured residential environment, including; engaging clients in the milieu, observing and monitoring client changes in physical and in behavioral health status, reinforcing treatment plans and health education, assisting with access to healthcare services, and responding to urgent health concerns by notifying appropriate clinical staff or emergency services as needed.

This role requires strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to effectively support clients with complex medical, behavioral health, and substance use needs in a structured residential environment.

PRIMARY/ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Client Service:

  • Utilize program-approved screening tools and established procedures to identify and document client risks, needs, and barriers while supporting client and facility safety.
  • Utilize Motivational Interviewing (MI) and other engagement strategies to support client participation and skill development.
  • Interpret and explain program policies and goals to clients during orientation and throughout treatment as needed.
  • Support client education by conducting health education activities and reinforcing self-care skills appropriate to the client’s stage of recovery.
  • Where applicable by site or unit, observe and document client self-administration of medications in accordance with program policies and procedures.
  • Where medication responsibilities are assigned to nursing staff, promptly communicate medication-related concerns, discrepancies, or client requests to the licensed nurse.
  • When applicable to the role at a specific site, review MAR documentation for completeness at shift change and escalate discrepancies according to policy.
  • Maintain a safe and healthy environment which includes maintaining, cleaning, and disposing of equipment and supplies according to policy and procedures (e.g., cleaning medication rooms, disinfecting vital signs equipment, maintaining health services spaces).
  • Where applicable, assist with medication storage, ordering, and returns in accordance with pharmacy services policies and site procedures.
  • Assist clients in meeting health and safety needs in accordance with each individual’s stage of recovery and program policies.
  • Provide basic first aid and serve as the first point of contact for emergency response when needed, notifying licensed nursing staff, providers, or emergency services as appropriate.
  • Follow provider orders and support implementation of care plans in accordance with program policy and the scope of the Health Coordinator role.
  • Gather and relay client-reported health information, including health and medication history, vital signs, symptoms, diagnoses, and other relevant concerns to nursing staff or providers as appropriate.
  • At sites with licensed nurses, assist Registered Nurses (RN) or Licensed Practical Nurses (LPN) with intake processes or coordination activities as directed.

Coordination of Services:

  • Support coordination of client physical and behavioral healthcare services during assigned shifts, including telehealth visits, clinic appointments, and outside provider services.
  • Coordinate and document client intake and discharge processes after hours, including financial documentation and secured belongings as required.
  • Coordinate internal and external services and referrals based on provider recommendations or treatment planning needs.
  • Support service navigation by assisting clients in accessing health services and communicating needs to clinical staff.

File and Document Management:

  • Maintain accurate, timely, and complete documentation of services in the electronic health record.
  • Ensure required notifications are completed during assigned shifts.
  • Complete eligibility assessments and follow-up assessments in designated systems.
  • Ensure client information is accurate and updated from intake through discharge to support continuity of care.
  • Record routine case notes and service contacts documenting client progress and services provided.
  • Review reports with the care team to identify service gaps and coordinate appropriate follow-up support.

Specific responsibilities related to medication handling and clinical coordination may vary by site or unit depending on staffing structure, program licensure, and the presence of licensed nursing staff.

QUALIFICATIONS:
REQUIRED

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • One (1) year of experience working in a caregiving, human services, behavioral health, or social services setting, or experience supporting marginalized or vulnerable populations
  • Must apply for Agency Affiliated Counselor registration within 30 days of hire and obtain and maintain active registration within 90 days of hire in accordance with WAC 246-810-015; RCW 18.19.210
  • First Aid/CPR certification within 90 days of hire
  • Proficient level of written/verbal communication, and efficiency with independent task management and ability to show attention to detail.
  • Basic computer skills and the ability to learn
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain a professional, empathetic, and client-centered approach when working with individuals in recovery

PREFERRED/DESIRABLE

  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR) or electronic records management systems.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, and Internet navigation.
  • Certified Nursing Assistant certification

EEO

Pioneer human services is an equal opportunity employer of minorities/women/individuals with disabilities/protected veterans and does not unlawfully discriminate under federal, state, or local laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. EEOC is the Law/EEO Policy Statement

PIONEER HUMAN SERVICES IS A DRUG FREE COMPANY

Pioneer Human Services is a drug free company. This position has been deemed safety sensitive under RCW 49.44.240(3) and is subject to both pre-employment drug testing and drug testing during employment, to include testing for marijuana.

title: Franchise Business Consultant – Mountain Region
description:
WHO WE ARE

We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry.

Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together.

WHAT WE’LL NEED

We are seeking a Franchise Business Consultant (FBC) that will influence and directly impact 90-125 franchised domestic Wingstop restaurants to drive results and deliver on business objectives in the Colorado and Utah area.

In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for your portfolio, with clear accountability for operational excellence, P&L results, and long-term franchise success. You will be responsible for building strong relationships with your franchisees, and driving KPIs including same store sales, guest experience metrics, and operational metrics including speed of service.

Key responsibilities:

  • Operate like the CEO of your portfolio, owning its business performance, health and P&L – driving accountability for both revenue growth and profitability.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between Wingstop Restaurants Inc. and Brand Partners, ensuring effective and timely two-way communication.

  • Travel regularly to Brand Partner restaurants to ensure operational excellence, provide coaching, and protect the brand across operations, facilities, marketing, training, purchasing, and development.

  • Analyze business performance using data and dashboards; partner with Brand Partners to identify opportunities and build strategic plans that drive sustained growth and profitability.

  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews with Brand Partners to align on goals, ensure accountability, and track progress towards results.

  • Anticipate challenges and exercise sound judgment to recommend solutions, make timely decisions, and influence outcomes that strengthen restaurant operations and overall business results.

  • Ensure adherence to brand standards and franchise agreements across your region.

  • Champion best practices and share learnings across the region to elevate performance.

  • Act as a Wingstop culture champion and brand ambassador.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Strong business acumen with proven ability to drive financial and operational performance.

  • Frequent use of a computer and other technology essential to everyday role responsibilities.

  • High stamina to travel up to 75%, work extended hours as needed, including nights, weekends and holidays.

  • Ability to manage travel effectively, ensuring adherence to Wingstop travel policies.

WHO YOU ARE

No job is too small. You recognize that the real work happens in the restaurants, and everything we do should support their success. You stay humble, roll up your sleeves, and always look for ways to help. You learn from others and contribute wherever you can.

You care deeply about doing great work and driving results. You’re curious, ask questions, and seek out opportunities to improve. You don’t just point out problems—you bring solutions, ideas, and perspectives that move the team forward.

You take full responsibility for your work and see things through to completion. You aren’t afraid to fail because you know that failure is a part of learning and growth. You take action, move fast, and keep pushing forward.

You lead with empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence. You collaborate effectively, fostering a culture of trust and constructive feedback. You understand the importance of teamwork and ensure that your actions build others up rather than break them down.

You push yourself and others to be better. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement.

BENEFITS

FLAVOR PERKS:

FUN IS THE BEST FLAVOR:

title: Mental Health Professional
description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Mental Health Professional (MHP) provides comprehensive assessment and diagnosis, treatment planning and direct clinical services. These services may occur in the community, school, home or at an ACCESS Group, Inc. site. The MHP provides direct supervision and manages scheduling and daily operations for the qualified behavioral health provider.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & BASIC DUTIES

  1. Completes an Intake and Assessment for each potential client being assessed for counseling/psychotherapy.
  2. Develops an individualized psychotherapy treatment plan for medically necessary services. This treatment plan will be based on the results of the diagnostic assessment, clinical observations of the client and/or family, and input of the Medical Director and Clinical Director.
  3. Reviews and updates psychotherapy treatment plan in the format and time frames outlined in the ACCESS Clinical Documentation policy and procedure.
  4. Conducts counseling/psychotherapy services with identified clients as indicated and/or prescribed. These services may include but are not limited to individual therapy, family therapy, group therapy, psychoeducation, collateral intervention, crisis intervention, and crisis stabilization. Explanations for missed sessions are documented.
  5. Makes every effort to work with the family/caregiver in scheduling family therapy sessions as indicated and works with the family/caregiver to overcome obstacles to their participation in treatment when possible.
  6. Accurately documents interventions and services provided in detail (both billable and nonbillable) in the format and time frames outlined in the ACCESS Clinical Documentation policy and procedure
  7. Completes other required documentation using either deTaso or paper documentation, as appropriate.
  8. Completes a written discharge summary when a client is discharged from counseling/psychotherapy.
  9. Attends and actively participates in job-related functions such as department and team meetings, parent conferences, peer reviews, workshops, and mandatory trainings.
  10. Works with Admissions Coordinators to manage and schedule weekly appointments to ensure that annual productivity requirement is met.
  11. Refers clients for additional evaluations and services, as appropriate.
  12. Supervises mental health professionals whose current license requires professional supervision (if applicable).
  13. Provides direct supervision to the qualified behavioral health providers including conducting weekly face-to-face supervision and monthly observations of service delivery. This supervision will be documented utilizing the QBHP supervision form and log.
  14. Participates in supervision each quarter as required. This supervision will be documented utilizing the MHP supervision form and log.
  15. Represents the program in a positive way to parents, visitors, and the public.
  16. Participates in relevant and approved continuing education each year as required to maintain professional licensure and to stay current with state and national trends in student achievement and behavioral health/psychological assessment, diagnosis, and treatment.
  17. Maintains familiarity with health and safety guidelines, including standard precautions and daily operating procedures.
  18. Ensures a positive and supportive relationship with clients and families.
  19. May perform other related or non-related duties, as assigned.


COMPETENCIES

Ethics:

  • Treats people with respect.
  • Keeps commitments.
  • Inspires the trust of others.
  • Completes work ethically and with integrity.
  • Upholds organizational values.

Judgment:

  • Displays willingness to make decisions.
  • Exhibits sound and accurate judgment.
  • Supports and explains reasoning for decisions.
  • Includes appropriate people in decision-making process.
  • Makes timely decisions.
  • Demonstrates safety awareness.

Client Focus:

  • Demonstrates a commitment to clinical excellence.
  • Manages difficult or emotional client situations.
  • Responds promptly to client needs.
  • Solicits client feedback to improve client care.
  • Responds to requests for service and assistance.

Planning/Organizing:

  • Prioritizes and plans work activities.
  • Uses time efficiently and effectively.
  • Plans for additional resources.
  • Develops realistic action plans.
  • Maintains a neat and organized workspace.

Problem Solving:

  • Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner.
  • Gathers and analyzes information skillfully.
  • Develops alternative solutions.
  • Works well in group problem-solving situations.
  • Uses reason, even when dealing with emotional topics.

Professionalism:

  • Communicates with others in a tactful and professional manner.
  • Participates appropriately as a member of a team.
  • Responds well under pressure.
  • Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position.
  • Accepts responsibility for own actions.
  • Follows instructions and responds to supervisory direction and feedback appropriately.
  • Completes tasks within established deadlines.

Quality:

  • Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.
  • Looks for ways to improve and promote quality.
  • Applies feedback to improve performance.
  • Monitors own work to ensure quality.

Written Communication:

  • Writes professionally, informatively, and in accordance with payor source guidelines.
  • Edits work for spelling and grammar.
  • Varies writing style to meet needs.
  • Presents numerical data effectively.
  • Able to read and interpret written information.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

title: Evergreen Women in Leadership Summit (MBA Application)

You’ll participate in workshops designed specifically for MBA students -- offering actionable strategies, leadership frameworks, and career insights to help you navigate your professional journey. title: Senior/Staff Systems Engineer
description:
About SirenOpt

SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks.

SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made.

We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia.

About the job

Job Title: Senior/Staff Systems Engineer

Location: On-Site (San Leandro, CA)

Job Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We are seeking a Staff Systems Engineer to define, integrate, and validate SirenOpt's plasma-based sensing platform for deployment into advanced manufacturing environments. As an early-stage member of the SirenOpt team, you will play a key role in shaping system-level behavior and ensuring technical coherence across hardware, software, and experimental domains, helping establish a strong and scalable technical foundation for the company.

This role carries responsibility both for system-level technical ownership and for shaping how technical work is documented across the organization. You will define and evolve the structure used to document experiments, system designs, interfaces, and technical decisions, ensuring clarity, consistency, and traceability as the company grows. These documentation practices are expected to be tightly coupled to hands-on engineering work, including experimentation, data analysis, and system validation.

The ideal candidate applies sound systems engineering judgment to complex, cross-disciplinary problems and is comfortable operating in areas of ambiguity. You will drive system-level trade studies, guide experimental strategy, and resolve non-trivial integration and performance issues, while remaining deeply engaged in day-to-day technical execution. This role offers an opportunity to operate at a high level of technical impact in a collaborative and fast-moving engineering environment.

What You'll Do

  • Define and own system-level architecture, integration, and validation of SirenOpt's plasma-based sensing platform

  • Guide system-level technical decisions through experimentation, data analysis, and cross-disciplinary evaluation

  • Lead investigation and resolution of complex system performance issues through structured experimentation, data analysis, and root cause analysis

  • Establish and evolve the structure used to document experiments, system designs, interfaces, and technical decisions across the organization

  • Ensure technical documentation is clear, consistent, and traceable, and tightly integrated with hands-on engineering and validation activities

  • Work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to guide system integration and resolve non-trivial cross-disciplinary issues

  • Incorporate customer and application feedback into system-level design evolution and validation strategy

  • Support on-site installation, validation, and system upgrade activities at customer sites as needed

  • Domestic and international travel of approximately 10-15% is expected.

What We're Looking For

  • B.S. in Engineering or Physics with 5+ years of relevant industry experience, M.S. with 3+ years, or Ph.D. with 2+ years of hands-on systems experience

  • Experience developing automated metrology, inspection, or diagnostic systems across system definition, integration, validation, deployment, and customer support

  • Experience working in early-stage or ambiguous R&D environments, using experimentation and data analysis to evaluate concepts and guide system-level decisions

  • Proficiency with tools such as Python, MATLAB, C, LabVIEW, or similar for data analysis, modeling, and evaluation of system performance

  • Extensive hands-on experience developing, integrating, and validating prototypes, subsystems, and complete systems

  • Experience working across mechanical, electrical, software, and experimental domains to resolve complex integration and performance issues

  • Demonstrated ability to guide technical direction through experimentation, data-driven analysis, and cross-disciplinary evaluation

  • Experience establishing or evolving technical documentation practices, ensuring clarity, consistency, and traceability of experimental results and system decisions

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in documenting complex technical work clearly for diverse audiences

Nice to have:

  • Experience with manufacturing metrology equipment and sensors used for characterization or fabrication of advanced materials

  • Experience with requirements and test management tools (e.g., Jama or similar) and data analysis software such as JMP

  • Experience with early-stage R&D and/or new product introduction (NPI) in complex technical systems

  • Exposure to high-precision, high-throughput industrial systems for material handling, metrology, or process automation

  • Prior work or research experience in one or more of the key industrial markets that SirenOpt addresses, including batteries, semiconductors, power generation, energy, or electronics

  • Familiarity with high-voltage devices; exposure to plasma-based systems

  • Experience with capital equipment designed for integration into manufacturing environments, particularly roll-to-roll and piece-to-piece processes

Base Pay Range
$150,000—$190,000 USD

Benefits

  • Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience
  • Health, Dental, Vision plans provided
  • 401k matching provided
  • Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

description:
Nearly 37 million Americans are currently affected by Chronic Kidney Disease. 37 million. At Akebia we take that number very seriously and every day we come to work, with the purpose of bettering the lives of each person impacted by kidney disease and the renal community that serves them.
Our tenacious, passionate employees’ challenge the status quo and work to develop unique therapeutics that have the potential to set new standards of care for people living with kidney disease.
This is life-changing work, and we are all in, are you?
Please note that our offices have recently relocated to Waltham. We follow a flexible, “magnet not mandate” approach to in-office work, encouraging collaboration and onsite engagement while supporting hybrid flexibility based on role and business needs.
Job Summary

The RQA Senior Director is a strategic leadership role responsible for management of day-to-day GCP/GLP/GVP Quality Operations including, goal setting, budgeting, hiring, team development, strategic execution and oversight of the Akebia RQA operational strategy. This position will be a member of the Quality Leadership Team and will report to the Vice President (VP)/Sr. Vice President (SVP) of Quality.

This individual will oversee, assess, and directly work to continuously improve Research and Development Quality processes at Akebia. This is an opportunity to continue the development of the GCP/GLP/GVP QA function and ensure high quality execution of non-clinical and clinical trials from first in human through commercial marketing authorization.

This position will also be responsible for interactions with regulatory agencies in regard to GCP, GVP and GLP matters.

Essential Functions and Duties

  • Drive achievement of strategic Quality objectives through leadership & coaching of direct reports and cross-functional influence at the senior level
  • Develop strong relationships, collaborate, and interact with various departments (i.e., Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Statistics & Data Management, Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance, Non-clinical) and levels of management at Akebia to accomplish company objectives.
  • Develop strong relationships and partner with external collaborators to ensure the appropriate processes, systems, and activities are in place to protect the rights, safety, and welfare of study subjects.
  • Ensure GCP/GLP/GVP projects and programs are conducted in accordance with current GCP/GLP/GVP regulations and ICH guidelines.
  • Provide consultation on, and interpretation of, regulations, guidance documents and industry standards.
  • Communicate and escalate critical risks to Senior Leadership: requires diplomatic and objective representation of the issue(s), robust root cause analysis and effective CAPA implementation for nonconformances.
  • Ensure Quality Agreements are established, as necessary, with Akebia’s key GCP/GLP/GVP vendors.
  • Lead inspection readiness preparations (internal and external) including hosting and interacting with regulatory agencies during inspections on GCP/GLP/GVP related matters.
  • Assist in the development and management of the annual budget for Quality Assurance Basic Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline is required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive responsibility in pharmaceutical/biotech GCP, GVP and GLP-related Quality environments.
  • 8+ years direct and indirect management level experience required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An advanced degree in a scientific discipline is strongly preferred.
  • In-depth working knowledge of the applicable GCP/GLP/GVP regulations and guidelines.
  • In-depth working knowledge of the non-clinical and clinical research process.
  • Must be able to efficiently utilize the computer hardware and software programs provided to plan, manage, conduct and track deliverables and to communicate with internal and external team members.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25% to various meetings including overnight trips. Some international travel may be required.

Base Compensation for this role will depend on a number of factors including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Base pay is only one component of the company’s total rewards package, all regular employees are also eligible for the corporate bonus program or the incentive compensation program (if applicable), as well as equity. Additional benefits include health care, vision, dental, retirement, PTO, etc.

Targeted Base Salary
$239,153—$295,424 USD
Are you an Akebian?
An Akebian is curious, empathetic, and values making connections to people and ideas. Akebian’s aren’t afraid of diving in and owning a process or a problem, because we all want to deliver a great solution. Akebian’s believe that we are better together because we are all working toward a common purpose – to better the life of each person impacted by kidney disease. Want to learn more about what it means to be an Akebian? Visit our website: www.akebia.com

title: Security Shift Supervisor - Weekends Only
description:
Security Shift Supervisor - Weekends Only

Wage: $21.56/ hour

Position Details:

  • 1st shift (0800-1600)
  • This is a secure site
  • No cell phone use is allowed
  • Communication is via radios
  • Must have strong leadership skills
  • Must be able to sit, stand, and walk for extended amounts of time
  • Will walk 1/4-mile checkpoint tours, 3 to 4 times per shift
  • Will handle access control of employees and visitors entering and exiting the site
  • Will wand and badge employees and visitors
  • Will monitor CCTV cameras
  • Will serve as the security escalation point if incidents occur on site
  • More than 2 years of security experience required

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Functions as a supervisor of Security Officers, Lead Officers, and other company personnel assigned to one or more posts at client site(s); acts to ensure that all post orders are followed, that established rounds are completed, and that required reports are filed; notifies proper authorities and client in emergency situations.
  • Coaches and disciplines personnel as appropriate; seeks advice from company management or designated representatives as appropriate; meets personally with employees and documents coaching and disciplinary actions.
  • Trains Security Officers and other company personnel; reviews post orders and other details of assignments with subordinates.
  • Assists in the submission of payroll and personnel information to the company as designated.
  • In conjunction with company management or designated representatives ensures adequate coverage of all posts and positions.
  • Prepares, files, and submits various reports as required.
  • Inspects posts as scheduled and meets with subordinates to outline tasks and responsibilities.
  • Meets with client representatives as scheduled or as needed to provide assurance that all security requirements are being met and to provide quality customer service.
  • As assigned, in accordance with applicable company policies and procedures and in compliance with state and federal laws, carries out supervisory duties that can include some or all of the following: interviewing, orienting and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; coaching and appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems; and, making hiring and termination recommendations.
  • May perform the duties of a Security Officer in accord with post orders and company policy.

Education/Experience: High School Diploma or G.E.D. and 2 years of related experience, or an an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job, as determined by the company. Minimum 2 years of experience in retail preferred.

Competencies (as demonstrated through experience, training, and/or testing):

  • May be required to hold and continue to meet the requirements for any applicable state, county and municipal license for Security Officers.
  • Knowledge of security operations with an emphasis on patrol, inspection and response services.
  • Knowledge of supervisory practices and procedures.
  • Ability to provide positive direction and motivate performance.
  • Understanding of a variety of security and safety devices and controls.
  • Ability to learn quickly and carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagrammatic form.
  • Ability to track and maintain schedule assignments.
  • Ability to be an effective team member.
  • Ability to maintain professional composure when dealing with unusual circumstances.
  • Courteous telephone manner.
  • Ability to adapt to various sites and changes in post procedures.
  • Ability to write routine correspondence, including logs and reports.
  • Good organizational skills.
  • Strong customer service and results orientation.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, at various social levels and across diverse cultures.

WORKING CONDITIONS (Physical/Mental Demands)

With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to perform effectively all essential functions. In addition to other demands, the demands of the job include:

  • Maintaining composure in dealing with authorities, executives, clients, staff and the public, occasionally under conditions of urgency and in pressure situations.
  • May be exposed to stressful situations, such as challenging individuals who are in or approaching an unauthorized area.
  • Must undergo and meet company standards for background and reference checks, controlled substance testing, and behavioral selection survey, in addition to any mandatory licensing requirements.
  • Directing and disciplining staff in a positive manner.
  • May be required to work overtime without advance notice.
  • Required ability to handle multiple tasks concurrently.
  • Keyboarding, basic computer usage, and operating controls.
  • Seeing, hearing, speaking and writing clearly in order to communicate with employees and clients, observe and report incidents, and direct others.
  • Frequent sitting, standing, and walking, which may be required for long periods of time, and may involve climbing stairs and walking up inclines and on uneven terrain.
  • Occasional reaching with hands and arms, stooping, kneeling, crouching and crawling.
  • Frequent lifting and/or moving up to 10 pounds and occasionally up to 25 pounds.
  • Close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Regular use of vehicle for the performance of duties.
  • On occasion may be required to perform stressful and physical activity.
  • Depending upon assignment may be exposed to inclement weather or be required to work in environments or under conditions that require the use of protective gear and devices and/or awareness of personal safety and safety of others.
  • May be exposed to or required to handle sensitive and confidential information.

title: Varsity Girls Soccer Assistant Coach (Goalkeeper Specialist)
description:
ABOUT POLY

Founded in 1907, Polytechnic School is the first nonprofit, coeducational, K-12, independent school in Southern California. The meaning of polytechnic as “many arts” is reflected in the school’s ambitious and student-centered educational program. Nationally recognized as a K-12 educational leader, Poly develops the unique intellect, talents, and character of each student through transformative teaching within a diverse community devoted to academic excellence, the creative arts, the camaraderie of team sports, and service to others.

Poly strives to be an inclusive community that fosters academic excellence and personal growth by ensuring that all of our 870 students, nearly 65% of whom identify as Students of Color, are seen, heard, and valued as their authentic selves. We respect the dignity and worth of every individual and seek to celebrate the joy, the love, and the creativity that emanate from the human spirit. Throughout our Lower, Middle, and Upper Schools, students, faculty, and staff commit to deepening our understanding and knowledge of ourselves, each other, and our ever-changing world.

Within our community of care, Poly students build the confidence and capacity to think critically and creatively to become responsible global citizens and intellectual leaders. Taught by an extraordinary faculty, Poly graduates are ready to fulfill the promise of their talents and lead meaningful, purposeful lives.

To learn more about Polytechnic School, please visit us.

The Role

The Varsity Girls Soccer program is seeking an Assistant Coach to develop our goalkeepers. You'll work alongside the head coach to run training sessions, support game-day operations, and build a goalkeeping culture that is technical, confident, and resilient. You'll be the primary point person for our keepers while contributing to the team as a whole.

Responsibilities

  • Design and run goalkeeper-specific training, including shot-stopping, footwork, positioning, distribution, crosses, 1v1s, and communication

  • Coach goalkeepers during matches and provide feedback before, during, and after games

  • Support the head coach with practice planning, team training, scouting, and game-day logistics

  • Help develop a pipeline of keepers across the program, including JV and any returning or developing players

  • Track goalkeeper performance and share constructive feedback with players

  • Model sportsmanship, respect, and positive communication with players, families, officials, and opposing teams

  • Follow school, league, and CIF Southern Section policies, including safety, communication, and student-athlete welfare protocols

  • Engage robustly in fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion to promote a healthy learning environment;

  • Willingness to take on other duties as needed.
