title: Engineering Director - Print
description:
About the team

Canva Print has 110+ people across Australia, the Philippines, and the United States, with a 70+-person technology org predominantly based in Sydney. We cover the full print funnel end-to-end — from helping people discover, design, and buy print-on-demand products to working with the print partners who manufacture and deliver them worldwide. We're building an e-commerce-first Print experience and working to grow Print's annual revenue while keeping sustainability at the core of what we do, including initiatives like one-print-one-tree.

What you’d be doing in this role

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.

Canva Print brings Canva designs into the real world, helping people and businesses turn ideas into products they can hold, share and use. We’re making it simpler to take an idea from screen to physical product, while building a billion-dollar business with the global scale and technical complexity to match.

We’re looking for an Engineering Director to lead engineering across Canva Print. This is a leadership role where your impact comes through the leaders you grow, the strategy you set, and the technical and delivery bar you hold. You'll be directly responsible for enabling Print to expand its product range, partner ecosystem and global commerce capabilities at pace.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Setting and delivering Print’s technical strategy with the Product and Design leads, translating ambitious commercial goals into a clear, scalable engineering roadmap
  • Building the foundations to dramatically increase the pace at which new print products, mock-ups and customer experiences can be brought to market
  • Evolving our partner integration capabilities: creating repeatable platform patterns while staying close to the partners most critical to the business
  • Strengthening the systems that support global commerce, including payments and the operational complexity behind a reliable checkout experience
  • Coaching and growing the Engineering Leads across Print, while building a strong and healthy leadership pipeline
  • Owning the quality of technical decisions across the group, particularly where platform investments, delivery speed and customer experience intersect
  • Making engineering trade-offs clear and actionable for Product, Design and commercial stakeholders
  • Building a high-performing, growth-oriented culture — hiring, developing and managing performance across the organisation
  • Owning engineering’s contribution to Print’s commercial growth and revenue outcomes
  • Championing practical AI adoption, both in the customer experience and in how the team operates

You're probably a match if

  • You've led engineering organisations at meaningful scale, including coaching and growing other engineering managers and leads

  • You bring strong technical judgement — comfortable weighing long-term trade-offs and making sure the right expertise is in the room, even where you're not the deepest expert yourself

  • You have a track record of turning technical strategy into goals and roadmaps that teams actually deliver against

  • You think commercially and understand how engineering decisions connect to revenue and business outcomes

  • You communicate well and build real rapport across product, design, operations, and partner teams

  • You're comfortable in a fast-growing, ambiguous environment where the role evolves as the business scales

  • Experience running an e-commerce or marketplace business is a strong plus

  • You're a genuine people leader — building inclusive, high-performing cultures, resolving conflict, and running fair performance and calibration processes

About the team

Canva Print is 110+ people across Australia, the Philippines, and the United States, with a 70+ person technology org predominantly based in Sydney. We cover the full print funnel end to end — from helping people discover, design, and buy print on demand products, to working with the print partners who manufacture and deliver them worldwide. We're building an e-commerce-first Print experience and working to grow Print's annual revenue while keeping sustainability at the core of what we do, including initiatives like one-print-one-tree.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

title: Pre-Award: APOLLO- Operations in the Information Environment (OIE) Journeyman Planner- Norfolk VA
description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking Operations in the Information Environment (OIE) Journeyman Planner to join the OIE Planning team dedicated to advancing national security through innovative irregular warfare and operations expertise. Specifically, the OIP team will deliver mission-critical advisory, training, and operational support services that help mission partners stay ahead of rapidly evolving global threats. The Operations in the Information Environment (OIE) Planner will contribute to high-impact missions, collaborate with experienced professionals, and support strategic operations that strengthen our nation’s defense capabilities around the world. Candidates who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace complex challenges, and are committed to mission excellence will find meaningful opportunities for growth and impact on this team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Integrates OIE objectives into campaign and operational plans, ensuring information effects align with commander intent and operational design.
  • Synchronizes information forces and capabilities with maneuver, joint fires, and non-kinetic activities to achieve desired effects in the information environment.
  • Designs, authors, and integrates OIE OPORD inputs, annexes, appendices, tabs, and supporting planning products into joint planning and execution.
  • Integrates intelligence, targeting, and collection requirements to inform OIE planning, execution, and decision-making.
  • Develops and incorporates measures of performance and effectiveness, evaluation frameworks, and assessment plans to support continuous monitoring, adaptation, and refinement of OIE activities.
  • Coordinates and synchronizes OIE planning and execution with interagency partners, allies, coalition forces, academia, industry vendors, and DoD/DoW stakeholders to ensure unity of effort and de-confliction.
  • Integrates DoD/DoW Rewards Program planning into OIE efforts to incentivize desired behaviors, enable information collection, and support operational objectives in accordance with authorities.
  • Ensures legal, policy, attribution, and operational risk considerations are embedded in OIE plans while producing decision-quality OIE assessments, briefs, and recommendations for senior leaders.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active TS clearance with SCI, or eligible to obtain SCI
  • Bachelor of Arts / Bachelor of Science degree in a relevant field such as Strategic Communications, International Relations, Political Science, Behavioral Science, or Military Science
  • 3+ years of experience planning, coordinating, synchronizing, and/or executing operations in the information environment (e.g., Psychological Operations (PSYOP), Operations Security (OPSEC), Defense Deception Activities, Electronic Warfare, Cyberspace Operations, Public Affairs, and/or Information Operations)
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience in military planning processes, including the Joint Planning Process (JPP), the military decision-making process (MDMP), the joint targeting process, and/or military campaign planning
  • Proficient in standard military software applications and communication systems

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Completion of advanced OIE-relevant training such as the FA30 Information Operations Qualification Course, Joint Information Planners Course (JIPC, formerly JIOPC), OPSEC Planners Course, MILDEC Planners Course, PSYOP Planners Course, or Joint Targeting School
  • Experience with military planning at the operational level, to include experience at the CCMD, Service Component Command, and/or Joint Task Force level
  • Experience coordinating and synchronizing military operations with multinational and/or interagency teammates

EEO Commitment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Principal Data Engineer | Leicester (Hybrid, 3 days/week onsite) | £80,000-90,000


If you are interested in applying for this job, please make sure you meet the following requirements as listed below.

title: Key Accounts Executive
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Key Accounts Executive based in India.

This role is focused on driving sales and distribution across an assigned territory while building strong relationships with key customers and distribution partners. You will take ownership of sales targets through personal market engagement and effective management of the RS distribution system. The position combines commercial execution, distributor management, customer development, competitive analysis, and promotional planning. You will use market insights and performance data to identify opportunities and strengthen the competitive position of the business. A key part of the role is developing distributor sales teams and addressing infrastructure gaps that may affect performance. The role offers a hands-on, market-facing environment where strong relationship management and commercial execution directly contribute to territory growth.

Accountabilities:

You will manage an assigned territory and customer portfolio with responsibility for sales growth, distribution performance, and market execution. The role requires close collaboration with distributors and their sales teams, strong commercial judgment, and the ability to translate market intelligence into effective actions.

  • Achieve assigned sales targets through personal selling, regular market visits, and effective management of the RS distribution system.
  • Drive sales and distribution performance across the allocated territory and customer base.
  • Manage RS relationships and negotiate effectively to generate additional business.
  • Develop distributor sales teams and strengthen their ability to manage customers and improve commercial performance.
  • Monitor RS and RS sales-team performance systematically and take corrective action when infrastructure or execution gaps arise.
  • Analyze market conditions and identify opportunities to improve competitive positioning through stronger customer service.
  • Monitor competitor activities and provide timely market feedback to the branch team.
  • Recommend appropriate actions in response to competitive developments.
  • Plan and execute promotional and brand activities within approved budget limits and in consultation with relevant superiors.
  • Support effective sales planning and RS appointment activities.
  • Apply ROI calculations to evaluate distribution and commercial initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with customers and distribution partners across the assigned market.
  • Provide relevant market reports, insights, and performance updates to internal stakeholders.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate brings practical experience in General Trade and Channel Sales, along with strong distributor management and commercial analysis capabilities. You should be comfortable working in the market, negotiating with distribution partners, managing sales teams, and using ROI and sales-planning principles to drive territory performance.

    • Minimum full-time graduation in any relevant discipline.
    • 3–7 years of experience in General Trade and/or Channel Sales, with strong distributor-handling experience.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Marketing Enablement & Technology
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Marketing Enablement & Technology (MET) team sits within Instacart's Marketing organization, building the systems, APIs, and data pipelines powering Instacart's Paid Marketing channels—one of our most substantial growth levers. Operating at the intersection of Marketing, Product, and Engineering, we own the platforms behind campaign feeds, audience targeting, event pipelines, and QA automation.

We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer for the Paid MarTech pod to architect and scale backend services and ETL processes enabling marketing campaign execution, conversion tracking, and third-party integrations across Paid Social, Display, SEM, Online Video, Linear Television, and Streaming Audio. You'll lead projects end-to-end, drive technical direction, mentor engineers, and partner closely with Marketing, Operations, and Product leadership to shape technical and product strategy.

About the Job

  • Lead complete projects independently across backend services, APIs, and data pipelines, defining experimentation, development, and rollout strategies across multiple systems with minimal guidance.
  • Architect scalable, robust solutions for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency, applying deep technical knowledge to design systems that handle high-throughput marketing operations.
  • Drive technical improvements by identifying and solving deeper underlying problems, designing appropriate abstractions to simplify complexity and promote reusability across the codebase.
  • Partner directly with Marketing and Product stakeholders to influence features and requirements, bringing strong technical perspective while making well-reasoned trade-offs between complexity, business value, and delivery timelines.
  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and onboarding support, while contributing to team productivity through process improvements and automation.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with expert-level proficiency in Python for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.
  • Proven track record of leading complete projects end-to-end, including architecture design, implementation, experimentation, and production rollout.
  • Deep expertise with data integration technologies (Snowflake, SQL, ETL processes) and workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, DBT).
  • Demonstrated ability to design for performance, scalability, and robustness, with experience implementing comprehensive observability solutions (logging, metrics, tracing).
  • Strong product thinking with ability to research problems deeply, influence product direction, and make strategic trade-offs balancing technical and business considerations.
  • Excellent communication skills with proven ability to mentor engineers, drive cross-team alignment, and translate technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting and implementing automation frameworks and reusable abstractions that improve team productivity and system extensibility.
  • Advanced knowledge of ad platform APIs (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Snapchat Ads) and conversion tracking mechanisms at scale.
  • Deep understanding of digital marketing operations and performance marketing KPIs (ROAS, LTV, CAC, CPA) with ability to identify technical opportunities that drive business impact.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization, chaos engineering, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Track record of managing technical debt strategically and leading legacy system modernization efforts.
  • Experience with security-by-design principles and leading incident response for production systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools for significant productivity improvements and contribute to AI-assisted development infrastructure.

description:
Clinical Supervisor - Pregnancy & Parental Service

Health New Zealand/Te Whatu Ora Waitematā

  • Permanent, full-time role
  • Based in Point Chevalier

Community Alcohol and Drug Services (CADS) is looking for a full-time registered health professional to provide clinical supervision for our Pregnancy and Parental Service (PPS) based in Point Chevalier, Tāmaki Makaurau / Auckland.

If you think this could be the role for you, we invite you to contact Angela McInerney, Clinical Team Leader on 021 190 8539 to find out more about this opportunity.

About the role\:

This is a senior role which sits within the PPS leadership team. You will\:

  • provide day to day clinical supervision and scheduled professional supervision for the team.
  • provide clinical and professional development support for health professionals and peer support specialists
  • support and orientate new staff
  • carry a small clinical caseload

Please click here for a copy of the position description.

About you\:

You are an experienced, registered health professional (e.g. nursing, social work, addictions, psychology) who has leadership and clinical supervision experience.

You have a strengths and equity focus with a commitment to working with tāngata whai i te ora from a biopsychosocial approach with an understanding of hauora Māori models of care. You will have excellent clinical and communication skills as well as an ability to work autonomously, and accountably within a highly consultative, supportive team.

You will have\:

Essential\:

  • Tertiary qualification (three (3) year degree or equivalent) in nursing, applied addictions studies, social work, or other related health field.
  • Five (5) years’ clinical experience in the mental health and addiction treatment field
  • Completed training in clinical supervision (or willingness to work towards this)
  • An understanding and willingness to action Tiriti based partnership in daily clinical work
  • A focus on equitable health outcomes for priority populations
  • Full driver’s licence
  • Legal right to work in Aotearoa New Zealand
  • Excellent computer and time management skills

Preferred\:

  • Seven (7) years’ clinical experience in the mental health and addiction treatment field
  • Relevant experience and training in clinical supervision and be a dapaanz accredited supervisor
  • Experience of working with whānau in community settings and in providing evidence based clinical interventions
  • An understanding of working from a harm reduction framework

Benefits

  • Making a difference for pregnant people, parents, children, and families
  • Regular supervision, training, and professional development
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression
  • Working for a regional service in Aotearoa’s largest Te Whatu Ora district

About us\:

CADS provides free community and inpatient treatment from several locations across Tāmaki Makaurau and is committed to empowering the community to reduce the harm associated with substance use and promote recovery and wellbeing.

PPS is a multi-disciplinary, regional team which works with pregnant people and parents of children under three years of age who are experiencing issues related to substance use. The whānau we work alongside are disconnected from health and social services and experiencing multiple and complex problems including family violence, physical and mental health issues, stigmatisation, housing insecurity, and other socio-economic concerns.

The aim of PPS is to improve outcomes for unborn and young children using evidence-based interventions to positively impact and enhance their health and wellbeing trajectories.

Our team provides assertive outreach and spends time developing a therapeutic relationship with tāngata whai i te ora and their whānau. We use a motivational, strengths based and client-led approach; are recovery focused, and practice within a whānau inclusive, child focussed framework. We also provide advocacy, education, service co-ordination and liaison, along with robust risk assessment and safety planning practices, in order to support this priority population to make significant changes and develop and maintain wellbeing and recovery.

Our Values

At Te Whatu Ora Waitematā we are driven by our values “everyone matters,” “with compassion,” “connected” and “better, best, brilliant.” We are committed to living up to these values to give you the right balance of autonomy, support, development, encouragement and aroha.

For more information about our recruitment process, please contact Abigail Sana Matic, Recruitment Consultant via email

title: Sygeplejerske til OPUS team i Psykiatrien Øst i Region Sjælland
description:
Motiveres du af at gøre en forskel for unge med debuterende psykoser? Og er du optaget af at arbejde kvalitet og udvikling på dette specifikke område? Så har vi en stilling ledig som sygeplejerske/primær OPUS behandler i vores OPUS team. Vi er et OPUS team med erfarne kollegaer, der nu må sige farvel til en kollega, der går på pension.

Velkommen til OPUS

Du kender det måske allerede, men OPUS er et 2-årigt ambulant behandlingstilbud til unge i alderen 18-35 år med debuterende psykose eller psykoselignende symptomer. Kerneopgaven er udredning og behandling af patienter med sværere psykiatriske lidelser indenfor det psykotiske område. Ud fra et recovery mindset tilrettelægges behandlingen (både den lægefaglige, psykologfaglige såvel som den sygeplejefaglige behandling) og interventioner. OPUS er et fastlagt tilrettelagt behandlingskoncept, som teamet af OPUS behandlere varetager. Vi er samtidig i gang med at implementere og udvikle på vores kliniske praksis med IDD (Integreret Dobbelt Diagnose behandling).

OPUS teamet har hovedsæde i Greve, men arbejder ud fra nærhedsprincippet og har geografi i Køge, Faxe og Roskilde. Dit primære mødested vil være i Roskilde. Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team, der består af overlæge, sygeplejersker, ergoterapeut, socialrådgiver, psykologer, sekretærer samt peermedarbejder.

Opgaver

  • Være en del af teamet og løfte de gruppebehandlingstilbud, der indgår i OPUS konceptet (fler- familiegruppe, socialfærdighedstræningsgruppe, psykoedukation og evt. andre grupper ad hoc
  • Medicinhåndtering og udlevering
  • Deltage i relevante møder m.m. angående patientforløb og kliniske opgaver
  • Undervisningsopgaver i forhold til pårørende og psykoedukation

Hvad forventer vi af dig

Vi søger en kollega, der har klinisk viden og erfaring inden for psykiatrien. Du trives med forskelligartede opgaver og kan arbejde selvstændigt med ansvar for patienter i individuelle forløb. Vi ser gerne at du:

  • Har lyst og evne til at indgå i et tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Tager aktivt del i nye løsninger og er fleksibel
  • Kan prioritere din tid i forhold til teamets ressourcer
  • Er villig til at lære nyt og opsøger gerne sparring og hjælp ved kollegaer
  • Er god til at samarbejde i et team
  • Har lyst til at aktivt engagere dig i en relation til patienter og dennes pårørende.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et personligt tilrettelagt introduktionsforløb med fælles introduktion til Psykiatrien
  • At blive en del af en tværfaglig personalegruppe med engagerede kolleger i en god atmosfære præget af samarbejde, gensidig velvilje og lysten til at arbejde recovery fokuseret
  • At være på en arbejdsplads hvor vi fra ledelsens side har fokus på medarbejdernes trivsel i forhold til egen faggruppe, øvrige faggrupper og i forhold til ledelse
  • Mulighed for tværfaglig sparring med øvrige personalegrupper
  • Fastlagt supervision og workshops indenfor OPUS feltet

Vi er et team, der er meget engagerede og dedikerede til vores patienter og deres pårørende. Og det samme er vi i vores arbejdsplads, hvor vi har en god og rummelig omgangstone.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 32 timer pr. uge og ønskes besat fra 1/12 2026 eller efter aftale.

Du ansættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Jf. Region Sjællands personalepolitik er det en betingelse for ansættelsen, at der indhentes tilfredsstillende børne- og straffeattest.

Du kan læse mere om Region Sjælland som arbejdsplads (link).

Vil du vide mere?

Ønsker du yderligere information er du velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Gitte Moth, mobil 61 50 80 29.

Ansøgningsfrist d. 15/10 2026 og ansøgere indkaldes løbende til samtale, som forventes afholdt d. 20/10 2026 eftermiddag.

Psykiatrien som arbejdsplads

I Psykiatrien Region Sjælland kan du gøre en forskel for hele mennesket. Vi skaber håb, vilje og lyst til livet. Du gør en meningsfuld forskel, når du vælger at arbejde i Psykiatrien. Gør karriere i Psykiatrien, hvis du vil redde mere end liv. Se mere på – og læs om udviklingsmuligheder, karriereveje og alt det andet som er rart at vide, når man søger nyt job.

Om Psykiatrien

Psykiatrien Region Sjælland er en behandlingspsykiatri, der består af en række sengeafsnit og ambulante enheder rundt omkring i regionen. Vi varetager psykiatrisk udredning og behandling samt akutforpligtelsen i Region Sjælland.

Vi udvikler og formidler en bred vifte af psykiatriske tilbud til regionens borgere, og vi har en anonym rådgivning, som er åben for alle, der har behov for viden eller sparring om psykisk sygdom. Vi forsker bredt med inddragelse af både patienter og pårørende. Vi ser det som en vigtig opgave at uddanne fremtidens medarbejdere, så vi varetager også en stor uddannelsesopgave.

Ansættelsen er betinget af modtagelse af tilfredsstillende straffeattest til offentligt brug

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

title: Radar System Modes & Algorithms Lead
description:
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

You will lead the successful execution of Radar signal processing, modes, and software function throughout Radar development programs, including weather signal processing, waveform design and implementation, embedded radar software, software architecture, and future multi-mode radar capability development. Working with the PI, and other system leads, this role establishes the technical approach and software capabilities for radar prototypes. Candidates should have demonstrated hands-on technical leadership of end-to-end radar signal processing, modes, and software development from concept through integrated prototype demonstration.

Key Technical Skills and Experience

  • Radar system architecture and implementation: hands-on experience defining and developing radar system architectures, including radar subsystems, functional allocation, interfaces, data flows, hardware/software partitioning, and the physical hardware and processing needed to realize an integrated radar system.
  • Radar mode development and management: hands-on development of radar modes from operational needs through mode definition, processing, resource needs, implementation, and integration.
  • Radar waveform design, scan strategy, and resource management: design and optimization of radar waveforms, PRFs, bandwidths, timing, ambiguity, Doppler considerations, beam/scan strategies, dwell, revisit/update rates, coverage, and allocation of radar resources across modes.
  • Radar signal processing and algorithm development: hands-on development of range/Doppler processing, detection, CFAR, beamforming, angle estimation, clutter suppression, tracking, and other advanced radar processing, including implementation and optimization for real-time radar systems.
  • Radar modeling, simulation, and data analysis: hands-on development and use of MATLAB, Python, or similar tools for radar architecture, waveform and algorithm development, performance modeling, and analysis of measured radar data.
  • Radar system/subsystem prototyping: demonstrated experience taking radar concepts, architectures, modes, waveforms, and algorithms beyond analysis and simulation into functional hardware prototypes or demonstrators.

Report to: Senior R&D Manager

Location: Torrance, CA., Phoenix, AZ., Redmond, WA.

Work Schedule: M-F hybrid (3 days onsite and 2 remote)

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics
  • Experience in Radar or RF systems. (i.e. radar modes, radar signal, radar system)
  • Experience as a Systems Engineer including two or more of the following: requirements, design; specification development, modeling, simulation, or performance analysis; HW/ SW integration and test and verification

WE VALUE

  • A master's degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline, such as science, technology, engineering, or mathematics.
  • Track record of solving difficult, complex problems through innovation, analysis, engineering, and experimentation.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills reflected in a record of published results and public presentations in your field of research.
  • Engage with customers and partners to define their needs and requirements, then apply your skills to find creative solutions through rigorous analysis, engineering, and experimentation.
  • Effectively communicate your ideas and results to research sponsors, scientific peers, and business leadership, through effective presentations, publications, and the writing of proposals.
  • Strong understanding of aircraft and avionics integration.

The annual base salary range for this position is $118,000 - $147,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell Aerospace considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations

US PERSON REQUIREMENTS:

  • Due to contractual requirements and compliance with US export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a US Person, a US citizen, or a US permanent resident.

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL AEROSPACE

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

• Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance

• Short-term and long-term disability coverage

• 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts

• Employee assistance program and educational assistance

• Parental leave and 12 paid holidays

• Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/

ABOUT THE BUSINESS UNIT

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space. We operate through three business areas:

• Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft

• Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying

• Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board

With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting Date: October 1, 2026

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
About Us

Imbue is a radically different AI company.

We believe that data should belong to you, humans should come before technology, and everyone deserves to own a personal team of AI agents. We believe in a future of open agents that you can modify to do exactly what you want.

We’re building a suite of tools to make tech serve humans, and making it open source.

Some first projects include

  • Studio: A custom digital HQ for building personalized software, apps, and tools
  • Bouncer: A social media feed filter that removes what you don't want to see and retrains your algorithm
  • Sculptor: An interface for programmers to run coding agents in parallel and stay in flow
  • mngr: A command-line tool for managing agents
  • Vet: A standalone tool that catches AI coding mistakes and reviews full PRs
  • Offload: A tool that automatically distributes your tests to run in isolated sandboxes
  • Latchkey: A command-line tool to integrate local agents with third-party APIs
  • Darwinian Evolver: A near-universal optimizer for code and agents

And we’re just getting started. If you’re excited about building a future with open agents, say hi!

We're supported by investors like Nvidia, Simon Last (co-founder of Notion), and Eric Schmidt (former CEO of Google), with $200M raised at over $1B valuation.

Summary

We are looking for software engineers with strong engineering foundations and a deep curiosity to solve technical problems for the benefit of humans. In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape our product and help build 0-1—not just the technologies that we use, but the overall direction of our product as it evolves. ​​You will be responsible for building across our entire stack, understanding customer needs, and contributing to our product roadmap.
This role is broad: you might design APIs, build infrastructure, improve model tooling, or shape new product features, depending on where the need is greatest. We're looking for engineers who thrive in ambiguity, enjoy working across the stack, and are excited about building open source AI tools. This role can be onsite at our San Francisco headquarters or remote.

You Are

• Someone who has built and shipped projects or products 0-1
• Very comfortable writing Python
• Excited to work on open source code
• Passionate about engineering best practices
• Self-directed and independent
• Excellent at getting things done

Compensation and Benefits

• Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits
• Lunch provided daily to onsite employees
• $250 lifestyle stipend per month
• Generous budget for self-improvement: coaching, courses, conferences, etc
• Actively co-create and participate in a positive, intentional team culture
• Spend time learning, reading papers, and deeply understanding prior work
• Frequent team events, dinners, off-sites, and hanging out
• Compensation packages are highly variable based on a variety of factors. If your salary requirements fall outside of the stated range, we still encourage you to apply. The range for this role is $170,000–$350,000 cash (plus equity)

How to Apply

All submissions are reviewed by a person, so we encourage you to include notes on why you're interested in working with us. If you have any other work that you can showcase (open source code, side projects, etc.), certainly include it! We know that talent comes from many backgrounds, and we aim to build a team with diverse skillsets that spike strongly in different areas.

title: Seafood Processor 2026/2027 Talent Pool (Perth Metro)
description:
Why GFC?

Locations: Welshpool & North Fremantle

  • Rock Lobster Royalty: We’re not just any seafood processor—we're one of the world's largest rock lobster processors, handling nearly three-quarters of WA's commercial rock lobster catch.
  • Easy Application Process: We have worked hard to remove unnecessary steps from the hiring process for these roles. We don't conduct interviews; we ask you to complete a few simple online forms so we can process your application.

What GFC looks for in Employees.

  • GFC operates in a rapidly changing, highly seasonal business environment. Employees who can demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in their approach to work, will thrive at GFC.
  • GFC's number one value is Safety. Employees must demonstrate a commitment to their own safety, and the safety of others at all times.

About the Job

Our work is highly seasonal with the peak usually between November and March each year. During the October - March peak season, we recruit heavily to support our operations and offer competitive pay (including overtime/weekend penalty rates).


Working hours can extend outside “regular office hours” including afternoons, evenings, and weekends (overtime rates and penalty rates apply!). There is a need to be flexible with most of our shifts allocated at short notice.


Job duties include:

  • Sorting, grading, trimming, washing and packaging lobsters.
  • Baskets – weighing, tipping, moving, returning and preparation for loading trucks.
  • Feeding graders, stun tank and packers.
  • Checking tanks – removing weak lobsters; notifications of these removals.
  • Ticketing, sealing, taping and stamping polystyrene boxes.
  • Cleaning workplace / holding tanks / freezers / waste bins etc; and
  • Removal of wastes.


For those who show an interest, there are structured training and competency assessments to progress to higher-level Seafood Process Attendant grades and to other positions within the organisation.

Essential Job Requirements

  • Safety – A desire to want to work in a safe environment, to be safety conscious. This position WILL involve contact with live seafood and shellfish products.
  • People – The ability to deal with situations calmly and diplomatically which allows open communication and rapport at all levels of the organisation.
  • Technical– Ability to follow and give instructions in English. Basic numeracy, literacy and reasoning are also required.

Desirable

  • Experience – worked in a light-to-medium industry production process workplace (preference given to seafood/meat/dairy).

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
By The Bay Health, a non-profit established in 1975, set the standard for hospice in the U.S. by emphasizing the role of the patient in making important medical decisions. Our spectrum of home-based services now includes Skilled Home Health Care, Palliative Care, Adult Hospice Care and Pediatric Care. Our team approach strives to address practical, social, emotional and spiritual aspects of care, with the goal to maximize quality of life for our patients, caregivers and families.

This full-time position offers competitive pay, generous benefits and a supportive work environment.

The Senior Program Manager is a highly visible, enterprise-level role responsible for leading and supporting complex strategic initiatives, cross-functional programs, and special projects across By the Bay Health.

Reporting directly to the CEO, this individual will work closely with the Executive Leadership Team, Board of Directors, operational leaders, and key internal stakeholders to translate organizational priorities into well-defined plans, drive execution, strengthen accountability, and ensure critical initiatives move forward effectively.

The ideal candidate is a sophisticated project and program leader who combines strategic thinking with exceptional execution. This individual will be comfortable navigating ambiguity, working across functions, building relationships at every level of the organization, and managing multiple priorities in a dynamic healthcare environment.

This is an outstanding opportunity for an experienced professional who wants significant exposure to executive leadership, organizational strategy, healthcare operations, and nonprofit governance while contributing directly to the continued growth and success of By the Bay Health.

Schedule:

Monday - Friday; 8:30am - 5:00pm

Location:

Larkspur, CA

By the Bay Health follows all CDPH vaccine requirements for healthcare personnel.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

Strategic Program and Project Leadership

Executive and Board Support

  • Build strong, trusted relationships across departments and serve as a connector between the CEO, Executive Leadership Team, Board members, and internal stakeholders.
  • Facilitate meetings, workgroups, and planning sessions designed to move initiatives from discussion to execution.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization, translating complex information into understandable and actionable updates.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Economics, Information Systems, Project Management, or a related field required. Equivalent education and relevant professional experience may be considered
  • Master’s degree, MBA, MHA, or similar advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience leading complex programs, enterprise initiatives, or strategic projects
  • Healthcare experience strongly preferred

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

title: Full-stack Python/Django Developer
description:
We're looking for somebody friendly, quick witted and suitably experienced to join our small digital team in building secure, reliable content-managed websites and web applications for the likes of the NHS, Home Office, Taylor Wimpey, Hasbean/Ozone Coffee and countless charities, universities, and police forces.

This position is remote, but a lot of the team are based in and around Leicestershire, and there may be a requirement at times to work together, visit clients, collaborate and socialise.

OUR TECH STACK

We have been creating websites and applications using Python and Django since 2007, and the Wagtail CMS for content managed websites since 2014. Other technologies and frameworks we use include Docker, Tailwind, PostgreSQL, MariaDB/MySQL, Elasticsearch, HTML5, JavaScript and sometimes, yes, WordPress. We host a large number of websites and applications with Rackspace and Amazon Web Services.

Requirements

Your key responsibilities will be the ongoing development and refinement of websites and apps old and new for a wide variety of clients. Youʼll be helping to improve existing projects and working on brand new projects too.

Day to day you'll be working alongside a small team of developers, designers, project managers, social media and search experts, who will all be there to support you and discuss and develop your ideas. You'll also have access to the other 70-odd talented writers, designers, strategists and creatives across the company.

We need somebody that knows their way around Python and Django, and ideally some experience of Wagtail CMS too. Two years experience feels right - if it's slightly less but you're mindblowingly good then we're all ears :)

Programming skills are definitely only half the story, youʼll also need to be able to:

  • Think independently and be able to solve unique challenges efficiently and autonomously using initiative... and AI
  • Be able to work cooperatively as part of a team
  • Possess good writing and communication skills
  • Be comfortable talking about and explaining technical concepts in plain English
  • Keep up to date with new techniques in your field and share knowledge and new ideas with the team
  • Be ready to muck in as and when needed

Itʼs not critical, but it would be beneficial if you also had experience in:

  • Working with WordPress websites at a basic level
  • Some working experience with Squarespace and Shopify
  • DevOps and deployment techniques

title: Business Analyst
description:
Overview

Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems LLC is seeking a highly motivated and qualified individual to join our team as a Business Analyst. This position offers the opportunity to work alongside a diverse and talented team dedicated to supporting mission success and delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.

The Business Analyst will provide contractor support to Space Systems Command (SSC), System Delta (SYD) 81, and the Portfolio Acquisition Executive – Infrastructure (PAE-I) Program Office. In this role, the Business Analyst will serve as the Staff Coordinator for the SYD 81 Physical and Range Materiel Leader (ML), providing direct tactical and administrative support for daily operations, organizational priorities, and team management activities.

The successful candidate will help coordinate day-to-day activities, facilitate communication and workflow across the organization, track priorities and actions, and support the Materiel Leader in maintaining efficient and effective program operations.

Key Responsibilities

The Business Analyst will:

  • Manage the Materiel Leader’s (ML) day-to-day schedule, meeting cadence, and coordination with internal team members, supporting analysts, and Senior Materiel Leader (SML) counterparts
  • Track and manage program-level taskers, deliverables, suspense dates, and action items, ensuring timely and accurate submission to the SML Front Office
  • Coordinate logistics for meetings, program reviews, and classified sessions, including conference room scheduling, visitor coordination, and access requirements
  • Coordinate travel arrangements and Visitor Access Request (VAR) submissions for ML-directed events, including events initiated or hosted at the SML level

  • Prepare and provide weekly status reports identifying past-due and upcoming taskers, deliverables, and suspense actions
  • Serve as the primary coordination liaison between the ML organization and SML Staff Coordinators
  • Maintain awareness of organizational priorities and proactively identify actions requiring ML attention or follow-up

Requirements

Skills and Experience

The Business Analyst must have:

  • Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one
  • 10+ years of relevant Department of Defense (DoD) experience supporting program management, staff coordination, operations, or related mission activities
  • Experience using Enterprise Task Management Software Solution (ETMS2) or similar enterprise task-management systems
  • Working knowledge of program management principles, processes, and practices, with demonstrated experience applying them in an operational environment
  • Experience managing taskers, suspense actions, executive-level coordination, and organizational reporting requirements
  • Ability to coordinate effectively across program, technical, administrative, and senior leadership teams
  • Experience supporting a Space Program Office, Major Command (MAJCOM), or Field Command (FLDCOM) environment is highly desired

Education and Certifications

The Business Analyst must meet the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or relevant job experience in being a staff officer

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Paid federal holidays

Security Clearance

Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of Defense active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

Headquartered in Hawaii, Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC, is an SBA-Certified NHO-owned 8(a) Small Business specializing in global information technology solutions. title: AI Transformation Director
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. As the AI Transformation Director, you will launch and scale AI agents and lead pilots.   • Connect AI transformation directly to enterprise financial levers, designing frameworks that maximize LTV, shorten CAC payback periods, accelerate funnel velocity, and lower cost-to-serve

  • Define enterprise-grade standards for Responsible AI, model drift monitoring, hallucination prevention, data security, and auditability across all automated revenue motions
  • Evaluate continuously emerging market trends in LLM orchestration, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI), and sales intelligence to keep the GTM tech stack at the market forefront

  • Focus on designing and launching pilots, and globally scaling up pilots that pass the gate, drive rep enablement, track friction, and manage culture shift

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • Experience in SaaS Sales operations, including designing sales compensation structures, managing quota allocation, and optimizing territory models in large-scale enterprise environments
  • 15+ years of leadership and program delivery experience within Go-To-Market operations, Revenue Operations, and GTM strategy in enterprise SaaS environments
  • 6+ years of specialized leadership in applied AI, machine learning automation, and operationalizing LLM agent applications
  • Experience designing and scaling multi-workstream AI transformation roadmaps across complex, global GTM motions (Sales, CS, Marketing, Digital, CPQ, Billing)
  • Experience with AI system architecture: multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI), LLM orchestration, RAG systems, vector DBs, and modern GTM data platforms (Snowflake, Reverse ETL, CDPs)
  • Experience with core SaaS financial metrics (ARR, NRR, LTV, CAC payback, pipeline velocity)
  • Experience presenting to, influencing, and aligning C-suite leadership on disruptive strategy, build vs. buy decisions, and technology investments
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related technical/quantitative field

Preferred

  • Recognized industry thought leadership in AI for Revenue Operations, AI GTM Systems, or Agentic AI Workflows
  • Expertise in leading build vs. buy evaluations for enterprise AI tools and negotiating key technology partnerships
  • Track record of successfully executing multi-million dollar AI/digital transformation portfolios that deliver measurable financial ROI

description:
DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.

DLR Group’s Omaha studio has an opening for a Civil Engineering Summer Intern.

We have multiple positions and locations available; please refer to all openings posted and apply to the locations that are most suitable for your living situation during the course of your internship. This is not a remote position.

About EPX at DLR Group

As an intern at DLR Group, you’ll be part of our Emerging Professional Experience (EPX) Program, designed to give you a meaningful introduction to life within an integrated design firm and a strong foundation for your career in the AEC industry.

Each person at DLR Group has a design voice, and EPX gives you opportunities to develop and share yours. Through hands-on project work, mentorship, and learning experiences, you’ll gain exposure to the people, disciplines, and ideas that shape the built environment. You may participate in design discussions, project meetings, site visits, business development efforts, office activities, and other experiences that broaden your understanding of the design profession.

The program combines three core components: mentorship, project work, and weekly learning sessions. Topics may include design culture, sustainability, design technology, communication, marketing and business development, project and resource management, research, equity, career development, and more. Along the way, you’ll hear from leaders and integrated designers across DLR Group and build connections with fellow emerging professionals.

Position Summary

As a Civil Engineering Intern at DLR Group, you will be an important part of our integrated design team, contributing to the design process of civil building systems from schematics through construction administration, for buildings of various types, sizes, and complexities. Working alongside electrical engineers and professionals across architecture, engineering, interiors, and other disciplines, you will gain hands-on experience with the design process from early concepts and system development through documentation and construction administration.

Our Summer Internship Program is a paid, full-time opportunity running May 18 through August 6, 2027, and interns are expected to participate for the duration of the program. This is an opportunity to apply what you’ve learned in the classroom, build your technical and professional skills, and contribute your perspective to design solutions that support our brand promise of Elevating the Human Experience through design.

What you will do

  • Collaborate with architects and engineers as part of our integrated design process
  • Learn the tools, technology and workflow involved with BIM and how today’s designers deliver successful projects, including creating and coordinating documents using Autodesk’s Civil 3D software
  • Accompany team members on site visits to project sites to see the real-world results of what you do
  • Assist in developing concepts, calculations, modeling, drawing review, and project execution
  • 2D Drafting and 3D Modeling using Autodesk Revit Software
  • Help write and review civil-related specifications
  • Assist team with civil engineering calculations and code research

Required Qualifications:

  • Completed at least one year at an ABET-accredited Civil Engineering program
  • Experience with drafting programs such as Revit
  • Excellent communication, technology, and organizational skills
  • Good multitasking skills to easily switch between projects while keeping track of tasks
  • Ability to work individually as well as in a team environment
  • A desire to learn about the architecture/engineering design process

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Goal oriented with strong skills in problem solving, creativity, and attention to detail
  • Experience and interest in sustainable building design
  • Goal oriented with strong skills in problem solving creativity and attention to detail
  • Experience and interest in sustainable and low-impact site and landscape design
  • An appreciation and understanding of landscape engineering and architectural systems and design and how architects work and think
  • A third-year student in an accredited engineering program

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About SirenOpt

SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks.

SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made.

We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia.

About the job

Job Title: Data Scientist – Signal Modeling & Applied Metrology

Location: On-Site (San Leandro, CA)

Job Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our Applications Engineering team. In this role, you will build and deploy machine learning models that turn complex, high-dimensional sensor signals into actionable predictions about material properties, bridging the gap between raw instrument data and manufacturing intelligence.

This is a forward-deployed, customer-adjacent role. You will work directly with customer samples and datasets to execute proof-of-concept studies, validate model performance on novel materials, and translate results into product improvements. You will collaborate closely with software and hardware engineering teams to move models from research into production.

What You'll Do

Model Development & Calibration

  • Build, calibrate, and validate predictive models that map sensor signal features to material properties

  • Design and evaluate new model architectures and featurization strategies suited to small-data, high-dimensional scientific datasets

  • Apply methods including regression, dimensionality reduction, probabilistic modeling, anomaly detection, and physics-informed ML

Model Validation & Production Readiness

  • Develop testing and validation frameworks for model performance, including uncertainty quantification and out-of-distribution detection

  • Characterize model robustness across sample types, process conditions, and instrument configurations

  • Prepare models and documentation for handoff to the software engineering team for production deployment

Customer-Facing Proof-of-Concept Work

  • Analyze datasets from customer proof of concepts

  • Compile technical reports and supporting materials to deliver to customers

  • Translate findings and stakeholder feedback into model improvement roadmaps

What We're Looking For

  • B.S. in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative science field with 3-5 years of applied ML/data science experience; or M.S. with 1-3 years (Ph.D. a plus, not required)

  • Hands-on experience building and validating predictive models (supervised and self-supervised) in Python

  • Ability to analyze multivariate, high-dimensional datasets and perform feature engineering and selection

  • Solid grasp of statistical modeling: uncertainty quantification, regularization, covariate analysis, and feature importance methods

  • Strong communicator; comfortable presenting technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Nice to have:

  • Experience working with time-series, spectroscopic, or other sensor-based signal data

  • Prior work in manufacturing, materials science, energy storage, semiconductors, or another physical science domain

  • Prior customer-facing or applications engineering experience in a technical product company

  • Experience deploying models in production software environments

  • Familiarity with data pipeline development (PostgreSQL or similar)

  • Fluency in Mandarin Chinese, Japanese, German, Korean, or another key stakeholder language

Base Pay Range
$100,000—$160,000 USD

Benefits

  • Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience
  • Health, Dental, Vision plans provided
  • 401k matching provided
  • Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

title: Lead Product Designer, Jira

  • Amplify Atlassian’s System of Work and Jira’s role within the Teamwork Collection app suite. You will help usher in a new era of connected context, powerful Rovo capabilities and third-party agent tooling and integrations.

  • Champion our users and great design. We run a world-class design organisation and aim to make customers love our products, measuring our work against competitors and industry standards.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Design end-to-end experiences that integrate AI into Jira workflows and collaboration.

  • Design journeys and patterns that modernise Jira’s design language and create cohesion across our platform, Rovo and 1P/3P agentic workflows.

  • Partner with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to define a unified vision for modern work management at Atlassian.

  • Identify opportunities to improve our apps and platform and to advance AI-native product evolution.

Your background

  • 7+ years of product design experience designing complex or enterprise-level software

  • High level of craft in visual design execution

  • Strong prototyping skills, with the ability to present clear options, configurations and trade-offs

  • Recent experience designing AI-native processes, workflows and agentic tooling

  • Experience in end-to-end UX and product design, crafting impactful solutions to challenging problems

  • Passion for storytelling, with the ability to bring design direction to life through a compelling narrative

  • Experience conducting and applying customer research, including design thinking, prototyping and conceptual modelling

  • Experience balancing customer needs with business goals, market viability and technical feasibility

  • Facilitation and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the demonstrated ability to integrate the work of multiple teams, solicit and synthesise feedback, and facilitate design discussions that lead to clear progress and outcomes

  • Experience measuring success through qualitative and quantitative methods

  • The ability to define complex projects, requirements, measures of success, testing approaches and feedback mechanisms

  • Strong stakeholder management, risk mitigation and negotiation skills

  • Experience improving processes and methodologies to increase product value, team velocity and adoption of new capabilities

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

title: Handelsassistentelev til kundeservice
description:
Til vores kundeservice på hovedkontoret i Middelfart søger AD Danmark en engageret, serviceminded og målrettet handelsassistentelev, der har lyst til en 2-årig uddannelse i en spændende virksomhed med højt tempo og store ambitioner.

Hos os får du en elevplads med gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling. Du bliver en del af en hverdag, hvor service, ansvar, samarbejde og godt humør vægtes højt, og hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for salg og kundeservice.

Du skal trives med forandringer, være serviceminded til fingerspidserne og have lyst til at gøre en forskel for vores kunder. For os er det vigtigt, at vores kunder får en god oplevelse, hver gang de er i kontakt med AD Danmark.

Om AD Danmark

AD Danmark er Danmarks eneste universaldistributør til autobranchen og leverer autoreservedele til det professionelle marked i hele Danmark.

Kunderne er omdrejningspunktet for vores forretning, og vores ambition er at være en attraktiv, seriøs og anderledes samarbejdspartner for den professionelle autobranche.

Vi tilbyder et bredt udvalg af kvalitetsreservedele og har adgang til mere end 300.000 forskellige reservedele. Gennem attraktive priser, gennemsigtige rabatordninger og innovative løsninger ønsker vi at bidrage til udviklingen af vores kunders forretning.

Autobranchen er i konstant udvikling, og derfor arbejder vi målrettet med løsninger og koncepter, der skaber værdi for vores kunder. Det er grundlaget for vores tilgang: “Partnerskab – der betaler sig!”

Vi har en travl og spændende hverdag – og vi keder os aldrig.

Dine primære opgaver

Som handelsassistentelev bliver du en del af vores kundeserviceteam, og dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Telefonisk salg og support til vores værkstedskunder
  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via chat, e-mail, sms mv.
  • Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på tilbud til kunder
  • Oprettelse af ordrer samt løbende opfølgning på egne ordrer for at sikre et højt serviceniveau
  • Optimerings- og opfølgningsopgaver
  • Forskellige administrative og driftsmæssige opgaver i den daglige kundeservice

Du vil løbende få mere ansvar i takt med din udvikling og blive grundigt introduceret til vores produkter, systemer og arbejdsgange.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • ønsker en spændende og alsidig uddannelse inden for handel, salg og kundeservice
  • har gode kommunikationsevner og er god til at skabe kontakt til andre
  • er serviceorienteret, engageret og motiveret
  • trives med at have kontakt med mange mennesker og kan lide at tale i telefon
  • arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver
  • er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære nyt
  • behersker dansk i skrift og tale og gerne også engelsk
  • har gode IT-kompetencer og kendskab til Microsoft Office
  • opfylder adgangskravene til handelsuddannelsen

Vi benytter Concorde XAL i vores daglige arbejde, men det er ikke et krav, at du kender systemet på forhånd.

Vi tilbyder

Vi tilbyder en elevplads i en ambitiøs virksomhed med fokus på udvikling, vækst og høj kundeservice.

Du bliver en del af et team af dedikerede kolleger med en uformel omgangstone, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og arbejder sammen om at skabe de bedste løsninger for vores kunder.

Du får en grundig oplæring og mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt gennem din elevtid.

Vi tilbyder gode ansættelsesvilkår og et stærkt fællesskab, hvor der er plads til både engagement, godt humør og højt tempo.

Så har du…

  • interesse for salg og kundeservice
  • lyst til at udvikle dig inden for salg og service og betjene vores professionelle værkstedskunder
  • interesse for biler, autoreservedele og udstyr
  • lyst til en travl hverdag med højt tempo, godt humør og mange forskellige opgaver
  • mod, vilje og lyst til at lære nyt

…så er du måske vores kommende handelsassistentelev.

Ansættelsesstart: Snarest muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Kundeservicechef Lennert Jensen på mobil 30 30 40 44.

Din ansøgning

Send din ansøgning via vores elektroniske ansøgningsskema ved at benytte knappen “Udfyld ansøgning”.

Vedhæft ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis i Word- eller PDF-format.

Mærk din ansøgning “Handelsassistentelev”.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. About the Role:

You’ll be a key engineer focused on building and owning the systems that move money and assets through Gusto Retirement. This is a very hands-on role: owning backend services and APIs end-to-end, shipping production code, and working through real financial edge cases. You’ll partner closely with product, compliance, and operations to turn complex financial requirements into reliable software. If you like working on core systems where correctness matters and enjoy getting things shipped, you’ll be a great fit.

About the Team:

The Financial Infrastructure team owns the core money and asset flow systems for Gusto Retirement. We’re a senior team that works on payments, settlements, tax and compliance integrations, and much more. The work is complex and often cross-functional, so we stay focused, collaborate closely, and keep tight ownership of what we build. We work closely with product and partner teams, but we’re responsible for execution and reliability end-to-end.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Design, build, and ship services and APIs for money movement and financial integrations
  • Work on payments, settlements, reconciliation, and corrections involving real customer funds
  • Build and support critical workflows like payroll integration, KYB/KYC, 401k loans, billing and invoicing, and IRA
  • Partner with product, compliance, and operations to scope work and deliver production-ready solutions
  • Debug production issues and improve reliability, observability, and operational tooling
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to integrate with shared systems and platforms
  • Mentor other engineers to help solve some of the hardest technical problems out there in very complex domains and at a large scale
  • Write clear, reliable, well-tested code that ships quickly and scales well
  • Build a product that our customers genuinely love

Here’s what we're looking for:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production products or platforms
  • Strong experience with services, APIs, and data-heavy workflows.
  • Experience working on financial systems, payments, or other high-correctness domains (or the ability to ramp quickly).
  • Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, including production support and operational work.
  • Experience working closely with PMs and cross-functional partners to deliver scoped work.
  • Pragmatic, execution-focused approach to engineering.
  • Clear communicator and collaborative teammate.
  • Ability to mentor engineers to maximize their performance and impact
  • Experience with Ruby on Rails (or a comparable backend framework).

Bonus Points:

  • Experience leveraging AI tools or systems to accelerate development, improve testing, and deliver new product capabilities.
  • Curiosity and experimentation with emerging AI frameworks, applying and sharing best practices to evaluate and scale AI use safely across teams.

Please note that travel to Gusto's office for onboarding is required for this position. If you have any questions regarding this requirement, please share with your recruiter.
