  • Aliquot urine and/or oral fluid specimens for sample preparation procedures
  • Perform sample preparation techniques including specimen hydrolysis, solid phase extraction, and liquid-liquid extraction in accordance with laboratory SOPs
  • Prepare samples for liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC/MS-MS) analysis
  • Prepare and restock reagents and buffers as needed
  • Assist with maintaining adequate inventory of laboratory supplies
  • Troubleshoot issues as necessary and escalate when appropriate
  • Maintain accurate records associated with specimen preparation and chain of custody
  • Perform other duties as assigned, consistent with education, training, and abilities

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science-related field required (Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Biomedical/Pre-Med, Forensics, or Toxicology) required
  • Laboratory experience preferred
  • Data entry skills (alpha and numeric keyboarding) required
  • Strong hand-eye coordination required
  • Ability to work in a high-volume environment while maintaining a high level of quality and accuracy required

Benefits

Cordant supports employees by offering a comprehensive benefits package to eligible staff (per state regulations), including:

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) • Paid Time Off (PTO) beginning Day 1 • Volunteer Time Off (VTO) • Paid Holidays • 401(k) with Company Match • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability (STD/LTD) • Company-Paid Basic Life Insurance #LAB123

title: Freelance Brand Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Brand Designer to join the Tendem project (** and create strong visual identities for real-world brands and products.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in brand strategy, visual identity, and design systems to create cohesive, modern, and impactful brand assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in brand asset creation, visual identity development, and maintaining brand consistency.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Brand Designer, your focus will be on brand asset creation, visual identity, and brand consistency. We need a core specialist dedicated to building a strong visual foundation. You will serve as the architect of the brand identity, modernizing aesthetics and ensuring that all visual touchpoints look cohesive across various mediums using industry-standard design tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop foundational brand assets, including logos, complete visual identities, and comprehensive color schemes.
  • Create, systematically organize, and deliver necessary variations of core brand elements.
  • Act as the strict gatekeeper for brand consistency across all internal and external materials, including pitch decks and social media kits.
  • Build scalable, long-lasting visual systems that align with modern design standards.
  • Enforce design quality through cross-platform validation, ensuring brand aesthetics translate flawlessly across both digital and print mediums.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in brand design, graphic design, art direction, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communication Design, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on brand identity creation, logo design, and comprehensive brand guidelines. We are looking for specialists with a deep understanding of how core branding translates seamlessly across different digital and print mediums. A strategic, detail-obsessed approach and the ability to work independently to build long-lasting visual systems are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Brand Identity Creation: Expertise in building foundational assets from scratch, including scalable logos, distinct color palettes, and typography systems.
  • Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma for crafting and managing core design assets.
  • Cross-Medium Adaptation: Proven ability to translate brand DNA perfectly across varied formats, from digital social media kits to corporate pitch decks and print materials.
  • Brand System Architecture: Strong organizational skills to develop clear brand guidelines, style guides, and structured asset libraries for wider team use.

Additional requirements

  • A strategic, detail-obsessed mindset focused on long-term brand equity.
  • Strong dedication to visual consistency and functioning as a true brand gatekeeper.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver high-quality assets.
  • Portfolio showcasing branding work (logos, identity systems, guidelines) must be included in the CV
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Overlæge(r), til sengeafsnit, Psykiatrien Øst
description:
Vi kom ikke helt i mål med første opslag, så vi udvider stadig, vil du med på holdet – og være med til at forme fremtiden for en psykiatri i positiv forandring.

I en tid med fokus på udvikling og 10 årsplan, lofter over speciallæger er vi glade for at kunne sige vi har mulighed for flere på holdet i vores sengepsykiatri.

Nedenfor er den vanlige tekst som alle kender, men nok de færreste læser – så her er et par bullets.

  • Vi søger 2-3 speciallæger for at udvide vores faglighed og behandlingstilbud i vores senge
  • Der er mulighed for ledelse, eller lektoropgaver
  • Vi har forskellige muligheder ift. hvor intensivt / åbent man har interesse for
  • Vi pryder os af fleksibilitet og mulighed for indflydelse på alt fra vagtplan og udvikling
  • Vi går højt op i at udvikle kompetencer til fælles gavn for patienter og kollegaer
  • Vi har stort fokus på supervision og det gode læringsmiljø
  • Vi tror på rette match, ikke på at fylde stolene op for enhver pris

Vi foretrækker at drikke en kop kaffe og være nysgerrige på hinandens ønsker tanker, muligheder og behov end at gætte os til konklusioner og lader muligheder gå tabt – så slå på tråden og lad os hilse på hinanden, uforpligtigende og fortroligt.

Bredt patientbillede

Vores sengeafsnit modtager og behandler patienter i alderen 18-75 år. Vi får plads til 14 patienter, og behandler blandt andet patienter med psykiatriske lidelser som skizofreni og andre psykoser, svære depressioner og bipolare sygdomme samt svære personlighedsforstyrrelser. Vi ser ind i en proces med at stratificere vores patienter, men har ikke diagnose-afsnit eller bopæls-afsnit, vi tror på bredden men selvfølgelig med særlige kompetencer historisk set.

Indlæggelsesforløbene strækker sig typisk over gennemsnitligt 3 uger og ofte i tæt samarbejde med ambulante forløb i Distriktspsykiatrien, hvor der arbejdes efter FACT-modellen.

Afsnitsledelserne består af 1 ledende overlæge og 2 oversygeplejerske – en til hver etage og alle oversygeplejerskestillinger er her besat.

Hvad ønsker vi af dig

  • At du er en engageret og fleksibel speciallæge i psykiatri med bred klinisk erfaring
  • At du har lyst til og erfaring med behandling af psykotiske lidelser
  • At du har gode samarbejdsevner
  • At du har lyst til at indgå i den fortsatte udvikling af afsnittet bl.a. via erfaring med eller interesse for kvalitetsudvikling
  • At du opfylder Sundhedsstyrelsens 7 kvalifikationskrav svarende til de 7 lægeroller
  • At du indgår i undervisning af lægestuderende, læger under uddannelse samt uddannelse og supervision af andre faggrupper på lige fod med de øvrige speciallæger.

Vi kan tilbyde dig

  • Et afsnit præget af en personalegruppe som vægter faglig udvikling højt
  • Et godt kollegialt og lægefagligt samarbejde
  • Supervision
  • Gode muligheder for efteruddannelse og forskning
  • Årlig personaletræning for eget afsnit
  • At dialog, formidling af informationer, processer og beslutninger vægtes højt
  • Vi sætter pris på ”Den gode tone” og ”Den gode ånd”.

Lidt om din kommende arbejdsplads

Psykiatrien Øst har i alt 82 senge, heraf har Psykiatrisk Akut Modtagelse 8 åbne senge.

Der findes bla. Distriktspsykiatri i Køge og Roskilde, Distriktspsykiatri for Ældre. Psykiatrisk klinik, der behandler ikke-psykotiske tilstande, hertil kommer Klinik for Selvmordsforebyggelse.

Vi har Regionsfunktioner for bl.a. angst, personlighedsforstyrrelse, udviklingsforstyrrelser, skizofreni og andre psykoser.

Vi er forskningsaktive bl.a. inden for områderne: Personlighedsforstyrrelser og debuterende psykoser (OPUS) samt Recovery. Forskningen foregår i samarbejde med den Psykiatriske Forskningsenhed. Vi har i skrivende stund 2 professorer tilknyttet; Julie Nordgaard og Mads Gram, samt emeritus Erik Simonsen

Vi har fokus på evidens, kvalitetssikring og patientsikkerhed, og behandlingen er baseret på dialog og relationer i intensive behandlingsforløb.

Der er i alt ansat ca. 20 speciallæger i Psykiatrien Øst, og vi gør meget både for den faglige udvikling og på det kollegiale område.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer, med tilknyttet vagt forpligtigelse (Beredskabsvagt jf. OK.

Udover Beredskabsfunktionen indeholder ordningen også delvagt i tidsrummet kl. 9.00-15.00 i weekender og på helligdage ved geografien i Roskilde.

Der er gode og hurtige trafikale forbindelser til Roskilde fra f.eks. København, selv med DSB’s renommé.

Sammenhæng og perspektiv for patienten

Du skal være med til at skabe sammenhæng i patientforløb og være en aktiv medspiller i indsatsen for nedbringelse af tvang i psykiatrien samt arbejde med Safewards og Second opinion.

Du skal kunne bidrage til udredning, psykiatrisk testning og medicinsk behandling, og for vores yngre læger deltage i klinisk struktureret observation.

Patienterne møder et miljø, hvor håb og muligheder er i fokus. Aktiviteter og psykoedukation er en del af behandlingsplanen. Dine handlinger sker på basis af patienternes individuelle behov og ud fra koordinerede og fagligt funderede hensyn - ikke ud fra firkantede regler.

Vi arbejder med udviklingen af en Recoveryorienteret psykiatri med brugerinddragelse på alle niveauer og sammenhæng i alle patientforløb. Det er en psykiatri, hvor patienterne gerne vil modtage behandling og medarbejderne gerne vil arbejde.

Vi er sammen om aktiviteter. Det daglige morgenmøde er vores omdrejningspunkt. Her planlægger vi dagens aktiviteter sammen med hinanden og sammen med patienterne, vi drøfter fælles anliggender og giver informationer. Patientaktiviteterne kan bestå af motion, kreative aktiviteter, psykoedukation eller social miljøterapi. Det kan også foregå udendørs.

Har du behov for flere oplysninger?

Kontakt Cheflæge Nicolas Hansen

Mail: nicolh@regionsjaelland.dk

Mobil: 93568534

Ansøgningen skal indeholde:

Ansøgning med oplysning om cpr.nr., eksamensår og resultat, tidligere ansættelse og bør desuden indeholde oplysninger vedrørende opnåede kompetencer i relation til de 7 kvalifikationer, som kræves af ansøgere til overlæge stillinger, jfr. Sundhedsstyrelsens vejledning nr. 62 af 25. juli 2005.

Ansøger skal have været ansat som afdelingslæge eller tilsvarende inden for det pågældende speciale eller fagområde i en samlet periode på minimum 5 år, efter opnået speciallægeanerkendelse.

Dispensation fra ovennævnte 5-årsregel kan i særlige tilfælde gives.Psykiatriledelsens dispensation er en betingelse for ansættelse.

Besøg os

Du er meget velkommen til at komme på et uforpligtende besøg eller du kan ringe og høre nærmere.

Du vil blive ansat efter overenskomsten indgået mellem Region Sjælland og FAS.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

title: Senior Solution Architect til løsninger med samfundsmæssig betydning
description:
Vil du sætte den arkitektoniske retning for komplekse IT-løsninger?
Trives du i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, teknologi og udviklingsteams?
Og vil du bruge din erfaring på løsninger, der understøtter nogle af Danmarks vigtigste samfundsfunktioner? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Som Senior Solution Architect hos os tager du ansvar for løsningsarkitekturen i vores projekter og produkter. Du bliver en central sparringspartner for både forretningen, udviklingsteams og andre arkitekter, når vi omsætter behov og krav til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis.

Du får stor indflydelse på de tekniske og arkitektoniske beslutninger og mulighed for at sætte retning på tværs af både projekter og arkitekturpraksis. Samtidig bliver du en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi udfordrer hinanden, deler viden og udvikler vores måde at arbejde med løsningsarkitektur på.

Dine opgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • designe og videreudvikle IT-løsninger, der skaber sammenhæng mellem forretningens behov, eksisterende systemer og nye teknologiske muligheder.
  • tage ansvar for løsningsarkitekturen i projekter og produkter, herunder afklare arkitektoniske spørgsmål og anbefale tekniske løsninger og designvalg.
  • samarbejde med forretningen, udviklingsteams, specialister og arkitektkolleger om at sikre, at løsningerne kan implementeres, driftes og videreudvikles.
  • udarbejde løsningsdesigns og arkitekturbeslutninger med fokus på integrationer, applikationsarkitektur, data, sikkerhed og cloud-teknologier.
  • bidrage til arkitekturreviews, faglige drøftelser og videndeling på tværs af ATP.
  • være med til at videreudvikle vores arkitekturpraksis gennem fælles principper, metoder og standarder.

Hvem er du?

Du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse og flere års erfaring som Solution Architect eller i en tilsvarende rolle. Du har arbejdet med løsningsarkitektur i større IT-projekter og kender samspillet mellem applikationer, integrationer, data og infrastrukturløsninger.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • kan omsætte forretningsmæssige og tekniske krav til konkrete løsningsdesigns og arkitekturbeslutninger
  • har erfaring med moderne arkitekturprincipper og teknologier inden for eksempelvis cloud, API'er og data
  • trives med at skabe fremdrift gennem dialog og samarbejde med både udviklere, specialister og forretningsområder
  • deler viden aktivt og bidrager til at udvikle kolleger og den samlede faglighed i organisationen.

Hvem er vi?
I Solution Architecture har vi ansvaret for løsningsarkitekturen i ATP’s projekter og produkter. Vores opgave er at sikre, at nye og eksisterende løsninger hænger sammen, understøtter forretningens behov og lever op til de tekniske krav og standarder, vi arbejder efter.

Vi er 15 arkitekter med forskellige baggrunde og specialer. Hverdagen spænder fra videreudvikling af etablerede løsninger til større projekter, hvor nye teknologier skal bringes i spil. Den enkelte Solution Architect har et stort ansvar for egne områder, men vi bruger også hinanden aktivt til faglig sparring, reviews og fælles problemløsning.

Hos os er der plads til faglige diskussioner, forskellige perspektiver og humor i hverdagen. Vi arbejder målrettet med at udvikle vores faglighed gennem videndeling, faglige sessioner og arkitekturreviews, og du får mulighed for at præge både vores løsninger og den måde, vi arbejder med arkitektur på.

Sådan ansøger du
Send os dit CV hurtigst muligt. Når du sender dit CV via vores system, får du mulighed for kort at beskrive din motivation for at søge stillingen.

I ATP arbejder vi for en fair rekrutteringsproces, og derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte billede i dit CV eller angive din alder, når du søger.

Vi ansætter på baggrund af kompetencer og potentiale og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset køn og kønsidentitet, etnicitet, national, social og kulturel baggrund, religion eller tro, seksuel orientering, funktionsnedsættelse og alder.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og tager opslaget ned, når vi har fundet vores nye kollega.

Du kan læse mere om rekrutteringsforløbet her:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Solutions Architecture Peter Bech på tlf. 4147 3013 eller mail pebe@atp.dk.

Af sikkerhedsmæssige årsager og for at beskytte værdier og datainfrastruktur beder vi om straffeattest, kopi af dit pas og eventuelt eksamensbevis. Straffeattesten må ikke give anledning til bemærkninger, og dokumenterne slettes umiddelbart efter vurdering.

Til annoncører og rekrutteringsbureauer: ATP frabeder sig uopfordrede henvendelser om annoncering, kandidater, produkter og ydelser i forbindelse med stillingsopslag og rekrutteringer. Vi beder om, at dette respekteres, og at vores ledere og medarbejdere ikke kontaktes i den henseende.

title: Facility Maintenance Tech/Automation ll
description:
At SanMar, the work you do makes a difference.

Location: 10462 Hickory Hill Rd. Ashland, VA 23005

Shifts Available: Monday through Friday, 2:30pm - 11pm, and Sunday through Thursday, 10pm-6:30am

Pay Range: $23.50 - $30.30

This position includes a $3,000 sign on bonus

Terms & Conditions
 All candidates who meet the essential qualifications for the position will be considered for employment
consistent with SanMar’s policies and procedures.
 Employee must be actively employed on the date of payout to receive the bonus.
 Agency staffing is not eligible for bonus. If hired as direct employee of SanMar from an agency,
employee is eligible for bonus.
 For rehired employees: no sign on bonus provided if employee received any sign on payment in the 12
months immediately preceding their new date of hire.

Job Summary

The Facilities III, AutoStore Technician is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing material handling equipment and building systems within a fast-paced distribution center environment. This position supports operational efficiency by performing preventive maintenance, coordinating vendor activities, responding to maintenance needs, and ensuring equipment operates safely and effectively. The role requires strong mechanical aptitude, attention to detail, and a commitment to safety and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Material Handling Equipment Maintenance

  • Perform minor and major repairs on material handling equipment, including AutoStore systems.
  • Diagnose mechanical issues and restore equipment to operational condition.
  • Assist with equipment lockout/tagout procedures as needed.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Conduct scheduled preventive maintenance on conveyor systems and other mechanical equipment.
  • Inspect belts, bearings, seals, filters, and fluid levels.
  • Repair or replace worn or damaged components.

Building Systems Support

  • Coordinate and work with external contractors and vendors involved in installation, commissioning, and maintenance projects.
  • Monitor building systems and ensure equipment is functioning properly.
  • Operate computerized systems that control and monitor mechanical and utility equipment when required.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Complete daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance checklists.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and service documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, OSHA requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Maintain HAZMAT-related records and documentation.

Operational Support

  • Respond promptly and professionally to maintenance requests and operational issues.
  • Support emergency maintenance activities as needed.
  • Obtain repair estimates and order replacement parts when necessary.
  • Recommend maintenance improvements, process enhancements, and cost-saving initiatives.

Additional Duties

  • Perform outside custodial responsibilities, including snow removal when required.
  • Operate powered lift equipment following safety standards and certification requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 4-6 years of facility maintenance, conveyor maintenance, industrial equipment repair, or related experience.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical systems, conveyors, motors, bearings, and material handling equipment.
  • Experience using hand and power tools safely and effectively.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with AutoStore systems or automated material handling equipment.
  • Experience operating powered industrial equipment (forklifts, lifts, etc.).
  • Knowledge of lockout/tagout procedures and OSHA regulations.
  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office and maintenance tracking systems.

Physical Requirements

  • Frequently stand, walk, bend, kneel, squat, climb stairs, and reach throughout the workday.
  • Frequently lift and move up to 60 pounds.
  • Work around conveyors, powered equipment, forklifts, and other mechanized systems.
  • Ability to work in varying temperatures and warehouse conditions.

Why Join Our Team?

You'll play a critical role in keeping our automated distribution operation running safely and efficiently. This position offers hands-on work with advanced material handling technology, opportunities for skill development, and the chance to directly impact operational success.

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand,

walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee operates powered

equipment requiring use of both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is

frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The

employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this

job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may

be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Employee will be required to wear Personal protective

equipment such as a Protective harness while operating equipment. Basic English literacy is required for operation

of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy.

The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced.The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

Why Work at SanMar?

Our people are at the heart of everything we do. They bring their talent, passion and dedication to work with them every day. Their hard work inspires us and gives us purpose. We love working here together.

Whether you work in our headquarters, from your home or in one of our distribution centers across North America, we believe that investing in you is just the right thing to do. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your health and well-being, life balance, career growth and (eventually) retirement.

SanMar works with brands you already know, like Nike, The North Face and Brooks Brothers, as well as providing industry-leading private label apparel and accessories. Our people come to work excited to do their part, providing clothing that helps people feel that they’re a part of something special.

Here’s your chance to be a part of this story. If you’re ready to work in a place where your participation matters and your growth is a priority, we’re ready for you.

SanMar is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, whoever you love or follow in faith, whatever your disability or superpower status, whichever ethnicity or gender you identify with, you are welcome at SanMar.

SanMar participates in E-Verify.

title: Echo Cardiac Technologist
description:
Sign-on bonus available for eligible applicants!

The Technologist would qualify for shift differentials!

Performs, administers & monitors Cardio-Diagnostic tests with primary emphasis on cardiac sonography and doppler studies. Administers all Cardio-Diagnostic tests. Provides physician with preliminary findings of recorded data through monitoring and performing the necessary calculations, in a timely fashion while demonstrating the appropriate knowledge and skills necessary to work with patients from pediatric through geriatric. Follows physician's instructions, prepares and operates equipment and positions patients correctly in order to record the requested diagnostic images. Treats patients with care and respect.

Title of the Position: In Process QA Specialist (Full Time)

At Nivagen as an In Process QA Specialist you will be responsible for ensuring that pharmaceutical products meet quality standards during the manufacturing process. This role involves real-time monitoring, sampling, testing, and documentation to identify and address any quality issues as they arise, ensuring that all production activities comply with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and regulatory requirements.

  • High level of attention to detail, particularly in identifying quality deviations and documenting production processes
  • Proficiency in using quality testing equipment and familiarity with statistical process control (SPC) methods

title: Railroad Switchman/Conductor
description:
Railroad Switchman / Conductor

Road & Rail Services
Location: Greensburg, IN
Starting Pay: $21.50 per hour
Job Type: Full-Time | On-Site

Work Hands-On in Railroad Operations

Road & Rail Services is hiring a Railroad Switchman / Conductor to join our operation in Greensburg, Indiana. This position works directly with railcars, track switches, and rail crews to help safely move and position equipment throughout the facility.

This is an active railroad job-not a warehouse position. You'll spend much of your shift outdoors, walking the rail yard, operating track switches, coupling and uncoupling railcars, communicating with the locomotive operator, and helping coordinate safe rail movements.

Previous railroad experience is preferred but not required. Training will be provided to dependable candidates who demonstrate strong safety awareness, good communication skills, and the ability to learn railroad operating procedures.

Experience in railroad operations, manufacturing, construction, heavy equipment, transportation, logistics, agriculture, industrial operations, or other physically demanding outdoor work may transfer well to this position.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Switchman / Conductor, you will work closely with other members of the rail crew to coordinate safe and efficient railcar movements.

Daily responsibilities may include:

Assist with switching, spotting, pulling, and positioning railcars

Throw and line manual track switches for planned rail movements

Couple and uncouple railcars as required

Communicate movement instructions to locomotive operators

Use two-way radios and approved hand signals to communicate with crew members

Verify tracks and routes are properly aligned before rail movements occur

Observe railcar movement and maintain safe clearance from moving equipment

Inspect tracks, switches, railcars, and work areas for visible hazards or defects

Apply or remove required railcar securement devices

Confirm railcars are safely positioned and secured

Climb rail equipment when necessary to perform assigned duties

Walk throughout the rail yard over ballast, tracks, and uneven surfaces

Maintain constant awareness of locomotives, railcars, vehicles, equipment, and coworkers

Immediately report damaged equipment, unsafe conditions, or operational concerns

Follow all Road & Rail Services, customer, and railroad safety procedures

Properly wear and maintain all required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

What We're Looking For

Railroad switching requires employees who can remain alert, communicate clearly, and follow established procedures every time.

Qualified candidates should have:

Valid state-issued driver's license

Reliable transportation to the Greensburg facility

Strong safety awareness and situational judgment

Ability to understand and follow detailed operating instructions

Ability to communicate clearly by radio and in person

Dependable attendance and punctuality

Ability to work effectively as part of a railroad crew

Willingness to learn railroad switching procedures

Ability to perform physically demanding work throughout the shift

Comfort working around moving railcars, locomotives, tracks, and industrial equipment

Previous Switchman, Conductor, Brakeman, railroad, rail yard, manufacturing, heavy-equipment, or industrial experience is a plus.

Physical & Outdoor Work Environment

This position is performed primarily outdoors in an active railroad environment. Employees must be prepared to work in heat, cold, rain, snow, wind, and other changing Indiana weather conditions.

The job requires frequent walking and standing, including travel across railroad ballast and uneven surfaces. Employees must also be able to bend, reach, climb, and perform the physical activities necessary to operate switches, couple or uncouple equipment, and complete other switching duties.

Rail operations may require schedules outside of traditional Monday-through-Friday business hours. Candidates should be prepared for operational schedules that may include weekends, holidays, or varying work hours based on customer needs.

Pay & Benefits

Starting Pay: $21.50 per hour

Road & Rail Services offers eligible full-time employees:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

401(k) retirement plan with company match

Paid holidays

Paid vacation

Annual steel-toe boot allowance

Company-provided PPE

Safety and railroad operations training

Career development opportunities

Opportunities for advancement

Promote-from-within culture

Veteran-friendly workplace

Join Road & Rail Services

Established in 1987, Road & Rail Services provides rail-related operational and maintenance services throughout North America. Our teams support railroads, manufacturers, rail shippers, and owners of rail equipment and facilities.

If you're looking for a hands-on opportunity where you can work directly with railcars, switching operations, and railroad equipment, apply today for our Railroad Switchman / Conductor position in Greensburg, IN.

Starting pay is $21.50 per hour.

title: Sr Manufacturing Technician
description:
As a Sr Manufacturing Technician here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will provide technical expertise to ensure the smooth operation of manufacturing processes and systems. Your leadership and technical skills will contribute to the success of our projects and the overall growth of our business.

In this role, you will have a significant impact on our business unit by providing technical support, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring the quality and efficiency of our manufacturing processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and implement best practices. Your attention to detail and ability to solve complex problems will be instrumental in meeting project deadlines and delivering high-quality results.

The annual base salary range for this position is $65,000- $84,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations

As a Sr Manufacturing Technician here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will report directly to our ISC Production Supervisor and you’ll work out of our Plymouth, MN location.

This position is Weekdays Mon-Thurs 6:00AM-4:30PM

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform complex assembly and testing of products according to work instructions and quality standards
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in the manufacturing process
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams to improve manufacturing processes and resolve issues
  • Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards
  • Maintain accurate documentation of assembly and testing processes

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Manufacturing Technician or a related role
  • Strong technical skills in mechanical systems and components
  • Experience leading a team of technicians
  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment

WE VALUE

  • Knowledge of industry standards and best practices
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment

BENEFITS

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
• Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
• Short-term and long-term disability coverage
• 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
• Employee assistance program and educational assistance
• Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
• Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time
Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/

ABOUT HONEYWELL AEROSPACE

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

THE BUSINESS UNIT


Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space. We operate through three business areas:
• Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft
• Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying
• Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board

With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses:

Honeywell Aerospace is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status. Learn more (https://www.honeywellaerospace.com/us/en/company/inclusion-and-engagement)

title: Field CTO
description:
Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

The Field CTO will serve as the executive technology voice, technology champion, and trusted executive advisor for our Enterprise Advisory & Solution Architecture practice. This is a senior, client-facing role where you build peer-level relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and transformation leaders, shape market narrative through industry presence and analyst engagement, and translate technology direction into business outcomes that executives can fund and govern.

You operate across multiple strategic accounts, set technology vision that influences how we advise, sell, and deliver, and use your credibility to create demand, expand strategic relationships, unlock and shape large transformation opportunities, and contribute to growth. You work closely with pursuit, delivery, engineering, practice, and partner teams, but your primary lane is advisory, market presence, and offering strategy, not day-to-day deal mechanics.

This is a matrix leadership role. You lead outcomes across pursuit, delivery, and partner teams through influence, executive alignment, and decision ownership, without relying on direct line management authority. You co-own portfolio-level results with practice leadership.

Responsibilities

Executive Advisory and Peer Relationships

  • Set credible technology vision and multi-year transformation strategy that executives can fund, sequence, and govern.
  • Frame decisions in business terms by explaining options, tradeoffs, enterprise risk, and expected value.
  • Champion technical debt elimination and modernization with client technology leaders to unlock value and create demand for transformation.
  • Connect technology investment to enterprise value by helping executives define measurable outcomes, adoption requirements, operating model implications, and governance needed to realize the expected business benefit.

Market Presence and Thought Leadership

  • Act as a named external technology voice across client forums, executive briefings, industry conferences, partner events, and analyst sessions.
  • Publish points of view, briefings, and narratives that establish the practice as a market leader.
  • Engage with industry analysts, sourcing advisors, consulting firms, and ecosystem partners to shape opportunities and influence market perception.
  • Build market awareness and excitement around our capabilities in ways that unlock large transformation opportunities, expand the scope of existing opportunities, and create new ones.

Partner Ecosystem Leadership

  • Cultivate senior relationships with Microsoft field teams, ISVs, platform partners, and the broader technology ecosystem to identify and shape joint opportunities.
  • Drive partner-influenced pipeline and co-sell success through joint solutioning, executive relationships, and coordinated pursuit execution.
  • Stay current on partner roadmaps and platform direction and translate that into client options and offering decisions.
  • Connect 3Cloud and Microsoft capabilities with the broader technology ecosystem, industry expertise, and partner landscape to shape differentiated client solutions and opportunities.
  • Position Microsoft technologies credibly within heterogeneous enterprise environments, understanding how they integrate and coexist with other cloud, data, AI, SaaS, and enterprise platforms.

Leadership

  • Set consistent technical direction and quality standards, build capability through coaching and communities of practice, and represent the practice in executive and cross-practice planning.
  • Model the 3Cloud Way to Lead through personal, organizational, and business leadership, building trust across organizational boundaries, developing people, and operating with a strategic and enterprise mindset.
  • Serve as a senior technology leadership interface across advisory, pursuit, engineering, and delivery, ensuring executive technology strategy remains grounded in what can be successfully engineered, operated, and scaled.

Solution and Offering Strategy

  • Shape the portfolio across Applications, Cloud Platforms, and Data & AI so it is technically sound, deliverable at scale, and aligned with market demand.
  • Sponsor reference architectures, solution playbooks, accelerators, and guardrails that improve win rate and delivery consistency across the firm.
  • Set technical direction on principled tradeoffs across speed versus quality, custom build versus platform, and innovation versus stability at a portfolio level.
  • Connect lessons from strategic client engagements, Microsoft, and the broader technology ecosystem back into offering strategy and capability development.

Pursuit Influence and Technical Win

  • Champion priority pursuits through executive credibility, solution strategy, and competitive positioning grounded in delivery reality.
  • Engage early on the highest-stakes opportunities to surface outcomes, constraints, and enterprise risks and to shape the opportunity before it is fully formed.
  • Champion technology choices and tradeoffs with clients as they evaluate recommended solutions and lead solution defense alongside pursuit and delivery teams.
  • Create executive-level demand and help expand individual technology initiatives into broader transformation opportunities where client outcomes support it.
  • Step in when stakes are high, decisions are contested, or executive alignment is at risk and restore clarity on the path forward.

Innovation and Horizon Scanning

  • Track emerging technology and industry shifts through Microsoft, partner roadmaps, and direct ecosystem dialogue, and evaluate them based on enterprise applicability and business value rather than technology novelty alone.
  • Translate innovation into clear client recommendations, pilot approaches, and phased adoption paths that balance value, risk, and operational readiness.
  • Maintain executive-level fluency in emerging AI capabilities, including generative AI, agentic systems, AI-enabled engineering, governance, security, and responsible enterprise adoption.
  • Educate sales, pursuit, and delivery teams on key components, trends, and capabilities so they can recognize and act on opportunities.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Field CTO, Principal CTO, Chief Architect, Distinguished Architect, or equivalent external-facing technology leader for an enterprise modernization, cloud, AI, or technology transformation practice.
  • Executive-level technology leadership experience advising and/or directly leading complex enterprise technology organizations, including significant C-suite interaction and a track record of building peer-level relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and transformation leaders at Fortune 500 or comparable enterprises.
  • Demonstrated industry voice through keynotes, published points of view, briefings, podcasts, analyst engagement, or other recognized external forums.
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure architecture, including enterprise-scale adoption, governance, security, integration, and modernization.
  • Experience setting technology direction across Applications, Cloud Platforms, and Data & AI, including operating model and governance implications.
  • Executive-level understanding of enterprise AI strategy and the implications of generative AI, agentic systems, data foundations, governance, security, and responsible adoption.
  • Ability to credibly advise executives on integrating Microsoft technologies with non-Microsoft cloud, data, AI, SaaS, and enterprise platforms.
  • Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate technology decisions into business impact, investment choices, constraints, and risk.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect technology strategy to investment, commercial outcomes, delivery economics, and measurable enterprise value.
  • Experience influencing large pursuits through credibility and solution strategy rather than pursuit mechanics.
  • Demonstrated ability to shape offerings, accelerators, platforms, or reusable intellectual property that improved pipeline, win rate, market differentiation, or delivery consistency.
  • Established senior relationships with hyperscaler and platform partners and the ability to drive joint solutioning and co-sell.
  • Experience leading through matrix influence across account, engineering, security, delivery, practice, and partner stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, coaching, and mentoring senior architects or technology leaders.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25 percent as needed.
  • Maintain, or be willing to obtain and maintain, relevant professional certifications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with hybrid environments and other cloud platforms, such as AWS and Google Cloud.
  • Prior CTO, CIO, Chief Architect, Distinguished Architect, VP of Engineering, or equivalent experience at an enterprise, software vendor, consulting organization, or hyperscaler.
  • Experience presenting in executive forums, steering committees, board-level settings, analyst briefings, or named industry events.
  • Experience operating within complex, highly regulated, or distributed enterprise environments.
  • Experience working across global or multicultural organizations and complex matrixed structures.

About the Opportunity

This role is part of a broader technology leadership model across 3Cloud. The Field CTO brings deep Microsoft ecosystem expertise, industry perspective, executive advisory, and enterprise technology strategy, and collaborates with technology leaders across AI, industry, engineering, and the partner ecosystem.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At 3Cloud, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

At this time, we cannot sponsor applicants for work visas.

title: COOP - EPPA III
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

This position will report to the Supervisor of the Emergency and Continuity Management Group (ECMG) within the Protective Services Division, Security Operations Section. The primary focus of this role will be to provide Continuity of Operations (COOP) Planning at JPL. Responsibilities include reviewing and maintaining current COOP plans, delivering program training, developing and executing ongoing exercises at domestic and international facilities, and preparing and submitting required COOP reports. Additionally, this position is expected to provide expert support to the ECMG across various emergency management areas, including Emergency Operations Center processes, Group software development, volunteer resource development, and other tasks as needed.

The COOP role within the Emergency and Continuity Management Group tackles a wide range of traditional and emerging challenges. The work is highly diverse, requiring diplomatic and tactful communication, as well as a demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships, foster teamwork, and encourage collaboration. If this dynamic environment excites you and you’re motivated to help sustain the continuity of space exploration and discovery, we encourage you to apply.

**Required Qualifications:**

- **Education & Experience:** Typically requires a bachelor’s degree in emergency management, Public Administration, or a related field with 6 years of experience; master’s degree with 4 years of experience; or a PhD with 2 years of experience.
- **COOP Expertise:** Extensive understanding and practical application of advanced COOP principles, theories, concepts, and techniques.
- **Program Knowledge:** Advanced knowledge of devolution and reconstitution procedures and policies.
- **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- **Problem Solving:** Excellent critical thinking skills with a creative, flexible approach to overcoming challenges.
- **Quality Assurance:** High standards for project quality and compliance.
- **Must be a U.S. Citizen with an active Top Secret (TS) or the ability to obtain that level of clearance based upon Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI).**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- CEM - Certified Emergency Manager
- COOP experience in a Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC)
- Professional or Master Professional Continuity Practitioner - FEMA
- Certified Business Continuity Professional or strong working knowledge of Business Continuity Planning

JPL has a catalog of benefits and perks that span from the traditional to the unique. This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. Our focus is on work-life balance, and living healthy, fulfilling lives as we Dare Mighty Things Together. For benefits eligible positions, benefits are effective the first day of the month coincident with or immediately following the employee’s start date.

For further benefits information click [Benefits and Perks](https://www.jpl.jobs/benefits-perks)

In extending an offer, Jet Propulsion Laboratory considers factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s job related skills, experience, knowledge, and relevant education/training.

$118,144 - $145,184

JPL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy or perceived pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, protected military or veteran status or any other characteristic or condition protected by Federal, state or local law.

title: Senior Tech QA Analyst - Audio
description:
CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Tech QA Analyst - Audio to take ownership of quality, stability and performance across our shared audio technologies.

Working closely with Audio Code, Sound Design, Music and QA teams, you will be responsible for validating complex audio systems, investigating difficult technical problems and building effective testing solutions. You will work across C++, Unreal Engine and Wwise, using debugging and profiling tools to understand not only when something fails, but why.

As a Senior, you will own complex technical quality topics end-to-end, make risk-based recommendations, develop testing and automation solutions, improve pipelines and practices, and help other QA team members grow their technical capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the stability, performance, and quality of shared audio systems throughout the entire development lifecycle.
  • Create comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans to identify technical risks early and define effective validation approaches.
  • Conduct deep-dive investigations and root-cause analysis on complex audio issues using C++, Unreal Engine, and Wwise.
  • Monitor and validate audio system performance metrics, including CPU usage, memory, streaming, and runtime behavior.
  • Design and maintain automated testing solutions, functional test environments, and debugging tools to increase investigation efficiency.
  • Work closely with Audio Code and Design teams to evaluate technical solutions and provide data-driven quality recommendations.
  • Drive improvements to testing pipelines, workflows, and QA practices by researching and integrating new testing technologies.
  • Manage technical QA efforts across in-house and external teams to ensure consistent coverage for complex audio features.
  • Elevate team capabilities through clear technical documentation, knowledge sharing, workshops, and mentoring.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in technical QA, software testing, or game development with a focus on complex technical systems.
  • Proven track record of owning quality, stability, and performance for technical features throughout the development cycle.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Unreal Engine and C++, with the ability to read, investigate, and debug production code.
  • Proficiency with audio middleware like Wwise, including technical debugging and performance profiling.
  • Expertise in using diagnostic and profiling tools such as Unreal Insights, PIX, or Razor to analyze performance data, logs, and traces.
  • Experience designing and implementing automated or programmatic testing solutions, pipelines, and internal tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis across complex systems to identify and resolve technical issues.
  • Skill in designing comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans for technically complex features.
  • Ability to assess technical quality risks and data-driven insights to make actionable recommendations.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in game audio technology, technical audio, or Audio QA with a shipped PC or console title.
  • Hands-on programming experience, including implementing fixes, tooling, or production features.
  • Expertise in creating test frameworks, internal QA tools, and custom testing infrastructure.
  • Experience with automated testing integrated into CI or development pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of audio programming concepts (DSP, mixing, streaming, voice management) and engine-level performance optimization.
  • Advanced Wwise skills, including integration, optimization, and complex profiling.
  • Experience creating debug levels, instrumentation, or visualization tools for complex systems.

Working mode

Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time or hybrid mode.

Relocation Support

  • Relocation package – flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet, shipping your belongings — it’s all covered.
  • Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you, assistance with finding residence, tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of.
  • Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too.

Health & Well-Being

  • Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
  • Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
  • Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
  • Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives.
  • Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
  • Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain.
  • RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events.
  • RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majority paid by the company.

Perks & Professional Growth

  • A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
  • Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
  • REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.
  • Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!

Social Activities & Life in the Office

  • Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
  • Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
  • Healthy selections — ​​canteens.
  • Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
  • Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog.
  • A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.
  • An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes.
  • No dress-code — we like to keep it casual.

Estimated pay range for this position: 14 200 - 24 400 PLN gross monthly.
Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications.

title: Business Systems Analyst III
description:
Overview

This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following location(s): New Jersey and North Carolina

This position delivers strategic insight into Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance processes, technology controls, and business systems through complex analysis, reporting, and operational activities. Serves as a subject matter expert on SDLC governance requirements, procedures, and compliance/adherence. Expert on SDLC governance requirements and implement appropriate processes, standards, and monitoring activities to ensure compliance and continuous improvement.

The role is responsible for supporting the implementation, adoption, and enablement of SDLC governance requirements across technology and business teams. This includes partnering with application development, business/product, and risk stakeholders to drive awareness, consistency, and adherence to established SDLC procedures. Assists in identifying and resolving process issues, which may involve adherence and governance reviews, reporting development, or governance process improvements.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Responsibilities & Qualifications


Data Analysis - Sources, compiles, and interprets data. Analyzes data for accuracy and efficiencies, effectively communicates analysis output.
Identifying Requirements - Determines system requirements and communicates them through the use of specifications, reports, project plans, or other forms of documentation. Identifies issues that affect system processes, and assists in correcting. Ensures compliance through testing and analysis.
Reporting - Produces advanced reporting based on data analysis, user input, and system testing. Identifies patterns, problems, and areas of improvement. May develop process enhancements based on analysis results.
System Support - Provides expert technical support for systems by responding to escalated inquiries, ensuring processes run smoothly, and working to continuously improve the end-user experience. Implements recommended modifications and enhancements. Serves as an analytics resource to wider organization or business units, offering guidance on systems and data output.



Qualifications:
Minimum Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's Degree and 4 years' experience

OR

High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 8 years' experience in Systems Support, or Analytics, or Operations Support

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Support execution and ongoing maturation of the SDLC Governance, including standards, procedures, and controls.
  • Perform complex analysis of SDLC processes, compliance data, and governance metrics to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Review SDLC artifacts to assess adherence to governance requirements, including requirements management, testing, approvals, change management.
  • Monitor and report on SDLC compliance, exceptions, issues, risks, and remediation activities.
  • Current contractor/contingent worker for First Citizens Bank

title: Lead Associate Account Director
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What you'll do:

  • Oversee the health of client relationships as a strategic advisor, guiding problem-solving discussions and providing best-in-class client services.
  • Demonstrate the value of The Trade Desk to clients by providing innovative solutions that meet the clients’ needs and our business goals.
  • Lead key agency client meetings in collaboration with business development and trading counterparts.
  • Develop trusting and productive relationships with key stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Lead the development of portfolio-specific goals based on the company’s vision and values and responsible for tracking progress of portfolio revenue goals on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Become heavily involved in product development by identifying how to build product that provides solutions for our clients’ business objectives and serving as a liaison between our clients and our product team.
  • Communicate effectively with others by solving business challenges together, identifying opportunities for growth, and collaborating to drive efficiency and effectiveness across the organization.

Who you are:

  • 7+ years of digital advertising experience
  • Experience in developing, nurturing and managing client relationships.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth with large customer accounts.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, executive team and industry groups.
  • Execute in a fast-paced environment through effective time management and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Highly organized with a strong attention to detail.

title: Senior Solutions Architect (Japan) [556]
description:
About the role

An exciting opportunity for a Senior Solutions Architect! In this role, you will help to build and deliver quantum optimization solutions for customer applications while working with delivery leads, applications developers, and other Senior solutions architects within the professional services department. Additionally, you will work with our internal teams and external customers to review customer business problems, map these problems to D-Wave’s hybrid solvers and advanced quantum systems, formulate solutions, build and test prototypes, and build applications that run-in production for our customers.


What you'll do

  • Build customer applications on the D-Wave quantum computer and internal tools
  • Ensure successful delivery of projects to achieve business value for customers
  • Communicate capabilities with customers and ask probing questions to understand the problem and propose solutions
  • Gather requirements on customer use cases, lead brainstorming sessions, consult with customers on potential solutions, model use cases mathematically, and design and develop quantum hybrid applications
  • Build and maintain relationships with leaders across various groups within D-Wave
  • Share customer and project-related insights with D-Wave's tools and product teams and help prioritize new product features
  • Organize, prepare, and present technical information in a clear and effective manner
  • Participate in the development of an inclusive, helpful, fun environment


About You

  • Someone with a Masters, PhD, or equivalent in Operations Research, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, or related technical field preferred
  • A professional with 3-5 years’ experience with Python. Knowledge of Numpy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Networkx is an extra bonus!
  • Business language proficiency in both English and Japanese.
  • Experienced working directly with external customers (ideally in a consulting role) to identify requirements and consult on solutions to complex business problems
  • Familiar with leading optimization tools (e.g., CPLEX or Gurobi)
  • Practical with a view of what it means to solve customer problems, with a strong sense of urgency and an understanding of project delivery requirements
  • Knowledge of mathematical modeling and optimization solution techniques
  • Experience with a version control software such as Git
  • Experience building applications to solve complex business problems for customers
  • Collaborative mindset and solid interpersonal skills
  • Passionate for writing state-of-the-art code
  • Ability to provide technical leadership from business problem definition, functional requirements specifications, to solution design and implementation
  • Proven record of successful on-time delivery of projects with a high degree of predictability and quality
  • Preferably experienced within industries such as Manufacturing, Logistics, Retail Services


A D-Waver's DNA

  • We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
  • We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
  • We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
  • As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.


Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.


During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) . The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level.


Inclusion:

We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.


The Fine Print:

No 3rd party candidates will be accepted


It is D-Wave Systems Inc. policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, local law.

Reporting to the Manager, Government of Nunavut ServiceDesk, The Deskside Support Supervisor is a senior member of the Government of Nunavut ServiceDesk team located in Iqaluit. The Service Desk forms an integral part of the client support functions for the citizens of Nunavut and GN departmental clients. The two main service delivery functions the Service Desk provides are the handling of all Incidents reported by clients and deskside support requests for office applications including all information communications technology hardware and software installed in client's offices. The GN Service Desk operates by receiving, documenting, assigning, and tracking all Call Centre incidents, requests for information and requests for informatics services on behalf of the Government of Nunavut (GN) and associated third party organizations and agencies. The GN Service Desk processes all Incidents and requests through direct telephone support or via dispatching deskside support technicians to the user office.

The Primary Responsibilities of the Supervisor Includes the following:

  • To provide supervisory duties for the team of Deskside Support agents within headquarters and Qikiqtaaluk region,
  • To provide escalation technical support for GN Service Desk Deskside Support agents.
  • To monitor and optimize the daily GN Service Desk and Deskside support processing of requests and incidents.
  • Provide mentorship and training to other Service Desk personnel to ensure staff members increase service delivery for the Government of Nunavut
  • This position is accountable for the supervision and technical development of Territorial Student Employment Program, Summer Student Equal Employment Program, Co-op and Apprenticeship participants assigned to the team.
  • Mmonitors and reports on receiving, configuration, installation, and standards compliance for all newly purchased informatics equipment and software.
  • Analyzes Deskside support service queues and ticket documentation.
  • Adjusts Deskside support team handling of service requests and incidents to improve service delivery.
  • Executes quality assurance reports and surveys to ensure customer service levels are maintained for the GN Service Desk.

The knowledge, skills, and abilities required for this job are usually obtained through a Diploma in Informatics Technology or related field from a recognized University.

  • Two (2) years relevant experience.
  • One (1) year of supervisory experience leading teams of technical support personnel
  • Proven experience in analysing complex technical issues and proposing solutions

to problems not previously encountered as well as having the ability to work independently or as part of a team environment.

  • ITIL Certification

This is a Position of Trust and a satisfactory Criminal Record Check is required.

The Official Languages of Nunavut are Inuktut, English and French. Applicants may submit their resume in any of the official languages of Nunavut. Fluency in more than one of Nunavut’s official languages would be considered an asset. Knowledge of Inuit communities, culture, land,Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit, Inuktut and experience working in a northern cross-cultural environment are also considered assets.

Acceptable combinations of education and experience may be considered for this position. We encourage you to apply if you have equivalent years of education and/or experience equal to the education and experience requirements listed above.
