Job Summary:

The official title of this role is Opt-In Team Supervisor. The Opt-In Team Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day supervision of Healthcare Representatives engaged in member outreach, enrollment, and benefit facilitation for Serene Health's Enhanced Care Management (ECM) Program. This role serves as a critical operational link between frontline staff and the Opt-In Manager, ensuring that individual and team performance meets or exceeds established productivity targets, quality benchmarks, and compliance standards. The Supervisor is accountable for generating timely and accurate performance reports, conducting compliance audits, monitoring daily workflow, and delivering consistent coaching to drive measurable improvement. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, data-driven, and skilled at motivating a team within a regulated healthcare environment.

Duties/Responsibilities:

Reporting and Data Management

  • Generate and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports covering enrollment rates, outreach activity, call volumes, attempt-to-contact ratios, and conversion metrics for review by the Opt-In Manager.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date member data across all assigned datasets, ensuring data integrity, completeness, and adherence to recordkeeping standards.
  • Track and report individual and team Key Performance Indicators (KPIs); escalate trends, anomalies, or performance gaps to the Opt-In Manager with supporting data.
  • Compile audit-ready documentation and productivity summaries on a scheduled and ad hoc basis as requested by leadership.
  • Prepare and present weekly team scorecards that include call quality scores, enrollment outcomes, error rates, and attendance metrics.
  • Analyze report data to identify patterns, surface root causes of underperformance, and recommend data-driven action plans.

Productivity Oversight and Performance Management

  • Monitor real-time and historical team productivity including daily outreach volumes, enrollment completions, follow-up activity, and schedule adherence.
  • Set and communicate daily/weekly productivity expectations aligned with program goals; hold team members accountable to established benchmarks.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one check-ins and structured performance conversations with each Healthcare Representative, documenting coaching notes and action plans.
  • Identify and address productivity blockers — including workflow inefficiencies, system issues, or skill gaps — in a timely manner.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and training of new Healthcare Representatives; ensure competency in enrollment processes, systems, and communication standards.
  • Manage scheduling, attendance tracking, and workload distribution to maintain optimal team coverage and throughput.
  • Escalate performance concerns, disciplinary needs, or recurring attendance issues to the Opt-In Manager with documented evidence.

Compliance and Regulatory Adherence

  • Ensure all team members adhere to HIPAA regulations, ECM program criteria, and applicable state and federal healthcare guidelines at all times.
  • Monitor and enforce proper documentation practices including accurate member notes, consent records, enrollment forms, and outreach logs.
  • Conduct routine compliance spot-checks and process reviews to verify that member interactions are handled in accordance with established protocols.
  • Communicate regulatory updates, policy changes, and compliance directives from the Opt-In Manager to the team; confirm staff acknowledgment and understanding.
  • Maintain readiness for internal and external compliance reviews by ensuring documentation is current, organized, and retrievable.
  • Report potential compliance violations, breaches, or irregularities to the Opt-In Manager and/or Compliance Officer immediately upon identification.

Audits and Quality Assurance

  • Conduct scheduled and random audits of call recordings, enrollment documentation, member notes, and data entries to assess quality and accuracy.
  • Score and evaluate Healthcare Representative performance using the ECM Opt-In Scorecard; provide structured, documented feedback following each audit.
  • Track QA audit results over time to identify improvement trends, recurring error types, or systemic process gaps.
  • Facilitate calibration sessions with the Opt-In Manager to align on scoring standards and quality expectations.
  • Implement targeted corrective action plans for team members with deficiencies identified through the audit process; follow up to verify improvement.
  • Maintain a complete and organized audit log for all completed reviews; ensure audit findings are submitted to the Opt-In Manager within established timelines.
  • Support preparation for departmental or external program audits by compiling required documentation and audit trails.

Team Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for frontline staff on day-to-day operational questions, escalating member issues or process exceptions to the Opt-In Manager as appropriate.
  • Foster a positive, accountable team culture focused on quality, member outcomes, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with the Opt-In Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to pilot and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency and member experience.
  • Participate in team meetings, leadership huddles, and departmental initiatives as required.
  • Demonstrate and model the organization's values, professional conduct standards, and commitment to ECM program goals.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience:

  • Associate's degree required; Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in healthcare services, member engagement, call center operations, or a related field.
  • At least 1 year of lead, supervisory, or team coordination experience, preferably in a healthcare or enrollment-focused environment.
  • Experience with healthcare systems, ECM or similar care management programs, benefits administration, or care coordination preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to generate reports, track metrics, and use data to drive team performance.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, customer service, and organizational skills.
  • Proficient computer skills and experience with Microsoft Office.
  • Maintain empathy and professionalism while contacting members and families.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 10 pounds at times.
Pay range
$29—$32.50 USD

Benefits

Our full-time employees are eligible for the following benefits enrollment after 60 days of employment:

Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits: We have various insurance options for you and your family.

Short & Long-Term Disability Benefits: Protection when you need it most.

Voluntary Accident, Voluntary Critical Illness, and Voluntary Hospital Indemnity Plans: Added security for you and your loved ones.

title: Accreditation and Regulatory Advisor
description:
Accreditation & Regulatory Advisor (Critical Access Hospitals)

The Accreditation & Regulatory Advisor serves as a subject matter expert in accreditation, regulatory compliance, and survey readiness across IU Health's Critical Access Hospitals. This position is responsible for facilitating accreditation and regulatory compliance activities within assigned facilities while providing readiness support and consultation to additional IU Health facilities as needed.

Working collaboratively with operational leaders, clinical teams, and key stakeholders, the advisor promotes a culture of continuous survey readiness and regulatory compliance. The role provides education, consultation, and expert guidance regarding accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and compliance best practices to support safe, high-quality patient care.

While the role is currently based out of IU Health Frankfort Hospital, flexibility may be considered regarding the home-base location based on the selected candidate's geographic location and organizational needs. Regular interfacility travel is required to support survey readiness, accreditation activities, and regulatory compliance initiatives.

Schedule: Monday-Friday, Day Shift

Key Responsibilities

  • Serves as the primary accreditation and regulatory compliance resource for assigned Critical Access Hospitals and provides interfacility support throughout the IU Health system.
  • Acts as a trusted advisor to leaders and stakeholders by interpreting accreditation standards, state and federal regulations, and organizational compliance requirements.
  • Plans, coordinates, and facilitates survey readiness activities, including mock surveys, tracers, education sessions, and readiness assessments.
  • Leads onsite accreditation and regulatory surveys, coordinating activities before, during, and after survey events to ensure successful execution.
  • Develops, coordinates, and monitors comprehensive corrective action plans in response to survey findings, deficiencies, or identified compliance gaps.
  • Prepares written responses to regulatory agencies and accrediting organizations and ensures timely completion of all required follow-up actions.
  • Proactively evaluates new or revised services, programs, workflows, and physical spaces to assess regulatory and accreditation compliance requirements prior to implementation.
  • Partners with operational and clinical leaders to identify opportunities for improvement and restore compliance when regulatory risks or deficiencies are identified.
  • Analyzes regulatory changes and communicates impacts, recommendations, and action plans to leaders and stakeholders.
  • Provides regular readiness and compliance updates to facility and system leadership, including assessment of compliance risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Serves as the facility liaison for communications with the Indiana Department of Health and applicable accrediting organizations.
  • Promotes a culture of continuous readiness through education, coaching, collaboration, and process improvement activities.
  • Participates in systemwide regulatory and accreditation initiatives, special projects, and performance improvement efforts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree is required.
  • Requires 4-6 years of relevant experience.
  • CPHQ or other comparable healthcare regulatory certification endorsed by IU Health System Regulatory Affairs required within two years of employment.
  • Interfacility travel for surveying and in-state overnight stays is required.
  • Requires current state of Indiana license as a health care professional (e.g., Registered Nurse with an active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Indiana or an active Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC) RN license, Respiratory Therapist, Pharmacy or Rehabilitation license).

title: .Net/React Software Developer

What You’ll be Doing * Design and develop a secure DMZ-to-core API gateway that allows external applications to safely exchange data with the SCADA/ADMS platform. * Apply threat modelling, authentication, data protection, and performance optimization to maintain a regulated isolation boundary. * Build a new configuration application that enables utility engineers to manage live grid databases and SCADA settings. * Help define the architecture, technology stack, development standards, and technical direction for new applications. * Design and build RESTful APIs and full-stack web applications. * Take ownership of client-side and server-side architecture. * Optimize applications for performance, scalability, security, and operation under heavy loads. * Write tests and deliver dependable, mission-critical software where accuracy and correctness are essential. * Comply with Survalent’ s ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information Security Management System (ISMS) Policy. * Comply with Survalent’ s ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System (QMS) Policy. * Other duties as required What You’ll Bring * Degree or diploma in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. * 5 years of full-stack development experience. * Experience with React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and related front-end development tools. * Experience with C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, microservices, identity authentication, and SignalR/WebSockets. * Experience with SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis. * Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming, multithreading, and performance-focused design. * Experience with Git, Docker, and CI-style workflows. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally. * Experience with C++, WPF, Windows Forms, mapping libraries, encrypted data, or real-time systems is an asset. This full-time role reports to the Team Lead of SCADA. The salary range for this role is $120,000- $130,000. title: Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure (Starshield)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, AI INFRASTRUCTURE (STARSHIELD)

At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy the Starshield constellation. Starshield is the world’s largest US government satellite constellation and is tasked with providing immediate access to critical intelligence and national security data for the US government anywhere on the globe. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – receivers that allow users to connect within minutes, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starshield's global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help us further our ambitious goals.

As an engineer focused on Starshield's software and GPU infrastructure, you will design, operate and scale the infrastructure that supports critical national security missions. These positions cover a variety of areas ranging from Site Reliability Engineering, Developer Operations, and GPU platforms. You will develop automation to deploy and manage on-premise compute resources, create highly scalable and maintainable software products, and directly collaborate with engineering across the board.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage GPU/CPU infrastructure deployments to Top Secret datacenters
  • Manage and provide support for GPU as a service for external customers on bare metal hardware and virtualized platforms
  • Design, validate, and productize solutions for AI clusters (100k+ GPU scale)
  • Develop automation to deploy and manage on-premise Kubernetes\AI clusters, and operating systems
  • Deploy and manage core infrastructure such as databases, monitoring and distributed storage
  • Closely collaborate with AI engineers to create highly scalable, operable, and maintainable products
  • Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services -- from inception and design, through deployment, operation and refinement
  • Monitoring and alerting supporting systems to have high availability
  • Identify areas for improvement and create innovative solutions that enable high system availability

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems/IT, or an engineering discipline and 1+ years of professional experience in site reliability engineering or DevOps; OR 3+ years of professional experience in site reliability engineering or DevOps in lieu of a degree
  • 1+ years of professional experience with Linux operating systems
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or other infrastructure tools
  • Experience with containerization technologies (i.e. OCI containers, Kubernetes)
  • Experience scripting in Bash, Python, or other similar languages
  • Development experience in Python, C++, or Go

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 1+ years of experience with Python and Python-based development frameworks
  • Experience managing Kubernetes clusters, not just using them
  • Knowledge of Linux boot process and systems configuration
  • Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & continuous monitoring
  • Understanding of relevant build technologies, such as Bazel and Makefiles
  • Focus on performance bottlenecks and performance improvement techniques
  • Understanding of distributed databases and data modeling
  • Experience with automatically managing thousands of servers (eg: Terraform or Ansible)
  • Strong networking knowledge of TCP/IP
  • Cloud virtualization experience (as the cloud provider)
  • Experience using NVIDIA GPU deployment stacks (Blackwell/Rubin)
  • Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with customers, peers, management etc. in both formal and informal situations
  • Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed
  • Must be willing to travel domestically and globally in the future when needed
  • This position requires successfully obtaining and maintaining a Top Secret Security Clearance as a condition of employment. While the clearance may not be immediately necessary upon hire, we encourage you to initiate the application process promptly upon accepting this offer. Your ability to secure the necessary clearance is essential for fulfilling key responsibilities of the role. Should you be unable to obtain it, SpaceX reserves the right to modify or terminate your employment to align with operational needs.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $125,000.00 - $165,000.00
Level 2: $145,000.00 - $200,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Those with an active clearance will receive a 10% differential, up to an additional $20,000 annually, once officially briefed into a classified program.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Senior Mainframe Systems Programmer
description:

Your role, your impact

As a Senior Mainframe Systems Programmer, you’ll work on low-level systems tooling in an IBM z/OS test environment. The work is Assembler-centric and sits below the application layer (module-level changes, subsystem exits, and the diagnostics around them), working alongside the infrastructure, application and security teams. If you’re comfortable with vendor-supplied modules, module maps and dumps, then this role is for you.

Your day-to-day

  • Write and maintain HLASM code that runs as part of the runtime and subsystem environment;

  • Build and package modules and analyze load modules;

  • Work with access methods (VSAM, QSAM) and Language Environment at the control-block level;

  • Develop and install subsystem exits (CICS, Db2, IMS or MQ);

  • Use JCL and REXX to automate build, install and verification steps;

  • Troubleshoot dumps and abends, and demonstrate that a change is behavior-neutral before it ships.

Keys to your success

  • 8+ years of hands-on z/OS experience, with significant time spent below the application layer;

  • Strong HLASM skills (not substitutable by COBOL or PL/I experience);

  • Binder and linkage-editor fluency;

  • Working knowledge of Language Environment internals, VSAM/QSAM control blocks, and the z/OS authorization model (APF, authorized concatenations);

  • Comfort with JCL and REXX; dump and abend analysis (IPCS, SLIP, GTF or component trace).

Extra edge

  • Db2 language interface internals, CICS global user exits and thread safety, IMS DL/I or MQ internals, SMP/E, experience with z/OS trace or diagnostic tooling, or IBM Z certifications.

title: Senior Staff People Analytics Executive Insights Lead
description:
Intuit is seeking an experienced Senior Staff Business Data Analyst to join our People Data & Analytics team. Our team partners closely with Intuit's HR leaders, COEs, Finance, and business partners to deliver data-driven insights that shape our people strategies and elevate decision-making across the company. We are looking for an experienced Analyst to own our executive insights and enablement portfolio: recurring workforce reporting for senior leadership, and the fast-turnaround analysis senior HR leaders rely on to make organizational, workforce planning, and talent decisions in real time, not after the fact.

In this role, you will be responsible for turning analysis into executive narratives that leaders act on, with the judgement to decide what a number means and to proactively surface insights and meaningful recommendations across the entire employee lifecycle. You will partner directly with Directors, VP+, and the broader community to move recommendations from insight to action, and will own ongoing analytics deliverables, HR enablement, and the continuous feedback loops that keep the team ahead of what leadership needs next.


Working across the broader People Analytics team, you will partner on the data & AI analytics products, and models that inform executive decisions, proactively identifying the patterns and risks worth flagging to leadership, combining hands-on analysis with the advisory judgment to turn findings into executive narratives, and the discretion to handle sensitive workforce information appropriately.


Responsibilities

Key Focus Areas

Executive Storytelling & Reporting Ownership

  • Own recurring workforce reporting and analysis deliverables for senior leadership end to end, reconciling narrative input from multiple senior HR partners into one credible, executive-ready story.

  • Own the organization's core executive workforce reporting suite as a product: definitions, cadence, access, and roadmap.

  • Turn analysis into narrative for HRBP, Director, and VP+ audiences: what the data says, why it matters, and what to do about it.

  • Turn an ambiguous business question into a clear analytical approach, and know when a one-off request is worth building into a standing deliverable.

Executive Analysis & Advisory

  • Serve as the senior analytical partner for leadership-level requests, including time-bound analysis spanning across the entire employee lifecycle.

  • Exercise sound judgment and discretion with sensitive workforce information.

  • Analyze data with depth to identify trends and patterns that improve decision making

  • Support strategic initiatives across People & Places by translating leadership priorities into an analytics agenda, sequencing the work to match when decisions actually get made.

Enablement Across HR

  • Drive analytics enablement across the HR and HRBP community, identifying opportunities for self-service, AI-powered solutions, and workflow automation.

  • Feed demand signals from the field back to the broader People Analytics team to shape the enablement roadmap.

  • Help set the standard for how workforce data should be interpreted and used across HR, so definitions and quality do not vary by who happens to answer the question.

Decision-Making and Influence

  • Act as a trusted advisor to HRBP, Director, and VP+ stakeholders, with the presence to sit in the room and the credibility to stand behind a recommendation under scrutiny.

  • Partner across the broader People Analytics team, HRBPs, and P&P COEs to keep the executive reporting layer consistent with the broader analytics portfolio.

  • Influence through storytelling, actively seeking feedback to build shared understanding of insights and recommendations across HRBPs, Business, and Finance stakeholders.

  • Communicate directly with senior stakeholders on sensitive or fast-moving topics, calibrating message and detail to the audience and the moment.


Qualifications


  • 8+ years of People Analytics, or Human Capital Consulting experience with a track record of advising senior stakeholders on workforce insights.

  • Highly data-driven, consultative, a great communicator and storyteller who can influence executive stakeholders by translating data into insights and solutions for their business problems.

  • Strong understanding of HR data and employee lifecycle processes (talent acquisition, workforce planning, talent development, internal mobility, employee listening etc.).

  • Strong data analytics skills with the ability to leverage multiple internal and external data sources to enable data-driven insights and inform strategic talent decisions.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn complex analysis into a narrative that changes a decision for senior leadership audiences, rather than one that only describes a situation.

  • Proven judgment handling sensitive workforce data.

  • Experience identifying and closing enablement gaps across a large stakeholder community through dashboards, self-service tools, or AI-powered solutions.

  • Comfort triaging competing leadership requests and knowing what to prioritize first.

  • Experience using AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis and reporting.

  • Comfort working across SQL, Python, or R.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of presenting to and influencing senior and executive audiences.

  • Passion for enabling data-driven, equitable people processes that foster growth and inclusion.


Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. title: Capital Project Manager
description:
CAPITAL PROJECT MANAGER

Midwest Region

LOCATION: Kansas City

TRAVEL: 50-75% regional travel

COMPENSATION: Commensurate with experience


Nolan Living is a vertically-integrated real estate investment and management firm, that owns and operates a diverse portfolio of 26 high quality and well-located residential properties, totaling over 6,300 units, across the United States. We are seeking an experienced, highly accountable Capital Project Manager to lead capital improvement and renovation projects across our Midwest portfolio. This is an opportunity for a proactive construction professional who takes ownership from initial planning and budgeting through execution, turnover, and financial closeout, and who wants to make a measurable impact on the performance and long-term value of multifamily communities.


The Opportunity:


You will serve as the owner-side project lead, partnering closely with Property Operations, Asset Management, leadership, consultants, and contractors. The right candidate is more than a task manager: you anticipate risks, develop complete scopes, communicate clearly, protect occupied communities from unnecessary disruption, and consistently look for smarter ways to improve cost, quality, durability, and resident experience.


What You'll Do:


· Manage the full project lifecycle for assigned capital projects, including site assessment, budgeting, scope development, procurement, contracting, scheduling, construction oversight, turnover, and closeout.

· Develop thorough scopes of work, bid packages, and bid comparisons that allow for informed decisions and reduce gaps, change orders, and surprises during construction.

· Build and maintain realistic project budgets and schedules; monitor commitments, invoices, forecasts, contingencies, and variances through completion.

· Lead contractor selection, contract coordination, preconstruction meetings, progress meetings, site walks, punch lists, and final acceptance.

· Anticipate scope, schedule, logistics, safety, permitting, resident-impact, and operational risks; raise concerns early and bring forward practical solutions.

· Coordinate work in occupied multifamily communities with a strong focus on resident communication, access, phasing, cleanliness, safety, and continuity of property operations.

· Provide concise, timely reporting to internal stakeholders on project status, budget, schedule, decisions, risks, and next steps.

· Maintain complete project documentation, including approvals, contracts, change orders, meeting notes, photos, invoices, lien waivers, warranties, permits, and closeout records.

· Evaluate materials, methods, and design decisions through an owner-focused lens, balancing upfront cost with quality, durability, maintainability, and long-term asset performance.

· Use Yardi CM and other reporting or project-management tools accurately and consistently; adapt as processes and systems continue to evolve.


What Success Looks Like:


· Projects are well planned, well documented, and executed predictably from start to finish.

· Budgets and schedules are actively managed, with risks and potential variances identified early.

· Scopes are complete, change orders are minimized, and decisions are supported by clear facts and recommendations.

· Operations, Asset Management, leadership, and vendors stay aligned through professional, proactive communication.

· Project closeout is timely and complete, including final billing, lien waivers, warranties, punch completion, and turnover documentation.

· Each project reflects a value-add mindset and supports the community's operations, resident experience, and long-term performance.

title: Nutrition Consultation Specialist (Dietitian / Nutritionist)
description:
About the Role

Black Girl Vitamins is looking for an engaging, culturally aligned Registered Dietitian (RD) or Certified Nutritionist (CN) to serve as an educational face for our community and provide direct support to our customers. In this dual-role, you will build trust through 1-on-1 micro-consultations, weekly public live-streaming and customer webinars —translating nutritional science around Black health disparities, vitamin deficiencies, and holistic wellness into accessible, relatable guidance.

Key Responsibilities

  • 1-on-1 Virtual Consultations:

    • Provide complimentary 15-minute 1-on-1 virtual consultation sessions to Black Girl Vitamins customers.

    • Maintain daily scheduling availability (approx. 2–3 dedicated hours per day via a provided Google Calendar/Scheduling link) to review customer goals, answer supplement questions, and offer tailored wellness advice.

  • Additional

    • Educational Programming: Host 1 interactive monthly or bi-weekly educational webinar for customers covering key wellness topics (e.g., Vitamin D deficiency, gut health, hormonal balance, reproductive health).

    • Live Social Content: Host 1 weekly TikTok Live session (~30–45 minutes) answering live audience questions, busting wellness myths, and explaining supplement science in an entertaining, digestible format.

    • Content Preparation & Strategy: Outline weekly discussion topics, Q&As, and slide decks or key takeaways for community events in collaboration with the marketing team.

    • Brand Advocacy: Serve as an expert voice to ensure messaging aligns with evidence-based nutritional standards while remaining relatable and culturally nuanced.

Qualifications

  • Credentials: Registered Dietitian (RD / RDN) or Certified Nutritionist (MS/PhD in Clinical Nutrition or relevant state licensure).

  • On-Camera & Counseling Presence: Strong experience hosting live streams/short-form video alongside proven experience conducting 1-on-1 client assessments or counseling.

  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable managing calendar availability and client bookings through Google Calendar / Google Scheduling.

  • Communication Style: Ability to break down complex medical/clinical data into engaging, everyday language tailored to Black women's health needs in both public and 1-on-1 settings.

  • Product Knowledge: Familiarity with dietary supplements, micronutrient bioavailability, and general wellness practices.

Compensation & Pay Structure

With the added scope of daily 1-on-1 consultations (~10–15 hours/week for client sessions + ~3–5 hours/week for group webinars, live streams, and preparation), contract rates reflect a total commitment of 15–20 hours per week.

  • 1-on-1 Consultations (10–15 hrs/week): $45 – $60 per hour.

  • TikTok Live Sessions (30–45 mins + prep): $150 – $250 per session.

  • Customer Webinars (60 mins + slide preparation): $250 – $400 per webinar.

The Executive Director of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) provides enterprise-wide financial leadership for Stanford Medicine Children's Health. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Finance, the Executive Director will have full ownership of the operating budget process, including design, execution, and reporting to senior leadership. This role will oversee and implement annual updates to the long-range financial plan, partnering closely with strategy, service lines, and operational leaders throughout the organization. In addition, the Executive Director will oversee labor productivity reporting and analysis, external benchmarking, and new financial reporting to allow for deeper insights into the enterprise financial performance and operational efficiency. This position will be a key advisor to senior leadership and will be responsible for preparing financial updates that are presented to the Board of Directors.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

  • Operating Budget Leadership: Own the operating budget process from end-to-end, including the design of the budget framework, coordination of department submissions, and preparation of executive-level reports and analysis for senior leadership.
  • Operational and Financial Transformation: Serve as the finance lead for the three-year $230M savings initiative, ensuring rigorous financial tracking and benefit validation.
  • Long-Range Financial Plan: Update and maintain the long-range financial plan, including the integration of the Operational and Financial Transformation program results and strategic growth investments.
  • Financial Analytics and Reporting: Oversee labor productivity reporting and analysis, external benchmarking submissions, and other reporting to drive operational efficiency and margin improvement.
  • Board and Executive Reporting: Prepare financial updates and key performance insights for the Board of Directors, ensuring clear and actionable information for enterprise decision-making.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field/discipline from an accredited college or university. Master’s degree or MBA is strongly preferred.

KNOWLEDGE

title: Project Manager
description:

The Construction Project Manager is to assist the SAM Development & Construction teams with the planning and daily execution of the construction project. The Project Manager is the link between office management, field activities, accounting, and project administration. The position is involved in pre-construction, estimating, material sourcing and procurement. The position will assist in the management of submittal processes, maintaining logs, schedules, budgets, and overall to facilitate a well-managed project, while maintaining project safety initiatives and the coordination of timely required materials delivery. They must be flexible and adaptable team-players, while being easygoing and possessing strong communication, task management and client service skills.

  • Perform outreach to trade partners to promote project opportunities and generate interest in increasing bid package coverage, supplier and subcontractor selection, and buyout process.
  • Perform project management responsibilities, such as: writing and administering Subcontract and Purchase Agreement exhibits; draft cost change requests, prepare cost forecasts, lead meetings & job walks, Q.C. coordination, etc.
  • Participate in all aspects of the procurement process for assigned projects
  • Participate in OAC meetings and prepare and distribute timely and accurate meeting minutes.
  • Assist in bidder selection and scope of work descriptions and qualification for Client RFP’s and new projects.

  • Lead the document control process: Distribute electronic and paper plans, review and approve shop drawings and submittals, specifications, drawings, permits, etc. to appropriate parties and maintain the drawing revision logs.

  • Identify conflicts in construction progress and communicate them to the construction team for resolution.
  • Complies with all SAM safety policies and wear proper safety equipment at all times.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.
  • Office based position but candidate will be required to travel to project sites on occasion.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management or engineering or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • Preferred prior experience in the construction industry is desired; specifically multifamily construction projects.
  • Minimum 5 plus years on New Multifamily Construction (Required).

  • OSHA 30-Hour Construction required or have the ability to obtain.

  • Demonstrated organizational and problem-solving skills and ability to adapt to changing needs.
  • Understanding building permit, approval and inspection processes.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills.
  • Excellent communication and partnering skills to work effectively with subcontractors, consultants, internal staff, and regulatory agencies.
  • Working Knowledge of OSHA regulations and accepted Safe Work practices for the Construction Industry.
  • Understanding of construction equipment, including safe operating practices and signs of maintenance issues is preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • Able to stand and walk project site for extended period of times.
  • Regularly sit, talk and/or hear for extended periods of time.
  • Frequently required to use hands to finger, handle or feel.
  • Occasionally required to but not limited to reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop kneel, crouch, and/or crawl.
  • Must be able to ascend and descend ladders, scaffolds, stairs and work in confined spaces and in proximity to loud equipment.
  • Must be able to lift and carry or otherwise move 50 pounds regularly/occasionally
  • Must be able to respond quickly to sounds.
  • Must be able to see and respond to dangerous situations.
  • Must be able to safely climb ladders.
  • Must be able to wear personal protective gear most of the day.
  • May be required to work in hot and cold environments and on concrete floors.

Employee Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • 401(k) matching
  • Life insurance
  • Paid vacation, sick and holidays

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Pricefx Configuration (Brazil - São Paulo)
description:
Want to build a stronger, more sustainable future and cultivate your career? Join Cargill's global team of 160,000 employees who use new technologies, dynamic insights and over 154 years of experience to connect farmers with markets, customers with ingredients, and people and animals with the food they need to thrive.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Senior Software Engineer - Pricefx Configuration will design, configure, develop and support scalable Pricefx solutions within Cargill's commercial technology ecosystem. In this role, you will translate pricing strategies and complex business requirements into maintainable calculation logic, data structures, workflows, integrations and user experiences that enable Cargill's go-to-market strategy. You will apply deep Pricefx and software engineering knowledge to deliver secure, resilient and high-performing solutions, bring clarity to ambiguous scenarios, and raise engineering standards across the pricing technology community.

Key Accountabilities

  • Configure and enhance Pricefx solutions using Groovy, Pricefx APIs, and reusable calculation logic.
  • Translate pricing requirements into solutions related to price setting, quoting, agreements, rebates, promotions, analytics, and optimization.
  • Design pricing models including margins, markups, discounts, segmentation, price waterfalls, currency conversions, and pricing controls.
  • Configure and manage Pricefx data structures such as Products, Customers, Data Sources, Datamarts, Extension Tables, and Rollups.
  • Develop dashboards, workflows, approval processes, and user-friendly pricing tools.
  • Design scalable and maintainable solution architectures, including data mapping and technical documentation.
  • Integrate Pricefx with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, ERP, CRM, and analytics systems through REST APIs and JSON-based integrations.
  • Optimize system performance and large-volume calculations using SQL, QueryAPI, DatamartContext, efficient queries, and data-processing best practices.
  • Apply security standards, role-based access controls, and secure configuration practices.
  • Develop, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain Pricefx solutions using Pricefx Studio and IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Implement automated testing, CI/CD processes, version control with Git, and deployment best practices.
  • Lead code reviews, provide technical guidance, and ensure high standards for quality, maintainability, performance, and security.
  • Collaborate with product owners, pricing teams, architects, and technology leaders to define solutions and deliver business value.
  • Support agile delivery practices, continuous improvement initiatives, and long-term platform evolution.
  • Resolve complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective actions.

#LI-Hybrid - #LI-RC2

Minimum (Must Have)

  • Strong Groovy development experience (or Java/JVM development with the ability to quickly work in Groovy).
  • Experience developing or configuring Pricefx solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data modeling.
  • Experience designing and troubleshooting REST API and JSON-based integrations.
  • Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, debugging, and production support.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Pricefx certification, training, or implementation experience.

  • Experience in Pricefx modules such as Price Setting, CPQ/Quoting, Rebates, Promotions, Analytics, or Optimization.

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

The Logistics Specialist will serve as a critical member of the Mission Operations team, helping plan, organize, and execute deployed support activities for both personnel and hardware. This person shall provide centralized support across all of the Stratolaunch departments for mission execution. As part of a hardworking team of flight operations experts, maintainers, and ground operators, the Logistics Specialist is focused on providing attentive and efficient support for our Mission Operations team members, from pre-deployment planning to post-mission recovery. In addition, he/she will support logistics and execution of events, both internal and external, associated with each mission. We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe and successful hypersonic missions that meet our customers’ needs.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform logistics and administrative job duties relating to hypersonic missions within the continental U.S. and overseas.
  • Compile accurate documentation for travel related events including passports, visas, airfare, transportation, hotels, rental cars, restaurants etc.
  • Help develop logistics for offsite deployments to include coordination with local GSE suppliers and accommodations.
  • Work with external customs agencies to have equipment ready and on site when needed.
  • Generate appropriate customs and border control documents and paperwork for overseas travel.
  • Oversee rigorous planning for onsite and recovery missions to ensure operational efficiency throughout each flight test.Design deployment timelines with Ground Operations for GSE delivery and staging
  • Work with procurement for liaising and contract negotiating with vendors, and ensure appropriate contract terms are met and followed.
  • Oversee and help manage travel plans, itineraries, and agendas for Stratolaunch deployment teams with up to 50 members.
  • Manage projects independently and/or in teams, from conception to completion and often with conflicting priorities.
  • Handling post-event reports, measuring impact and ROI.
  • Using strong organizational skills, perform and prioritize multiple calendars and events while prioritizing conflicting needs.
  • Work with and task cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the organization including our Executive Leadership team, to drive missions to completion across teams and time zones.
  • Handle matters expeditiously and proactively, following through on requirements to successful completion, often with deadline pressures. Adapt to competing demands.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • A self-starter with ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional business relationships and a provide a superior level of internal and external customer support.
  • Must have a high level of autonomy when working to achieve goals while also being a collaborator with cross functional teams.Will be required to develop budgets for mission events with leadership and demonstrate fiscal responsibility.
  • Proficiency Microsoft Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, internal software packages) and Smartsheet, Outlook, Teams, Zoom
  • Maintain a high degree of professionalism and confidentiality at all times

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree required or similar experience
  • Experience with generating customs paperwork and compiling HTS codes, ECCNs, and biohazard requirements.
  • Experience supporting a team of deployed personnel highly desired.
  • Aerospace and/ or Defense industry experience desired.
  • Understanding of risk management and effective mitigation strategies.
  • The ability to attain up to a TS/SCI clearance desired.

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

  • Mojave, CA based.
  • Extended work schedule with early starts and late work hours, weekends and holidays supporting Stratolaunch personnel all over the world.
  • Ability to lift up to 50lbs.
  • Driver license required.
  • Ability to obtain a US passport.
  • 9/80 schedule:
  • 5-8 years experience: $79,000-$105,800
  • 8+ years experience: $99,000-$135,000

Benefits and our location(s):

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave
  • 50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles. The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

Our purpose at Gallagher is ‘Protect what matters most’ and we live it every day, whether that’s protecting the world’s highest security environments or agricultural businesses, we care deeply about our people, their families, and our wider communities.

Gallagher Security is on a mission to unlock more value for our customers through the power of our people and solutions - and right now is a pivotal moment in our evolution. We’re scaling with intent, driving an incredible growth trajectory with innovation and customer impact at the heart of everything we do. With operations across New Zealand, Australia, Asia, Africa, the USA, Canada, and Europe and exports to over 140 countries we’re building globally focused career pathways right here in New Zealand.

This is an opportunity to work on complex, real-world products where software and hardware come together. You'll take ownership of technical initiatives, contribute to architectural decisions, mentor other engineers, and help deliver innovative solutions that make a difference for customers around the globe.

About the Role

As part of an agile development squad, you'll lead the design, development and maintenance of embedded software features and products from concept through to delivery. You'll collaborate closely with hardware engineers, testers, project teams, and fellow developers to build high-quality, reliable solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing, developing and maintaining embedded software solutions

  • Collaborating with hardware engineers on board bring-up, debugging and integration

  • Analysing system performance and driving technical improvements

  • Taking ownership of assigned projects and leading them through to completion

  • Conducting code reviews and supporting engineering best practices

  • Investigating and resolving complex technical issues and defects

  • Mentoring and sharing knowledge with other developers

  • Contributing to continuous improvement across products, processes and development standards

About You

You'll be a passionate software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and working in a collaborative product development environment. You're comfortable taking ownership, influencing technical direction and supporting the growth of those around you.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent industry experience

  • At least five years' experience in commercial software development

  • Strong experience with Embedded C/C++

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Join Protein Works as our Senior Backend Developer, and build a greenfield, cloud-native platform from the ground up using Go and modern microservices architecture.

About The Role

The Protein Works is a UK direct-to-consumer sports nutrition brand. We develop and manufacture our own products, sell them through our own e-commerce platform and ship them from our own warehouse. Behind the website sits a set of internal applications connecting orders, stock, finance, fulfilment and manufacturing, alongside a growing number of marketplaces and third‑party services.

We are replacing those legacy internal applications with a new cloud‑native platform: independently deployable services that will become the single integration layer between the website, finance, warehouse and manufacturing, and a foundation for AI‑assisted automation across the business. This role is a core builder of that platform.

You will join a small, polyglot engineering team working DevOps, Information Security, Data and IT. Go is our preferred language for services because of its performance and operational simplicity, but we hire for engineering depth first: if your background is C#, Java or PHP and you are willing to work in Go, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

Platform Development & Architecture: Design, build, and maintain microservices and domain models (orders, stock, fulfilment, finance) using Go, Domain‑Driven Design, enterprise integration patterns, and clean architecture to incrementally replace legacy applications.

Integration & Asynchronous Workflows: Build event‑driven and queue‑based workflows with REST APIs, authentication, idempotency, and contract testing to connect e‑commerce, ERP, WMS, finance, and manufacturing systems.

Operations, Security & AI: Own end‑to‑end delivery including containers, CI/CD, IaC, full observability (metrics, traces, logs), security/privacy compliance (OWASP, GDPR, pen testing), and day‑to‑day use of AI‑assisted/agentic tools.

Cross‑Functional Leadership: Collaborate across tech and business teams, write ADRs, contribute to golden‑path templates/standards, and translate business needs into technical execution.

What you will bring

Essential

  • Backend & Architecture: 5+ years of backend development (Go, Java, C#, or PHP with a focus/openness to Go) with strong CS/software engineering foundations, SOLID principles, and clean/event‑driven patterns across microservices and monoliths.
  • Data & Async Systems: Solid background in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and asynchronous messaging (queues, events, retries, idempotency).
  • DevOps & Observability: Practical experience with Docker, Linux/Windows, Git/GitHub, Jira/Agile, monitoring/alerting, and diagnostic/profiling tools in high‑volume e-commerce environments.
  • Communication & AI Integration: Strong problem‑solving and stakeholder communication skills, coupled with active practice using AI development/coding tools.

Desirable

  • AI & Cloud Technologies: Agentic AI (LLMs, frameworks, guardrails) and cloud platforms (AWS, IaC/Terraform, serverless, managed messaging, Kubernetes, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch).
  • Advanced Engineering & Integrations: Production Go experience, GoF/Enterprise integration patterns, durable workflows, contract testing, ERP/WMS/e‑commerce integrations, OpenTelemetry/Grafana/Datadog, and OWASP/ISO 27001 security standards.

How we work

Two‑week sprints for planned platform work and a Kanban lane for operational and integration requests, both in Jira. Pull requests with code review, automated tests and CI/CD to staging and production. Architecture Decision Records for anything that changes the shape of the platform, and golden‑path templates per language so services stay consistent without forcing one runtime. Observability, security and documentation are part of the definition of done.

What we offer

  • State of the art PW Campus
  • Hybrid working
  • A greenfield platform to build, a modern toolchain and direct access to the decisions that shape both
  • Company bonus eligibility
  • Exclusive staff discounts
  • Private healthcare
  • Birthday day off
  • Pension scheme
  • Access to staff discounts
  • Staff socials and events
  • Refreshments on‑site

title: Data and Systems Engineer
description:
WHO ARE SUPERCARS?

The Repco Supercars Championship is the premier motorsport category in Australasia and one of the most watched and attended sports in the country. The sport is evolving and is now globally recognised as the best touring car category in the world and a leader in motorsport entertainment.

Our ambition is to be a part of every Australian household. That is, we aim to grow value by increasing our reach and improving our market relevance, so it is an exciting time to be a member of the Supercars team, as we continue to grow as one of the leaders in Australian sport.

The Motorsport Department at Supercars is the cornerstone of the safe, fair and competitive Championship that enables the entire Supercars organisation to continue as the leading touring car category. We take on the responsibility to our organisation, and the broader sport, that the Supercars championship continues to have technical parity between makes, as well as ensuring the overall sustainability of the sport in all aspects.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Data and System Engineer will assist the Motorsport Technical team, and the greater Motorsport department, to maintain the technical integrity of the Repco Supercars Championship through ongoing monitoring of teams, specific analysis of their data, and continual improvement of component designs for reliability, scrutineering and parity purposes. This role involves work across south-east Queensland, Australia and overseas, in both office & track-based environments.

It is an exciting time to be a member of the Supercars Team as the series continues to develop and grow. The responsibility of the Technical department is increasing year by year as we improve our scrutineering ability and capacity to provide a level playing field for all competitors. Additionally, Supercars’ ownership of the GEN3 platform has added a level of responsibility to ensure reliability, safety and parity for all.

CULTURE

It is an exciting time to be a member of the Supercars team, as we continue to grow as one of the leaders in Australian sport. Our culture supports high performance and is characterised by our values, which foster a team who display:

  • Excellence
  • Respect
  • Teamwork
  • Passion

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Non-event tasks

Team Related

  • Be the main point of contact for all Data Engineering related enquiries.
  • Lead the maintenance and development of all MoTeC system Configs (Dash, Display, PDM), as well as issuing updates to all teams.
  • Respond to team enquiries as required.
  • Travel to teams as required for scrutineering & testing purposes.

Scrutineering Related

  • Producing reports from telemetry or logged data to help enforce rules.
  • Data analysis and reporting for analysis of systems and parity.
  • Pre-event preparation of required templates & software and overview of upcoming event, e.g. MoTeC software.
  • Post-event scrutineering checks as required and applicable to the role.
  • Assist with design, production and maintenance of scrutineering equipment relevant to vehicle data and system, for analysis.
  • Assist with designing new components & systems as required.
  • Assist with maintenance of CAD drawing files & systems as required.

Special Projects

  • Assist with new vehicle homologations both locally & overseas, including aerodynamic and engine testing.
  • Individual R&D project management.
  • Assist other departments with technical deliverables from time to time.

Vehicle Platform

  • Lead the device configuration updates and documentation.
  • Assist with design, integration and validation of new hardware, software and electrical components & systems as required.
  • Assist with development and updates to existing and new Supercars vehicle platforms as required.

Event/track based tasks:

Team Related

  • Evaluate vehicle issues during sessions or post-sessions.
  • Respond to team enquiries.
  • Involved in ensuring parity logger systems are fully operational.
  • Assist with diagnosing issues with control components & wiring.

Scrutineering, data & analysis

  • Downloading team dash, ECU and/or parity logger data post session, or as required.
  • Assist with post session analysis of cars performances and parity monitoring using data across various subsystems.
  • Producing reports from telemetry or logged data to help enforce rules.
  • Ensure timing & data management systems are operational.
  • Manage testing of additional systems & development items on-track.
  • Assist with scrutineering during & post-session as required.

Other

  • Assist with set-up and tear-down of motorsport operational equipment, including scrutineering patch, etc.
  • Assist with set-up, tear-down, and maintenance of Supercars Data Stand.
  • Assist with overall Supercars business needs as required.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

You should possess the following professional skills and experience:

  • Degree level qualification in Mechanical Engineering or similar.
  • 2+ years professional motorsport experience in a similar role, Supercars preferred.
  • Skilled in MoTeC software, specifically i2 Pro, Dash Manager, M1 Tune.
  • Skilled in Office Suite, specifically Excel (including effective data visualisations, and the ability to write advanced formulas, macros, etc.)
  • Basic understanding of programming (e.g. Python, VBA) at a minimum.
  • Competency in usage of LLM’s and AI-assisted development.
  • Basic knowledge of CAD (e.g. Solidworks) and 3D printing techniques.
  • Understanding of vehicle dynamics and analysis techniques are desirable.
  • Understanding of networking, electronics and general computing advantageous.
  • Knowledge of motorsport timing software is desirable.
  • Basic electrical knowledge is desirable.

PERSONAL PROFILE

You are expected to display the following traits:

  • Adaptability & willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work successfully independently and in a team environment.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and under pressure.
  • Desire to provide excellent mechanical knowledge/diagnosis with ability to present and communicate information clearly.
  • Exceptional analytical skills to critically assess trends and complex numerical data in order to convey information and provide robust conclusions.
  • Capacity to communicate findings logically and in a manner which enables clear understanding of concepts.

KEY RELATIONSHIPS

  • General Manager of Motorsport
  • Category Technical Director
  • Motorsport Engineering Manager
  • Senior technical Supercars staff
  • Motorsport Department staff
  • External category staff including team managers, engineers, and mechanics

title: Associate Planner
description:
About UPP

At Urban Planning Partners (UPP), we help create better places as partners with our clients and the communities where we work. Our projects are dynamic, complex, and rooted in real places and real people—spanning housing policy, CEQA review, land-use approvals, municipal planning, and community engagement throughout the Bay Area and Northern California.

We’re a small, savvy team known for designing a way forward when the path isn’t obvious. We innovate within existing policy, set new precedents thoughtfully, and bring clarity to the trickiest planning codes. We care about impact and about how we get there: with curiosity, rigor, collaboration, and a healthy dose of fun. Our culture values flexibility, work-life balance, and showing up for one another.

The Role

This is a mid-level, longer-term role for a planner who’s ready to lead. As an Associate Planner, you’ve already managed smaller projects and supported big, complicated work. At UPP, you’ll grow into fuller project management, mentoring, and proposal leadership—shaping both our projects and the firm alongside us.

You’ll help deliver high-quality planning and CEQA work across Northern and Central California, with increasing responsibility for strategy, client relationships, and deliverables that move projects from vision to implementation.

What You’ll Do

(Responsibilities vary by experience and project needs.)

Project Management & Entitlements

  • Lead small and medium planning/environmental projects as PM or Deputy PM
  • Draft and manage project descriptions, entitlement pathways, and CEQA topic sections
  • Coordinate streamlined reviews and approvals for commercial, mixed-use, and multifamily projects

CEQA Analysis & Environmental Review

  • Prepare CEQA documents (exemptions → EIRs) for infill, TOD, mixed-use, and policy projects
  • Conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis with clear logic and defensible conclusions
  • Coordinate subconsultants and maintain strong QA/QC across deliverables

Housing Policy & Objective Design Standards

  • Support jurisdictions adopting pro-housing policies and objective design standards
  • Review, refine, and propose ordinance updates that are implementable and durable
  • Turn complex policy into clear tools that communities and staff can use

GIS, Graphics & Technical Research

  • Pull GIS data, perform spatial analysis, and create maps/visuals that tell the story
  • Develop graphics for reports and engagement
  • Research codes, ordinances, and official records to build sound planning pathways
  • Use Adobe/SketchUp as needed to translate ideas into accessible visuals

Contract Planning / Municipal Services

  • Support Bay Area jurisdictions as an extension of staff
  • Review applications for completeness, coordinate department feedback
  • Write staff reports and present clearly to Planning Commissions/City Councils

Community Engagement

  • Design and facilitate engagement—from surveys to workshops to focus groups
  • Use inclusive, innovative approaches to reach representative voices
  • Translate community insight into planning outcomes people can see themselves in

Marketing & Firm Development

  • Lead/co-lead proposals and interview prep
  • Support social media/marketing as needed
  • Lead a long-term internal project (website, graphics, BD, etc.)
  • Play an active role in professional organizations and the planning community

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 3–6 years of professional planning experience with progressive responsibility

Education

  • Bachelor’s in planning, community development, environmental science, public administration, or related field
  • Master’s degree may substitute for 1 year of experience

Project Management Background

  • Managed 2–3 small projects (<$100K) and/or
  • Served as assistant/deputy PM on 2–3 medium/large projects ($100K–$1M+)

Skills & Working Style

  • Excellent writing/editing, research, and analytical skills
  • Strong understanding of planning process, land use policy, and/or CEQA foundation
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • Confident navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities
  • Proactive, discerning problem-solver who knows when to ask questions and who to pull in

Professional Engagement

  • Active membership in a professional organization (APA, SPUR, AEP, ULI, etc.) or clear commitment to professional development

Other Requirements

  • Eligible to work in the U.S.
  • Valid California driver’s license and ability to drive for company business

Extra Credit

  • Advanced GIS and graphic design (InDesign, Illustrator, SketchUp, etc.)
  • Strong policy/research orientation; curiosity and love of problem solving
  • Bilingual (spoken/written) relevant to local communities

Who You Are

You’re the kind of planner who doesn’t wait for perfect clarity to move a project forward—you help create it. You bring both independence and a collaborative instinct, and you know how to build momentum across teams, clients, and communities. You care about doing great work and doing it in a way that feels good to the people around you.

Adaptable, Entrepreneurial Problem-Solver

You take initiative in uncertain or evolving planning environments, confidently identifying creative, code-aligned solutions. Ambiguity energizes you—whether it’s a zoning puzzle, a fast-moving entitlement pathway, or a CEQA question with no tidy precedent.

Independent and Collaborative Project Leader

You’ve delivered shared goals within diverse teams. You manage multiple priorities, track deliverables, and help everyone stay on course for deadlines. You know when to run with a task and when to pull in principals, peers, or subconsultants for the strongest result.

Committed to Excellence

You welcome feedback and continuously sharpen both your work and your process. Your deliverables are not only accurate—they’re clear, persuasive, and built to last.

Relational, Trust-Building Communicator

You build authentic relationships across stakeholders—clients, agency staff, community members, and teammates. You listen well, communicate clearly, and approach engagement with respect, inclusivity, and care.

Detail-Oriented and Results-Focused

You take pride in thorough, accurate work and don’t lose sight of outcomes: approvals secured, policies adopted, and communities better served.

Connector and Big-Picture Thinker

You connect community needs, planning policy, feasibility, and environmental constraints into actionable pathways. You synthesize qualitative and quantitative insight into recommendations that move ideas into implementation.

Why UPP

We’re small enough that your work will matter right away—and big enough in impact that you’ll keep learning. We care deeply about the places we shape and the way we show up with clients and communities. Our core values guide how we work together:

We Care. We Collaborate. We Reach. We Are Real.

Our Oakland office is one block from 19th St BART on a quiet, tree-lined street. We’re on-site Mon–Thu in a fun, collegial environment fueled by snacks and coffee (or tea!).

Benefits

  • Paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays
  • Medical, dental, group life, long-term disability
  • Transit reimbursement + monthly wellness stipend
  • 401k with 3% company contribution + profit sharing
  • Charitable donation matching + referral bonus

UPP is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants of diverse backgrounds to apply.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and cover letter describing your interest in UPP and why you’re a great fit.

No phone calls please.

Thanks — we’re excited to read your application!

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

We are seeking a Senior or Staff Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the backend services behind our clinical platform — the systems that move patient imaging data through our AI analysis pipeline and deliver results to clinicians around the world.

We are looking for an engineer who takes end-to-end ownership of their work, from design through production, and who holds a high bar for correctness and security because there is a patient on the other side of every case. You will work with complex medical data in a regulated environment, where design controls and traceability are part of how we build, not a step at the end.

This posting covers two levels. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own the design and delivery of significant features and services within a team. As a Staff Software Engineer, your scope extends beyond a single team — you will lead multi-quarter technical initiatives that span services and teams, and act as a force multiplier for the engineers around you. We will calibrate level based on your experience and the interview process.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, and operate backend services and APIs for the Heartflow clinical platform, owning your work from design review through production monitoring
  • Technical Design: Translate product and clinical requirements into clear technical designs; write and review design documents, and reason explicitly about trade-offs among correctness, performance, security, and long-term maintainability
  • Write high-quality, well-tested code, and hold a high bar in code review — for correctness, readability, and the documentation our regulated environment requires
  • Build and improve the services and data pipelines that move patient imaging data and analysis results through the platform reliably and securely, at scale
  • Implement secure-by-default patterns for authentication, authorization, access control, and data integrity, in line with platform-wide security architecture standards
  • Own reliability and performance for the systems you build: instrument them, set up monitoring and alerting, investigate production issues, and participate in on-call
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and developer tooling that make the whole team faster
  • Produce the design, verification, and traceability documentation required for FDA-regulated medical software, and build to HIPAA requirements for handling patient data
  • Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and design feedback; help onboard new team members and raise the engineering bar around you
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Use AI coding assistants or agents in production work, with clear judgment about where they speed you up, where they don’t, and how you verify what they produce
  • Partner with Product, Clinical, Operations, and Regulatory to scope work, and communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-engineering stakeholders
  • Technical Leadership (Staff): Lead technical initiatives that span multiple services and teams — drive the design, align stakeholders, break the work into deliverable milestones, and carry it through to production
  • Risk and Standards (Staff): Identify technical risk and dependencies early and propose mitigations; help define and evolve engineering best practices, tooling standards, and architecture patterns adopted beyond your immediate team

Qualifications Required

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent experience
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional software engineering experience for the Senior level; 10+ years, including demonstrated technical leadership beyond a single team, for the Staff level
  • Technical Proficiency:
    • Strong backend programming skills in Python or Java, with solid fundamentals in object-oriented programming, data modeling, concurrency, and API design
    • Hands-on experience building and operating services on a cloud platform (AWS), and working knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL data stores
  • Project Experience:
    • Demonstrated experience designing, shipping, and operating production services in a distributed or microservices architecture
    • Track record of owning a meaningful service or component end to end, including its reliability and performance in production
  • Engineering Craft: Disciplined approach to automated testing, code review, and debugging; you can explain why your code is correct, not only that it works
  • Methodologies: Experience with Agile development methodologies and project management tools
  • Security Knowledge: Working knowledge of web and OWASP security best practices
  • Platform: Hands-on experience with AWS services (Lambda, ECS, EKS, Fargate, S3, SQS, VPC), infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform, CDK), CI/CD, and observability
  • Communication: Ability to write and speak clearly about technical work, including to stakeholders outside engineering
  • Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

How you stand out

  • Experience with medical imaging data (DICOM), healthcare interoperability standards (HL7, FHIR), or systems that handle PHI
  • Deep experience with Django and the Django ORM in a production service, including migration strategy and query performance tuning on large datasets
  • Experience working within a controlled development process — FDA-regulated medical software, or another regulated or safety-critical domain
  • For Staff-level candidates: a track record as a tech lead or staff engineer driving technical initiatives across multiple teams

A reasonable estimate of the base salary compensation range is $180,000 to $215,000 (for Senior level) or $190,000 to $250,000 (for Staff level), bonus and equity. #LI-Hybrid

Heartflow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.
